meaning: 英文字母表第十八個字母的大寫形式

sentences: The title Rab appears in several early Jewish writings. 這個尊稱出現在若干早期猶太文獻中。

An old inventory listed a raband among the clothing pieces. 一份舊清單把這種帶狀物列在衣物配件之中。

meaning: 馬達加斯加的拉菲草編織布
sentences: She bought a rabanna bag at the market. 她在市場買了一個拉菲草編袋。
rabanna dried quickly on the porch after the rain. 那塊拉菲草編布在雨後的門廊上很快就乾了。
Our route ended in Rabat after a long drive. 長途車程後，我們的路線在拉巴特結束。
The guide spent three days in Rabat before returning home. 導遊在拉巴特待了三天才回家。
The portrait shows a rabatine around the man's neck. 那幅肖像畫出男子頸間的窄領飾。

She lowered the rabatte to turn the cabinet into a desk. 她把翻板放下，讓櫃子變成一張書桌。
The old chest still had a wooden rabatte in front. 那個老箱櫃前方仍保留著一塊可折下的板面。
The manual describes the rabattement of the folding panel. 那本手冊說明了摺疊板面向下折的動作。
A smooth rabattement kept the mechanism from jamming. 平順的折回動作讓機構不會卡住。

meaning: 拉比傳統的擁護者，猶太口傳律法的支持者
sentences: The rabbanist defended the authority of oral tradition. 那位學者為口傳傳統的權威性辯護。
A rabbanist would reject the group's narrow reading of scripture. 這類傳統的支持者會反對該團體對經文的狹隘解讀。

meaning: 信奉拉比傳統者，拉比派成員
sentences: The rabbanite community followed rabbinic legal teaching. 那個群體遵循拉比法學傳統。
He identified himself as a rabbanite rather than a sectarian reformer. 他表明自己屬於拉比派，而不是宗派改革者。
The carpenter cut a rabbet along the edge of the board. 木匠沿著木板邊緣切出一道槽口。
A tight rabbet helps the frame fit together neatly. 合適的榫槽能讓框架更密合。
The lesson on cabinet making covered rabbeting in detail. 那堂櫥櫃製作課詳細講解了開槽工序。
Careful rabbeting made the wooden joints much stronger. 細緻的開槽讓木製接合處堅固許多。
The rabbi greeted the children after the service. 拉比在禮拜結束後向孩子們問好。
She asked the rabbi to explain the tradition again. 她請拉比再解釋一次那項傳統。

meaning: 拉比，猶太教學者或教師
sentences: The village rabbin was respected for his learning. 村裡的拉比因學識淵博而受到尊敬。
People asked the rabbin to explain a difficult passage. 人們請這位猶太教師解釋一段難懂的文字。
He entered the rabbinate after years of study. 他多年研習後進入拉比職位。
The rabbinate debated the question for several months. 拉比群體為這個問題辯論了好幾個月。
The question caused debate across rabbindom. 這個問題在拉比界引起辯論。
Rabbindom kept many old legal traditions alive. 拉比群體保存了許多古老的法律傳統。
Rabbinic commentaries often discuss the meaning of old laws. 拉比傳統的註釋常討論古老律法的含義。
The library has a shelf of Rabbinic literature. 那座圖書館有一排收藏猶太法學文獻的書架。
The professor donated a rare set of Rabbinica to the archive. 那位教授把一套罕見的拉比文獻捐給檔案館。
Students of Judaism often work closely with Rabbinica. 研究猶太教的學生常需要細讀這類文獻。

meaning: 拉比的，與拉比職責或學問有關的
sentences: He attended a rabbinical school in Jerusalem. 他在耶路撒冷就讀拉比學校。
The rabbinical court issued its opinion yesterday. 那個拉比法庭昨天發布了意見。

meaning: 以拉比方式地，依拉比傳統地
sentences: The passage was interpreted rabbinically rather than literally. 那段文字是依拉比傳統來解讀，而不是照字面理解。
He argued rabbinically, drawing on many layers of commentary. 他以拉比式的方法論證，援引了多層註釋。

meaning: 拉比主義，拉比學說與制度
sentences: The book traces the development of rabbinism after the temple era. 那本書追溯了聖殿時代之後拉比制度的發展。
Scholars disagree on how rabbinism first spread. 學者對拉比學說最初如何傳播看法不一。

meaning: 拉比學者，研究拉比文獻的人
sentences: A noted rabbinist lectured on legal interpretation. 一位知名的拉比學者講授了法典詮釋。
The rabbinist compared several ancient commentaries. 那位研究者比較了數種古老註釋。

meaning: 拉比學的，帶有拉比傳統色彩的
sentences: The argument follows a strongly rabbinistic pattern. 那段論證帶有強烈的拉比學傳統風格。
He used rabbinistic sources to support the claim. 他用拉比學資料來支持那項主張。
The essay has a distinctly rabbinistical tone. 那篇文章帶有明顯的拉比式語氣。
Several rabbinistical debates shaped the tradition. 若干拉比式的辯論塑造了這項傳統。

meaning: 拉比派信徒，遵循拉比傳統的人
sentences: The rabbinite rejected the rival group's doctrine. 那位拉比派信徒拒絕接受敵對群體的教義。
A rabbinite would usually honor the authority of later teachers. 這類傳統的信徒通常尊重後世師長的權威。

meaning: 使受拉比傳統影響，以拉比方式解釋
sentences: Later editors tried to rabbinize the older narrative. 後來的編者試圖用拉比傳統來重新詮釋較早的敘事。
The commentary seemed to rabbinize a simple rule. 那份註釋似乎把一條簡單規則拉比化了。
After years of study, he finally entered the rabbinship. 經過多年研習後，他終於進入拉比職位。
The community expected wisdom and patience from anyone in the rabbinship. 社群期待任何擔任拉比職位的人都具備智慧與耐心。
The old document refers to his rabbiship with great respect. 那份古老文件以十分尊敬的語氣提到他的拉比身份。
She devoted her life to study before accepting the rabbiship. 她在接受拉比職位之前，把一生都投入學習。

meaning: 兔子；一種長耳朵、短尾巴的小型哺乳動物
sentences: The little rabbit was happily nibbling on a fresh carrot. 小兔子正在開心地啃著一根新鮮的紅蘿蔔。
Rabbits are known for their long ears and fast running speed. 兔子以長耳朵和跑得快聞名。

meaning: 兔莓；一種野生莓果植物
sentences: rabbitberry grew beside the old fence all summer. 那種野莓整個夏天都長在舊籬笆旁。
The birds ate the rabbitberry before we could pick any. 我們還沒採到，鳥就先把那些莓果吃掉了。

His rabbithearted reply disappointed the rest of the team. 他那怯懦的回應讓團隊其他人很失望。

Its rabbitlike ears made the toy look unusually cute. 那對像兔子般的耳朵讓玩具看起來格外可愛。
The mask had a rabbitmouth under the painted nose. 那個面具在畫出的鼻子下方做了兔唇狀開口。
The old statue showed a rabbitmouth on one side. 那尊老雕像的一側做出唇裂般的嘴形。
They built a rabbitproof fence around the vegetable beds. 他們在菜圃周圍蓋了一圈防兔圍欄。
The farmer chose rabbitproof mesh to protect the young plants. 農夫選用了防兔網來保護幼苗。
The herbal list mentions rabbitroot among several woodland plants. 那份藥草清單把兔根列在幾種林地植物之中。
Few modern readers recognize the name rabbitroot today. 現代讀者已很少認得這個植物名稱。
His small rabbitry stood behind the family barn. 他的兔舍就建在家中穀倉後面。
The book explains how rabbitry once provided food and fur. 那本書說明養兔業過去如何提供食物與皮毛。
The old trader carried bundles of rabbitskin to the market. 那名老商人帶著一捆捆兔皮到市場販售。
A soft rabbitskin lining kept the gloves warm in winter. 柔軟的兔皮內裡讓手套在冬天更保暖。
Yellow rabbitweed covered the dry hillside in autumn. 秋天時，黃色的兔草鋪滿了乾燥的山坡。
The botanist collected rabbitweed for the field notebook. 植物學家採集了兔草樣本，記入野外筆記。

meaning: 像兔子般地，就兔子的方式而言
sentences: The animal darted rabbitwise into the brush at the first sound. 那隻動物一聽到聲音，就像兔子般迅速竄進灌木叢。

Their rabblelike behavior ruined what should have been a peaceful rally. 他們那種像暴民般的行為毀掉了原本應該和平的集會。

The mayor tried to calm the rabblement before violence began. 市長試圖在暴力爆發前先安撫那群騷動的人。

meaning: 防暴民的，不易受鬧眾衝擊的
sentences: The archive moved its rare books into a rabbleproof room during the unrest. 在動亂期間，檔案館把珍本移到防暴民破壞的房間中。

His rabblesome style made even simple debates feel chaotic. 他那種愛鼓動鬧場的作風讓連簡單辯論都變得混亂。

meaning: 拉波尼；對老師或拉比的尊稱
sentences: The student called his teacher rabboni with deep respect. 學生滿懷敬意地稱老師為拉波尼。
In the story, rabboni shows a close and respectful form of address. 在故事裡，拉波尼表示親近而尊敬的稱呼。

meaning: 多位老師或拉比，尊稱的複數形式
sentences: The letter opens by greeting the rabbonim of the community. 那封信一開頭便向社群中的多位拉比致意。
Scholars debated how the title rabbonim should be translated in context. 學者們討論在不同語境中該如何翻譯這個複數尊稱。

meaning: 拉伯雷式的，豪放滑稽的
sentences: The play has a Rabelaisian humor that delights some readers and shocks others. 那齣戲帶有拉伯雷式的豪放幽默，讓有些讀者喜愛，卻讓另一些人震驚。
His Rabelaisian appetite became a running joke in the novel. 他那種豪放誇張的食量成了小說中的一個反覆笑點。

meaning: 拉伯雷風格，豪放粗獷的詼諧文風
sentences: The essay examines Rabelaisianism in modern satirical fiction. 那篇文章探討現代諷刺小說中的拉伯雷風格。
Not every reader enjoys the excess and laughter of Rabelaisianism. 並不是每位讀者都欣賞這種豪放粗獷的滑稽風格。

meaning: 拉伯雷式作風，誇張粗獷的幽默
sentences: The critic accused the novel of slipping into cheap Rabelaism. 評論家指責那部小說滑向廉價而誇張的拉伯雷式幽默。
A touch of Rabelaism gave the dinner speech unexpected energy. 一點拉伯雷式的誇張趣味，讓晚宴演講突然變得很有活力。

meaning: 拉比季，印度的冬季作物生長期
sentences: Farmers sow wheat during the Rabi season after the monsoon ends. 農民會在雨季結束後的拉比季播種小麥。
This report compares rice yields from the Kharif and Rabi crops. 這份報告比較了卡里夫季與拉比季作物的收成。
The vet checked the dog for rabic symptoms. 獸醫檢查那隻狗是否有狂犬病症狀。
Rabic behavior in wild animals should be reported quickly. 野生動物若有疑似狂犬病行為，應該立刻通報。

meaning: 觀點非常極端、不合理或狂熱；過度熱心。
sentences: He is a rabid socialist who never misses a protest. 他是一個狂熱的社會主義者，從不錯過任何抗議活動。

She rabidly defended the singer against every online comment. 她極端激烈地替那位歌手反駁每一則網路留言。
The fans followed the team rabidly through a terrible season. 即使球季表現糟糕，球迷仍然狂熱地一路支持那支球隊。
The rabidness of the debate made sensible discussion impossible. 那場辯論的狂熱程度讓理性討論變得不可能。
Her rabidness as a supporter frightened even her close friends. 她作為支持者的極端狂熱，連親近的朋友都感到害怕。
The vet explained how rabies spreads from infected animals. 獸醫解釋狂犬病如何從受感染的動物傳播。
Vaccination helps protect pets from rabies. 接種疫苗有助於保護寵物避免狂犬病。
The report describes rabietic symptoms in several infected animals. 報告描述了幾隻受感染動物身上的狂犬病症狀。
A rabietic bite was treated as a medical emergency in the village. 在那個村莊裡，疑似狂犬病動物的咬傷被視為醫療急症。

meaning: 致狂犬病的；引發狂犬病的
sentences: The lab tested the rabific agent in the sample. 實驗室檢測樣本中的致狂犬病因子。
A rabific bite needs urgent medical care. 可能引發狂犬病的咬傷需要緊急醫療處理。

meaning: 似狂犬病的，呈狂躁狀的
sentences: The physician noted a rabiform reaction in the final stage of illness. 醫師記錄到病程末期出現類似狂犬病的反應。
His rabiform agitation alarmed everyone in the ward. 他那種近似狂躁的激動狀態讓病房裡的人都很不安。

meaning: 引起狂犬病的，能產生狂犬病的
sentences: The team isolated a rabigenic strain for further testing. 團隊分離出一株能引發狂犬病的菌株以作進一步檢測。
Researchers debated whether the exposure was truly rabigenic. 研究人員討論那次暴露是否真的具有致狂犬病性。
Rabin gave a short speech after the meeting. 拉賓在會後發表了一段簡短談話。
The article quoted Rabin on the peace process. 那篇文章引用了拉賓對和平進程的看法。
The history lesson mentioned Rabin during a discussion of Middle East politics. 歷史課在討論中東政治時提到了拉賓。
Several students had heard Rabin's name but did not know his role. 幾位學生聽過拉賓這個名字，卻不知道他的身分。
The story introduces a rabinet still learning from older teachers. 故事中出現一位仍在向前輩學習的年輕拉比。
A rabinet often served the community before taking larger duties. 年輕拉比常會在承擔更大責任前先服務社群。

meaning: 狂犬病相關紅斑；皮膚發紅狀態
sentences: The nurse noted rabirubia around the wound. 護理師記錄傷口周圍有相關紅斑。
Rabirubia made the doctor check the bite more carefully. 皮膚發紅讓醫師更仔細檢查咬傷。

meaning: 狂犬病的；受狂犬病感染的
sentences: The shelter isolated the rabitic animal. 收容所隔離了疑似狂犬病感染的動物。

Everyone in class knew he could turn even a simple point into a rabulous argument. 班上每個人都知道，他連簡單的問題都能扯成一場詭辯。
Her rabulous style made the meeting drag on for hours. 她那種愛爭辯又好詭辯的作風，讓會議拖了好幾個小時。

meaning: 普通浣熊；一種夜行性哺乳動物。
sentences: A raccoon rummaged through the fallen leaves beside the fence. 一隻浣熊在籬笆旁的落葉堆裡翻找東西。
We watched the raccoon wash its food in the shallow water. 我們看著那隻浣熊在淺水裡清洗食物。
The children were told not to eat the wild raccoonberry without guidance. 大人告訴孩子們，不要在沒有指導下亂吃野生浣熊莓。
A cluster of raccoonberry grew near the damp edge of the woods. 一簇浣熊莓長在林地潮濕的邊緣。

meaning: 臨時拼湊的辦法，權宜之計
sentences: Their whole travel plan was a raccroc thrown together at the last minute. 他們整個旅行計畫都是最後一刻才臨時拼湊出來的。
The village survived that winter through luck and a series of raccrocs. 那個村莊靠著運氣與一連串權宜之計才撐過那個冬天。
The race started as soon as the rain stopped. 雨一停，比賽就立刻開始了。
Our class won the race by half a second. 我們班以半秒之差贏了那場賽跑。
The young mechanic spent all summer restoring an old raceabout. 那位年輕技師整個夏天都在修復一艘舊競賽小艇。
A shiny raceabout cut across the lake before the crowd cheered. 一艘閃亮的快艇劃過湖面，引來觀眾歡呼。
The breeder recorded each racebrood on the farm. 育種者記錄農場裡每一個品系。
A strong racebrood helped the herd survive the winter. 強健的品系幫助畜群撐過冬天。
The racecourse was quiet before the first gate opened. 賽道在第一場開跑前十分安靜。
Bright flags lined the racecourse from end to end. 鮮豔的旗幟沿著賽道一路排開。

meaning: 賽會觀眾，常去賽馬場的人
sentences: Every racegoer studied the program before placing a bet. 每位到場觀賽的人都先研究賽程表，再決定下注。
The station was crowded with racegoers on Saturday morning. 星期六早上，車站擠滿了前往賽場的觀眾。

meaning: 觀賽活動，前往賽場的消遣
sentences: For him, racegoing was as much a social habit as a sport. 對他來說，去看比賽既是一種社交習慣，也是一種運動娛樂。
The novel captures the noisy excitement of weekend racegoing. 那部小說捕捉了週末觀賽活動的喧鬧與興奮。

meaning: 像競賽的，充滿競爭感的
sentences: The interview process felt oddly racelike, with candidates rushing from room to room. 那場面試流程帶著奇怪的競賽感，應徵者急忙在各房間間穿梭。
Their racelike sprint to finish first amused the teacher. 他們那種像在比賽一樣衝刺著想拿第一的模樣，把老師逗笑了。
The chemist separated the racemate into two optical isomers. 化學家把這個消旋體分離成兩種光學異構物。
A racemate may behave differently from either pure enantiomer. 消旋體的表現可能和任何一種純對映異構物都不同。
Heat during storage can accelerate racemation in some compounds. 儲存時的高溫可能加速某些化合物的消旋化作用。
The paper focuses on racemation under acidic conditions. 那篇論文聚焦在酸性條件下發生的消旋化現象。
Each raceme carried small white flowers along a central stem. 每一個總狀花序都沿著中央花軸長出小白花。
The student learned to distinguish a raceme from a spike in botany class. 那位學生在植物學課上學會了如何分辨總狀花序與穗狀花序。
The racemed cluster hung neatly from the upper branch. 那串呈總狀花序的花從上方枝條整齊垂下。
Botanists described the species as racemed in its flowering stage. 植物學家描述這個物種在開花期呈現總狀花序。
The sample remained racemic after the first reaction step. 在第一個反應步驟之後，樣本仍維持消旋狀態。
Researchers compared the racemic mixture with the purified product. 研究人員把這種消旋混合物和純化後產物作了比較。
The racemiferous stems made the plant easy to recognize in the field. 這種會長出總狀花序的莖，讓植物在野外很容易辨認。
A racemiferous habit is common in several members of the family. 這種形成總狀花序的型態在該科的數個成員中很常見。

meaning: 總狀的，呈總狀花序形的
sentences: The flowers formed a racemiform arrangement near the tip of the stem. 那些花在莖的頂端形成近似總狀花序的排列。
The field note describes the inflorescence as loosely racemiform. 野外筆記把那種花序描述成鬆散的總狀形。
The lecturer used a simple diagram to explain racemism. 講師用一張簡單圖表說明消旋現象。
Unexpected racemism reduced the purity of the final product. 意外發生的消旋現象降低了最終產物的純度。
The team monitored racemization throughout the synthesis process. 團隊在整個合成過程中監測消旋化情況。
Even mild heat can trigger racemization in sensitive molecules. 即使溫和的加熱，也可能在敏感分子中引發消旋化。
Strong acid can racemize the compound under laboratory conditions. 在實驗室條件下，強酸可能使該化合物消旋化。
The chemist tried not to racemize the sample during purification. 那位化學家在純化過程中盡量避免讓樣本發生消旋化。
The reaction produced racemocarbonate in a small amount. 這個反應產生了少量消旋碳酸鹽。
The student labeled the racemocarbonate sample before storage. 學生先標示消旋碳酸鹽樣本，再放入儲藏櫃。

meaning: 消旋碳酸的；與消旋碳酸鹽有關的
sentences: The chemist studied a racemocarbonic compound. 化學家研究一種消旋碳酸相關化合物。
A racemocarbonic change appeared during the reaction. 反應過程中出現與消旋碳酸有關的變化。

meaning: 使外消旋化合物甲基化
sentences: The chemist had to racemomethylate the sample before running the next test. 那位化學家必須先把樣本做外消旋甲基化，才能進行下一輪測試。
A tiny change in temperature can racemomethylate the mixture in an unexpected way. 溫度只要有一點變化，就可能以出人意料的方式讓混合物發生外消旋甲基化。
The lavender grew in a racemose spray along the sunlit wall. 薰衣草沿著曬著太陽的牆面長成總狀花序。
Her notebook sketched the blossoms as a racemose cluster of pale dots. 她在筆記本裡把那些花畫成一簇簇總狀排列的淡色小點。

meaning: 以總狀花序般的方式；成簇地
sentences: The branches spread racemosely, with each bloom opening a little lower than the next. 枝條以總狀的方式展開，每朵花都比下一朵更早一些綻放。
The ornaments hung racemosely from the garland, like beads on a loose string. 裝飾物以總狀串成一列掛在花環上，像鬆鬆的一串珠子。
The plant formed a racemous cluster at the top of the stem. 這株植物在莖頂形成總狀的花簇。
Her notes described the racemous arrangement of the tiny blossoms. 她的筆記描述了那些小花成簇排列的樣子。

meaning: 以總狀花序般的方式；成簇地
sentences: The seedlings rose racemously from the pot, each tiny stem crowding the center. 幼苗從花盆裡呈總狀般冒出來，每根細莖都擠在中央。
He arranged the grapes racemously on the tray so the display would feel airy, not packed. 他把葡萄以總狀般的方式排在盤上，讓擺盤看起來通透而不擁擠。

meaning: 小總狀花序；小型總狀花
sentences: A single racemule was enough to make the herbarium sheet look delicate and crowded at once. 只要一個小總狀花序，就讓標本紙看起來同時細緻又擁擠。
She pointed to the racemules hidden near the top of the stem. 她指著藏在莖頂附近的那些小總狀花序。
The botanist marked the racemulose branch in her notes. 植物學家在筆記裡標出了長著小總狀花序的枝條。
This herb looks racemulose near the top of the stem. 這株草本植物在莖的上端看起來長著小型總狀花序。
The racer adjusted his helmet before the starting signal. 那位賽車手在起跑訊號前調整好頭盔。
Every racer hoped to finish the course without a mistake. 每位參賽者都希望在不犯錯的情況下完成賽程。
Water rushed through the raceway beside the mill, turning the wheel all afternoon. 水流穿過磨坊旁的水道，整個下午都在推著水輪轉動。
The electrician tucked the cables into a raceway so the office would look cleaner. 電工把電線收進線槽裡，辦公室看起來就整潔多了。
The hunter led a rach through the wet field at dawn. 獵人在黎明時帶著一隻嗅獵犬穿過濕地。
Our neighbor keeps a rach for rabbit hunting. 我們鄰居養了一隻專門追兔子的獵犬。
The village elder kept a rache for tracking deer after the first snowfall. 村裡的長者養了一隻獵犬，在初雪後追蹤鹿蹤。
A good rache can follow a scent trail that people would never notice. 一隻優秀的獵犬能沿著人類根本察覺不到的氣味追蹤。
Rachel left early to catch the first train home. 瑞秋很早就離開了，準備趕上第一班回家的火車。
When Rachel smiled, the whole room seemed calmer. 當瑞秋露出微笑時，整個房間都顯得平靜些。
He pointed to the rachial curve on the X-ray and explained it to the intern. 他指著 X 光片上的脊椎曲線，向實習醫師解釋。
The guide used rachial pain as a clue that the injury was deeper than a simple strain. 那位醫師把脊椎疼痛視為線索，判斷這次受傷不只是單純拉傷。
After the long drive, she complained of rachialgia and could barely sit upright. 開車久了之後，她抱怨脊椎痛，連坐直都很勉強。
The doctor asked whether the rachialgia started suddenly or had been building for weeks. 醫師問那種脊椎疼痛是突然開始的，還是已經累積了好幾週。
His rachialgic posture made it hard for him to bend over the sink. 他因脊椎疼痛而維持的姿勢，讓他很難彎腰洗手台前。
The therapist adjusted the chair to make the rachialgic patient more comfortable. 治療師調整椅子，好讓那位脊椎疼痛的病人坐得舒服一些。
The procedure aimed to produce rachianalgesia so the surgery could be done without pain. 這個處置的目的是造成脊髓鎮痛，讓手術能在無痛下進行。
For a few hours, the patient enjoyed complete rachianalgesia below the waist. 那位病人有幾個小時在腰部以下都完全沒有痛感。

meaning: 拉奇亞內克特斯；灰鯨曾用的屬名。
sentences: Rachianectes was once used as a genus name for the gray whale. 拉奇亞內克特斯曾是灰鯨的屬名。
The old label kept the name Rachianectes for historical accuracy. 舊標籤為了保留史料準確性，沿用了拉奇亞內克特斯這個名稱。
The anesthesiologist chose rachianesthesia for the operation below the waist. 麻醉科醫師為了腰部以下的手術選擇了脊麻。
She recovered quickly from the rachianesthesia, though her back felt sore for a while. 她從脊麻中恢復得很快，不過背部還是酸了一陣子。
The neurologist ordered a rachicentesis to collect spinal fluid for testing. 神經科醫師安排了腰椎穿刺，採集脊髓液做檢驗。
They explained the risks of rachicentesis before the patient signed the consent form. 他們在病人簽署同意書前，先說明了腰椎穿刺的風險。
The student lined up the rachides beside each feather sample. 學生把每根羽毛樣本的羽軸一一排好。
Several rachides cracked after the box was crushed. 箱子被壓壞後，有好幾根主軸裂開了。
The chart marked the rachidial structures in blue for easier study. 圖表用藍色標示出脊柱相關結構，方便學習。
A rachidial ache can make even a short walk feel longer than it is. 脊柱部位一痛，連短短的路都會走得像很遠。
The specialist described the rachidian column as unusually stiff. 專家形容那條脊柱特別僵硬。
She felt a sharp rachidian twinge when she lifted the heavy box. 她抬起沉重的箱子時，脊柱突然刺痛了一下。
The sketch showed a rachiform stem in the center. 圖中間畫出一條軸狀的莖。
Under the lens, the structure looked rachiform and stiff. 在放大鏡下，那個構造看起來像細軸一樣筆直。

meaning: 拉奇格洛薩類群；一類海螺。
sentences: Rachiglossa is an older group name for certain predatory sea snails. 拉奇格洛薩是某些食肉海螺的舊分類名稱。
The lecture mentioned Rachiglossa while discussing mollusk history. 那場講課在談軟體動物分類史時提到了拉奇格洛薩。
The shell belonged to a rachiglossate snail. 這枚貝殼屬於具簡化齒舌的螺類。
The biology chart showed a rachiglossate feeding structure. 生物圖表顯示了簡化齒舌的攝食構造。

meaning: 脊柱描記器；背部輪廓描繪儀。
sentences: The clinic used a rachigraph to map the patient's spine. 診所用脊柱描記器來描繪病人的脊柱。
An old rachigraph could record a back outline with surprising detail. 舊式脊柱描記器竟能把背部輪廓記錄得相當細緻。
Each grain cluster had a thin rachilla at its center. 每個穀物小穗中央都有一條細小的小穗軸。
The botanist examined the rachilla before naming the species. 植物學家在命名物種之前先檢視了小穗軸。
The patient had a rachiocentesis before the lab test. 那名病人在化驗前接受了腰椎穿刺。
rachiocentesis helped the team collect spinal fluid safely. 這項穿刺讓醫療團隊順利取到脊髓液。
The surgeon would rachiococainize the area before making the incision. 外科醫師會先以脊髓注射可卡因的方式讓局部麻醉，再進行切開。
It sounds archaic now, but physicians once used cocaine to rachiococainize the spinal canal. 這個說法現在聽來很古老，但醫師過去確實曾用可卡因讓脊髓腔麻醉。
The X-ray showed rachiocyphosis, which explained the patient's hunched posture. X 光顯示脊柱後凸，這也解釋了病人彎背的姿勢。
Physical therapy can help ease the pain, though it may not fully reverse rachiocyphosis. 物理治療能減輕疼痛，但不一定能完全逆轉脊柱後凸。

meaning: 具脊齒的；喉牙呈脊棘狀的。
sentences: The rachiodont jaw looked unusual in the specimen drawer. 那副具脊齒的下顎在標本抽屜裡看起來很特別。
The zoologist pointed to the rachiodont feature in the skull. 動物學家指著頭骨上的脊齒特徵。
After carrying the boxes up three flights of stairs, he complained of rachiodynia. 他把箱子搬上三層樓後，抱怨自己脊椎痛。
The doctor asked whether the rachiodynia started after the fall or long before it. 醫生問這種背脊疼痛是摔倒之後才開始，還是早就有了。

meaning: 脊柱測量器；脊椎測量儀
sentences: The technician used a rachiometer to check the curve of the patient's spine. 技術人員用脊柱測量儀檢查病人的脊椎彎曲程度。
In an old anatomy museum, a brass rachiometer sat beside the surgical tools. 在一間老解剖博物館裡，黃銅製的脊椎測量儀擺在外科器具旁邊。

meaning: 脊髓炎；脊髓與脊柱的發炎
sentences: The rare infection led to rachiomyelitis and severe back pain. 那種罕見感染引發了脊髓炎，還造成劇烈背痛。
She spent weeks in rehabilitation after the rachiomyelitis weakened her legs. 脊髓炎使她雙腿無力後，她花了好幾週做復健。

meaning: 脊椎麻痺；脊髓相關的癱瘓
sentences: The fall caused temporary rachioparalysis, so he could not move for several minutes. 那次跌倒造成暫時性的脊椎麻痺，所以他有好幾分鐘都動不了。
The article described how rachioparalysis can follow a serious spinal injury. 那篇文章說明了嚴重脊椎受傷之後，可能會出現脊椎麻痺。
The surgeon feared that the accident might result in rachioplegia. 外科醫師擔心那場事故可能導致脊椎癱瘓。
Because of the rachioplegia, he needed help with even the simplest movements. 由於脊髓癱瘓，他連最簡單的動作都需要人幫忙。

meaning: 脊椎側彎；脊柱側彎畸形
sentences: The screening found mild rachioscoliosis, but it did not require surgery. 篩檢發現她有輕微脊椎側彎，但還不需要手術。
He stood straighter after months of exercise aimed at easing his rachioscoliosis. 經過幾個月針對脊柱側彎的運動後，他站姿明顯挺直了些。

meaning: 脊椎切開器；脊柱手術刀具
sentences: The archive displayed a rachiotome beside other antique surgical instruments. 檔案館把一把脊椎切開器和其他古董外科器具一起展示。
A rachiotome was once used in operations that modern medicine now handles very differently. 過去脊椎切開器曾用於手術，如今現代醫學的做法已經很不同了。
The textbook mentioned rachiotomy as a historical procedure, not a common modern one. 那本教科書把脊椎切開術列為歷史上的手術，不是現代常見做法。
Before the operation, the doctor explained exactly what rachiotomy would involve. 手術前，醫生清楚解釋了脊椎切開術會包含哪些步驟。

meaning: 脊背聯體嬰；背部相連的雙胎
sentences: The medical report described the twins as a rare rachipagus case. 那份醫療報告把這對雙胞胎描述為罕見的脊背聯體嬰個案。
News of the rachipagus birth drew specialists from several hospitals. 這起脊背聯體嬰的出生消息吸引了好幾家醫院的專家前來。
The rachis of the feather bent in the wind. 那根羽毛的羽軸在風中彎了。
A broken rachis made the leaf droop to one side. 中軸斷掉後，那片葉子垂向一邊。

meaning: 脊柱裂；脊椎裂開的先天異常
sentences: The ultrasound raised concerns about rachischisis early in the pregnancy. 超音波檢查在懷孕初期就讓醫師擔心可能有脊柱裂。
Rachischisis is a serious condition that requires careful medical counseling. 脊柱裂是一種嚴重的狀況，需要細心的醫療諮詢。
The child's legs showed a rachitic shape because of a vitamin D deficiency. 那孩子因為缺乏維生素 D，雙腿出現了佝僂病的變形。
The old photograph showed a rachitic posture that reflected years of poor nutrition. 那張老照片裡的姿勢帶著佝僂病特徵，反映了多年營養不良。
The clinic treated several children with rachitis during the winter months. 冬天期間，那間診所治療了好幾位罹患佝僂病的孩子。
Doctors later confirmed that the bone pain came from rachitis, not an injury. 醫生後來確認，那些骨頭痛是佝僂病引起的，不是受傷。

meaning: 佝僂病；骨骼軟化與發育不良
sentences: Poor sunlight and diet can contribute to rachitism in children. 日照不足和飲食不良都可能讓孩子罹患佝僂病。
The researcher traced the village's rachitism to years of limited nutrition. 研究人員把那個村莊的佝僂病追溯到多年來的營養匱乏。

meaning: 致佝僂病的；引起佝僂病的
sentences: The team studied rachitogenic diets that lacked enough calcium and vitamin D. 團隊研究了那些會導致佝僂病的飲食，因為鈣和維生素 D 都不夠。
An old medical handbook warned that certain malnutrition patterns were rachitogenic. 一本舊醫學手冊警告說，某些營養不良型態具有致佝僂病的風險。

meaning: 脊椎切骨器；脊柱切開器
sentences: The surgeon's tray included a rachitome among the old steel instruments. 外科醫師的器械盤裡，有一把脊椎切骨器和其他舊式鋼製器械。
Museum labels explained that the rachitome belonged to a much earlier era of surgery. 博物館標示說明，那把脊椎切骨器屬於更早期的外科年代。

meaning: 脊椎切開的；與脊椎切開有關的
sentences: The surgeon reviewed a rachitomous procedure from old records. 外科醫師查閱舊紀錄中的脊椎切開術式。
A rachitomous scar was visible along the spine. 脊椎旁可看見與切開手術有關的疤痕。

meaning: 脊椎切除術；脊椎切開術
sentences: The history book mentioned rachitomy as part of early spinal surgery. 那本歷史書提到脊椎切除術，說它是早期脊椎外科的一部分。
He winced when he read the old description of rachitomy and the risks it carried. 他讀到古老的脊椎切除術說明以及其中的風險時，不禁皺了眉。
The guidebook listed Rachycentridae among the fish families found in warm seas. 那本指南把鯧鰺科列為溫暖海域常見的魚類科別之一。
Biologists compared the swimming patterns of species in Rachycentridae with other pelagic fish. 生物學家把鯧鰺科物種的游泳模式和其他遠洋魚類做比較。
Rachycentron includes the cobia, a strong and fast-swimming fish. 拉奇森特龍屬包括鰤鰺，一種游得又快又有力的魚。
The museum card explained how Rachycentron differs from related genera. 博物館卡片說明了拉奇森特龍屬和近緣屬的差異。
The government is taking steps to combat racial discrimination. 政府正採取措施打擊種族歧視。
The city is a fascinating blend of various ethnic and racial groups. 這座城市是各種民族與種族群體的迷人融合。
The company has strict rules against racial discrimination. 這家公司有嚴格規定禁止種族歧視。
Students discussed how racial discrimination affects job opportunities. 學生討論種族歧視如何影響工作機會。

Laws against racial segregation changed many public schools. 反種族隔離的法律改變了許多公立學校。

meaning: 種族主義；種族偏見思想
sentences: The professor argued that racialism distorts both history and public policy. 教授認為，種族主義會扭曲歷史，也會扭曲公共政策。
They rejected racialism openly and chose to build a more inclusive school culture. 他們公開反對種族主義，並選擇建立更包容的校園文化。
The speaker was exposed as a racialist by his own posts. 那名講者因自己的貼文而被揭穿是種族主義者。
No one wanted the racialist at the community dinner. 社區晚餐時沒有人歡迎那個種族主義者。
The essay examined how society assigns raciality to people based on appearance. 那篇文章探討社會如何根據外表，把種族屬性套用到人身上。
Her work questioned the idea that raciality can be read as something fixed and simple. 她的作品質疑了一種觀念，也就是把種族特性看成固定而簡單的東西。

meaning: 種族化；把某人或某事物歸為某種族的過程
sentences: The debate focused on the racialization of immigrant communities in the media. 這場辯論聚焦於媒體如何把移民社群種族化。
Racialization can happen quickly when stereotypes shape the first impression. 當刻板印象主導第一印象時，種族化就可能來得非常快。

meaning: 使種族化；把...歸入某種族
sentences: The article warned that the government should not racialize a public health issue. 那篇文章警告說，政府不該把公共衛生問題種族化。
People sometimes racialize accents, even when the speaker's background is completely different. 人們有時會因為口音就把別人種族化，哪怕說話者的背景根本不同。
The crime was classified as a racially aggravated attack. 這起犯罪被歸類為種族仇恨攻擊。
If someone acts racially, they do so in a way that relates to race. 如果某人以種族的方式行事，他們的行為與種族有關。

meaning: 奔放地；略帶挑逗地；辛辣地
sentences: The novel was racily written, with dialogue that felt lively and a little cheeky. 那部小說寫得很奔放，對白活潑又帶點俏皮。
He racily described the party, leaving out the parts that would have embarrassed his mother. 他用略帶挑逗的方式描述那場派對，還刻意省略了會讓媽媽尷尬的部分。

meaning: 活潑俏皮；辛辣；帶挑逗意味
sentences: The raciness of the joke made the whole table laugh. 那個笑話的俏皮辛辣感讓整桌人都笑了。
Some readers enjoy the raciness of his writing, while others find it too bold. 有些讀者喜歡他文字裡那種帶點挑逗的活潑感，另一些人則覺得太大膽。
The crowd kept racing toward the exit when the alarm sounded. 警報響起時，人群一路疾奔向出口。
His mind was racing after he heard the unexpected news. 聽到那個意外消息後，他腦中飛快轉個不停。
The red racing car sped around the track. 那輛紅色賽車在賽道上疾駛。
My brother built a small racing car model. 我哥哥做了一個小賽車模型。
The children ran in a racinglike burst down the long hallway. 孩子們像在賽跑一樣，一陣風似地衝過長廊。
His heartbeat had a racinglike rhythm after he heard the unexpected news. 聽到那個意外消息後，他的心跳快得像在衝刺一樣。
We must all work together to fight against racism and promote social justice. 我們必須共同努力打擊種族歧視，促進社會正義。
The report highlights the problem of systemic racism in the education system. 報告強調了教育系統中存在的系統性種族歧視問題。

meaning: 種族歧視的；種族主義者
sentences: The school punished the student for a racist comment. 學校因那名學生的種族歧視言論而處分他。
A racist policy can hurt an entire community. 種族歧視政策可能傷害整個社群。
He hung his wet coat on the rack by the door to dry. 他把濕大衣掛在門邊的架子上晾乾。
The company is being racked by a series of financial scandals and lawsuits. 該公司正遭受（被折磨）一連串金融醜聞和訴訟的困擾。

meaning: 骨瘦如柴的人；瘦骨嶙峋的人
sentences: The old sailor looked like a rackabones after months at sea. 那位老水手在海上待了幾個月後，看起來瘦骨嶙峋。
The novel's hero starts out as a rackabones, but food and rest change him. 那部小說的主角一開始瘦得像根骨架，後來靠吃飯和休息才慢慢恢復。

meaning: 壁爐上的吊鍋鐵桿；鍋鉤架
sentences: The cook hung the pot from the rackan above the fire. 廚子把鍋掛在火爐上方的吊鍋鐵桿上。
A rusty rackan still hung in the old cottage kitchen. 那間老農舍廚房裡還掛著一根生鏽的鍋鉤架。
She placed the clean cups on the upper rackboard to dry. 她把洗乾淨的杯子放到上層架板上晾乾。
The old cabinet was missing one rackboard near the back. 那個舊櫃子後方少了一塊架板。
The racker stacked the trays before lunch. 那名上架工在午餐前把托盤都排好了。
A fast racker cleared the cooling rack in minutes. 動作快的上架工幾分鐘內就清空了冷卻架。

meaning: 以營利為目的的非法計劃；欺詐或詐騙；或兩者同時實例化。
sentences: The police uncovered a racket involving illegal gambling and prostitution. 警方破獲一個涉及非法賭博和賣淫的詐騙集團。
They had quite a racket devised to relieve customers of their money. 他們為了搶奪顧客的錢而設計了相當大的騙局。

meaning: 敲詐者，從非法勾當牟利的人
sentences: The police finally arrested the racketeer who controlled the neighborhood bars. 警方終於逮捕了那名控制社區酒吧的敲詐者。
He pretended to be a businessman, but everyone knew he was a racketeer. 他假裝自己是商人，但大家都知道他是靠非法勾當牟利的人。

meaning: 敲詐勒索，非法營利活動
sentences: The investigation uncovered years of racketeering inside the union. 調查揭發了工會內部多年來的非法營利活動。
Federal agents built the case around patterns of racketeering and bribery. 聯邦探員以敲詐勒索與賄賂的模式建立案件。

meaning: 敲詐者，非法勾當參與者
sentences: The article traced the rise of a small-time racketer into a crime boss. 那篇報導追溯了一名小規模敲詐者如何變成黑幫頭目。
A racketer often hid behind a legitimate-looking business. 這類從事非法勾當的人，常躲在看似正當的生意背後。
The prosecutor focused on the group's racketing across several cities. 檢察官把重點放在該團體橫跨多座城市的敲詐活動上。
We heard the racketing of carts in the alley before dawn. 天亮前，我們先聽見巷子裡車輛喧鬧奔行的聲音。
The insect has a curious racketlike wing shape. 那種昆蟲有一種奇特的球拍狀翅形。
A racketlike clatter came from the loose window in the wind. 鬆動的窗戶在風中發出一種像喧鬧敲擊般的聲音。

meaning: 防喧鬧干擾的；不怕騷亂的
sentences: The studio walls were designed to be nearly racketproof. 那間錄音室的牆面被設計得幾乎不受喧鬧干擾。
They wanted a racketproof office where calls could be heard clearly. 他們想要一間不受噪音干擾、能清楚通話的辦公室。
City leaders promised to clean up the racketry around the port. 市府領導人承諾整頓港口周邊的非法勾當。
The neighbors were tired of the late-night racketry from the street below. 鄰居們受夠了樓下街道深夜的吵鬧折騰。

meaning: 拉凱特管，一種古代雙簧管樂器
sentences: The early music group performed with a rackett and a lute. 那個早期音樂團使用拉凱特管和魯特琴演出。
A rackett produces a surprisingly rich tone for its size. 這種古樂器雖然體積不大，卻能發出相當厚實的音色。

meaning: 拍尾鳥；尾羽末端呈拍形的鳥
sentences: The birder waited all morning to photograph a rackettail in flight. 那位賞鳥者等了一整個早晨，只為拍到拍尾鳥飛行的畫面。
The rackettail is easy to notice because of its unusual tail feathers. 這種鳥因為尾羽形狀特別，很容易被注意到。
The children made the room rackety with drums and laughter. 孩子們敲鼓又大笑，讓整個房間變得鬧哄哄的。
We found a cheap but cheerful rackety cafe near the station. 我們在車站附近找到一家便宜卻熱鬧嘈雜的小咖啡館。

meaning: 一架之量，一整架的份量
sentences: The bakery cooled a rackful of bread before opening. 那家麵包店在開門前先放涼整整一架的麵包。
She washed a rackful of glasses after the banquet. 宴會後，她洗了一整架的杯子。
The family spent a racking night waiting for news from the hospital. 那家人在等待醫院消息的那一夜備受煎熬。
A racking cough kept him awake until dawn. 一陣折磨人的咳嗽讓他一直醒到天亮。
Time passed rackingly slowly as they waited for the verdict. 在等待判決時，時間過得痛苦得異常緩慢。
She smiled, but the effort was rackingly hard for her. 她雖然露出微笑，但那樣的努力對她來說十分煎熬。

meaning: 使鬆散；使凌亂；發出吵雜聲
sentences: The wind began to rackle the loose boards on the shed. 風開始把棚屋上鬆動的木板吹得吵吵作響。
He did not mean to rackle the neat pile of tools on the bench. 他本來無意把工作台上整齊的一堆工具弄亂。
The kitchen looked oddly bare with its rackless wall. 那面沒有架子的廚房牆看起來特別空。
After the confession, he finally felt rackless and calm. 招認之後，他終於覺得自己不再受折磨，平靜了下來。
The warehouse rackmaster checked every storage row before closing. 倉庫的貨架主管在下班前檢查了每一排儲位。
A careful rackmaster can prevent many costly inventory mistakes. 細心的架具管理者能避免許多代價高昂的庫存錯誤。

meaning: 不易變形的；不易受拉扯損壞的
sentences: The frame was built from rackproof metal to hold heavy loads. 那個框架以不易變形的金屬製成，用來承受重物。
They needed a rackproof design for long-distance transport. 他們需要一種在長途運輸中不易受拉扯損壞的設計。

meaning: 可收高租的，可課重租的
sentences: Land close to the harbor was considered highly rackrentable. 靠近港口的土地被認為非常適合收取高租。
The owner viewed every renovated room as rackrentable property. 屋主把每間整修過的房間都視為可高價出租的資產。
The mountain train moved slowly along the steep rackway. 那列山地火車沿著陡峭的齒軌道緩慢前進。
Engineers inspected the rackway after the storm. 暴風雨過後，工程師檢查了那段帶齒軌道。
The old clock still runs on a delicate rackwork system. 那座老鐘至今仍靠著精巧的齒條機構運作。
He studied the rackwork before attempting any repair. 他在動手修理前先研究了那套齒軌機構。
The restorer used a fine racloir to remove the old varnish. 修復師使用一把精細的刮削器去除舊清漆。
A racloir lets the craftsperson shave the surface with control. 刮刀能讓工匠更精準地削平表面。
The ship picked up a racon signal near the rocky coast. 船隻在多岩海岸附近接收到一個雷達信標訊號。
A racon helps vessels identify hazards in poor visibility. 在能見度差的情況下，雷達信標能幫助船隻辨識危險。
At dinner, he became the perfect raconteur and kept everyone laughing. 晚餐時，他成了最會說故事的人，讓大家笑個不停。
A good raconteur knows when to pause and when to surprise the audience. 優秀的說書者知道什麼時候該停頓，什麼時候該讓聽眾驚喜。
An old field guide spells raccoon as racoon in one passage. 一本舊的野外圖鑑在某段文字裡採用了較少見的舊拼法。
The children watched a racoon search for food near the stream. 孩子們看著一隻浣熊在溪邊找食物。

meaning: 拉科夫的；與拉科夫教義有關的
sentences: The scholar compared several Racovian texts from the same period. 那位學者比較了同一時期的幾篇拉科夫派文本。
A Racovian argument appears in the appendix of the book. 書的附錄裡出現了一段與拉科夫教義相關的論證。

meaning: 生動有趣的；略帶挑逗意味的
sentences: Her speech was lively and racy enough to wake the whole room up. 她的演講生動又有勁，足以讓整個房間的人都清醒起來。
The magazine was criticized for printing racy gossip on the front page. 那本雜誌因在頭版刊登帶點挑逗意味的八卦而受到批評。

meaning: 拉德，輻射吸收劑量單位
sentences: Older laboratory records listed exposure in rad instead of newer units. 較早的實驗室紀錄會用拉德而不是較新的單位來記錄暴露量。
The technician converted the rad reading before writing the report. 技術員在寫報告前先換算了拉德的讀值。
The bill passed in the rada after a long debate. 那項法案在長時間辯論後於議會通過。
Local reporters waited outside the rada all morning. 當地記者整個早上都守在議會外面。

meaning: 雷達；利用無線電波偵測物體位置的系統
sentences: The ship's radar detected another vessel approaching in the thick fog. 船隻的雷達在濃霧中探測到另一艘船正在靠近。
Air traffic controllers use radar to monitor the location of all aircraft. 飛航管制員使用雷達來監控所有飛機的位置。
The radarman tracked every vessel entering the harbor at night. 那名雷達操作員追蹤了夜間進入港口的每一艘船。
A skilled radarman can notice a suspicious change on the screen at once. 熟練的雷達操作員能立刻察覺螢幕上的可疑變化。

meaning: 雷達顯示器；雷達觀測器
sentences: The pilot glanced at the radarscope to check for nearby traffic. 飛行員看了一眼雷達顯示器，確認附近是否有其他飛行器。
In the control room, a bright dot on the radarscope made everyone pay attention. 在管制室裡，雷達顯示器上一個亮點讓所有人都立刻警覺起來。

meaning: 給羊隻等做記號的紅色塗料；標記粉
sentences: The farmer mixed fresh raddle before the sheep were moved to a new field. 農夫在把羊群移到新牧場前，先調好新的標記粉。
A streak of raddle on the ewe's back showed that she had already been counted. 母羊背上一道標記粉痕，表示牠已經被清點過了。

meaning: 使用標記粉的人；塗記號的工人
sentences: The raddleman walked through the pen and marked each sheep with care. 那位塗記號的工人走進圍欄，小心地在每隻羊身上做記號。
Everyone waited for the raddleman before the flock was sent out to pasture. 在羊群被趕去牧場之前，大家都在等那位標記工人到場。

meaning: 與標記粉或塗記號工作相關的殘留物；餘料
sentences: After the job was finished, the raddlings were scraped from the bucket and thrown away. 工作完成後，桶裡剩下的餘料被刮出來丟掉了。
The old shed smelled faintly of wool, oil, and raddlings. 那間舊棚子裡隱約有羊毛、油脂和殘留標記粉的味道。

meaning: 牙根切除術；根部切除手術
sentences: The dentist explained that a radectomy could save the tooth. 牙醫解釋，牙根切除術也許能保住那顆牙。
He felt nervous before the radectomy, but the procedure went smoothly. 他在接受牙根切除術前很緊張，不過手術進行得很順利。
Radek arrived early and set his backpack beside the door. 拉德克很早就到了，還把背包放在門邊。
Everyone listened when Radek explained the problem clearly. 當拉德克清楚說明問題時，大家都安靜聽著。

meaning: 可被輻射的性質；可輻照性
sentences: The scientist tested the material's radiability before using it in the experiment. 科學家在實驗前先測試了這種材料的可輻照性。
Its radiability made it useful in settings where controlled exposure mattered. 它的可輻照性讓它適合用在需要精準控制曝光的場合。
This coating is radiable, so the lab handles it with extra caution. 這層塗層可受輻照，因此實驗室會格外小心處理。
The engineer chose a radiable surface for the test to measure how it reacted. 工程師選了一個可輻照的表面做測試，好觀察它的反應。

meaning: 徑向的；由中心向外放射的
sentences: The map uses radial lines from the city center. 地圖使用從市中心向外放射的線條。
A bicycle wheel has a clear radial pattern. 腳踏車輪有明顯的放射狀圖案。

meaning: 橈骨側腕骨；前腕骨之一
sentences: In some animals, the radiale forms part of the wrist structure. 在某些動物體內，橈骨側腕骨構成腕部結構的一部分。
The anatomy text showed the radiale beside the other small wrist bones. 解剖學課本把橈骨側腕骨畫在其他小腕骨旁邊。

meaning: 橈側腕骨群；橈骨側的小骨群。
sentences: The diagram labeled the radialia as a small cluster of wrist bones. 圖示把橈側腕骨群標成一組小而細的腕骨。
She pointed to the radialia before turning the page. 她指著橈側腕骨群，然後翻到下一頁。

meaning: 放射狀；呈輻射狀的性質
sentences: The radiality of the fountain made it the centerpiece of the plaza. 噴泉的放射狀設計讓它成了廣場的中心。
An artist can use radiality to guide the viewer's eye toward the middle. 藝術家可以利用放射狀構圖，帶著觀眾的視線集中到中心。

meaning: 放射狀排列；使成放射狀
sentences: The radialization of the spokes gave the wheel a delicate look. 輻條的放射狀排列讓輪子看起來很精緻。
Designers discussed the radialization of the menu so users could reach each option quickly. 設計師討論把選單改成放射狀排列，好讓使用者更快點到每個選項。
The architect decided to radialize the garden paths around the fountain. 建築師決定把花園小徑設計成以噴泉為中心的放射狀。
You can radialize the chart if you want the categories to stand out more clearly. 如果你想讓分類更清楚，就可以把圖表改成放射狀。

meaning: 放射狀地；沿半徑方向地
sentences: The petals spread radially from the center of the flower. 花瓣從花心向外放射狀展開。
The cracks moved radially across the glass after it hit the floor. 玻璃掉到地上後，裂痕沿著半徑方向散開。
The calculator asked for the angle in radian, not degrees. 計算機要輸入弧度，不是角度。
She converted the value to one radian before finishing the problem. 她在完成題目之前，先把數值換成了一弧度。
A warm radiance filled the room after sunset. 日落後，溫暖的光輝充滿了房間。
Her radiance made the photograph feel alive. 她的明亮神采讓那張照片顯得充滿生命力。
The radiancy of the sunrise lit up the whole valley. 日出的光輝照亮了整個山谷。
Her radiancy at the wedding came from more than just the dress. 她在婚禮上的神采，不只是因為那件禮服。
The bride looked absolutely radiant in her beautiful white wedding dress. 新娘穿著美麗的白色婚紗，看起來真是容光煥發。
The sun's radiant energy provides heat and light to everything on Earth. 太陽的輻射能（發光的能量）為地球上的萬物提供熱和光。
She smiled radiantly when she heard the good news. 她聽到好消息時，笑得容光煥發。
The lake reflected the moon so radiantly that the whole shore seemed bright. 湖面把月光映得格外明亮，連整個湖岸都像亮了起來。

meaning: 輻射對稱動物類群；放射狀生物群。
sentences: Older textbooks placed jellyfish in Radiata. 舊教材曾把水母歸入輻射對稱動物類群。
The teacher noted that Radiata is now a historical term. 老師指出，輻射對稱動物類群如今已是歷史用語。
The heat began to radiate from the fireplace and warmed the entire room. 熱氣開始從筆爐中散發出來，溫暖了整個房間。
She radiates confidence and enthusiasm whenever she gives a presentation. 每當她做簡報時，都流露（散發）出自信與熱情。
The radiated pattern on the tile made the room feel more elegant. 磁磚上放射狀的圖樣讓房間看起來更典雅。
Warmth radiated from the cup, so I held it with both hands. 溫度從杯子裡散出來，所以我用雙手捧著它。
The branches grew radiately from the trunk. 樹枝從樹幹向外放射狀生長。
The lines on the shell spread radiately, giving it a striking look. 貝殼上的線條向外放射，讓它看起來很醒目。
The radiateness of the design made the logo easy to recognize. 這個設計的放射感讓標誌很容易辨認。
He admired the radiateness of the painting under the gallery lights. 他很欣賞那幅畫在展廳燈光下呈現出的光輝感。

meaning: 輻射學；與輻射有關的研究
sentences: The professor spoke about radiatics as part of the broader physics course. 教授在更廣泛的物理課程中提到了輻射學。
Her interest in radiatics started when she first studied how energy travels. 她對輻射學的興趣，始於第一次學到能量如何傳遞。

meaning: 呈放射狀的；輻射狀形態的
sentences: The radiatiform leaves opened like a small star. 那些呈放射狀的葉子展開時像一顆小星星。
A radiatiform crack can spread quickly across a thin surface. 呈放射狀的裂痕會很快沿著薄表面擴散。
Sunlight is a natural form of radiation that provides light and heat. 陽光是提供光和熱的一種自然輻射形式。
The researchers studied the potential health effects of long-term exposure to radiation. 研究人員研究了長期暴露在輻射中對健康的潛在影響。
The team discussed the radiational effects of the equipment. 團隊討論了這台設備的輻射效應。
Radiational exposure was kept low throughout the test. 在整個測試過程中，輻射暴露都被控制得很低。
The radiative heat from the fire warmed the entire tent. 火堆散出的輻射熱把整個帳篷都烘暖了。
Researchers measured the radiative transfer of energy in the chamber. 研究人員測量了箱體內能量的輻射傳遞情形。
The petals looked radiatopatent in the pressed sample. 那份壓製標本裡的花瓣呈現放射狀張開。
Under the lamp, the shell appeared radiatopatent and flat. 在燈下，那個殼看起來放射展開而且平坦。
The fossil surface looked radiatoporose under the lens. 在鏡下，那塊化石表面看起來有放射狀孔隙。
This shell is radiatoporose near the center. 這個殼靠近中心的地方帶有放射狀小孔。

meaning: 具放射狀孔洞的；輻射多孔的
sentences: The radiatoporous stone was full of tiny channels that spread outward. 這塊具放射狀孔洞的石頭充滿了向外延伸的小通道。
A radiatoporous surface can trap light in interesting ways. 多孔且呈放射狀的表面會以很有趣的方式捕捉光線。
The radiator clicked softly as the water began to warm. 水開始變熱時，暖氣片發出輕微的喀嗒聲。
She set her wet gloves near the radiator to dry. 她把濕手套放在散熱器旁邊晾乾。
The radiatory panel spread heat across the room. 那塊輻射板把熱量散布到整個房間。
The doctor pointed to the radiatory pattern on the image and explained it simply. 醫師指著影像上的輻射狀圖樣，簡單地做了說明。

meaning: 具放射條紋的；放射狀條紋的
sentences: The radiatostriate shell had fine lines spreading from the center. 那個具放射條紋的貝殼有細細的線條從中心向外延伸。
She noticed a radiatostriate pattern on the leaf after the rain. 雨後，她注意到葉子上出現了放射狀的條紋圖案。
The shell has a radiatosulcate surface that catches the light clearly. 那個貝殼表面帶有放射狀溝紋，受光時十分明顯。
The guide describes the fossil as radiatosulcate near the outer rim. 圖鑑把那件化石外緣的特徵描述為具放射狀溝紋。
The artist studied the radiature of the starburst pattern before drawing it. 那位畫家在下筆前先研究了星芒圖案的放射排列。
Botanists noted the radiature of the veins in the broad leaf. 植物學家記錄了寬葉上葉脈的輻射狀構造。

memoryHint: radical 源自表示「根」的拉丁文 radix，因此可聯想到「從根本改變」。注意拼作 radical，不是 redical。作名詞時也可指激進分子、數學的根號或化學的自由基。
sentences: The company made radical changes to its business model to avoid bankruptcy. 公司對商業模式進行了根本性的改革，以避免破產。
Her proposal seemed radical at first, but it eventually transformed the entire industry. 她的提案起初看似激進，最後卻改變了整個產業。
The lecture examined how economic crisis can feed political radicalism. 那場演講探討了經濟危機如何助長政治激進主義。
Some students admired his idealism but worried about his radicalism. 有些學生欣賞他的理想性，但也擔心他的激進傾向。
The radicality of the proposal shocked even its supporters. 那項提案的激進程度，連支持者都感到震驚。
Researchers discussed the radicality of the reform in historical context. 研究人員從歷史脈絡討論那場改革的根本性。
The report links online isolation to rapid radicalization in small groups. 報告指出，網路隔離可能使小群體快速激進化。
Teachers discussed how to prevent radicalization among vulnerable youth. 教師們討論了如何預防脆弱青年走向激進化。
Repeated injustice can radicalize people who once trusted the system. 反覆的不公可能使原本信任體制的人變得激進。
The group tried to radicalize new members through angry speeches. 那個團體試圖用憤怒的演說讓新成員激進化。

meaning: 以激進的方式；從根本上來說；非常。
sentences: The two political groups held radically different views on education reform. 這兩個政治團體對教育改革持有截然不同的觀點。
The new design radically changed the way users interact with the app. 新設計從根本上改變了使用者與應用程式互動的方式。
The radicalness of her solution left no room for compromise. 她那個方案的徹底程度，幾乎沒有妥協空間。
Critics attacked the radicalness of the party platform. 批評者猛烈抨擊該政黨綱領的激進性。
In the expression square root of 49, the radicand is 49. 在四十九的平方根這個式子裡，被開方數是四十九。
The teacher wrote a negative radicand on the board to start a discussion. 老師在黑板上寫下一個負的被開方數，作為討論的開端。
The gardener chose a radicant cutting that would root quickly. 園丁挑了一段容易生根的插枝，好讓它盡快扎根。
A radicant stem can anchor itself when it touches moist soil. 能生根的莖在碰到濕土時可以自行固定。
The vine can radicate wherever a joint touches the ground. 這種藤蔓只要節部接觸地面，就能生根。
The farmer hoped the transplanted shoots would radicate before the dry season. 農夫希望移植的嫩枝能在旱季前順利扎根。
The radicated cuttings were moved into larger pots after two weeks. 那些已經生根的插枝在兩週後被移到較大的盆裡。
A well-radicated plant survives transplanting with less stress. 一株扎根穩固的植物在移植時比較不容易受損。
Keep the radicating shoots in shade until the roots strengthen. 把正在生根的嫩枝放在陰處，直到根部長強壯。
The nursery separated the radicating stems from mature plants. 苗圃把正在生根的枝條和成熟植株分開管理。
Warm soil speeds the radication of many garden cuttings. 溫暖的土壤能加快許多園藝插枝的生根作用。
The experiment measured radication under different moisture levels. 那項實驗測量了不同濕度下的生根情況。
A fine radicel emerged from the seedling after the first rain. 初雨之後，幼苗長出了一條細小的小根。
The microscope image shows each radicel branching from the main root. 顯微鏡影像顯示，每一條小根都從主根分出。

meaning: 根；詞根；基數（radix 的複數）
sentences: Students compared the Latin radices of several English words. 學生比較了幾個英文單字的拉丁詞根。
The professor explained how different radices affect number systems. 教授說明了不同基數如何影響數字系統。
The soil sample contained a tiny radicicola living near the root hairs. 那份土壤樣本中含有一種棲於根毛附近的小型根棲生物。
Researchers identified the radicicola by its close association with plant roots. 研究人員依據其與植物根部的密切關聯辨識出這種根棲生物。

meaning: 生於根上的；棲於根部的
sentences: The fungus is radicicolous and rarely appears above the soil. 這種真菌棲生於根部，很少在土表上方出現。
A radicicolous habit helps the organism stay close to nutrients. 棲於根部的生長習性有助於該生物靠近養分來源。
The radiciferous stem was buried lightly to encourage stronger growth. 那條會長根的莖被輕輕埋入土中，以促進更強的生長。
Botanists described the node as distinctly radiciferous. 植物學家把那個節點描述為明顯具有生根能力。

meaning: 根生花的；花從根部長出的
sentences: The species is unusual because it is radiciflorous rather than stem-flowering. 這個物種很特別，因為它的花從根部長出，而不是從莖上開花。
A radiciflorous plant can surprise hikers who expect blossoms higher up. 根生花的植物常讓以為花會長在上方的登山客感到意外。
The specimen has a radiciform swelling near its base. 那個標本的基部附近有一塊根狀膨大部分。
Its radiciform structure helps it cling to rough surfaces. 它那種根狀構造有助於附著在粗糙表面上。
The farmer blamed a radicivorous insect for the damaged carrots. 農夫把紅蘿蔔受損歸咎於一種食根昆蟲。
Radicivorous larvae can ruin an entire bed of young plants. 食根的幼蟲可能毀掉整片幼苗。
The radicle is the first part of the seedling to emerge. 胚根是幼苗最先長出的部分。
If the radicle dries out, the seed may fail to develop. 如果胚根乾掉，種子可能就無法繼續發育。

meaning: 生於根上的；依附根部的
sentences: The moss is radicolous and prefers damp roots near streams. 這種苔蘚附生於根部，偏好溪邊潮濕的樹根。
A radicolous species may be overlooked unless the roots are examined closely. 若不仔細檢查根部，這類附根生的物種很容易被忽略。
The radicose base helped the plant grip the loose soil. 多根的基部有助於植物抓住鬆散的土壤。
The botanist marked the lower stem as thick and radicose. 植物學家把下部莖記為粗厚且具有多根特徵。
The paper places the fossil species in Radicula rather than a larger genus. 該論文把這種化石物種歸入拉迪庫拉屬，而不是更大的屬。
Museum labels often italicize Radicula as a scientific genus name. 博物館標籤通常會把這個學名用斜體標示。
The scan showed inflammation around the radicular nerve root. 掃描顯示神經根周圍有發炎現象。
A radicular pain often travels down the leg or arm. 神經根性的疼痛常會沿著腿部或手臂往下放射。
The gardener checked whether the radicule had broken through the seed coat. 園丁查看那條小根是否已穿出種皮。
A healthy radicule is a good sign in seed germination tests. 在種子發芽測試中，健康的小根是個好跡象。
The surgeon recommended radiculectomy only after other treatments failed. 外科醫師是在其他治療失敗後才建議進行神經根切除術。
Recovery from a radiculectomy can take several weeks. 神經根切除術後的恢復可能需要好幾週。
The patient was diagnosed with cervical radiculitis after the exam. 檢查後，病人被診斷為頸部神經根炎。
Radiculitis can cause sharp pain, numbness, and weakness. 神經根炎可能引起刺痛、麻木和無力。
The lower stem becomes radiculose in very damp conditions. 在非常潮濕的條件下，下部莖會長出許多小根。
Its radiculose texture made the specimen easy to identify. 它那種多小根的外觀，使標本容易辨認。
After the abscess spread, the dentist scheduled a radiectomy for Friday. 膿包擴散後，牙醫把牙根切除術排在星期五。
Her cheek stayed swollen for days after the radiectomy. 她做完牙根切除術後，臉頰腫了好幾天。

meaning: 逐漸發光的；微微明亮的
sentences: At dusk, the clouds looked radiescent for a few seconds before the sun disappeared. 黃昏時，雲層有那麼幾秒看起來微微發亮，然後太陽就不見了。
Her radiescent face in the photo made the whole scene feel almost dreamlike. 照片裡她那帶著光澤的臉龐，讓整個畫面幾乎像夢境一樣。

meaning: 發光的；帶有放射光芒的
sentences: The old lamp had a radiferous glow that softened the corners of the room. 那盞舊燈散出柔和的光芒，把房間角落都照得溫柔些。
Minerals in the cave gave the walls a radiferous shimmer after the torchlight hit them. 火把光一照到洞穴裡的礦物，牆面就泛起放射般的微光。
The teacher compared the radii of the two circles. 老師比較了兩個圓的半徑。
Equal radii made the design easy to measure. 相同的半徑讓這個圖案很容易測量。
My grandfather likes to listen to the radio news every morning. 我祖父喜歡每天早上聽廣播新聞。
Please turn down the volume of the radio; it's too loud. 請調低收音機音量，太響了。

meaning: 無線電聲學；研究聲音如何經由無線電傳送與重播的學科
sentences: In the lecture, she linked radioacoustics to the early history of broadcasting. 在那場演講中，她把無線電聲學和早期廣播史連在一起講。
Radioacoustics once helped engineers improve how voices sounded over weak signals. 無線電聲學曾幫助工程師改善微弱訊號下的人聲表現。

meaning: 放射錒；舊稱的放射性釷同位素。
sentences: Radioactinium is an old name for a radioactive thorium isotope. 放射錒是某種放射性釷同位素的舊稱。
The history chapter mentioned radioactinium in an early research timeline. 歷史章節在早期研究年表中提到了放射錒。

meaning: 使具放射性；以輻射活化
sentences: The sample was radioactivated before it went into the detector. 樣本在送進偵測器前先經過輻射活化。
Researchers radioactivate certain materials so they can follow tiny changes in a process. 研究人員會讓某些材料被輻射活化，好追蹤過程中的細微變化。
The safe disposal of radioactive waste is a major environmental challenge. 放射性廢棄物的安全處理是一項重大的環境挑戰。
The scientists used special equipment to detect radioactive substances in the soil. 科學家們利用特殊設備檢測土壤中的放射性物質。

meaning: 以放射性方式；放射性地
sentences: The waste must be stored radioactively safe, not just hidden away. 這些廢棄物必須以符合放射安全的方式保存，不能只是隨便藏起來。
The sample behaved radioactively, so the lab added extra shielding. 那個樣本表現出放射性，因此實驗室加了額外屏蔽。
The warning label reminded everyone to check the radioactivity before opening the box. 警示標籤提醒所有人在打開箱子前先確認放射性。
Even a tiny amount of radioactivity can matter in a medical lab. 即使只有微量放射性，在醫學實驗室裡也可能很重要。

meaning: 無線電放大器；射頻放大器
sentences: The radioamplifier boosted the signal enough for the old receiver to catch it. 那台無線電放大器把訊號放大到足以讓老接收機收到。
He replaced the faulty radioamplifier after the music started to crackle. 音樂開始出現雜訊後，他就把故障的無線電放大器換掉了。

meaning: 放射性過敏反應；輻射引發的過敏樣反應。
sentences: The doctor considered radioanaphylaxis after the symptoms appeared suddenly. 症狀突然出現後，醫師便考慮是否為放射性過敏反應。
Because radioanaphylaxis is rare, the team recorded every detail carefully. 由於放射性過敏反應十分罕見，團隊把每個細節都仔細記錄下來。
The lab pinned the radioautograph beside the sample list. 實驗室把那張放射自顯影圖釘在樣本清單旁。
A clear radioautograph showed where the tracer had spread. 清楚的自顯影圖顯示了示蹤物擴散的位置。

meaning: 放射自顯影的；自顯影攝影的
sentences: The radioautographic image made the hidden pathway visible. 放射自顯影影像讓原本看不見的路徑變得清楚可見。
They used radioautographic analysis to map the movement of the compound. 他們用放射自顯影分析來描繪那種化合物的移動路徑。

meaning: 放射自顯影術；自顯影法
sentences: Radioautography helped the researchers track the drug inside the cells. 放射自顯影術幫助研究人員追蹤藥物在細胞內的去向。
The class spent an afternoon learning how radioautography works with film and tracers. 那一班花了一整個下午學習放射自顯影術如何搭配底片和示蹤劑運作。

meaning: 橈骨與肱二頭肌的；與橈骨和肱二頭肌有關的
sentences: The radiobicipital reflex is one of the small details a neurologist may check. 橈骨肱二頭肌反射是神經科醫師可能會檢查的一個細節。
Pain in the radiobicipital region can make simple lifting feel awkward. 橈骨與肱二頭肌區域疼痛時，連簡單的抬手都會覺得卡卡的。

meaning: 用無線電廣播；以電台播送
sentences: The station will radiobroadcast the final game live tonight. 那家電台今晚會現場無線電轉播決賽。
Back then, a speech could radiobroadcast across the country in a single evening. 在那個年代，一場演說就能在一個晚上透過無線電傳遍全國。

meaning: 無線電廣播者；電台播報員
sentences: She became a radiobroadcaster after years of reading the news on campus radio. 她在校園電台念了好幾年新聞後，成了一名無線電廣播員。
The radiobroadcaster paused, listened to the studio cue, and smiled before going on air. 那位廣播員停了一下，聽完棚內提示後，才微笑著再次上線。
Radiobroadcasting changed how families heard music, sports, and speeches at home. 無線電廣播改變了家庭在家收聽音樂、球賽和演說的方式。
The museum exhibit traced the early days of radiobroadcasting with old microphones and scripts. 博物館展覽用老麥克風和腳本，追溯了無線電廣播的早期歷史。

meaning: 無線電觀測者；電波監測員
sentences: As the station's radiobserver, he spent hours noting every strange burst on the screen. 作為電台的無線電觀測員，他花了好幾個小時記錄螢幕上每一次奇怪的脈衝。
A careful radiobserver can spot interference long before listeners complain. 細心的無線電觀測員常常在聽眾抱怨前，就能先發現干擾。
The archaeologist used radiocarbon to estimate the age of the bone. 考古學家用碳十四來估算那塊骨頭的年代。
Radiocarbon dating works best when the sample has been preserved well. 樣本保存得越好，碳十四定年通常就越準。

meaning: 橈腕的；與橈骨和腕骨有關的
sentences: The radiocarpal joint moves smoothly when the wrist is healthy. 當手腕健康時，橈腕關節會活動得很順暢。
She wore a brace to protect the radiocarpal area after the fall. 她摔倒後戴上護腕，保護橈腕部位。

meaning: 用無線電播送；無線電轉播
sentences: The concert was radiocast to listeners who could not get a ticket. 那場演唱會透過無線電播出，讓買不到票的聽眾也能收聽。
A local station once radiocast the mayor's address from the town hall. 從前有家地方電台曾從市政廳無線電轉播市長演說。

meaning: 無線電播音員；電台播送者
sentences: The radiocaster introduced each song with a warm, easy voice. 那位電台播音員用溫暖自然的聲音介紹每一首歌。
Kids in the studio treated the radiocaster like a celebrity. 棚內的小孩都把那位播音員當成明星看待。

meaning: 放射化學的；與放射化學有關的
sentences: The lab ordered a radiochemical test to identify the tracer. 實驗室安排了放射化學檢測來辨認那個示蹤劑。
Her thesis focused on radiochemical reactions in seawater samples. 她的論文聚焦在海水樣本中的放射化學反應。

meaning: 放射化學；研究放射性物質化學性質的學科
sentences: Radiochemistry combines chemistry with the study of radioactive elements. 放射化學把化學和放射性元素的研究結合在一起。
He chose radiochemistry because he wanted work that felt both precise and consequential. 他選擇放射化學，是因為那份工作既精密又有影響力。
The team used a radiocinematograph to record the swallowing test. 團隊用 X 光動態攝影裝置記錄吞嚥測試。
A radiocinematograph captured the joint in motion. 那台裝置拍下了關節活動時的影像。

meaning: 受電波影響而導電的物質或裝置
sentences: The old set relied on a radioconductor for signal pickup. 那台老設備靠一個受電波作用的導電元件收訊。
The engineer replaced the radioconductor in the demo unit. 工程師更換了展示機裡的那個檢波導電元件。
The museum displayed a radiode from the early clinic. 博物館展示了一台早期診所使用的放射治療器。
A radiode once stood in the corner of the treatment room. 治療室角落以前放著一台舊式照射器。

meaning: 輻射性皮膚炎；放射線引起的皮膚炎
sentences: The patient developed radiodermatitis after repeated exposure to the beam. 那位病人因為反覆接觸射線而出現輻射性皮膚炎。
Creams can soothe radiodermatitis, but avoiding further exposure matters even more. 乳膏能緩解輻射性皮膚炎，不過避免進一步暴露更重要。
The hobbyist fixed the radiodetector in his old receiver. 那位玩家修好了舊接收機裡的檢波器。
A portable radiodetector beeped near the sealed box. 一台手持偵測器在密封箱旁發出嗶聲。
Modern radiodiagnosis allows doctors to detect hidden injuries quickly. 現代放射診斷能讓醫師迅速發現隱藏的傷害。
The hospital expanded its radiodiagnosis unit with newer imaging equipment. 那家醫院以更新的影像設備擴充了放射診斷部門。

meaning: 橈骨與手指的；與前臂和指部相關的
sentences: The surgeon studied the radiodigital alignment before operating on the hand. 外科醫師在手術前先研究橈骨與手指之間的排列情況。
A radiodigital injury can affect both grip and wrist motion. 涉及前臂與手指的損傷可能同時影響握力和手腕活動。
The clinic uses radiodontia to assess hidden tooth decay. 那家診所利用放射線牙科學來檢查隱藏的蛀牙。
Students in radiodontia learn how to interpret dental images safely. 放射線牙科學的學生會學習如何安全解讀牙科影像。
The radiodontic exam revealed a problem below the gum line. 放射線牙科檢查顯示牙齦下方有問題。
She completed a radiodontic course before joining the dental center. 她在加入牙科中心前完成了放射線牙科相關課程。
The radiodontist reviewed the images before planning treatment. 那位放射線牙科醫師在規劃治療前先看過影像。
A skilled radiodontist can spot tiny changes around the tooth root. 熟練的放射線牙科醫師能看出牙根周圍極細微的變化。

meaning: 輻射動力的；受輻射作用影響的
sentences: The team studied radiodynamic effects in sensitive materials. 團隊研究了敏感材料中的輻射動力效應。
A radiodynamic model helped explain the energy transfer in the sample. 一個輻射動力模型有助於解釋樣本中的能量傳遞。
The graduate seminar focused on radiodynamics in high-energy systems. 研究所研討課聚焦於高能系統中的輻射動力學。
Radiodynamics connects radiation behavior with motion and energy exchange. 輻射動力學把輻射行為與運動及能量交換連結起來。
Uranium is a well-known radioelement used in nuclear research. 鈾是一種著名的放射性元素，常用於核能研究。
The scientist handled the radioelement with strict safety precautions. 那位科學家以嚴格的安全措施處理這種放射性元素。

meaning: 放射成因的；由放射作用產生的
sentences: The lab measured radiogenic heat inside the rock sample. 實驗室測量了岩石樣本中的放射成因熱。
Radiogenic isotopes help geologists estimate the age of minerals. 放射成因同位素能幫助地質學家估算礦物年齡。
The ship used a radiogoniometer to locate the distress signal. 那艘船利用無線電測向儀定位求救訊號。
Before satellite systems became common, the radiogoniometer was a vital tool. 在衛星系統普及前，無線電測向儀是很重要的工具。
The report compares several radiogoniometric methods for coastal navigation. 報告比較了幾種沿岸航行使用的無線電測向方法。
Engineers improved the radiogoniometric accuracy of the station. 工程師提升了該站的無線電測向精度。
Pilots once relied heavily on radiogoniometry during bad weather. 過去飛行員在惡劣天氣下很依賴無線電測向術。
The manual explains the principles of radiogoniometry with simple diagrams. 手冊用簡單圖解說明無線電測向術的原理。
A short radiogram was sent to the outpost before nightfall. 天黑前，一封簡短的無線電報被發往前哨站。
The doctor pinned the radiogram to the light box for review. 醫師把 X 光片夾到看片燈上查看。
The radiograph showed a fine crack in the wrist bone. 那張 X 光片顯示手腕骨上有一道細小裂痕。
Engineers also use a radiograph to inspect hidden flaws in metal. 工程師也會利用放射成像來檢查金屬中的隱藏缺陷。
The radiographer asked the patient to hold still for a second image. 那位放射技師請病人在拍第二張影像時保持不動。
A careful radiographer can reduce repeat scans and save time. 細心的放射技師能減少重拍次數並節省時間。
The surgeon requested a radiographic view of the injured knee. 外科醫師要求拍攝受傷膝蓋的放射影像。
Radiographic evidence confirmed the position of the implant. 放射攝影證據確認了植入物的位置。
The textbook includes a radiographical atlas of common fractures. 那本教科書收錄了一本常見骨折的放射影像圖譜。
A radiographical survey revealed damage beneath the painted surface. 一次放射影像調查顯示彩繪表面下方有受損情況。
The defect was radiographically visible long before it could be seen directly. 那個缺陷早在肉眼可見之前，就能以放射影像方式辨認出來。
The joint was radiographically normal despite the patient's pain. 儘管病人疼痛，那個關節在放射影像上仍顯示正常。
Radiography remains one of the most common imaging methods in clinics. 放射攝影術仍是診所中最常見的影像方法之一。
Students practiced radiography on models before working with patients. 學生先在模型上練習放射攝影術，再接觸真正病人。
The scan focused on the radiohumeral joint after the fall. 跌倒之後，掃描重點放在橈骨與肱骨形成的關節。
Pain around the radiohumeral region can limit elbow movement. 橈肱區域的疼痛可能限制手肘活動。
The hospital uses a radioisotope to trace organ function. 那家醫院利用放射性同位素追蹤器官功能。
Scientists handled the radioisotope in a shielded laboratory room. 科學家在有屏蔽防護的實驗室房間裡處理這種放射性同位素。
Radiolaria are admired for their intricate microscopic skeletons. 放射蟲類因其精巧的顯微骨骼而受到欣賞。
Marine scientists collected Radiolaria from deep-water samples. 海洋科學家從深水樣本中採集了放射蟲類。
A single radiolarian can display an astonishing geometric form. 單一一隻放射蟲就可能呈現驚人的幾何形態。
The sediment contained many radiolarian shells from ancient seas. 那些沉積物含有許多來自古海洋的放射蟲殼。
The sample contained traces of radiolead from radioactive decay. 樣本中含有放射衰變產生的少量放射性鉛。
Researchers measured radiolead to reconstruct the decay sequence. 研究人員測量放射性鉛，以重建衰變序列。
The collector labeled the radiolite before packing it. 收藏者在裝箱前先替那塊放射貝化石貼標籤。
A radiolite was embedded in the pale limestone slab. 一塊淡色石灰岩板裡嵌著放射貝化石。
The fossil was tentatively assigned to Radiolites by the curator. 館員暫時把那件化石歸入放射貝屬。
Paleontologists compared Radiolites with related reef-building forms. 古生物學家把放射貝屬和其他造礁類型作比較。

meaning: 放射貝類的；與放射貝有關的
sentences: The limestone contains several radiolitic fragments. 那塊石灰岩中含有幾塊與放射貝有關的碎片。
A radiolitic reef once stood where the dry hill is now. 如今這座乾燥山丘所在之處，過去曾是一座放射貝礁。
Radiolitidae formed an important family of rudist bivalves. 放射貝科是舵形雙殼類中相當重要的一個科。
The exhibit explains how members of Radiolitidae helped build ancient reefs. 展覽說明了放射貝科成員如何形成古代礁體。
Radiolocation transformed navigation during the twentieth century. 無線電定位在二十世紀徹底改變了導航方式。
The pilot trusted radiolocation when clouds hid the coast. 當雲層遮住海岸時，飛行員依靠無線電定位判斷位置。

meaning: 無線電定位器；雷達定位裝置
sentences: The rescue crew deployed a portable radiolocator after the crash. 救援隊在事故後部署了一台可攜式無線電定位器。
A radiolocator can help identify objects beyond visual range. 無線電定位器能幫助辨識視線範圍外的目標。
The radiologic report confirmed that the shadow on the X-ray was harmless. 放射學報告確認，X 光片上的陰影是無害的。
She chose a hospital with a strong radiologic department for her follow-up care. 她選擇了一家放射科很強的醫院來做後續治療。
The radiological team worked quietly behind the curtain while the patient waited. 病人等待時，放射科團隊在簾子後安靜地忙著。
New radiological tools have made tiny fractures much easier to spot. 新的放射影像工具讓細小骨裂更容易被發現。
A radiologist looked at the scan and asked for one more image. 放射科醫師看過掃描後，又要求再補一張影像。
My sister wants to become a radiologist because she enjoys reading medical images. 我妹妹想成為放射科醫師，因為她很喜歡判讀醫學影像。

meaning: 放射學；利用放射進行診斷與治療的學科。
sentences: She chose radiology because she liked images and careful diagnosis. 她選擇放射學，因為她喜歡影像與精細判讀。
The hospital's radiology team reviewed the scan before noon. 醫院的放射學團隊在中午前檢視了掃描結果。

meaning: 放射透亮區；X 光透亮性
sentences: The dentist pointed out a small radiolucency near the root of the tooth. 牙醫指出牙根附近有一小塊放射透亮區。
On the film, that radiolucency suggested the bone had a gap or softer tissue inside. 在片子上，那個透亮區表示骨頭裡可能有空隙或較軟的組織。
The surgeon chose a radiolucent table for the scan. 外科團隊選了一張可透 X 光的檢查床。
This brace is radiolucent, so the bone stays visible. 這個支架可透 X 光，所以骨頭仍看得見。
The museum display explained radioluminescence with a glowing old watch face. 博物館展示用一只發光的老手錶面板來說明輻射致發光。
Scientists studied the radioluminescence of the sample to see how it reacted under radiation. 科學家研究樣本的輻射致發光現象，看看它在輻射下如何反應。
The old sign had a faint radioluminescent glow that was easy to miss in daylight. 那塊老招牌有一層淡淡的輻射致發光光芒，在日光下很容易被忽略。
A radioluminescent marker can stay visible long after the lights go out. 輻射致發光的標記即使燈熄了，也能維持可見。

meaning: 無線電操作員；電台工作人員
sentences: The radioman kept the ship in contact with the coast all night. 那名無線電操作員整晚都讓船隻和海岸保持聯絡。
In the old war movies, the radioman is often the one who sends the urgent message. 在老戰爭電影裡，無線電操作員常常是那個傳送緊急訊息的人。
The pain moved in a radiomedial direction across the wrist. 疼痛沿著手腕往橈側又靠近中線的方向移動。
The cut sat on the radiomedial side of the forearm. 傷口位在前臂偏橈側且靠近中線的一面。

meaning: X 光金相學；放射金相檢查
sentences: The lab used radiometallography to study cracks deep inside the alloy. 實驗室用 X 光金相檢查來研究合金深處的裂痕。
Radiometallography can reveal hidden flaws without cutting the metal open. X 光金相檢查不必把金屬切開，就能找出隱藏的瑕疵。
The balloon carried a radiometeorograph that sent weather data back to the station. 氣球帶著無線電氣象儀，把天氣資料回傳到測站。
By noon, the radiometeorograph had recorded a sharp drop in pressure. 到了中午，無線電氣象儀已經記錄到氣壓明顯下降。
The scientist adjusted the radiometer before placing it near the lamp. 科學家先調整輻射計，然後把它放到燈旁邊。
A radiometer can help measure how much radiant energy is hitting a surface. 輻射計可以幫忙測量有多少輻射能量照射到某個表面。

meaning: 輻射測量的；輻射測定的
sentences: The geologist trusted the radiometric date because two different methods matched. 那位地質學家信任那個輻射測定年代，因為兩種方法的結果一致。
Radiometric analysis helped the team estimate the age of the rock layer. 輻射測量分析幫助團隊估算那層岩石的年代。
The fossils were dated radiometrically, not by guesswork. 這些化石是用輻射測量方法定年的，不是靠猜測。
Radiometrically, the sample looked older than the rest of the layer. 從輻射測量結果來看，那個樣本比該地層其他部分更古老。
She studied radiometry because she liked turning invisible energy into numbers. 她學輻射測量學，因為她喜歡把看不見的能量轉成數字。
Radiometry plays a role in astronomy, medicine, and environmental monitoring. 輻射測量學在天文、醫療和環境監測中都有作用。
The technician used a radiomicrometer to detect a very small change in heat. 技術員用微輻射計偵測極小的熱變化。
A radiomicrometer is useful when ordinary instruments are not sensitive enough. 當一般儀器不夠靈敏時，微輻射計就派得上用場。

meaning: 無線電播出的戲劇或電影改編節目
sentences: Grandpa remembered listening to radiomovies before television became common. 爺爺記得在電視普及前，大家會收聽無線電播出的電影改編節目。
The studio tried to make the radiomovies vivid with music, voices, and sound effects. 製作室試著用音樂、聲音和音效讓這些廣播電影節目更生動。
The scan showed radiomuscular strain near the elbow. 掃描顯示手肘附近有與橈骨和肌肉相關的拉傷。
The report mentioned radiomuscular tissue around the forearm. 報告提到前臂周圍的橈骨肌肉組織。
The treatment plan was adjusted to reduce the risk of radionecrosis. 治療計畫被調整過，以降低放射性壞死的風險。
Radionecrosis can damage healthy tissue if radiation exposure is too strong. 如果輻射暴露太強，放射性壞死就可能傷害健康組織。
The patient complained of numbness, and the doctor checked for radioneuritis. 病人抱怨麻木，醫生便檢查是否有放射性神經炎。
Radioneuritis may appear after radiation therapy and cause burning pain. 接受放射治療後，放射性神經炎可能出現，並引起灼痛。

meaning: 放射能療法說；電子診療學說
sentences: The pamphlet promoted radionics as a cure for fatigue. 那本小冊子把這套療法說成能治疲勞。
His grandfather kept a radionics machine in the attic. 他祖父把一台電子診療機放在閣樓裡。

meaning: X 光不透明度；放射不透性
sentences: The surgeon liked the material's radiopacity because it was easy to see on the scan. 外科醫師喜歡那材料的 X 光不透明度，因為在掃描中很容易看見。
High radiopacity usually means the object blocks X rays well. 很高的 X 光不透明度通常表示那個物體能有效阻擋 X 光。

meaning: 橈掌側的；靠手掌橈側的
sentences: The cast covered the radiopalmar side of his wrist to keep it steady. 石膏固定了他手腕的橈掌側，好讓它保持穩定。
The therapist checked the radiopalmar area for swelling after the workout. 治療師在運動後檢查了手掌橈側是否腫脹。

meaning: X 光不透的；放射不透的
sentences: The marker is radiopaque, so it shows up clearly on the scan. 那個標記是 X 光不透的，所以在掃描上很清楚。
Dentists often use radiopaque materials when they want a filling to stand out on an image. 牙醫常用 X 光不透的材料，讓補牙物在影像上更醒目。
The obstetric team ordered a radiopelvimetry to measure the mother's pelvis. 產科團隊安排了 X 光骨盆測量來量度母親的骨盆。
Radiopelvimetry was once used more often before newer imaging methods became common. 在較新的影像方法普及之前，X 光骨盆測量曾經更常被使用。

meaning: 無線電信標；無線電導航標誌
sentences: The pilot followed the radiophare until the runway lights came into view. 飛行員沿著無線電信標飛行，直到看見跑道燈。
A radiophare helps aircraft find their way when visibility is poor. 在能見度很差時，無線電信標能幫助飛機找到方向。
The explorer used a radiophone to speak with the base camp from the mountain ridge. 那位探險家用無線電話在山稜上和基地營通話。
Before smartphones, a radiophone sounded futuristic and expensive. 在智慧型手機出現之前，無線電話聽起來既未來感又昂貴。
The play had a strong radiophonic style, full of voices and layered sound. 那齣戲有很強的廣播聲音風格，充滿人聲與層次分明的音效。
Her radiophonic narration made the old story feel vivid again. 她那種適合廣播的旁白，讓老故事重新鮮活起來。
The engineer cleaned up the radiophony until the message became clear. 工程師把無線電傳音的雜訊整理好後，訊息才變得清楚。
Old recordings of radiophony often feel rough, but they carry a lot of atmosphere. 老式無線電聲響錄音常常很粗糙，但很有氛圍。
Researchers used radiophosphorus to track how the body absorbed the compound. 研究人員使用放射性磷來追蹤身體如何吸收這種化合物。
Radiophosphorus must be handled carefully because even small amounts can be hazardous. 放射性磷必須小心處理，因為即使少量也可能有危險。
The surgeon studied the radiophotograph before discussing the fracture. 外科醫師在討論骨折前先仔細看了那張放射照片。
A clear radiophotograph helped confirm the position of the broken rib. 一張清楚的 X 光照片幫助確認了肋骨骨折的位置。

meaning: 放射攝影術；X 光攝影
sentences: Radiophotography became essential in modern chest examinations. 放射攝影術成為現代胸腔檢查中不可或缺的一部分。
The museum exhibit explains early radiophotography with historical machines. 博物館展覽以歷史機器介紹早期的 X 光攝影。

meaning: 放射治療實務；放射應用實作

During training, we watched the weld through a radioscope. 訓練時，我們透過放射線檢視器觀察焊接處。

meaning: 放射觀察的；透視檢查的
sentences: The doctor requested a radioscopic exam during the procedure. 醫師在手術過程中要求進行放射透視檢查。

Radioscopy lets clinicians watch internal motion in real time. 放射透視術讓臨床醫師能即時觀察體內動態。

sentences: Radiostereoscopy gave the surgeon a clearer sense of depth. 放射立體觀察術讓外科醫師更清楚掌握深度資訊。

The patient chose radiosurgery as a less invasive treatment option. 那位病人選擇放射外科作為侵入性較低的治療方式。
Radiosurgery can target a small lesion without opening the skull. 放射外科可以在不開顱的情況下精準處理小型病灶。
The team reviewed the radiosurgical plan one last time before treatment. 團隊在治療前最後一次檢查放射外科計畫。
A radiosurgical approach was recommended for the small brain tumor. 對於那個小型腦瘤，醫師建議採用放射外科方式。

The ship sent a radiotelegram when the engine failed offshore. 引擎在外海故障時，那艘船發出了一封無線電報。
A radiotelegram carried the news faster than ordinary mail ever could. 無線電報傳遞消息的速度遠比普通郵件快。

meaning: 無線電報機；無線電報系統
sentences: The operator tapped the message out on the radiotelegraph. 那位操作員在無線電報機上敲出了那則訊息。
A radiotelegraph linked isolated stations across the sea. 一套無線電報系統把分散在海上的站點連了起來。
The museum preserves several radiotelegraphic devices from the war era. 博物館保存了幾件戰時的無線電報設備。
Radiotelegraphic communication once formed the backbone of long-range contact. 無線電報通訊曾經是長距離聯絡的骨幹。
Radiotelegraphy played a critical role in maritime safety. 無線電報術在海上安全方面曾扮演關鍵角色。
Students learned basic radiotelegraphy in the naval communications course. 學生在海軍通訊課程中學習基礎無線電報術。
The pilot contacted the tower by radiotelephone. 飛行員透過無線電話與塔台聯絡。

The ship maintained radiotelephonic contact with the coast guard. 那艘船與海巡單位維持無線電話聯絡。
Radiotelephonic traffic increased sharply during the storm. 暴風雨期間，無線電話通訊量大幅增加。
Radiotelephony made aviation communication far more immediate. 無線電話術讓航空通訊變得即時許多。
The training manual covers both Morse code and radiotelephony. 那本訓練手冊同時涵蓋摩斯電碼與無線電話術。

meaning: 放射獸類；一類假想或古分類名稱
sentences: The old classification used radioteria for a disputed group of animals. 較早的分類法曾用這個名稱指稱一群有爭議的動物。

Researchers handled radiothallium only inside a shielded chamber. 研究人員只在有防護的密閉艙內處理放射性鉈。
The decay of radiothallium was monitored throughout the experiment. 實驗全程都在監測放射性鉈的衰變情況。
The doctor outlined a radiotherapeutic plan for the patient. 醫師替病人規劃了一套放射治療方案。
Radiotherapeutic doses must be calculated with great care. 放射治療的劑量必須非常謹慎地計算。
Radiotherapeutics combines physics, biology, and clinical medicine. 放射治療學結合了物理、生物與臨床醫學。
She specialized in radiotherapeutics during her final year of training. 她在訓練的最後一年專攻放射治療學。
The radiotherapeutist adjusted the beam settings before treatment. 那位放射治療專家在治療前調整了射束設定。
A radiotherapeutist must balance effectiveness with patient safety. 放射治療專家必須在療效和病人安全之間取得平衡。

meaning: 放射治療師；放射治療醫師
sentences: The radiotherapist explained each stage of the treatment clearly. 放射治療師清楚說明了治療的每一個階段。
An experienced radiotherapist can reassure anxious patients before the session. 有經驗的放射治療師能在療程前安撫焦慮的病人。
The doctor recommended radiotherapy after reviewing the biopsy results. 醫師在看過切片結果後建議進行放射治療。
Radiotherapy can shrink tumors while avoiding major surgery in some cases. 在某些情況下，放射治療能縮小腫瘤，同時避免大型手術。
The clinic once used radiothermy to warm deep tissue. 那家診所過去曾用放射熱療法加熱深層組織。

The sample contained traces of radiothorium among other decay products. 那份樣本中除了其他衰變產物外，還含有少量放射性釷。
Researchers stored radiothorium in a heavily shielded container. 研究人員把放射性釷存放在有嚴密屏蔽的容器中。
Doctors watched for radiotoxemia after the accident. 事故後，醫師留意是否出現放射中毒症。
Radiotoxemia can require careful hospital treatment. 放射中毒症可能需要細心的住院治療。
The bone's reduced radiotransparency suggested an abnormal change. 骨頭放射透明性的降低顯示出異常變化。
Radiotransparency helps doctors compare healthy tissue with damaged tissue. 放射透明性能幫助醫師比較健康組織與受損組織。

meaning: 無線電技師；放射設備技師
sentences: The radiotrician repaired the damaged circuit before the test resumed. 那位無線電技師在測試恢復前先修好了損壞的電路。
An experienced radiotrician can diagnose equipment faults very quickly. 有經驗的放射設備技師能很快判斷機器故障。
The radio would not start until the Radiotron warmed up. 那台收音機要等真空管熱起來才會啟動。
He found a spare Radiotron in a dusty drawer. 他在積灰的抽屜裡找到一支備用電子管。

meaning: 向輻射的；受輻射趨引的
sentences: The researcher described the cells as radiotropic under certain conditions. 研究人員描述這些細胞在特定條件下具有向輻射性。

meaning: 早期電視；無線視覺傳送

meaning: 具齒舌的；有細齒刮紋的

meaning: 一群粗魯或聲名狼藉的人（= riffraff）

All that raffery wasted half the meeting. 那些誇張空話浪費了半場會議。

sentences: She tied the bouquet with raffia. 她用椰棕纖維把花束綁好。

meaning: 抽獎參加者；抽獎籌辦者
sentences: The raffler shook the box before drawing a name. 抽獎主持人在抽名字前先搖了搖箱子。

sentences: Botanists placed the plant in Rafflesiaceae. 植物學家把這株植物歸入大王花科。

sentences: The botanist noted rafflesiaceous traits in the specimen. 植物學家在標本上記下了大王花科的特徵。
