Our raft drifted slowly down the calm river. 我們的木筏沿著平靜的河流慢慢漂下去。
The company used raftage to move logs downstream. 那家公司用木排運輸把原木送往下游。
Winter ice stopped raftage on the river. 冬天的浮冰讓這條河上的筏運停了下來。
A cracked rafter made the roof sag slightly. 一根裂開的椽子讓屋頂微微下陷。
The cat slept on a warm rafter above the barn. 那隻貓睡在穀倉上方一根暖暖的斜梁上。
The raftiness of the basement ruined the boxes. 地下室的潮霉感把那些箱子弄壞了。
A weekend of sun finally eased the raftiness indoors. 連曬兩天太陽後，屋內那股濕悶霉味終於散了一些。
We went rafting on the river last summer. 去年夏天我們到河上泛舟。
Rafting can be exciting, but everyone must wear a life jacket. 泛舟很刺激，但每個人都必須穿救生衣。
The floating platform looked raftlike from the shore. 從岸上看，那個漂浮平台很像木筏。
They built a raftlike bed from tied bamboo. 他們用綁起來的竹子做了一張像木筏的床。
The raftman pushed off before sunrise. 那名筏工在日出前就出發了。
A skilled raftman read the current at a glance. 有經驗的筏工一眼就看得出水流。
The raftsman tied the logs with wet rope. 那名筏工用濕繩把木頭綁在一起。
An old raftsman showed us where the river turned fast. 一位老筏工指給我們看河水變急的地方。
The towels felt rafty after two days in the shed. 毛巾在棚子裡放了兩天後摸起來又濕又霉。
This room gets rafty whenever the windows stay shut. 這個房間只要窗戶一直關著，就會變得濕悶發霉。

meaning: 抹布；破布（常用來清潔或擦拭）
sentences: She used an old rag to clean the dust from the wooden furniture. 她用一塊舊抹布清理木家具上的灰塵。
He went from rags to riches by starting a successful tech company. 他透過創立一家成功的科技公司，從一貧如洗變成了富有。

meaning: 印度古典音樂中的曲調或調式
sentences: The musician began with a slow raga at dusk. 那位樂手在黃昏時以一段緩慢的拉嘎開場。
Her favorite raga made the room feel calm. 她最喜歡的拉嘎讓整個房間都安靜下來。
The mayor called the hecklers ragabash and left early. 市長罵那些起鬨的人是烏合之眾，然後提早離開。
A ragabash crowd gathered outside the gate at dusk. 黃昏時，一群雜亂低俗的人聚在大門外。
The guard drove the ragabrash away from the steps. 守衛把那群烏合之眾趕離台階。
By midnight, only ragabrash lingered near the fairground. 到了半夜，遊樂場附近只剩一群雜亂閒人。

meaning: 衣衫襤褸的人；髒兮兮的小孩
sentences: The novel opens with a ragamuffin sleeping by a bakery. 那本小說一開始就是一個衣衫襤褸的人睡在麵包店旁。
After soccer, my son looked like a ragamuffin. 踢完足球後，我兒子看起來像個髒兮兮的小鬼。

meaning: 流浪兒般的邋遢狀態；衣衫襤褸的樣子
sentences: The director used ragamuffinism to give the street scene a rough realism. 導演利用這種衣衫襤褸的感覺，讓街景顯得更真實粗礪。
His deliberate ragamuffinism hid the fact that he came from a wealthy family. 他刻意營造出的邋遢流浪樣，掩蓋了自己出身富裕家庭的事實。
The boy smiled ragamuffinly as he ran through the market. 那男孩像個小流浪兒似地笑著穿過市場。
She dressed ragamuffinly for the role to match the script. 她為了符合劇本角色而刻意穿得邋遢。
He was trembling with rage when he found out that his car had been stolen. 當他發現自己的車被偷時，氣得渾身發抖（狂怒）。
The storm continued to rage throughout the night, causing widespread damage. 風暴在整晚持續肆虐（發威），造成了廣泛的破壞。
He gave the manager a rageful look before leaving the room. 他離開房間前，憤怒地瞪了經理一眼。
Her rageful speech unsettled even the people who agreed with her. 她那番充滿怒氣的發言，連同意她的人都感到不安。
He ragefully struck the desk when he heard the news. 他聽到消息後憤怒地拍打桌子。
The crowd shouted ragefully at the locked gate. 人群朝著緊閉的大門憤怒地大喊。
To everyone's surprise, he gave a rageless answer to the insult. 令所有人驚訝的是，他對那番侮辱給出了平靜的回應。
Her rageless tone made the argument lose its force. 她那種沒有怒氣的語氣，讓爭吵一下子失去了火力。
A rageous storm rolled over the hills at dusk. 傍晚時，一場猛烈的暴風雨越過山丘襲來。
His rageous reaction shocked the whole office. 他那種狂怒的反應讓整個辦公室都嚇了一跳。
The river rose rageously after two days of heavy rain. 經過兩天豪雨後，河水猛烈地上漲。
He denied the charge rageously in front of the cameras. 他在鏡頭前激烈地否認了那項指控。
By midnight, the rageousness of the storm shook every window. 到了半夜，暴風的猛烈氣勢震得每扇窗都在響。
His face showed rageousness after the insult at lunch. 午餐時受到羞辱後，他臉上立刻浮現狂怒。
The mediator seemed almost rageproof during the heated meeting. 在那場火藥味十足的會議中，調解人幾乎像是不會被激怒一樣。
Years of experience made her nearly rageproof in public debates. 多年的經驗讓她在公開辯論中幾乎不會動怒。

meaning: 狂歡派對；怒不可遏的人
sentences: The neighbors complained about the rager that lasted until sunrise. 鄰居們抱怨那場一路鬧到日出的狂歡派對。
He turned into a real rager when the deal collapsed. 當交易破局時，他整個人簡直像個怒火中燒的人。
The old king was remembered as proud and ragesome. 那位老國王因驕傲又易怒而為人記憶。
A ragesome mood spread through the crowd after the verdict. 判決出來後，一股充滿怒氣的情緒在群眾間蔓延。
The fishermen hauled up a ragfish from deep cold water. 漁夫從寒冷的深水裡拉上一條布魚。
A ragfish has a long body and a strangely soft appearance. 布魚身體修長，外表看起來異常柔軟。
The homeless man was wearing ragged clothes and old worn-out shoes. 那名無家可歸的人穿著破爛的衣服和磨損的舊鞋。
The edges of the old photograph were ragged and torn after many years. 那張舊照片的邊緣在多年後變得破爛（不齊）且撕裂了。
The torn flag hung raggedly from the pole after the storm. 暴風雨過後，那面破旗凌亂地垂掛在旗桿上。
He breathed raggedly after running up the stairs. 他跑上樓梯後，上氣不接下氣地喘著。
The raggedness of his coat told its own story of hardship. 他外套的破舊凌亂，本身就訴說著生活的艱難。
Designers softened the raggedness of the draft before publication. 設計人員在出版前修整了草稿中的凌亂感。
The child hugged a raggedy doll with one missing eye. 那孩子抱著一個少了一隻眼睛的破舊洋娃娃。
A raggedy line of tents stretched along the muddy road. 一排破破舊舊的帳篷沿著泥濘道路延伸。
The tailor used raggee for work clothes that needed to be durable. 裁縫使用粗布來製作需要耐穿的工作服。
A bundle of raggee lay beside the dyeing vat. 一捆粗織布料放在染缸旁邊。

meaning: 收破布的人；愛喧鬧的學生
sentences: The ragger pushed his cart through the alley at dawn. 那名收破布的人在黎明時推著車穿過巷子。
On campus, the ragger was known for organizing loud charity stunts. 在校園裡，那名愛起鬨的學生以策劃喧鬧的慈善活動聞名。
His grandfather once owned a small raggery near the station. 他的祖父曾在車站附近經營一間小破布店。
The old raggery dealt in scraps, sacks, and worn cloth. 那間舊破布店經營碎布、麻袋與舊布料。
A raggety fence leaned around the abandoned yard. 一道破破爛爛的圍籬歪斜地圍著那座廢棄庭院。
The choir began in a raggety way but soon found the right pitch. 合唱團一開始唱得參差不齊，但很快就找回正確音準。
The package was wrapped in old raggil to protect the glass. 那個包裹用舊破布包著，以保護裡面的玻璃。
She wiped the bench with a piece of raggil from the drawer. 她從抽屜裡拿出一塊粗布，把長凳擦乾淨。
The old banner fluttered raggily above the gate. 那面舊旗幟破破爛爛地在門上方飄動。
He dressed raggily for the role of a homeless wanderer. 他為了詮釋流浪漢角色而穿得很邋遢。

meaning: 戲弄；粗魯惡作劇；用破布擦拭
sentences: The school banned ragging after several students were humiliated. 學校在幾名學生受到羞辱後，禁止了那種惡作劇式的欺負行為。
The mechanic finished the polishing with a bit of ragging by hand. 那位技師最後用手拿破布擦拭，完成了拋光。
The mason used a tool to raggle the edge of the stone. 石匠用工具在石塊邊緣刮出一道凹槽。
Wind and rain began to raggle the paper signs on the wall. 風吹雨打開始把牆上的紙告示弄得破破爛爛。
The hikers followed a raggled path through the brush. 登山客沿著一條參差難辨的小路穿過灌木叢。
A raggled hem showed how old the curtain had become. 那道參差破損的下襬顯示那窗簾已經很舊了。

meaning: 破布似的；邋遢的；毛邊的
sentences: The puppy had a raggy coat that made it look even smaller. 那隻小狗的毛亂蓬蓬的，讓牠看起來更小了。
She prefers a raggy denim style to polished fashion. 她比起精緻時尚，更喜歡那種毛邊牛仔的風格。
Workers sorted cloth by color and weight inside the raghouse. 工人們在破布倉裡按顏色和重量分類布料。
The fire started near the back of the old raghouse. 火災從那座舊布回收場的後方燒了起來。
Raghu called just in time to warn us about the delay. 拉古及時打電話來提醒我們會有延誤。
The novel describes Raghu as patient, clever, and quietly brave. 小說把拉古描寫成有耐心、聰明而沉著勇敢的人。
A raging fire blocked the road last night. 昨晚一場猛烈大火堵住了道路。
She stayed home with a raging sore throat. 她因為喉嚨痛得很厲害而待在家裡。
The fever burned ragingly through the night. 高燒在整個夜裡猛烈地持續著。
He argued ragingly until the chairman cut him off. 他憤怒地爭辯個不停，直到主席打斷他。

meaning: 插肩袖大衣；插肩袖式樣
sentences: He wore a gray raglan over his suit on cold mornings. 寒冷的早晨裡，他會在西裝外面穿一件灰色插肩袖大衣。
The designer chose a raglan cut for easier shoulder movement. 設計師選用插肩袖剪裁，讓肩部活動更自在。

meaning: 拉格蘭石；一種稀有礦物
sentences: The curator kept the raglanite in a locked case. 館員把那塊拉格蘭石放在上鎖的展示櫃裡。
A thin vein of raglanite ran through the sample. 樣本裡穿過一條細細的拉格蘭石礦脈。
She wiped the ink with a raglet from the drawer. 她從抽屜拿出一小塊碎布擦掉墨水。
A greasy raglet lay beside the toolbox. 工具箱旁邊放著一塊沾油的小布片。
He tied the handle with a raglin to stop the rattle. 他用一條細布綁住把手，讓它不要一直晃響。
A blue raglin hung from the fence wire. 一條藍色小布條掛在鐵絲圍欄上。
The ragman came by every Thursday with a cart. 那個收舊布的人每週四都會推著車來。
My grandmother saved worn sheets for the ragman. 我祖母把用舊的床單留給收舊布的人。
Ragnar volunteered to lead the discussion at the workshop. 拉格納自願在工作坊中帶領討論。
The novelist chose Ragnar as the name of the ship's captain. 那位小說家把船長取名為拉格納。
The cook served a beef ragout with bread. 廚師端上牛肉濃燉菜和麵包。
A hot ragout filled the kitchen with steam. 一鍋熱燉菜讓整個廚房都冒著蒸氣。
The ragpicker sorted bottles under the bridge. 那名拾荒者在橋下分揀瓶子。
A ragpicker found the missing wallet near the bins. 一位撿破爛的人在垃圾桶旁找到遺失的皮夾。
The ragseller weighed each bundle on a hanging scale. 那位舊布商把每一捆都掛上秤來量。
A ragseller rented the narrow shop by the lane. 一名舊布商租下了巷口那間窄店面。

meaning: 穿破布的人；穿破衣化裝的人
sentences: The parade ended with a laughing ragshag in patched clothes. 遊行最後是一個穿著補丁衣服、笑個不停的破布裝人物。
A ragshag danced across the small stage at dusk. 黃昏時，一個穿破布的人在小舞台上跳舞。
The ragsorter separated wool from cotton by hand. 那名分揀工用手把羊毛和棉布分開。
A careful ragsorter found coins in one old coat. 一位細心的分揀工在一件舊外套裡找到硬幣。
The wall was built from pale ragstone blocks. 那道牆是用淡色粗面石塊砌成的。
Rain darkened the ragstone around the doorway. 雨水讓門口周圍的粗石變深了。
A ragtag team cleaned the beach before noon. 一支七拼八湊的隊伍在中午前把海灘清乾淨了。
Their ragtag chairs somehow matched the old table. 他們那幾張東拼西湊的椅子居然和老桌子搭得起來。
ragtime drifted from the piano in the next room. 隔壁房間的鋼琴傳來拉格泰姆音樂。
My grandfather still taps his foot to ragtime. 我祖父現在聽到這種切分節奏音樂還是會跟著打拍子。
The ragtimer played through dinner without a break. 那位演奏者整場晚餐都沒停下來。
A local ragtimer filled the café with bright rhythms. 一位在地演奏者讓咖啡館充滿明亮的切分節奏。
The band gave the march a ragtimey bounce. 樂團把那首進行曲演得很有拉格泰姆的跳動感。
Her left hand kept a ragtimey beat on the keys. 她的左手在琴鍵上一直敲出拉格泰姆味道的節拍。
A ragule was enough to polish the silver spoon. 一小塊碎布就夠把銀湯匙擦亮。
He stuffed a ragule into the crack to stop the draft. 他塞了一小塊碎布進縫裡擋風。

meaning: 鋸齒枝節狀的；邊緣不規則的
sentences: The branch left a raguly shadow on the wall. 那根樹枝在牆上投下鋸齒枝節般的影子。
Its raguly edge made the broken tile easy to spot. 那塊破磁磚邊緣凹凸鋸齒，很容易看出來。
ragweed covered the empty lot by August. 到了八月，那塊空地長滿了豚草。
My eyes itch whenever ragweed blooms nearby. 只要附近的豚草開花，我的眼睛就會發癢。
Yellow ragwort spread along the roadside bank. 黃色千里光一路長滿路邊斜坡。
The farmer pulled ragwort before the horses grazed. 農夫在馬放牧前先把千里光拔掉了。
Rah stood near the stage door. 拉赫站在舞台門邊。
The teacher asked Rah to read the last line. 老師請拉赫讀最後一句。
Rahanwin signed the guest book in neat script. 拉漢溫用整齊的字跡簽了來賓簿。
No one forgot Rahanwin after the memorable speech. 那場難忘的演講後，沒有人忘記拉漢溫。

meaning: 收過路稅的人；道路關卡守衛
sentences: The rahdar checked our papers at the pass. 那名關卡守衛在山口查驗了我們的文件。
A tired rahdar waved the cart through at sunset. 一名疲憊的收稅守衛在日落時揮手讓馬車通過。
The trader paid the rahdaree before entering the town. 那名商人在進城前先付了過路稅。
Without a rahdaree, the driver had to turn back. 沒有通行路證，司機只好折返。
Rahul arrived early and helped arrange the chairs. 拉胡爾很早就到了，還幫忙把椅子排好。
I asked Rahul to send the photos after the event. 活動結束後，我請拉胡爾把照片傳給我。
Raia folded the map before leaving. 拉亞離開前把地圖折好。
The note on the desk was meant for Raia. 桌上的字條是留給拉亞的。
Raia sent a postcard from the seaside town. 拉亞從海邊小鎮寄來一張明信片。
The teacher smiled when Raia answered the question clearly. 拉亞清楚回答問題時，老師笑了。

meaning: 鰩屬的複數分類形式；魟魚類
sentences: The biology chart grouped several Raiae together. 生物圖表把幾種魟魚類放在一起。
The student compared Raiae with other flat-bodied fish. 學生把魟魚類與其他扁身魚類比較。
The police seized a large amount of illegal drugs during the raid last night. 警方在昨晚的突襲搜查中沒收了大量的非法毒品。
The army launched a surprise raid on the enemy's base early this morning. 軍隊今天清晨對敵軍基地發動了突擊（搜查）。
The villagers hid their food when the raiders approached. 掠奪者接近時，村民把糧食藏了起來。
The museum described the ship as a coastal raider from the past. 博物館把那艘船描述成過去沿海地區的襲擊船。
The archive kept its oldest papers in a raidproof room. 檔案館把最老的文件放在防突襲的房間裡。
They built a raidproof door behind the shop. 他們在店後方裝了一扇防闖入的門。
Raif greeted everyone at the door with a warm smile. 拉伊夫在門口帶著溫暖的笑容迎接大家。
The reservation was under the name Raif. 那筆訂位是用拉伊夫這個名字登記的。
The specimen was identified as part of Raiidae. 那件標本被判定屬於鰩科。
Raiidae members usually live near the seabed. 鰩科成員通常生活在海底附近。
The juvenile fish had a raiiform body in the tank. 水箱裡那條幼魚有著像鰩魚的扁平身形。
Its fins spread in a raiiform shape over the sand. 牠的鰭在沙面上展成鰩魚般的形狀。
Traveling by rail is a convenient and scenic way to explore the country. 搭火車（鐵路）是探索這個國家方便且風景優美的方式。
He held onto the hand rail as the train rounded a sharp curve. 火車轉急彎時，他緊緊握住扶手（欄杆）。
railage cut the shipping cost for the factory. 鐵路運輸降低了工廠的出貨成本。
The clerk added the railage to the final invoice. 店員把鐵路運費加進最後的發票。

meaning: 賽場欄邊常客；愛在場邊看賽的人
sentences: A railbird shouted tips from beside the track. 一個場邊老觀眾在跑道旁大聲喊著看法。
My uncle is a railbird at every weekend race. 我叔叔每逢週末賽事都會去場邊看。
The railer complained about every small delay. 那個愛抱怨的人連一點小耽擱都要罵。
Nobody sat beside the railer on the bus. 在公車上沒人想坐在那個碎念又愛罵的人旁邊。

meaning: 鐵路終點站；鐵路支線的終點
sentences: We met the driver at the railhead before sunrise. 日出前，我們在鐵路終點站和司機會合。
Supplies were unloaded at the railhead and sent inland by truck. 物資在鐵路終點站卸下後，再用卡車送往內陸。
He gripped the railing while walking down the stairs. 他下樓時緊抓著欄杆。
Fresh paint covered the railing beside the balcony. 陽台旁的欄杆剛刷上新漆。
He spoke railingly about the policy for nearly ten minutes. 他責難地談論那項政策將近十分鐘。
The critic laughed railingly at the mayor's excuse. 那位評論者帶著譏誚責罵的口氣嘲笑市長的藉口。
Their friendly raillery made the long dinner feel lively. 他們友善的戲謔讓漫長的晚餐變得很有氣氛。
The professor accepted the students' raillery with a smile. 那位教授笑著接受學生們善意的打趣。
The railless bridge looked beautiful but made tourists nervous. 那座沒有欄杆的橋看起來很美，卻讓遊客有些不安。
A railless platform is unsafe during heavy rain. 沒有欄杆的月台在大雨時很不安全。
The insect had long raillike legs that bent at sharp angles. 那隻昆蟲有像欄杆般細長的腿，還在明顯的角度處彎折。
A raillike beam ran across the ceiling above us. 一根像欄杆似的長梁橫在我們頭上的天花板下。
The fence stretched railly across the field in neat lines. 那道柵欄像一排排欄杆般整齊地延伸過田野。
The sketch was drawn railly, with long parallel strokes. 那張素描畫得很像軌道結構，帶著長長的平行線條。
The old railman knew every tunnel and bridge on the route. 那位老鐵路工人熟悉這條路線上的每一座隧道和橋梁。
A railman waved the lantern to signal the train forward. 一名鐵路工人揮動燈號，示意火車前進。
The new railroad connected the mining town to the coast. 新建的鐵路把那座礦業城鎮和海岸連接起來。
Workers spent years building the railroad through the mountains. 工人們花了好幾年在群山之間修築這條鐵路。
The railroad/railway runs behind our school. 那條鐵路從我們學校後面經過。
A new railroad/railway station opened near the market. 市場附近新開了一座車站。
His study was filled with railroadana from vanished local lines. 他的書房裡擺滿了來自已消失地方鐵路的紀念收藏品。
Collectors traded railroadana at the weekend fair. 收藏家們在週末市集上交換鐵路文物。
The retired railroader still tells stories about snowbound trains. 那位退休鐵路員工仍常講起火車受困雪中的故事。
Every railroader in the town knew the station master by name. 鎮上的每一位鐵路人都認識站長。
The museum opened a room devoted entirely to railroadiana. 博物館開了一個房間，專門展示鐵路文物。
Old tickets, signs, and clocks are all prized railroadiana. 舊車票、標誌和時鐘都屬於珍貴的鐵路收藏品。

meaning: 鐵路工作；強行推動；不公正地草率處理
sentences: He spent thirty years in railroading before retiring. 他從事鐵路工作三十年後才退休。
The lawyer argued that the defendant had been convicted by pure railroading. 律師主張被告是被草率而不公正地定罪的。

meaning: 像鐵路的；帶有鐵道風格的
sentences: The cafe had a railroadish charm with brass lamps and old maps. 那家咖啡館帶著鐵道風格的魅力，擺著黃銅燈與舊地圖。
His model layout looked charmingly railroadish from a distance. 從遠處看，他的模型場景有種可愛的鐵路味道。
For him, railroadship was more than a job; it was a family tradition. 對他而言，鐵路工作不只是一份職業，更是家族傳統。
The novel links railroadship with discipline and endurance. 那部小說把鐵路人的職業精神與紀律、耐力連在一起。
The railway carries passengers between the two cities every day. 這條鐵路每天在兩座城市之間運送乘客。
Snow blocked the railway for several hours last night. 昨晚的大雪讓這條鐵路中斷了好幾個小時。
The news spread quickly through railwaydom after the accident. 事故發生後，消息很快傳遍整個鐵路界。
He was well known in railwaydom for his practical designs. 他在鐵道圈裡以實用設計聞名。
The railwayless region depended on river boats and rough roads. 那個沒有鐵路的地區仰賴河船和顛簸的道路。
A railwayless interior slowed trade for decades. 缺乏鐵路的內陸地區讓貿易停滯了好幾十年。

meaning: 雷曼尼亞屬；一種植物屬
sentences: The label identified the vine as Raimannia. 標籤把那株藤本植物標成雷曼尼亞屬。
Raimannia appeared in a narrow bed beside the greenhouse. 那個溫室旁的狹長花圃裡出現了這屬植物。
The prince appeared in rich raiment woven with gold thread. 王子身穿用金線織成的華麗服裝現身。
Her plain raiment contrasted sharply with the bright festival crowd. 她樸素的衣著和熱鬧節慶中的人群形成強烈對比。
The refugees arrived cold and nearly raimentless after the flood. 洪水過後，難民們在寒冷中幾乎衣不蔽體地抵達。
The old text describes a raimentless figure wandering in the desert. 那篇古文描述一個未著衣的人影在沙漠中徘徊。
It started to rain just as we reached the park entrance. 就在我們到達公園門口時，開始下雨了。
The heavy rain caused severe flooding in some low-lying areas. 大雨導致一些低窪地區嚴重淹水。
A thick rainband moved across the island before dawn. 一條厚重的雨帶在黎明前掃過那座島。
The forecast warned that the outer rainband would reach the coast by noon. 氣象預報警告，外圍雨帶會在中午前抵達海岸。

meaning: 雨鳥；傳說中會帶來雨的鳥
sentences: Villagers listened for the cry of the rainbird before planting. 村民們在播種前會留意雨鳥的叫聲。
The child believed the rainbird had called the storm from the hills. 那孩子相信是雨鳥從山裡喚來了暴雨。
We were rainbound in the cabin for two full days. 我們因大雨受困在小屋裡整整兩天。
The hikers stayed rainbound at the station until the path reopened. 登山客們因雨滯留在車站，直到道路重新開放。
A beautiful rainbow appeared in the sky after the storm. 暴風雨過後，天空中出現了一道美麗的彩虹。
The colorful rainbow stretched across the entire horizon. 繽紛的彩虹橫跨了整個地平線。
Oil on the water made a rainbowlike sheen near the shore. 水面上的油膜在岸邊形成像彩虹般的光澤。
The fabric showed a soft rainbowlike shift when it moved in the light. 那塊布在光線下移動時呈現柔和的彩虹般色澤變化。
The botanist found rainbowweed growing near the marsh edge. 植物學家發現彩虹草長在沼澤邊緣。
Rainbowweed gets its name from the shifting colors of its leaves. 彩虹草因葉片顏色會變化而得名。
The artist chose a rainbowy palette for the children's mural. 那位畫家為兒童壁畫選用了彩虹般繽紛的色盤。
A rainbowy glow spread across the soap bubble in the sun. 肥皂泡在陽光下散發出彩虹般的光。
A sudden rainburst sent everyone running under the awning. 突如其來的驟雨讓所有人都衝到棚子底下躲雨。
The dry riverbed filled within minutes after the rainburst. 一場暴雨過後，乾涸的河床在幾分鐘內就積滿了水。
Don't forget to take your yellow raincoat; it's going to rain. 別忘了帶妳的黃色雨衣；快要下雨了。
I bought a stylish and waterproof raincoat for my trip to London. 我為去倫敦的旅行買了一件時尚且防水的雨衣。
A single raindrop landed on the page before the storm began. 暴風雨開始前，一滴雨先落在書頁上。
Each raindrop on the window caught the city lights. 窗上的每一滴雨珠都映著城市燈光。
Rainer arrived early with a folder full of notes. 萊納提早到了，手裡還帶著一大疊筆記。
The letter from Rainer was brief but unusually warm. 萊納寄來的信雖然簡短，卻出奇地溫暖。
Farmers called the dark cloud a rainer. 農夫把那片烏雲稱為會帶來雨的雲。
The sea wind became a steady rainer by evening. 到了傍晚，海風變成持續帶來雨的風。
The average annual rainfall in this tropical region is quite high. 這個熱帶地區的平均年降雨量相當高。
Heavy rainfall caused several rivers to overflow their banks yesterday. 昨天的強降雨導致幾條河流的河水溢出了河岸。
The elders said the cry of the rainfowl meant the monsoon was near. 長者們說雨鳥一叫，就代表季風快到了。
A pair of rainfowl nested near the flooded fields. 一對雨鳥在淹水田地附近築巢。
It was a rainful summer, and the river never ran low. 那是一個多雨的夏天，河水從未明顯下降。
The farmers welcomed the rainful season after years of drought. 經歷多年乾旱後，農民們欣然迎來這個多雨季節。
The morning began rainily, so we stayed indoors. 早晨在陰雨中開始，所以我們待在室內。
Our trip ended rainily, with umbrellas at every door. 我們的行程在陰雨裡結束，每扇門旁都立著雨傘。
The raininess of spring kept the yard green. 春天的多雨讓院子一直很綠。
We were tired of the week's endless raininess. 我們受夠了那一整週沒完沒了的陰雨。
The farm had a rainless month in July. 那座農場在七月整整一個月沒下雨。
A rainless sky made the dust rise quickly. 無雨的天空讓地上的灰塵很快揚起來。
The long rainlessness cracked the pond bank. 長期缺雨讓池塘邊裂開了。
Farmers worried that another week of rainlessness would hurt the rice. 農民擔心再一週不下雨會傷到稻作。
rainlight turned the alley silver at dawn. 雨中的微光在清晨把小巷染成銀色。
We ate by the soft rainlight from the window. 我們在窗邊柔和的雨光裡吃飯。
She packed a rainproof jacket before the mountain trip. 上山旅行前，她先收進了一件防雨外套。
The bag is rainproof enough for a short walk in wet weather. 這個袋子夠防水，足以應付潮濕天氣下的短程步行。

meaning: 防雨處理劑；防雨處理用品
sentences: She sprayed rainproofer on her canvas shoes. 她把防雨處理劑噴在帆布鞋上。
A small bottle of rainproofer saved my jacket. 一小瓶防雨噴劑救了我的外套。
The rainspout overflowed beside the front steps. 前階旁的雨水管溢出來了。
Leaves clogged the rainspout after the storm. 暴風雨後，落葉堵住了落水管。
A rainstorm flooded the street in ten minutes. 一場暴雨十分鐘內就把街道淹了。
We waited out the rainstorm in a bus stop. 我們在公車亭裡等那場大雨過去。
The camper stayed raintight through the night. 那頂露營車整晚都沒有漏雨。
This box is raintight even in heavy showers. 這個箱子就算遇到大雨也不會進水。
rainwash carved thin lines into the dirt path. 雨水沖刷在土路上刻出細細的痕。
The hill showed fresh rainwash after the storm. 暴雨過後，山坡上出現新的雨蝕痕跡。
A rainworm curled on the sidewalk after lunch. 午餐後的人行道上蜷著一條雨後冒出的蚯蚓。
The robin grabbed a rainworm from the wet grass. 知更鳥從濕草地叼起一條蚯蚓。
I like to stay at home and read books on a rainy day. 我喜歡在下雨天待在家裡讀書。
The rainy season in this area usually starts in June. 這個地區的雨季通常從六月開始。
The sketch gave the fish a raioid outline. 那張素描把那條魚畫成鰩魚般的外形。
Its flat fins made the young shark look raioid. 那條幼鯊因為扁平的鰭而看起來很像鰩魚。
A tiny rais formed near the edge of the stone. 石頭邊緣形成了一個細小的隆起物。
He smoothed the rais with a fingertip. 他用指尖把那個隆起物撫平。
Rais left a short note on the kitchen table. 拉伊斯在廚房桌上留了一張簡短的便條。
The receptionist pronounced Rais carefully before calling him in. 櫃檯人員先小心地念出拉伊斯的名字，才請他進來。
The desk has a raisable top for standing work. 那張桌子有可升高的桌面，方便站著工作。
This stage is raisable by a small motor. 這個舞台可以由小馬達升起。
Please raise the window before the rain starts. 下雨前請把窗戶拉起來。
raise your hand if you know the answer. 如果你知道答案，請舉手。
The map showed a raised path through the park. 地圖上畫出一條穿過公園的隆起小徑。
She felt the raised lettering with her fingertips. 她用指尖摸著那一排凸起的字。
The raiseman climbed out of the shaft at dusk. 那名掘昇井礦工在黃昏時爬出了井道。
A veteran raiseman checked the rock before blasting. 一位資深礦工在爆破前先檢查了岩壁。

meaning: 抬升裝置；使上升的人或物
sentences: The mechanic fitted a raiser under the platform. 技工在平台下裝了一個抬升裝置。
A small raiser lifted the monitor to eye level. 一個小墊高架把螢幕抬到視線高度。
She likes to add some raisins and nuts to her oatmeal in the morning. 她喜歡在早上的燕麥片裡加一些葡萄乾和堅果。
The children enjoyed the sweet raisin bread that their mother baked. 孩子們很喜歡母親烤的甜葡萄乾麵包。
The crew is raising the bridge for the boat. 船員正在升起橋面讓船通過。
She kept raising her hand to ask questions. 她不停舉手提問。
The cake had a raisiny smell from the oven. 蛋糕剛出爐時帶著葡萄乾般的香氣。
This tea tastes slightly raisiny when it cools. 這款茶放涼後喝起來有點像葡萄乾。
Raiz opened a small bakery near the station. 雷茲在車站附近開了一家小麵包店。
The letter was signed by Raiz at the bottom. 信的下方署名是雷茲。

meaning: 英屬印度時期；英國在印度的統治（通常稱為 British Raj）
sentences: The exhibit showed photographs from the days of the Raj. 那個展覽展示了英屬印度時期的照片。
Historians still debate how the Raj changed daily life in India. 歷史學者至今仍在討論英屬印度統治如何改變印度人的日常生活。
The prince hoped to expand his raj beyond the river. 王子希望把自己的領地擴到河的另一邊。
That village stayed under one raj for generations. 那個村子好幾代都在同一位王公的統治下。
Raja greeted the guests from a shaded balcony. 那位王公在有遮蔭的陽台上迎接賓客。
The painter showed a Raja in a silk robe. 畫家畫出一位穿絲袍的王公。
A local raja funded the repair of the old well. 一位地方王公出資修好了那口老井。
The raja rode through town with a small guard. 那位王公帶著一小隊護衛穿過城鎮。
A rajah once lived in the hilltop palace. 從前有一位印度王公住在山頂宮殿裡。
The village festival honors a generous rajah from the old stories. 村莊節慶紀念古老故事中一位慷慨的土邦首領。

meaning: 聖王；兼具統治與修行智慧的人
sentences: The elder was praised as a Rajarshi for his wise rule. 那位長者因為治理明智而被譽為聖王。
A Rajarshi is respected for both power and virtue. 聖王同時因權威與德行而受人敬重。
The treaty confirmed his rajaship after the dispute. 那份條約在爭議後確認了他的王公地位。
rajaship passed to the eldest son that winter. 那年冬天，王公之位傳給了長子。
Rajasthani music played during the evening market. 晚市裡播放著拉賈斯坦風格的音樂。
She wore a bright Rajasthani skirt to the festival. 她穿著一條鮮豔的拉賈斯坦裙子去參加節慶。

meaning: 拉傑班西族的；拉傑班西語的
sentences: They collected rajbansi songs from village elders. 他們向村裡長者蒐集拉傑班西民歌。
The museum displayed rajbansi textiles and tools. 博物館展出了拉傑班西族的織物和器具。
Rajeev stayed calm even when the meeting grew noisy. 即使會議變得吵雜，拉吉夫依然保持冷靜。
My cousin Rajeev writes short stories on the train ride home. 我表哥拉吉夫會在回家的火車上寫短篇小說。
Rajendra checked every detail before signing the form. 拉真德拉在簽表格前仔細檢查了每一個細節。
We thanked Rajendra for organizing the volunteer team. 我們感謝拉真德拉把志工隊安排得井井有條。
Rajesh fixed the broken lamp in less than ten minutes. 拉傑什不到十分鐘就把壞掉的燈修好了。
The package was delivered to Rajesh yesterday afternoon. 那個包裹昨天下午送到了拉傑什手上。
The textbook placed the skate in Rajidae. 教科書把那種鰩歸入鰩科。
Rajidae includes many flat fish that live on the seafloor. 鰩科包含許多生活在海底的扁平魚類。
Rajiv sent the revised schedule before anyone else woke up. 拉吉夫在其他人醒來之前就寄出了修正版行程表。
The report quoted Rajiv as one of the lead engineers on the project. 那份報告引用拉吉夫的話，並把他列為專案的主要工程師之一。
The film follows a young Rajput during a border war. 那部電影描寫一名年輕拉傑普特人在邊境戰事中的遭遇。
A Rajput family hosted us for tea in the courtyard. 一個拉傑普特家庭在庭院裡招待我們喝茶。
The temple hall displayed wooden statues of each rakan. 那座寺廟大殿陳列著一尊尊木雕羅漢像。
A calm expression on the rakan figure gave the room a quiet dignity. 那尊羅漢像平靜的表情讓整個房間多了幾分莊嚴。

meaning: 耙子；一種有齒的園藝工具（也可作動詞：用耙子耙）
sentences: He used a rake to gather the fallen leaves into a pile. 他用耙子把落葉耙成一堆。
The old rake was leaning against the garden wall. 那把舊耙子靠在花園的牆邊。
The gardener piled the morning rakeage beside the compost bin. 園丁把早上耙起來的落葉堆在堆肥桶旁。
A cart was filled with rakeage after the storm stripped the trees. 暴風雨把樹葉打落後，整車都裝滿了耙集物。
He carried a rakeful of wet leaves to the fire pit. 他把一耙的濕葉搬到火坑旁。
Each rakeful cleared only a small strip of the muddy yard. 每耙一次都只能清出泥濘院子裡的一小條空地。
The play turns the handsome rakehell into a tragic figure by the end. 那齣戲把那位俊美的浪蕩子寫成最後的悲劇人物。
Everyone warned her not to trust a charming rakehell with a gambling habit. 大家都提醒她，不要相信一個又迷人又愛賭的浪蕩子。
The bar owner warned us about that rakehellish singer. 酒吧老闆提醒我們別靠近那個放蕩不羈的歌手。
The party took a rakehellish turn after midnight. 午夜過後，派對氣氛變得放縱失序。
He laughed rakehelly and spent the last of his pay in one night. 他像個浪蕩子似地大笑，並在一夜之間花光了最後的工資。
The memoir describes how he lived rakehelly in the port city. 那本回憶錄描述他如何在港口城市裡放蕩度日。
The gardener called for a raker after the leaves piled up. 園丁在落葉堆高後叫來耙葉工。
That greedy official was a raker of public funds. 那個貪心官員是搜刮公款的人。
The gossip column followed every new act of his rakery. 八卦專欄一路追著報導他每一次新的放蕩行徑。
Years of rakery left him famous but deeply in debt. 多年的放蕩生活讓他聲名狼藉，也債台高築。
The blacksmith tempered the rakesteel before shaping the teeth. 鐵匠先淬鍊耙齒鋼，再把它打成齒狀。
Good rakesteel keeps its edge even after long field work. 優質的耙用鋼材即使長時間在田裡使用，也能保持鋒利。
The rakestele cracked where the wood had dried too much. 那支耙柄因木頭太乾而裂開了。
He sanded the rakestele smooth so it would not blister his hands. 他把耙桿磨平，好讓雙手不會起水泡。
They swept the cold rakh from the oven before lighting a new fire. 他們在重新生火前先把爐子裡冰冷的灰燼掃出來。
The road crossed a stretch of dry rakh where little grew. 那條路穿過一片貧瘠粗礫地，幾乎長不出什麼植物。
Rakhal greeted us at the station with a wide, easy smile. 拉卡爾在車站用輕鬆燦爛的笑容迎接我們。
The diary records Rakhal as one of the poet's closest companions. 日記把拉卡爾記成那位詩人最親近的同伴之一。

meaning: 拉克酒，一種烈性茴香酒
sentences: The host poured a small glass of raki before dinner. 主人在晚餐前倒了一小杯拉克酒。
Cold water turned the raki cloudy and pale. 加了冷水後，那杯拉克酒變得乳白而混濁。
He tilted his hat rakily and walked into the casino. 他瀟灑地斜戴著帽子走進賭場。
The actor smiled rakily at the crowd from the stage door. 演員從舞台側門朝人群露出一個帶點浪子氣的笑容。
The photo used raking light to show the scratches. 那張照片用掠射光照出了刮痕。
She made a raking comment about his lazy excuse. 她尖刻地批評了他偷懶的藉口。

meaning: 瀟灑不羈的；帶點浪子氣的
sentences: He had a rakish grin that made strangers trust him too quickly. 他那抹帶點浪子氣的笑容，讓陌生人太快就對他產生信任。
The narrow boat looked elegant and rakish in the evening light. 那艘細長的小船在傍晚光線下顯得優雅又瀟灑。
He wore the scarf rakishly loose around his neck. 他把圍巾瀟灑地鬆鬆繞在脖子上。
The yacht leaned rakishly as it cut through the waves. 那艘遊艇在浪間穿行時帶著一種瀟灑的傾斜姿態。
His rakishness charmed some guests and annoyed others. 他的瀟灑不羈讓有些客人著迷，卻讓另一些人不快。
The painting captures the rakishness of a young officer at sea. 那幅畫捕捉到一名年輕海軍軍官的瀟灑氣質。
The old report describes the child as thin and rakit. 那份舊報告把那個孩子描述得瘦弱而佝僂。
A rakit frame suggested years of poor nutrition. 那種佝僂的體態顯示出多年營養不良。
The puppet show opened with a rakshasa at the gate. 布袋戲一開場就有一隻羅剎守在門口。
A rakshasa in the poem tricks travelers at night. 詩中的羅剎會在夜裡欺騙旅人。
She learned raku to create bowls with smoky crackled glaze. 她學習樂燒技法，好做出帶有煙燻裂紋釉色的碗。
A raku firing demands both timing and courage from the potter. 一次樂燒出窯對陶藝家而言既考驗時機，也考驗膽量。
Ralf checked the measurements twice before signing the form. 拉爾夫在簽表前把尺寸又核對了兩次。
The letter from Ralf arrived with pressed flowers inside. 拉爾夫寄來的信裡夾著壓乾的花。
The conductor signaled a gentle rallentando before the final chord. 指揮在最後一個和弦前示意全團稍微漸慢。
A tasteful rallentando gave the melody a sense of farewell. 一個得宜的漸慢讓旋律帶出告別感。
After a week of rest, she felt a clear ralliance of energy. 經過一週休息後，她明顯感到精神回復了。
The town hoped the new bridge would bring a ralliance of trade. 小鎮希望新橋能帶來商業的復甦。
Rallidae includes rails, coots, and their close relatives. 秧雞科包括秧雞、骨頂雞及其近親。
Birdwatchers in the marsh were hoping to spot a member of Rallidae. 在沼澤裡賞鳥的人希望能看到秧雞科的成員。
She became the rallier of the group when everyone else lost confidence. 當其他人都失去信心時，她成了召集並鼓舞大家的人。
The mayor was praised as a rallier after the storm damage. 暴風災過後，市長因凝聚人心而受到稱讚。
The chick has a ralliform body and long toes. 那隻幼鳥有秧雞般的身形和長腳趾。
We saw a ralliform bird slip through the reeds. 我們看見一隻秧雞形的鳥鑽過蘆葦叢。
The field guide places the species within Rallinae. 那本野外圖鑑把這個物種歸在秧雞亞科之中。
Several island birds in Rallinae evolved unusual habits after isolation. 秧雞亞科中的幾種島嶼鳥類在隔離後演化出不尋常的習性。

meaning: 秧雞類的；屬於秧雞科的
sentences: The bird guide noted a ralline species in the reeds. 那本鳥類圖鑑記下蘆葦間有一種秧雞類的鳥。
Her notes separated ralline birds from other marsh species. 她的筆記把秧雞類鳥和其他沼澤物種分開。
The specimen was placed in Rallus after closer study. 經過更細的研究後，該標本被歸入秧雞屬。
Birdwatchers looked for Rallus in the wet grass. 賞鳥者在濕草地裡尋找秧雞屬的鳥。
Thousands of people gathered at the political rally in the city center yesterday. 數千人昨天聚集在市中心的政治集會上。
The team managed to rally in the second half and win the match. 該隊在下半場成功重整旗鼓並贏得了比賽。
Ralph always carries a notebook in his jacket pocket. 拉爾夫總是在外套口袋裡放一本筆記本。
We waited for Ralph outside the station entrance. 我們在車站入口外等拉爾夫。
He had to ralph after the ferry ride. 他搭完渡輪後吐了。
Please pull over if you think you might ralph. 如果你覺得快吐了，請先靠邊停。

meaning: 拉爾斯托尼石；一種鹵化物礦物
sentences: The geologist spotted ralstonite in a tiny crystal vein. 地質學家在細小的晶脈中發現拉爾斯托尼石。
Collectors value ralstonite because it is rare and fragile. 收藏家珍視拉爾斯托尼石，因為它稀少又脆弱。
The desktop needs more RAM to run several programs at once. 這台桌上型電腦需要更多記憶體，才能同時執行好幾個程式。
Upgrading the ram made the old laptop feel much faster. 升級記憶體之後，那台舊筆電明顯快了很多。
A heavy ram pushed against the gate until it finally gave way. 一隻強壯的公羊把圍欄門頂到最後鬆開。
The shepherd kept one ram separate so the flock would stay calm. 牧羊人把一隻公羊分開飼養，免得羊群變得躁動。

meaning: 羅摩；印度史詩中的人物
sentences: Rama is an important figure in the Ramayana. 羅摩是《羅摩衍那》中的重要人物。
The play tells the story of Rama and Sita. 這齣戲講述羅摩與悉多的故事。
Rama stands beside Sita in the wall painting. 壁畫裡的羅摩站在悉多身旁。
My neighbor named his dog Rama after the epic hero. 我鄰居用史詩英雄的名字替狗取名。
We ate lunch under a ramada near the trail. 我們在步道旁的枝棚下吃午餐。
The ranch built a ramada for afternoon shade. 那座牧場搭了一座涼棚遮下午的太陽。
Ramadoss reviewed the contract before the meeting. 他在會議前檢視了合約。
The team counted on Ramadoss for careful work. 團隊仰賴他做事細心。
The fence was hidden by ramage by May. 到五月時，籬笆已被繁枝蓋住。
The path disappeared under the ramage of the hedge. 小徑被樹籬的叢生枝葉遮住了。
Ramaism shapes the songs sung at the festival. 羅摩信仰影響了節慶上吟唱的歌曲。
Her paper compares Ramaism with other devotional traditions. 她的報告比較了羅摩信仰與其他敬神傳統。
A Ramaite at the shrine handed us flowers. 神龕前的一位羅摩信徒遞花給我們。
The village still has a small Ramaite community. 那座村子現在仍有一小群羅摩信徒。

meaning: 枝狀的；與分枝或支脈有關的
sentences: The drawing showed a ramal vein in the leaf. 圖畫顯示葉片中的一條枝狀脈。
Doctors traced the ramal nerve toward the shoulder. 醫師沿著分枝神經追蹤到肩部。

meaning: 印度物理學家拉曼，或以其名衍生的姓氏
sentences: Raman was invited to speak about his research. 那位物理學家受邀談論他的研究。
Students still remember Raman when they study light. 學生們在學習光的時候仍會記得他的貢獻。
Ramanan stayed late to finish the community report. 他加班到很晚把社區報告完成。
Everyone trusted Ramanan to keep the records organized. 大家都信任他把紀錄整理得井井有條。

meaning: 文學上使用的梵語複數詞形
sentences: The manuscript used ramanas in an unusually old style. 這份手稿以一種很古老的風格使用拉瑪納斯。
The scholar explained why ramanas appeared in the verse. 那位學者解釋了拉瑪納斯為何出現在詩句裡。

meaning: 拉馬拉馬樹；新西蘭的一種樹或灌木
sentences: A ramarama grew beside the narrow track. 狹窄小徑旁長著一棵拉馬拉馬樹。
Birds fed on the ramarama berries in the morning. 早晨，鳥兒在拉馬拉馬的果實上覓食。
The toys ended up in a ramass under the bed. 玩具最後亂成一堆塞在床底下。
After the sale, boxes sat in a ramass by the door. 特賣結束後，一堆箱子亂放在門邊。
The fern had a ramate pattern along its stem. 那株蕨類沿著莖長出枝狀紋路。
A ramate shape can spread like a small tree. 分枝狀的形態會像小樹一樣伸展。
The collector kept a rambeh in a wooden case. 收藏家把一把傳統短刀收在木盒裡。
A rambeh with a carved handle hung on the wall. 一把刀柄雕花的傳統短刀掛在牆上。
The knight lifted the ramberge before entering the hall. 騎士走進大廳前舉起了長劍。
The curator explained how the ramberge was used in battle. 館員解釋了這把長劍在戰場上的用法。

meaning: 不停地說話或寫作，不清楚或語無倫次，有很多離題的內容。
sentences: Francine has a tendency to ramble when it gets to be late in the evening. 到了深夜，法蘭辛總喜歡胡言亂語。
She often rambles about bees' behavior, both in the hive and in the field. 她經常閒聊蜜蜂在蜂巢和田間的行為。
The rambler spent the morning on back roads. 那名漫遊者整個早上都走在鄉間小路上。
Our uncle is a rambler who never tells a short story. 我們叔叔很愛扯遠，從來不講短故事。
Her rambling voicemail lasted five minutes. 她那段漫無邊際的語音留言長達五分鐘。
We followed a rambling lane to the lake. 我們沿著蜿蜒小路走到湖邊。
He answered ramblingly and never reached the point. 他回答得東拉西扯，始終沒講到重點。
She spoke ramblingly on the phone while cooking. 她邊煮飯邊在電話裡漫無邊際地說個不停。
The ramblingness of the email hid the main question. 那封信太過散漫，主問題反而被埋沒了。
I trimmed the ramblingness from my speech before class. 我在上課前把講稿裡冗長散亂的部分刪掉。

meaning: 強悍好鬥的人；愛逞英雄的人
sentences: He tried to play Rambo, but the job needed patience. 他想扮演蘭博式人物，但這份工作需要耐心。
Nobody wanted a Rambo attitude during the negotiation. 談判時沒有人想看到蘭博式作風。
The yard had a rambong behind the house. 屋後院子有一棵熱帶無花果樹。
Fruit from the rambong fell after the storm. 暴雨後，那棵熱帶無花果樹掉了不少果子。
They used to rambooze after payday. 他們以前一發薪就去痛飲狂歡。
He swore he would not rambooze before the race. 他發誓比賽前不再酗酒胡鬧。
Rambouillet appears on the train line west of Paris. 蘭布耶位在巴黎西邊的鐵路線上。
The farm raises Rambouillet for fine wool. 那座農場飼養蘭布耶羊來取細羊毛。
The rambunctious kids bounced on every sofa cushion. 那群吵鬧好動的孩子把每個沙發墊都跳遍了。
Our rambunctious puppy knocked over the water bowl. 我們那隻精力過剩的小狗把水盆打翻了。
She peeled a ripe rambutan and offered the sweet fruit to her friend. 她剝開一顆熟透的紅毛丹，請朋友一起吃那甜美的果肉。
A basket of rambutan sat on the market table beside mangoes and bananas. 一籃紅毛丹擺在市場攤位上，旁邊是芒果和香蕉。
The label beside the ore sample said ramdohrite. 礦樣旁的標籤寫著拉姆多石。
A collector bought a tiny piece of ramdohrite at the fair. 收藏家在礦石展買了一小塊拉姆多石。
The old inventory lists rame among the metals in storage. 那份舊清單把銅列在庫存金屬之中。
A green stain on the tool suggested the presence of rame. 工具上的綠色污痕顯示其中含有銅質成分。
The decorator hung rameal patterns across the winter window display. 設計師在冬季櫥窗上掛上枝狀圖樣。
A rameal structure spread outward from the center of the fungus. 那種真菌從中心向外長出枝狀結構。
The plant grew in a Ramean pattern. 那株植物呈現分枝狀生長。
A Ramean chart helped explain the family lines. 分枝圖表有助於說明家族脈絡。
The ramed stem carried clusters of small flowers. 那條分枝的莖上帶著一簇簇小花。
A heavily ramed plant filled the whole corner of the greenhouse. 一株分枝繁多的植物幾乎占滿了溫室的一角。
The chef baked the custard in a white ramekin. 主廚把卡士達放在白色小烤盅裡烘烤。
Each guest received a warm ramekin of onion soup. 每位客人都得到一盅熱騰騰的洋蔥湯。
Under magnification, the lichen appears ramellose along the edges. 在放大觀察下，那種地衣邊緣呈現細枝狀。
The specimen's ramellose texture helped narrow its classification. 標本那種帶有細小分枝的質地，有助於縮小分類範圍。
The fern stem was covered with dry brown rament. 那株蕨類的莖上覆著乾燥的棕色薄鱗片。
A few rament fell away when the specimen was handled. 標本被拿起時，有幾片細碎屑片掉了下來。
The underside of the leaf is distinctly ramentaceous. 葉片背面明顯帶有鱗片狀構造。
A ramentaceous coating protected the young shoot in dry weather. 那層鱗片狀覆層在乾燥天氣中保護了嫩芽。
The fern showed a ramental coating near the bud. 那株蕨的芽附近有一層鱗片狀覆層。
A ramental surface made the young stem look dusty. 鱗片狀表面讓嫩莖看起來像蒙了灰。

meaning: 生有鱗片的；具碎屑片的
sentences: The young frond is strongly ramentiferous near the base. 那片幼嫩蕨葉在基部附近帶有明顯的鱗片構造。
A ramentiferous surface can be an important clue in plant identification. 帶鱗片的表面可能是辨識植物的重要線索。
The microscope slide revealed a single ramentum attached to the stalk. 顯微鏡玻片顯示莖上附著著一片薄鱗片。
A golden ramentum clung to the base of the leaf sheath. 一片金黃色的細屑黏在葉鞘基部。
The rameous coral formed a delicate fan in the tank. 那株枝狀珊瑚在水箱裡展成一把細緻的扇形。
A rameous outline spread across the frozen windowpane. 一道枝狀輪廓在結霜的窗玻璃上向外擴展。
The dessert arrived in a blue ramequin still warm from the oven. 甜點盛在一只藍色小烤盅裡端上來，還帶著烤箱餘溫。
She arranged six ramequin dishes on the tray for the guests. 她把六個焗烤小皿整齊擺在托盤上招待客人。

meaning: 拉美西斯；古埃及法老名
sentences: The documentary highlighted the monuments built under Rameses. 那部紀錄片聚焦介紹拉美西斯統治下興建的古蹟。
Many students first encounter the name Rameses in ancient history class. 許多學生第一次接觸這個名字，是在古代史課堂上。
Rameseum glowed pink in the first light of morning. 拉美西斯神廟在清晨第一道光裡泛著粉紅色。
We reached the Rameseum before the tour buses arrived. 我們在遊覽車到達前就先到了拉美西斯神廟。
Ramesh stayed late to finish the final set of calculations. 拉梅什留下來加班，把最後一組計算完成。
The invitation from Ramesh arrived with a handwritten note inside. 拉梅什寄來的邀請函裡還夾著一張手寫便條。

meaning: 拉美西斯王朝的人；拉美西斯王朝的
sentences: The sculpture is believed to date from the Ramessid period. 那尊雕像被認為可追溯到拉美西斯王朝時期。
A Ramessid inscription was found on the temple wall. 神廟牆上發現了一段屬於拉美西斯王朝的銘文。
The museum arranged the Ramesside artifacts in a separate gallery. 博物館把拉美西斯王朝的文物安排在獨立展廳中。
Ramesside architecture often emphasized scale and authority. 拉美西斯王朝的建築常強調宏偉與權威感。
Each ramet of the grass spread outward from the same parent plant. 那叢草的每一個分株都從同一母株向外擴展。
The ecologist counted every ramet before mapping the colony. 生態學家在繪製那片群落圖前，先數清每一個分株。
A broken ramex hung low after the heavy wind. 強風吹過後，一截折斷的枝條低低垂著。
The specimen kept a curious ramex shape even after drying. 那份標本即使乾燥後，仍保留著奇特的分枝輪廓。

meaning: 精疲力竭的；邋遢無力的
sentences: After the night shift, he looked completely ramfeezled. 值完夜班後，他看起來完全精疲力竭。
The hikers arrived at camp tired, muddy, and ramfeezled. 登山客們抵達營地時又累又髒，整個人疲憊不堪。

meaning: 莽撞自信的；冒失又有膽量的
sentences: His ramgunshoch decision nearly ruined the negotiation. 他那種莽撞自信的決定差點毀了整場談判。
A ramgunshoch driver sped through the village without slowing down. 那名冒失又大膽的駕駛穿過村子時完全沒有減速。
The shield was decorated with a bronze ramhead in the center. 那面盾牌中央飾有一個青銅公羊頭。
An old carving showed a priest wearing a ramhead mask. 一件古老雕刻描繪一名祭司戴著公羊頭面具。

meaning: 公羊狀態；雄性猛烈特性
sentences: The herder joked about the sudden ramhood of the young sheep. 牧人開玩笑說，那隻年輕羊突然顯出了公羊脾氣。
In the poem, ramhood stands for force and stubborn pride. 在那首詩裡，公羊性象徵力量和固執的驕傲。
The diagram labels the main nerve and its smaller rami. 圖中標示出主神經及其較小的各個分支。
Several rami extend from the vessel toward nearby tissue. 幾條分支從那條血管延伸到附近組織。

meaning: 有公羊角的；角如公羊的
sentences: The ancient helmet had a ramicorn design on both sides. 那頂古代頭盔兩側都帶有公羊角造型。
A ramicorn beast appears on the carved gatepost. 門柱雕刻上出現了一隻長著公羊角的獸。
The shirt was woven from ramie and felt cool in the heat. 那件襯衫以苧麻織成，在炎熱天氣裡穿起來很涼爽。
Ramie fibers are known for their strength and clean texture. 苧麻纖維以結實和清爽的手感聞名。
The young coral became strongly ramiferous in shallow water. 那株年輕珊瑚在淺水中長出大量分枝。
A ramiferous growth pattern made the shrub ideal for nesting birds. 多枝的生長型態讓那株灌木成了鳥類築巢的好地方。
The roots ramificate quickly in loose soil. 這種根在鬆土裡分枝很快。
One rumor can ramificate into several new problems. 一個謠言可能分化出好幾個新問題。
The first ramification of the delay was a missed shipment. 延誤帶來的第一個後果就是漏掉出貨。
Each legal ramification was explained before we signed. 簽名前，每一項法律上的連帶影響都有人說明。
The plant has ramified roots under the sand. 這株植物在沙地下有分枝密布的根。
Their ramified schedule confused every new employee. 他們錯綜複雜的時程讓每個新員工都搞混。
This ramiflorous shrub blooms along bare branches. 這種灌木會直接在光禿枝條上開花。
A ramiflorous tree can look pink before it leafs out. 這種枝上開花的樹還沒長葉前就會整株泛粉。
The river made a ramiform pattern on the map. 那條河在地圖上形成樹枝狀紋路。

The archive lists Ramusi among the early witnesses to the treaty. 檔案把拉穆西列為該條約的早期見證者之一。
Scholars are still debating whether Ramusi was a personal or tribal name. 學者們仍在爭論拉穆西究竟是人名還是族名。

meaning: 跑；奔跑，為 run 的過去式
sentences: She ran to the station when she realized the train was leaving. 她發現火車快開了，就立刻跑向車站。
The dog ran across the field and disappeared behind the trees. 那隻狗跑過田野，消失在樹後。

meaning: 蘭，北歐神話中的海神女
sentences: In Norse stories, Ran gathers the drowned into her net. 在北歐故事中，海神女蘭會把溺者收進自己的網裡。
The poet invoked Ran while describing the dark winter sea. 詩人在描寫冬日陰沉海面時提到了蘭。
Rana sat near the front row. 拉納坐在前排附近。
The invitation listed Rana as a special guest. 邀請函把拉納列為特別來賓。
The field guide places the common frog in the genus Rana. 那本圖鑑把普通青蛙歸入蛙屬。
Rana signed her name neatly at the bottom of the page. 拉娜把自己的名字工整地簽在頁面底端。
The biologist compared several ranal species from the wetland. 生物學家比較了來自那片濕地的幾種蛙屬物種。
A ranal call echoed from the reeds after sunset. 日落後，一陣與青蛙相關的叫聲從蘆葦叢傳來。
Older manuals place magnolias in Ranales. 較早的教材把木蘭歸進毛茛類舊目。
Ranales no longer matches modern plant classification. 毛茛類舊目已不符合現代植物分類。
The notebook included a ranarian sketch of tiny webbed feet. 那本筆記裡畫了一張與蛙類有關的細小蹼足草圖。
Her ranarian exhibit focused on frogs, toads, and their unusual life cycles. 她的蛙類展覽聚焦於青蛙、蟾蜍以及牠們特別的生命週期。
The school keeps a small ranarium in the science room. 學校在自然教室放了一個小養蛙箱。
We checked the ranarium after feeding the tadpoles. 餵完蝌蚪後，我們查看了養蛙箱。

meaning: 水蠍屬；一種長身的水棲昆蟲屬
sentences: The biologist identified the insect as Ranatra from its long sticklike body. 那位生物學家根據牠細長像棍子的身體，辨認出那是水蠍屬的昆蟲。
A single Ranatra drifted through the pond grass like a twig with legs. 一隻水蠍屬昆蟲穿過池邊水草，像帶腿的細枝一樣漂過去。
The butter had turned rance by the time we opened the picnic box. 我們打開野餐盒時，那塊奶油已經酸敗了。
He wrinkled his nose at the rance smell coming from the back of the fridge. 他對著冰箱後方飄出的腐臭味皺起了鼻子。
The rancel appeared in a dusty glossary. 這個罕見的舊詞出現在一本佈滿灰塵的詞彙表裡。
No one in class recognized the rancel at first. 起初班上沒有人認得這個舊詞。
The rancellor was listed among obsolete court titles. 這個舊式職稱被列在過時的宮廷官名之中。
Historians rarely agree on what a rancellor did. 歷史學家很少能一致說明這個職稱原本的職責。

meaning: 奧克尼與昔德蘭的舊制警吏
sentences: The record says a rancelman inspected the stolen sheep case. 紀錄寫著一名舊制警吏查辦了偷羊案。
A rancelman in Orkney handled minor crimes for the parish. 奧克尼的一名舊制警吏替教區處理輕罪案件。
The manuscript mentioned a rancer in the margin. 古手稿的邊註裡提到了一個罕見的古式名稱。
Nobody knew whether the rancer was a job or a nickname. 沒有人知道這個名稱究竟是職業還是綽號。

meaning: 開始酸敗的；逐漸變質的
sentences: The oil gave off a rancescent odor after sitting in the sun all afternoon. 那瓶油在太陽下放了一下午後，散出逐漸酸敗的氣味。
We tossed the rancescent nuts before they ruined the whole salad. 我們把開始變質的堅果丟掉了，免得整盤沙拉都被毀掉。
He spent his childhood on a large cattle ranch in the state of Texas. 他的童年是在德克薩斯州的一個大型養牛場（大牧場）度過的。
The movie features several beautiful scenes of cowboys working on a ranch. 電影中有幾幕牛仔在牧場工作的優美畫面。

meaning: 牧場；舊式拼法中的 ranch
sentences: The old map marked a ranche near the river bend. 那張舊地圖在河灣附近標了一座牧場。
She spent the summer on a ranche where horses grazed beside the fence. 她整個夏天都待在一座牧場裡，馬匹就在圍欄旁吃草。
The rancher checked the fences before sunrise. 牧場主在日出前先檢查了圍欄。
A rancher nearby raised cattle on dry grassland. 附近一位牧場主在乾燥的草地上飼養牛隻。
The road to the rancheria follows the dry creek bed. 通往那個原住民小聚落的路沿著乾涸溪床。
Families gathered in the rancheria for the evening meal. 各家人到那個牧場村一起吃晚飯。

meaning: 牧場主人；牧場工人，尤指西班牙語地區的稱呼
sentences: The ranchero rode out before sunrise to check the cattle. 那位牧場主人在日出前就騎馬出去查看牛群。
Everyone in town knew the ranchero by his wide hat and dusty boots. 鎮上的每個人都因那頂寬帽和滿是塵土的靴子認得那位牧場工人。

meaning: 沒有牧場的；缺乏牧場的
sentences: The family felt ranchless after selling the land to a developer. 這家人在把土地賣給開發商之後，覺得自己再也沒有牧場了。
His ranchless childhood made him dream about open fields and horses. 他沒有牧場的童年，讓他一直夢想著開闊草原和馬匹。
The ranchman checked the water trough before feeding the horses. 那位牧場工人在餵馬之前先檢查了水槽。
A tired ranchman can still recognize a storm by the smell of the wind. 疲憊的牧場主人仍然能從風中的氣味辨認出暴風雨。
The family spent the summer working on a rancho in northern Mexico. 那家人在墨西哥北部的一座大牧場度過了整個夏天。
Visitors rode horses across the wide rancho at sunset. 遊客在日落時騎馬穿過寬廣的大牧場。

meaning: 牧場女主人或牧場女工
sentences: The ranchwoman knew exactly which calf had wandered off at dusk. 那位牧場女工很清楚黃昏時是哪隻小牛走失了。
As a ranchwoman, she could mend a fence and saddle a horse without help. 身為牧場女主人，她不用別人幫忙就能修籬笆、替馬上鞍。
The butter smelled rancid after sitting in the heat all day. 那塊奶油在高溫下放了一整天後聞起來已經酸敗了。
He threw away the rancid oil before anyone used it for cooking. 他在有人拿那瓶油做菜前，就先把已經變質的油丟掉了。

meaning: 酸敗；變質成酸敗狀態的過程
sentences: The lab report described the rancidification of the sample oil over two weeks. 實驗報告描述了樣本油品在兩週內酸敗的過程。
Heat and moisture speed up rancidification in stored nuts and seeds. 熱和濕氣會加速儲存中的堅果與種子酸敗。
If you leave the butter near the window, the sun will rancidify it quickly. 如果你把奶油放在窗邊，太陽很快就會讓它酸敗。
The chef warned that bad storage can rancidify even expensive ingredients. 主廚警告說，保存不當連昂貴的食材也會變質。
A faint rancidity in the oil told us it was no longer fresh. 油裡那股淡淡的酸敗味告訴我們，它已經不新鮮了。
The label helps prevent rancidity by telling shoppers how to store the product. 標籤會提醒消費者如何保存產品，以避免酸敗。

meaning: 以酸敗的方式；令人作嘔地
sentences: The old cooking oil smelled rancidly from the corner of the kitchen. 那桶舊食用油從廚房角落散出令人作嘔的酸敗氣味。
He described the spoiled milk rancidly, which made everyone push the glass away. 他用一種很惡心的方式形容那杯壞掉的牛奶，讓大家都把杯子推遠了。
The rancidness of the leftovers made the whole apartment smell bad. 剩菜的酸敗味讓整間公寓都變得很難聞。
We threw away the sauce as soon as we noticed its rancidness. 我們一發現那醬汁已經有酸敗味，就立刻把它丟掉。
Their long rancor made every discussion tense. 他們長久的怨恨讓每次討論都緊繃起來。
She answered without rancor and ended the dispute. 她沒有帶著怨恨回答，終於化解了爭執。
Their rancorous argument lasted long after the guests had gone home. 賓客都回家後，他們那場充滿怨恨的爭吵還持續了很久。
The editor refused to publish such rancorous comments on the website. 編輯拒絕在網站上刊登那種充滿惡意的評論。
He spoke rancorously about the decision, even though the meeting was over. 會議明明已經結束了，他還是帶著怨恨地談論那個決定。
The two neighbors stared rancorously across the fence and said nothing. 那兩位鄰居隔著圍欄惡狠狠地互看，誰也沒開口。

meaning: 怨恨；惡意；充滿敵意的狀態
sentences: The rancorousness in the room vanished once someone opened the windows. 房間裡的怨恨氣氛在有人打開窗戶後就消失了。
She was tired of the rancorousness that followed every family dinner. 她已經受夠了每次家庭晚餐後都會出現的那種敵意。

meaning: 不易記仇的；不受怨恨影響的
sentences: He had a rancorproof way of answering criticism without losing his temper. 他有一種不易記仇的回應方式，面對批評也不會失控。
A good leader should be almost rancorproof when a project goes wrong. 一位好領導在計畫出錯時，應該幾乎不受怨氣影響。
They camped along the rand of the marsh. 他們在沼澤邊緣紮營。
The old map marked the rand with a thin line. 舊地圖用細線標出邊界。
Rand left his notebook on the desk. 蘭德把筆記本留在桌上。
Everyone remembered Rand because he spoke so clearly. 大家都記住了蘭德，因為他說話很清楚。
Randal arrived early for the meeting. 蘭道爾很早就來開會。
My cousin Randal can fix almost anything. 我表哥蘭道爾幾乎什麼都能修。
Randall signed the form with a steady hand. 蘭德爾用穩定的手勢簽了表格。
The teacher called on Randall to read first. 老師點了蘭德爾先朗讀。
Randallite formed a pale crust on the sample tray. 蘭德爾石在樣品盤上形成淡色薄殼。
The note says Randallite was found in a phosphate seam. 便條寫著蘭德爾石是在磷酸鹽礦層中發現的。

meaning: 狂歡式的酒宴或喧鬧聚會；舊式舞曲
sentences: The students ended finals week with a noisy randan downtown. 學生們在市中心用一場喧鬧的狂歡結束了期末週。
At the wedding, the randan kept the dancers moving past midnight. 在婚禮上，那段舊式舞曲讓舞者一直跳到午夜之後。
The mineral cabinet included a small piece of randannite. 那個礦物展示櫃裡放著一小塊蘭丹石。
She was thrilled to find randannite listed in the field guide. 她很高興在野外指南裡找到蘭丹石的條目。
Randell arrived early with a notebook full of questions. 藍道提早到了，手裡拿著一本寫滿問題的筆記本。
Everyone trusted Randell to keep the meeting calm and productive. 每個人都相信藍道能讓會議保持冷靜而有效率。
The horse made a wild randem toward the open gate. 那匹馬朝著打開的門口猛衝過去。
One randem from the frightened crowd nearly knocked him over. 驚慌人群的一次猛撞差點把他撞倒。
The villagers posted guards after a rander hit the barn. 掠奪者洗劫穀倉後，村民開始輪流守夜。
A rander grabbed the bag and ran into the fog. 一名掠奪者搶了袋子就跑進霧裡。
Randia grows well in warm coastal gardens. 蘭迪亞屬植物在溫暖的海邊花園長得很好。
The label says this thorny shrub belongs to Randia. 標籤寫著這株多刺灌木屬於蘭迪亞屬。
The cobbler replaced the worn randing along the boot sole. 鞋匠換掉了靴底邊緣磨損的鑲邊皮條。
Strong randing helps the shoe keep its shape in wet weather. 牢固的鞋邊鑲條能幫助鞋子在潮濕天氣裡保持形狀。
Randir signed the letter with a short note of thanks. 蘭迪爾在信末加了一小段致謝。
The story presents Randir as a cautious but loyal friend. 故事把蘭迪爾描寫成一位謹慎但忠誠的朋友。
The mineral sample was identified as Randite after laboratory analysis. 那塊礦物樣本在實驗分析後被辨認為藍迪石。
Randite is mostly mentioned in specialized geological catalogs. 藍迪石多半只出現在較專門的地質目錄裡。
The basket held together because the old randle was still strong. 那個籃子之所以沒有散掉，是因為舊支撐橫條還很牢固。
He cut a new randle to repair the broken frame. 他切了一根新的橫桿來修理損壞的框架。
Randolph asked the hardest question at the end of the lecture. 藍道夫在演講最後提出了最難的一個問題。
The letter from Randolph arrived together with the maps. 藍道夫寄來的信和地圖一起送到了。
The winners were chosen by a random selection from all the entries. 獲獎者是從所有參賽作品中隨機選出的。
The data points appeared to be scattered in a random pattern on the graph. 數據點在圖表上似乎呈隨機分佈。

meaning: 隨機存取記憶體；電腦記憶體
sentences: This laptop has sixteen gigabytes of random access memory. 這台筆電有十六 GB 隨機存取記憶體。
Adding random access memory can make an old computer faster. 增加記憶體能讓舊電腦跑得更快。

meaning: 有點隨機的；略顯雜亂的
sentences: The seating pattern looked randomish, but it had a hidden logic. 那個座位安排看起來有點隨機，其實背後有一套邏輯。
He gave a randomish answer because he had not read the report. 因為沒看過報告，他給了一個略顯隨意的回答。
The trial used randomization to avoid hidden bias. 那項試驗利用隨機化來避免隱藏偏差。
Good randomization can make two study groups more comparable. 良好的隨機化能讓兩組研究對象更容易比較。
The software can randomize the order of the questions instantly. 那套軟體能立刻把題目的順序隨機化。
Researchers decided to randomize the samples before testing them. 研究人員決定在檢測前先把樣本隨機分配。
I just randomly remembered this dream from 2 years ago. 我突然想起了兩年前的這個夢。
If someone acts randomly, they do so in a way that is in a random manner. 如果某人隨機行事，他們就會以隨機的方式這樣做。
A little randomness makes the card game exciting. 一點隨機性會讓紙牌遊戲更刺激。
We tested the randomness of the number generator twice. 我們測了兩次這個數字產生器的隨機性。
The names were drawn randomwise from a sealed box. 那些名字是從密封盒中隨機抽出的。
The lights seemed to flash randomwise across the stage. 那些燈光看起來在舞台上無規則地閃爍。
The movie used a randy joke that some viewers disliked. 那部電影用了讓部分觀眾不喜歡的好色笑話。
He apologized for the randy comment at dinner. 他為晚餐時那句好色的話道歉。
Randy brought coffee for the whole team before sunrise. 蘭迪在天亮前替整個團隊帶來了咖啡。
Everyone knew Randy as the first person to volunteer for extra work. 每個人都知道蘭迪總是第一個自願多做事的人。
Rane checked the door twice before bed. 拉內睡前把門檢查了兩次。
The program ended with a thank-you to Rane. 活動最後特別向拉內致謝。
The shell was cataloged under Ranella in the museum collection. 那枚貝殼在博物館藏品裡被歸在蛙螺屬之下。
Collectors admire Ranella for its heavy ridges and bold shape. 收藏家欣賞蛙螺屬外殼上厚實的稜紋與鮮明外形。
Ranere sent a careful reply after reading the full proposal. 拉內爾在讀完整份提案後寄來一封謹慎的回信。
The diary mentions Ranere only once, but the note is affectionate. 日記裡只提到拉內爾一次，語氣卻很親切。

meaning: 魁北克省的一長條矩形土地
sentences: The surveyor marked each rang on the map. 測量員在地圖上標出每一條長條土地。
Farmhouses lined the rang beside the road. 農舍沿著道路旁的長條土地排列開來。
The rangatira spoke first, and everyone else listened in silence. 那位毛利領袖先發言，其他人都安靜地聆聽。
A respected rangatira often carried both political and spiritual authority. 受人尊敬的毛利酋長往往同時具有政治與精神上的權威。
The shop sells a wide range of organic fruit and vegetables. 這家店銷售各式各樣的有機水果和蔬菜。
The temperatures can range from ten to thirty degrees Celsius. 氣溫可能在攝氏十度到三十度之間變化。

meaning: 排列好的；成行的；涵蓋範圍廣的
sentences: The chairs were neatly ranged along the wall. 那些椅子整齊地排列在牆邊。
Her interests ranged from music to marine biology. 她的興趣範圍很廣，從音樂到海洋生物學都有。
The poet imagined a rangeless sky above the dark plain. 那位詩人想像黑色平原上方有一片沒有邊界的天空。
In theory, the signal looked almost rangeless. 理論上，那個訊號看起來幾乎沒有明顯界限。

meaning: 牧場管理員；靶場管理員
sentences: The rangeman rode out at dawn to check the cattle fences. 那位牧場管理員在黎明時騎馬外出檢查牛欄圍籬。
A good rangeman knows every water source on the open land. 優秀的牧場管理員熟悉開闊土地上的每一處水源。
A park ranger warned us not to feed the wild animals. 一名國家公園的巡守員提醒我們不要餵食野生動物。
The ranger checked the trail after the storm had passed. 暴風雨過後，那名護林員去檢查步道狀況。
She accepted the rangership of the forest district last spring. 她在去年春天接下了那片森林分區的巡守職位。
The novel treats rangership as a lonely but honorable duty. 那部小說把這份巡守職責寫成孤獨卻光榮的工作。
Years of rangework had made him tough and patient. 多年的牧場工作讓他變得堅韌而有耐性。
The camp provided water, tools, and shelter for summer rangework. 營地為夏季的牧場作業提供水、工具與住宿。

meaning: 修長靈活的；活動範圍大的
sentences: The colt grew into a rangey animal with a long, easy stride. 那匹小馬長成了一隻修長靈活、步伐輕鬆的動物。
A rangey midfielder can cover both wings during a match. 一名活動範圍大的中場球員在比賽中能兼顧左右兩翼。
The museum display grouped reindeer fossils under Rangifer. 博物館展區把馴鹿化石歸在馴鹿屬之下。
Rangifer is important in studies of Arctic animal migration. 馴鹿屬在北極動物遷徙研究中相當重要。

meaning: 馴鹿屬的；與馴鹿有關的
sentences: The paleontologist compared several rangiferine antler patterns. 那位古生物學家比較了幾種與馴鹿有關的鹿角形態。
Rangiferine traits can be seen in the bone structure of the specimen. 那份標本的骨骼結構上可以看出馴鹿屬相關特徵。
The horse's ranginess made it ideal for long distances. 那匹馬修長靈活的體態，使它非常適合長途移動。
Fans admired the ranginess of the young striker. 球迷欣賞那位年輕前鋒活動範圍大又靈活的特質。
Laser ranging gave the team a precise distance to the cliff face. 雷射測距讓團隊能精準算出峭壁距離。
The discussion covered topics ranging from farming to philosophy. 那場討論涵蓋了從農業到哲學等廣泛主題。
The loose metal sheets began to rangle in the wind. 鬆動的鐵片開始在風中發出喧鬧聲。
Years of neglect had let weeds rangle the once neat path. 多年的荒廢讓雜草把原本整齊的小路弄得凌亂不堪。
The rangler spent the afternoon checking the outer fence line. 那名牧場工人花了一整個下午檢查外圍圍欄。
Every experienced rangler knew where the horses liked to rest. 每位有經驗的巡場者都知道馬喜歡在哪裡休息。

meaning: 高瘦而靈活的；延展開的
sentences: The rangy dog crossed the field in a few long leaps. 那隻高瘦靈活的狗用幾個大步就穿過了田野。
He had a rangy frame that made him look taller than he was. 他那種修長的身形讓他看起來比實際更高。
The rani greeted visitors from a shaded balcony. 那位王妃在有遮棚的陽台上迎接來客。
A portrait of the rani hangs near the stairs. 樓梯旁掛著那位女王的肖像。
The ranid leapt into the grass before I could take a photo. 那隻蛙科動物在我來得及拍照前就跳進了草叢。
Scientists often compare ranid frogs when studying wetland habitats. 科學家研究濕地棲地時，常會拿蛙科青蛙來比較。
The guidebook explained that Ranidae includes many common frogs. 那本指南說明，蛙科包含許多常見的青蛙。
Researchers tagged the specimen as part of Ranidae after a careful review. 研究人員經過仔細檢查後，把那個標本標記為蛙科的一員。
The raniferous marsh was full of croaks after sunset. 那片產蛙的沼澤在日落後充滿了蛙鳴。
A raniferous pond can sound louder than a busy street at night. 一個有很多青蛙的池塘，在夜裡聽起來可能比熱鬧的街道還吵。
The artist carved a raniform ornament for the garden fountain. 那位藝術家替花園噴泉刻了一個蛙形裝飾。
Under the lamp, the raniform shadow looked almost alive. 在燈光下，那個蛙形影子看起來幾乎像活的一樣。
Ranina is a genus of crabs. 蛙蟹屬是一個螃蟹屬名。
The student drew a Ranina crab for the marine biology project. 學生為海洋生物作業畫了一隻蛙蟹屬螃蟹。
Raninae belongs within a broader crab family. 蛙蟹亞科屬於更大的螃蟹科群。
The chart placed Raninae below the family name. 圖表把蛙蟹亞科放在科名下面。
The toy has a ranine face and huge eyes. 那個玩具有一張蛙狀的臉和大眼睛。
A ranine shape appeared in the marsh mud. 沼澤泥地上出現了一個蛙狀輪廓。

meaning: 與 Ranina 有關的；蛙蟹類的
sentences: The paper described a raninian specimen collected from shallow water. 那篇論文描述了一個從淺水採集到的蛙蟹類標本。
Its raninian features were enough for the class to identify it quickly. 牠那些與 Ranina 相關的特徵，讓全班很快就能辨認出來。
The field guide noted that the snake was ranivorous. 那本野外指南註明，這條蛇是食蛙的。
A ranivorous bird can help control frog populations in the marsh. 食蛙的鳥類可以幫助控制沼澤中的青蛙數量。
Ranjit greeted us with a warm smile. 蘭吉特帶著溫暖的笑容向我們打招呼。
Everyone listened when Ranjit started to explain the plan. 當蘭吉特開始說明計畫時，大家都安靜聆聽。
He holds a high rank in the military and has a lot of experience. 他在軍中擔任高階職務且擁有豐富經驗。
Taipei is ranked as one of the best cities to live in Asia. 台北被評為亞洲最適合居住的城市之一。
The coach ranked the runners after the race. 教練在比賽後為跑者排定名次。
She ranked the tasks by urgency. 她依緊急程度為任務排了順序。

meaning: 軍隊中的士兵；列兵；下層階級的人
sentences: The ranker stood at attention while the officers reviewed the parade. 軍隊裡的列兵在軍官檢閱隊伍時立正站好。
He was a ranker who earned respect by working harder than anyone expected. 他原本只是個普通士兵，卻靠著比誰都努力而贏得尊重。
Her tennis ranking improved after the tournament. 比賽後，她的網球排名進步了。
The website shows the ranking of the most popular songs. 這個網站顯示最受歡迎歌曲的排名。

meaning: 略帶粗臭味的；有點繁茂而粗野的
sentences: The rankish cheese was too strong for my taste. 那塊略帶粗臭味的起司對我來說味道太重了。
By midsummer, the rankish weeds had taken over the garden path. 到了仲夏，那些有點繁茂又粗野的雜草已經佔滿了花園小徑。
The unfair comment continued to rankle long after the meeting ended. 那句不公平的評論在會議結束後仍然讓人耿耿於懷。
It still rankles him that he was not invited to the ceremony. 他到現在還對自己沒被邀請參加典禮這件事感到不快。

meaning: 沒有等級的；沒有地位的
sentences: The rankless volunteers worked side by side with the staff. 那些沒有等級之分的志工和工作人員並肩工作。
In his rankless early days, he slept wherever there was space. 在他還沒有地位的早期日子裡，有空位他就睡哪裡。

meaning: 令人惱火地；使人耿耿於懷地
sentences: The issue was ranklingly unresolved even after three rounds of talks. 即使經過三輪談判，這件事還是令人惱火地沒有解決。
She ranklingly remembered the promise he had broken. 她總是帶著一股難以釋懷的情緒記起他違背的承諾。
The vines grew rankly along the old stone wall. 那些藤蔓沿著古老的石牆茂盛地生長。
She spoke rankly about the mistakes instead of softening the truth. 她坦率地談論那些錯誤，沒有把真相說得太委婉。

meaning: 粗臭；茂盛而粗野的狀態
sentences: The rankness of the swamp air hit us as soon as we opened the hatch. 我們一打開艙門，就立刻聞到沼澤空氣中的粗臭味。
The rankness of the weeds made the fence line hard to see. 雜草長得太茂盛又粗野，讓圍欄線幾乎看不見。
The ranksman followed the orders without hesitation. 那名列兵毫不猶豫地服從命令。
As a ranksman, he cared more about his unit than about medals. 身為普通士兵，他比起勳章，更在乎自己的單位。
The list was arranged rankwise from the most senior to the newest member. 名單是按等級排列的，從資深者排到最新成員。
Rankwise, she was below the manager but above the rest of the team. 按職等來看，她在經理之下，但高於團隊其他人。

meaning: 鹽沼；鹽漠，尤指印度和巴基斯坦一帶的 Rann
sentences: The caravan crossed the rann under a white, empty sky. 那支商隊在一片蒼白空曠的天空下穿越鹽漠。
During the dry season, the rann looked like a plain of cracked salt. 旱季時，那片鹽沼看起來就像一整片龜裂的鹽地。
A shallow rannel cut across the pasture after the storm. 暴風雨過後，牧場上出現了一條淺淺的細溝。
Water from the spring gathered in the rannel before slipping into the field. 泉水先匯進那條細溝，接著才流入田裡。

meaning: 粗野喧鬧的；吵鬧不安的
sentences: The rannigal crowd kept shouting long after the band had left. 那群吵鬧的人在樂團離開後還一直喧嘩。
Even the patient teacher looked tired of the rannigal behavior in class. 連一向有耐性的老師，也對班上的粗野吵鬧感到疲憊。
That ranny started yelling before anyone sat down. 那個愛鬧事的人還沒坐下就開始大喊。
The shop owner banned the ranny after last week's fight. 店主在上週吵架後禁止那個潑辣女人再進店。

meaning: 阿根廷的倫克爾族；倫克爾人
sentences: The museum exhibit explained how the Ranquel lived on the open plains. 博物館展覽說明了倫克爾人如何在廣闊的草原上生活。
Many Ranquel families still protect their traditions and language today. 許多倫克爾家族至今仍在守護他們的傳統與語言。
Burglars ransacked the apartment and left drawers open everywhere. 竊賊把公寓洗劫一空，抽屜也全都被拉開。
She had to ransack her desk before she found the missing receipt. 她把書桌翻了個底朝天，才找到那張不見的收據。

meaning: 洗劫者；翻找得很徹底的人
sentences: The police identified the ransacker from a blurry security video. 警方根據一段模糊的監視畫面認出了那名洗劫者。
As a child, he was a harmless ransacker of kitchen cabinets and candy jars. 小時候的他只是個會亂翻廚櫃和糖罐的搗蛋鬼。

meaning: 被翻得亂七八糟的；遭洗劫後雜亂的
sentences: The attic looked ransackle after years of careless storage. 經過多年雜亂堆放後，閣樓看起來亂成一團。
We stepped into a ransackle room that had clearly been searched in a hurry. 我們走進一間明顯被匆忙搜過的凌亂房間。
The hiker strapped his ransel on and headed for the ridge. 那名登山客背好背包，便朝山稜出發。
In old paintings, soldiers often carried a ransel over one shoulder. 在古畫裡，士兵常把行軍背囊掛在一側肩上。

meaning: 背著行囊的人；行軍背包兵
sentences: The ranselman moved ahead of the caravan with an easy stride. 那名背行囊的人步伐輕快地走在商隊前面。
Every ranselman in the story looked prepared for a long and dusty road. 故事裡的每個背包兵看起來都已準備好走上一條漫長而塵土飛揚的路。

meaning: 為釋放人質所支付的費用。
sentences: They were held for two million dollars ransom. 他們被扣留，要求 200 萬美元的贖金。
They were held to ransom. 他們被勒索贖金。
The smugglers thought the cargo was ransomable. 走私者認為這批貨可以拿來勒索贖金。
Any ransomable hostage needs immediate rescue planning. 任何可被索贖的人質都需要立刻安排營救。
The ransomer arrived with cash in a plain bag. 付贖者提著素色袋子帶來現金。
A worried ransomer waited by the bridge at dawn. 一名焦急的付贖者在天亮時等在橋邊。

meaning: 無須贖金的；免費贖回的
sentences: The treaty allowed ransomfree release of wounded captives. 那項條約允許受傷俘虜無須贖金即可獲釋。
The child was returned ransomfree after the mistake was discovered. 真相大白後，那個孩子被無償送了回來。

meaning: 未被贖回的；無贖金可付的
sentences: The ransomless prisoners remained in the fortress through winter. 那些無人付贖金的囚犯整個冬天都被關在堡壘裡。
A ransomless hostage had little hope in those brutal times. 在那個殘酷的年代，無人贖回的人質幾乎沒有希望。
Smoke rose quietly from the ranstead at the edge of the moor. 荒原邊那處農舍場院靜靜升起炊煙。

His rant filled the room with frustration. 他那段長篇怒罵讓整個房間都充滿挫折感。

The alley was full of the rantan of pans, voices, and barking dogs. 巷子裡充滿鍋盆敲擊聲、叫喊聲與狗吠交雜的喧鬧。
We heard the rantan of carts long before we saw the market. 我們還沒看見市場，就先聽到車輛鏗鏘作響的雜聲。
The old mechanic was skilled but notoriously rantankerous. 那位老技師技術很好，但脾氣暴躁得出了名。
A rantankerous guest can ruin the mood of an entire dinner. 一位愛爭吵的客人足以破壞整場晚餐的氣氛。

sentences: The crowd listened politely until the ranter lost control of his temper. 人群原本還算客氣地聽著，直到那名咆哮演說者失控發火。

meaning: 狂喊派思想；激進咆哮式主張
sentences: The pamphlet warns against the excesses of Ranterism. 那本小冊子警告人們提防狂喊派思想的極端傾向。
Historians treat Ranterism as a small but noisy current in religious debate. 歷史學家把狂喊派看成宗教爭論中規模不大卻十分喧鬧的一支。

The speech slipped from criticism into pure ranting. 那場演說從批評慢慢滑向毫無節制的怒吼。
He spoke rantingly for fifteen minutes without taking a breath. 他連珠炮似地咆哮了十五分鐘，幾乎沒換氣。
The caller complained rantingly about a problem nobody could verify. 那通電話裡的人用憤怒大叫的方式抱怨一個誰都無法證實的問題。

meaning: 胡鬧的人；放蕩的年輕人
sentences: Her grandfather still remembered being called a rantipole in his youth. 她的祖父仍記得年輕時常被人叫作胡鬧鬼。
The play presents the prince as a rantipole before he matures. 那齣戲把王子描寫成一個在成熟前愛胡鬧的年輕人。
One hard rantock on the rope nearly tore the knot loose. 那條繩子被猛力一扯，結差點就鬆開了。
We heard the rantock of chains from the dark shed. 我們聽見黑暗棚屋裡傳來鐵鍊被粗暴扯動的聲音。

meaning: 愛咆哮的；動不動就怒罵的
sentences: The review called the film clever but a bit ranty in tone. 那篇影評說這部片很聰明，只是語氣有點太咆哮了。
He gets ranty whenever the topic turns to politics. 只要話題轉到政治，他就會變得愛怒罵。
The dentist recognized the swelling as a ranula beneath the tongue. 牙醫辨認出舌頭下方的腫脹其實是舌下囊腫。
A large ranula can interfere with speech and swallowing. 較大的舌下囊腫可能影響說話和吞嚥。

meaning: 舌下囊腫的；似小囊泡的
sentences: The surgeon described the mass as ranular in appearance. 外科醫師把那個腫塊描述為帶有舌下囊腫樣外觀。
A ranular swelling usually needs careful examination before treatment. 類似舌下囊腫的腫脹通常需要在治療前仔細檢查。
Ranunculaceae includes buttercups, anemones, and many poisonous plants. 毛茛科包括毛茛、銀蓮花與許多有毒植物。
The field guide grouped the specimen under Ranunculaceae after flowering. 那本野外圖鑑在植物開花後把標本歸入毛茛科。
The botanist noted several ranunculaceous traits in the leaves and flowers. 植物學家注意到這株植物的葉與花具有多項毛茛科特徵。
Some ranunculaceous species are beautiful but highly toxic. 有些毛茛科植物雖然美麗，卻毒性很強。
The professor placed the family within Ranunculales on the phylogenetic chart. 教授在系統發育圖上把這個科放進毛茛目。
Older classifications treated Ranunculales somewhat differently from modern systems. 較舊的分類法對毛茛目的處理方式和現代系統不太相同。

meaning: 毛茛屬植物；毛茛的複數
sentences: Yellow ranunculi brightened the wet meadow in spring. 春天時，黃色的毛茛花點亮了潮濕的草地。
The gardener planted several ranunculi along the stone border. 園丁沿著石頭邊界種了好幾株毛茛。
The species was cataloged under Ranunculus after close study. 經過仔細研究後，這個物種被歸入毛茛屬。
Many gardeners know Ranunculus for its bright layered blooms. 許多園藝愛好者因那層層鮮豔花瓣而認識毛茛屬植物。
Marine biologists identified the specimen as belonging to Ranzania. 海洋生物學家把那個標本辨認為翻車魨屬成員。
Ranzania is mentioned far less often than larger sunfish genera. 和較大型的翻車魚屬相比，翻車魨屬較少被提及。
The alpine garden included several mats of Raoulia between the rocks. 那座高山花園在岩石之間種了幾叢勞利亞屬植物。
Raoulia is prized for its compact silver cushions in cold climates. 勞利亞屬植物因在寒冷氣候中形成緊密的銀色墊狀外觀而受到珍視。
He enjoys listening to rap music and wants to become a professional rapper. 他喜歡聽饒舌音樂，並想成為一名專業饒舌歌手。
She rapped on the wooden door several times, but nobody answered her. 她在木門上敲了幾下，但沒人應門。
Older bird books group hawks under Rapaces. 較早的鳥類書把鷹隼歸在猛禽類舊稱之下。
Rapaces is useful when reading older zoology notes. 讀早年的動物學筆記時，猛禽類舊稱這個詞很常見。
The sculptor gave the creature a rapaceus profile with a hooked beak. 雕塑家把那生物塑造成帶有猛禽般輪廓與鉤喙的樣子。
His rapaceus style of negotiation made everyone uneasy. 他那種掠奪性的談判方式讓所有人都感到不安。
The company was accused of rapacious pricing after the shortage. 缺貨之後，那家公司被指控採取了貪婪掠奪式的定價。
A rapacious landlord can drain an already poor neighborhood. 一位貪婪的房東可能把本已貧困的社區榨得更乾。
The investors moved rapaciously to buy every available lot. 投資人們貪婪地搶購每一塊可得的土地。
The animal fed rapaciously before the others could approach. 那隻動物在其他同伴靠近前就貪婪地進食。
The novel portrays the rapaciousness of a city consumed by greed. 那部小說描寫了一座被貪欲吞噬的城市及其掠奪性。

The judge condemned the rapacity behind the fraud scheme. 法官譴責了那場詐騙計畫背後的貪婪本質。
Unchecked rapacity can turn a public service into a private racket. 不受節制的貪婪可能把公共服務變成私人牟利工具。

meaning: 球粒花崗岩；拉帕基維花崗岩
sentences: The quarry is famous for a coarse pink rapakivi used in monuments. 那座採石場以出產用於紀念建築的粉紅色球粒花崗岩聞名。
Geology students examined the texture of rapakivi under the hand lens. 地質系學生用放大鏡觀察了球粒花崗岩的紋理。

meaning: 義大利利古里亞海岸的拉帕洛；拉帕洛條約
sentences: We spent a quiet afternoon in Rapallo, watching boats move along the harbor. 我們在拉帕洛度過安靜的午後，看著船隻穿過港灣。
History students still discuss the Treaty of Rapallo for its political impact. 歷史學生至今仍會談論《拉帕洛條約》的政治影響。
Rapanea lined the windy path above the beach. 海灘上方迎風的小路兩側長著紫金牛屬植物。
The nursery sold a Rapanea shrub in a clay pot. 苗圃賣著一盆紫金牛屬灌木。

meaning: 拉帕特科；一類熱帶開花植物科
sentences: Botanists added the plant to Rapateaceae after studying its flowers. 植物學家研究它的花朵後，把它歸入拉帕特科。
Rapateaceae is a small family, but its species can be quite distinctive. 拉帕特科雖然是個小科，但其中物種的特色相當鮮明。

meaning: 拉帕特科的；屬於拉帕特科的
sentences: The rapateaceous specimen surprised the students with its unusual flower head. 那株拉帕特科植物以不尋常的花序讓學生們驚訝。
Her notes described a rapateaceous plant collected from the wet tropical forest. 她的筆記記錄了一株採自潮濕熱帶森林的拉帕特科植物。

A rape case can take years to finish in court. 一件強姦案件在法院可能拖上好幾年。

meaning: 帶有暴力掠奪意味的；殘虐貪婪的
sentences: The poem warned against rapeful men who ruined whole villages. 那首詩警告人們要提防會摧毀整個村落的暴虐之徒。
His rapeful ambition left no room for mercy or restraint. 他那種帶有掠奪性的野心，完全沒有寬容或節制的空間。

Farmers harvested rapeseed in late spring and sent it to the mill. 農夫在晚春收割油菜籽，再送往榨油廠。
Rapeseed oil has a mild flavor, so it works well in everyday cooking. 芥花油味道溫和，因此很適合日常烹調。
Raphael painted soft faces and clear skies. 拉斐爾筆下的人臉柔和，天空也很明淨。
My cousin chose Raphael for his baptism name. 我表弟替自己選了拉斐爾作為洗禮名。

meaning: 拉斐爾風格的；優雅和諧的
sentences: The portrait had a Raphaelesque calm that softened every line. 那幅肖像帶著拉斐爾式的安詳，連每一道線條都顯得柔和。
Her teacher praised the Raphaelesque balance of color and composition. 她的老師稱讚那幅作品在色彩與構圖上有拉斐爾式的平衡感。

meaning: 拉斐爾式的；理想化美感的
sentences: The chapel ceiling had a Raphaelic grace that drew every visitor upward. 禮拜堂天花板帶著拉斐爾式的優雅，讓每位訪客都忍不住抬頭。
She described the painting as Raphaelic because of its serene faces. 她把那幅畫形容為拉斐爾式的，因為人物的表情十分安寧。

meaning: 拉斐爾風格；對拉斐爾藝術原則的推崇
sentences: The professor explained Raphaelism as a love of harmony, clarity, and ideal beauty. 教授把拉斐爾主義解釋為對和諧、清晰與理想美的熱愛。
Raphaelism influenced several painters who wanted order instead of drama. 拉斐爾主義影響了幾位更偏好秩序而非戲劇效果的畫家。

meaning: 拉斐爾派的；拉斐爾風格追隨者
sentences: He called himself a Raphaelite and admired classical proportions. 他自稱是拉斐爾派，崇尚古典比例。
The gallery featured work by a Raphaelite who painted with remarkable restraint. 畫廊展出了一位拉斐爾派畫家的作品，筆觸克制卻相當出色。

meaning: 拉斐爾主義；崇尚拉斐爾風格的傾向
sentences: The critic said the school showed too much Raphaelitism and not enough risk. 那位評論家說，這個畫派太過崇尚拉斐爾風格，缺少冒險精神。
Raphaelitism can sound old-fashioned, yet many artists still admire it. 拉斐爾主義聽起來或許有些老派，但許多藝術家仍然欣賞它。
The clinic suspected raphania after the foraged meal. 那餐採集野菜後，診所懷疑是野蘿蔔中毒。
Old farm records mention raphania in bad seed years. 舊農務紀錄提到歉收年份曾出現野蘿蔔中毒。
Raphanus includes the radish sold at our market. 蘿蔔屬包含我們市場裡賣的蘿蔔。
The seed packet lists Raphanus on the back. 種子包背面列著蘿蔔屬名稱。
The article links raphany to contaminated seed meals. 那篇文章把蘿蔔中毒和受污染的種子餐點聯繫起來。
The villagers still feared raphany, even though it was rare. 村民雖然知道蘿蔔中毒少見，還是很害怕。
The seed shows a pale raphe along one side. 那顆種子一側有一道淡色脊線。
A raphe ran down the middle of the tissue. 那片組織中央有一道縫線。

meaning: 拉菲亞棕櫚屬；可提供纖維的棕櫚
sentences: Raphia palms grow tall and dramatic near wetlands. 拉菲亞棕櫚常在濕地附近長得高大而醒目。
The basket was woven from fibers taken from a Raphia leaf. 那個籃子是用拉菲亞棕櫚葉的纖維編成的。

meaning: 針晶；植物細胞中的針狀結晶
sentences: Under the microscope, a single raphide looked like a tiny needle. 在顯微鏡下，一個針晶看起來就像細小的針。
Some plants use raphide to discourage animals from eating them. 有些植物利用針晶來讓動物不敢吃它們。

meaning: 針晶複數；植物中的針狀結晶群
sentences: The leaf cells were packed with raphides that sparkled under the slide. 葉片細胞裡充滿針晶，在玻片下閃閃發亮。
Botany students learned that raphides often help defend the plant. 植物學學生學到，針晶常常是植物的防禦方式之一。

meaning: 含針晶的；能產生針狀結晶的
sentences: The raphidiferous tissue made the plant unpleasant to chew. 那種含針晶的組織讓這株植物嚼起來很不舒服。
A raphidiferous species may protect itself with microscopic crystals. 含針晶的物種有時會靠微小結晶保護自己。

meaning: 蛇蛉科昆蟲；蛇蛉科成員
sentences: The raphidiid rested on the window screen with its long body stretched out. 那隻蛇蛉科昆蟲伸展著細長身體，停在紗窗上。
He was surprised to learn that a raphidiid is a harmless predator of small insects. 他很驚訝地發現，蛇蛉科昆蟲其實是捕食小型昆蟲的無害獵手。
Raphidiidae includes insects with delicate wings and elongated necks. 蛇蛉科包含翅膀纖細、頸部細長的昆蟲。
The textbook placed the specimen in Raphidiidae after a close examination. 教科書在仔細檢查後，把那個標本歸入蛇蛉科。
Raphidodea appears in older insect catalogs. 舊版昆蟲名錄裡會出現蛇蛉類群這個名稱。
The fossil may belong to Raphidodea rather than a beetle line. 這塊化石可能屬於蛇蛉類群，而不是甲蟲支系。

meaning: 蛇蛉總科；蛇蛉相關的昆蟲總科
sentences: The guidebook listed Raphidoidea among the more ancient insect groups. 那本導覽書把蛇蛉總科列為較古老的昆蟲類群之一。
Students were asked to compare Raphidoidea with other winged orders. 老師要求學生把蛇蛉總科和其他有翅目做比較。

meaning: 石斑木屬；常見園藝灌木屬
sentences: Raphiolepis is popular in gardens because it stays neat all year. 石斑木屬植物因為四季都保持整齊，常被種在庭園裡。
The shrub outside the cafe was a Raphiolepis with thick, shiny leaves. 咖啡館外的灌木是一株葉片厚實油亮的石斑木。
A visible raphis ran down the shell like a pale seam. 一條清楚的縫線像淡色接縫一樣沿著貝殼延伸下來。
The microscope slide showed a raphis that divided the structure cleanly. 顯微鏡切片顯示出一條把結構清楚分開的脊線。
Her rapic reply ended the conversation before it could grow awkward. 她迅速的回覆讓對話在變得尷尬前就結束了。
The rapic change in weather caught everyone off guard. 天氣的急遽變化讓每個人都措手不及。
The city has experienced rapid economic growth in recent years. 這座城市近年來經歷了快速的經濟增長。
There has been a rapid improvement in his health over the week. 他的健康狀況在這一週內有了迅速的改善。
The rapidity of the storm surprised even the weather forecasters. 那場風暴來得太快，連氣象預報員都很意外。
She admired the rapidity with which the team solved the problem. 她很佩服團隊解決問題的速度。
She packed her case rapidly and hurried out. 她迅速收拾好行李，匆匆出門。
If someone acts rapidly, they do so in a way that is with speed; in a rapid manner. 如果某人行動迅速，那麼他們就是以快速的方式行事；快速地。
The rapidness of the train made the short trip feel effortless. 火車的快速讓這段短程旅途幾乎毫不費力。
He measured the rapidness of the response as a sign of good planning. 他把回應的迅捷視為計畫周全的表現。
The actor wore a rapier at his side during the stage duel. 這位演員在舞台決鬥時腰間佩著一把細長的刺劍。
His rapier flashed in the light before the scene ended. 場景結束前，他的輕劍在燈光下閃了一下。

meaning: 佩劍的；像細劍一樣銳利的
sentences: The rapiered guard stood motionless at the palace door. 那名佩劍守衛一動不動地站在宮門前。
She answered with rapiered wit that left the room silent. 她以如劍般銳利的機智回應，讓整個房間都安靜了下來。

meaning: 輕敲聲；小而短促的敲擊
sentences: I heard a rapillo on the door, just soft enough to miss at first. 我聽見門上傳來輕敲聲，輕得一開始幾乎沒注意到。
The rapillo of rain on the roof kept him awake for hours. 雨點在屋頂上的輕敲聲讓他好幾個小時都睡不著。
The soldiers were accused of rapine after the city fell. 城市失守後，那些士兵被指控犯下劫掠行為。
The novel shows how rapine destroys trust faster than war itself. 那部小說呈現出，劫掠如何比戰爭本身更快摧毀信任。
The rapiner vanished into the forest with stolen food and tools. 那名掠奪者帶著偷來的食物和工具消失在森林裡。
History remembers him less as a king and more as a rapiner. 歷史記住他的，與其說是國王，不如說是掠奪者。
The officer stopped the suspect before he could continue raping the victim. 警官在嫌犯繼續施暴前就將他制止。
The report documented the trauma caused by raping and other violence. 報告記錄了強暴與其他暴力造成的創傷。

meaning: 掠奪性的；充滿劫掠意味的
sentences: The rapinic raid stripped the village of almost everything useful. 那場掠奪式突襲幾乎把村子裡所有有用的東西都搶光了。

The old coat was made of raploch and felt scratchy against the skin. 那件舊外套是用粗呢布做的，貼在皮膚上很刺。

The antique shop displayed a rappe spoon beside the jar. 古董店把鼻煙匙和那罐粗鼻煙一起展示。
She clipped the rope to her harness and practiced a rappel down the wall. 她把繩子扣上安全帶，練習沿著岩壁繩降。
The rescue team had to rappel into the canyon before nightfall. 救援隊必須在天黑前繩降進峽谷。
The rapper greeted fans outside the club. 那位饒舌歌手在夜店外和歌迷打招呼。
My brother wants to be a rapper after college. 我弟弟大學畢業後想當饒舌歌手。
Soft rapping woke me just before sunrise. 天快亮前，一陣敲擊聲把我吵醒。
We heard steady rapping on the apartment wall. 我們聽見公寓牆邊傳來規律的敲擊聲。
A Rappist family once lived in that brick house. 以前有一戶拉普派信徒住在那棟磚屋裡。
The diary was written by a young Rappist in Indiana. 那本日記是印第安納州一位年輕拉普派信徒寫的。
The archive mentions one rappist baker by name. 檔案裡點名提到一位拉普派麵包師。
A rappist in the settlement rang the work bell at dawn. 聚落裡一名拉普派信徒在天亮時敲響了工鐘。
The Rappite sold woven cloth at the town market. 那位拉普派成員在鎮上市集賣織布。
Her essay follows a Rappite community through one winter. 她的文章追蹤一個拉普派社群如何度過一個冬天。
Good rapport made the interview feel easy. 融洽關係讓那場面談進行得很輕鬆。
It took weeks to build rapport with the new class. 我花了好幾週才和新班級建立融洽關係。
The cat burglar was a lovable rapscallion who bowed before he ran. 那名貓賊是個討人喜歡的無賴，每次逃跑前都會先鞠躬。

His memoir has a streak of rapscallionism that makes the stories fun. 他的回憶錄帶著一點無賴作風，讓故事特別有趣。

He grinned rapscallionly and slipped the key into his sleeve. 他帶著無賴似的笑，把鑰匙塞進袖子裡。

The novel is full of tavern quarrels and other rapscallionry. 那本小說滿是酒館爭吵和其他流氓作風。
We laughed at the boys' harmless rapscallionry, but we still set rules. 我們雖然笑看男孩們無傷大雅的調皮惡作劇，仍然訂了規矩。
The children sat in rapt silence during the magician's final trick. 魔術師表演最後一個把戲時，孩子們安靜地看得入迷。
She listened with rapt attention as her grandmother told the story. 外婆說故事時，她專注得一個字也不想漏掉。

meaning: 用來抓取獵物的；掠食性的
sentences: The insect's raptatorial forelegs snap shut on prey in an instant. 那隻昆蟲的掠食前足會瞬間夾住獵物。

A raptatory claw helps the nymph seize prey. 捕食用的鉤爪能幫若蟲抓住獵物。
She listened raptly as her grandfather told the old family story. 她全神貫注地聽著祖父講老家族故事。
The crowd stared raptly at the fireworks above the river. 人群全神貫注地望著河面上空的煙火。
His raptness during the concert made the whole row go quiet. 他在音樂會上那種全神投入的神情，讓整排座位都安靜了下來。

A raptor circled high above the valley in search of prey. 一隻猛禽在山谷上空盤旋，尋找獵物。

meaning: 猛禽類；舊式分類群名稱
sentences: Raptores was once used as a broad taxonomic group. 猛禽類曾被當作一個廣泛的分類群。
Modern ornithology uses other terms instead of Raptores. 現代鳥類學改用別的說法，而不再用這個舊名。

meaning: 像猛禽的；掠食性的；用於抓獲獵物的
sentences: The hawk's raptorial talons curved like hooks. 那隻鷹的掠食性爪子彎得像鐵鉤。
The spider's raptorial forelegs helped it seize insects from the leaf. 那隻蜘蛛的掠食前足幫它從葉子上抓住昆蟲。
The hawk had a raptorious stare. 那隻鷹有著猛禽般的凝視。
His raptorious approach made the deal feel dangerous. 他那種掠食般的做法讓這筆交易顯得危險。
I found raptril in an old puzzle list. 我在一份老謎題清單裡找到這個冷僻詞。
Raptril is the kind of word you verify twice. 這類冷僻詞通常都得再確認一次。
The crowd shouted in rapture when the band returned. 樂團回到台上時，人群狂喜地大叫。
Her face showed pure rapture at the first bite. 她咬下第一口時，臉上滿是狂喜。
The audience sat raptured through the violin solo. 聽眾在小提琴獨奏時都被深深吸引住了。
She looked raptured when the baby finally fell asleep in her arms. 當嬰兒終於在她懷裡睡著時，她看起來滿是喜悅與陶然。

meaning: 沒有狂喜的；缺乏陶醉感的
sentences: After the long debate, the room felt oddly raptureless. 經過長時間的辯論後，房間裡反而有種毫無激情的冷清感。
His raptureless answer showed that he was only half listening. 他那毫無興致的回答顯示他只聽進了一半。

meaning: 相信被提的人；宗教上的熱狂者
sentences: The pastor spoke to a crowd of rapturists who believed the end was near. 那位牧師對一群相信被提即將到來的信徒演說。

The singer returned to rapturous applause after the encore. 那位歌手安可結束後在如雷的狂喜掌聲中再度登台。
Their reunion at the airport was brief but rapturous. 他們在機場的重逢雖然短暫，卻充滿欣喜若狂的情緒。

He spoke rapturously about the years he spent studying music in Vienna. 他陶醉地談起自己在維也納學音樂的那些歲月。
The rapturousness of the audience surprised even the veteran performers. 觀眾那股狂喜熱烈的反應，連資深表演者都感到意外。
Her letter still carries the rapturousness of first love. 她的信裡至今仍帶著初戀般的欣喜與陶醉。

meaning: 近乎狂喜的；充滿陶醉感的
sentences: There was a raptury glow on his face after he heard the verdict. 聽到判決後，他臉上浮現出一種近乎狂喜的神情。
The poem ends in a strangely raptury vision of light and silence. 那首詩以一幅帶著奇異陶醉感的光與寂靜景象作結。

meaning: 衝動性發作；病態衝動爆發
sentences: The doctor noted that the violent act appeared to be a raptus rather than a planned attack. 醫師指出，那次暴力行為看起來像是一種衝動性發作，而非預謀攻擊。

The bird is a very rare species that is only found on this island. 這種鳥是僅在該島上發現的非常罕見物種。

meaning: 威爾斯起司吐司；起司醬烤吐司
sentences: He ordered a Welsh rarebit and black tea for lunch. 他午餐點了一份威爾斯起司吐司和一杯紅茶。
The rarebit arrived bubbling hot, with mustard folded into the cheese sauce. 那份起司吐司端上桌時熱氣騰騰，起司醬裡還拌進了芥末。

meaning: 稀疏化；稀薄化；低壓稀疏區
sentences: At high altitude, the rarefaction of the air makes breathing feel different. 在高海拔地區，空氣的稀薄化會讓呼吸感覺明顯不同。
The technician explained that one phase of the sound wave is a region of rarefaction. 技術員解釋說，聲波的一個階段就是壓力較低的稀疏區。

meaning: 稀疏化的；與稀疏區有關的
sentences: The sensor can detect small rarefactional changes in pressure. 那個感測器能偵測壓力中細微的稀疏化變化。
In the diagram, the rarefactional zone is marked in blue. 圖中用藍色標出了稀疏區域。

meaning: 造成稀疏化的；屬於稀疏化的
sentences: Heat has a rarefactive effect on many gases. 熱對許多氣體都有使其變得稀薄的作用。
The engineer compared the rarefactive and compressive phases of the pulse. 工程師比較了那道脈衝的稀疏期與壓縮期。

sentences: Steam is highly rarefiable when the chamber pressure drops. 當腔體壓力下降時，蒸氣很容易被稀薄化。
Early scientists debated whether all matter was equally rarefiable. 早期科學家曾爭論，是否所有物質都同樣可以被稀疏化。
The rarefication of the gas changed the reading on the gauge. 氣體的稀薄化讓儀表讀值改變了。
The lecture used rarefication to explain how sound moves through air. 那場講座用稀疏化來解釋聲音如何在空氣中傳遞。

meaning: 稀薄化裝置；使變稀薄者
sentences: This nozzle acts as a rarefier by spreading the vapor over a wider chamber. 這個噴嘴像稀薄化裝置一樣，把蒸氣分散到更寬的腔室。
In older texts, the sun was sometimes called a rarefier of morning mist. 在較早的文獻裡，太陽有時被稱為晨霧的稀化者。

sentences: As the balloon climbs, the air continues to rarefy. 氣球愈升愈高，四周空氣也持續變得稀薄。
Time seemed to rarefy the bitterness of the argument. 時間彷彿把那場爭執的苦澀感慢慢沖淡了。

The gemstone's rareness drove the final auction price even higher. 那顆寶石的稀有性把最後的拍賣價格又推高了一截。
People forget the rareness of a truly quiet evening in the city. 人們常忘了，在城市裡真正安靜的夜晚其實相當難得。
This peach variety is prized for its rareripe fruit. 這個桃子品種因果實成熟得早而備受重視。
The novel warns that a rareripe child is not always a happier one. 那本小說提醒人們，過度早熟的孩子未必更快樂。

sentences: The paper revisits a rariconstant model of isotropic solids. 那篇論文重新檢視了一種描述等向性固體的單彈性常數模型。

meaning: 拉羅湯加語；拉羅湯加人
sentences: The guide greeted us in Rarotongan before switching to English. 導遊先用拉羅湯加語向我們打招呼，接著才改說英語。
A young Rarotongan told us how village life changes during festival week. 一位年輕的拉羅湯加人跟我們說起節慶週期間村裡生活的變化。

Rasalas was visible above the roof after sunset. 日落後，拉薩拉斯星出現在屋頂上方。

meaning: 拉薩哈格星；蛇夫座最亮的恆星
sentences: Rasalhague shone above the observatory after midnight. 午夜過後，拉薩哈格在天文台上空閃耀。

meaning: 拉薩馬拉樹；一種常綠喬木
sentences: The workers planted rasamala along the slope. 工人們在坡地上種植拉薩馬拉樹。

A rascacio rested among the rocks without moving. 一條花鮋靜靜伏在岩石間。
The diver almost missed the rascacio because of its color. 潛水員差點因為保護色而沒看見那條花鮋。

meaning: 厚臉皮的人或生物；一個麻煩製造者。
sentences: That little rascal bit me. 那個小流氓咬我了。
If you have deer in the area, you may have to put a fence around your garden to keep the rascals out. 如果您所在地區有鹿，您可能需要在花園周圍設置柵欄以防止流氓進入。

meaning: 無賴之徒的整體；一群惡棍；無賴行徑
sentences: The reformer claimed the city hall was ruled by rascaldom. 那位改革者聲稱市政廳已被一群無賴之徒把持。
He wrote a comic essay exposing the small rascaldom of office politics. 他寫了一篇諷刺散文，揭露辦公室政治裡那些小小的無賴勾當。

She called herself a rascaless with a grin and tucked the stolen cookie behind her back. 她笑著自稱是個女小搗蛋鬼，還把偷來的餅乾藏到身後。

meaning: 無賴；流氓；rapscallion 的古寫法
sentences: The judge refused to be charmed by the young rascalion's manners. 法官沒有被那個年輕無賴表面上的禮貌打動。
In the old novel, every tavern seems to shelter a rascalion or two. 在那本老小說裡，每家酒館似乎都藏著一兩個流氓無賴。

meaning: 無賴性；惡作劇般的狡黠；無賴行為
sentences: The prank looked harmless at first, but its rascality became obvious when the locks were changed. 那場惡作劇一開始看似無害，但當門鎖都被換掉時，裡頭的無賴行徑就很明顯了。
