sentences: The novel shows how neglect can rascalize a clever boy over time. 那部小說寫出長期忽視如何把一個聰明男孩慢慢逼成小無賴。

She gave him a rascallike grin and slipped out before anyone could stop her. 她對他露出一抹帶點無賴氣的壞笑，隨後趁大家來不及阻止就溜走了。

His rascally charm made people laugh before they remembered to be angry. 他那股無賴式的魅力總讓人先笑出來，之後才想起自己本該生氣。
The children invented a rascally plan to ring the bell and run. 孩子們想出一個淘氣的計畫，按完門鈴就拔腿跑。

He was tired of the petty rascalry that passed for business in the port. 他受夠了那座港口裡被當成生意手段的各種小人伎倆。
Even his friends grew weary of his constant rascalship. 連朋友們都漸漸厭倦了他層出不窮的無賴作風。
The memoir treats youthful rascalship with humor rather than pride. 那本回憶錄用幽默而不是自豪的口吻，談起年少時的胡鬧惡行。

Her guitar solo opened with a sharp rasgado that woke the whole room. 她的吉他獨奏以一串俐落的刷弦開場，整個房間瞬間被喚醒。
The teacher slowed the rasgado down so beginners could hear each stroke. 老師把刷弦奏法放慢，好讓初學者聽清每一下撥動。
The baby developed a red rash on his skin due to an allergic reaction. 寶寶因過敏反應皮膚上長了紅疹。

He fried a rasher of bacon and laid it beside the eggs. 他煎了一片培根，放在蛋旁邊。
One rasher was enough to make the whole kitchen smell savory. 只要一片薄培根，就足以讓整個廚房香味四溢。
It was rashful of him to sign the paper without reading the last page. 他連最後一頁都沒看就簽字，實在太輕率了。

His rashness in traffic frightened everyone in the car. 他開車時的魯莽讓車上每個人都心驚膽跳。
The general regretted the rashness of attacking before dawn. 那位將軍後悔自己過於輕率，竟在黎明前就下令進攻。
Rashti appears only once in the tablet text. 石版文裡的拉施提只出現過一次。

meaning: 掘地鳥類；雞形鳥類的舊分類名
sentences: Older textbooks placed chickens, pheasants, and their kin among the Rasores. 較早期的教科書把雞、雉與近親鳥類都歸入這一類群。

meaning: 善於扒地覓食的；雞形鳥類的

meaning: 覆盆子飲料；覆盆子汽飲
sentences: They cooled the guests with glasses of raspberriade on the shaded porch. 他們在陰涼的門廊上用一杯杯覆盆子飲料招待客人。

meaning: 像覆盆子的；帶覆盆子風味的
sentences: The candy had a bright raspberrylike scent without using real fruit. 那顆糖帶著明亮的覆盆子般香氣，卻沒有使用真正果實。

meaning: 沙啞刺喉的；被銼磨過的
sentences: After the speech, his throat felt rasped and raw. 演說結束後，他的喉嚨覺得又乾又磨。

meaning: 刺耳粗啞的；令人難受地沙啞的
sentences: His rasping voice filled the tiny room before anyone saw him. 還沒有人看見他之前，他那刺耳沙啞的嗓音就先充滿了整個小房間。

meaning: 刺耳粗啞；磨耳的不適感

sentences: He has a raspish way of answering questions when he is tired. 他累的時候回答問題總帶著一種刺刺的口氣。

meaning: 《拉塞拉斯》；亦指書中主角拉塞拉斯
sentences: She wrote her thesis on Rasselas and the search for happiness. 她的論文寫的是《拉塞拉斯》以及其中對幸福的追尋。

meaning: 天棓四；天龍座的一顆恆星

Even after a long dispute, she remained rationable and willing to listen. 即使爭論了很久，她仍然理性而且願意傾聽。
The editor wanted a rationable explanation, not a dramatic excuse. 編輯要的是合理的說明，不是戲劇化的藉口。
They discussed the budget rationably and reached a calm compromise. 他們理性地討論預算，最後達成平和的折衷。
He responded rationably even when the accusation was unfair. 即使指控並不公平，他還是很通情達理地回應了。
rational buyers compare prices before they pay. 理性的買家會先比價再付款。
Her plan sounded rational after we saw the budget. 我們看過預算後，她的計畫聽起來很合理。
Please explain the rationale for this change. 請說明這項變更的理由。
Her rationale was simple and practical. 她的理由簡單而務實。
The course introduced rationalism as a tradition that trusts reason as a path to knowledge. 那門課把理性主義介紹為一種相信理性能通往知識的傳統。
Her essay compared rationalism with empiricism instead of treating them as enemies. 她的文章拿理性主義和經驗主義做比較，而不是把兩者當成敵對陣營。
As a rationalist, he trusted careful argument more than instinctive fear. 身為理性主義者，他比起本能的恐懼更相信審慎的論證。
She is not cold-hearted; she is simply a rationalist who likes evidence first. 她不是冷酷無情，只是一位凡事先看證據的理性主義者。

meaning: 理性主義的；過度強調理性的
sentences: Some critics found the proposal too rationalistic and disconnected from ordinary emotions. 有些評論者認為那份提案過於理性主義，與一般人的情感脫節。
His rationalistic reading of the myth focused on symbols rather than miracles. 他對神話所做的理性主義式解讀，把重點放在象徵而不是奇蹟。

meaning: 理性主義式的；偏重理性的
sentences: His rationalistical style left little room for emotion. 他偏重理性的風格幾乎不留情感空間。
The essay took a rationalistical view of religion. 那篇文章用理性主義式觀點看待宗教。

meaning: 以理性主義方式；偏重理性地
sentences: He interpreted the ritual rationalistically, treating each gesture as social theater. 他以理性主義的方式解讀那場儀式，把每個動作都當成社會性的表演。
The debate was framed rationalistically, leaving little room for mystery or faith. 那場辯論被設定成偏重理性的框架，幾乎沒有留給神祕感或信仰的空間。

meaning: 理性主義傾向；理性主義作風
sentences: The critic accused the movement of rationalisticism and said it had drained wonder from art. 那位評論家指責那場運動帶有理性主義傾向，說它把藝術中的驚奇感都抽乾了。
A little rationalisticism can clarify a doctrine, but too much can flatten it. 一點理性主義作風能讓教義更清楚，但太多就會把它變得扁平。
rationality matters when the team chooses between two risky options. 團隊在兩個高風險選項間做決定時，理性很重要。
His anger wiped out any sign of rationality. 他的怒氣讓理性幾乎消失。
The delay was rationalizable once we learned that the road had been closed by a landslide. 當我們得知道路因山崩封閉後，那次延誤就變得可以理解了。
Not every mistake is rationalizable, especially when people were clearly warned in advance. 並不是每個錯誤都能被合理化，尤其是在大家事前已經被清楚提醒的情況下。
His long speech sounded less like honesty and more like rationalization. 他那段長篇大論聽起來不像坦白，反而更像是在自我合理化。
The company called it restructuring, but workers saw it as rationalization for cutting jobs. 公司稱那是重整，但員工認為那只是裁員的說詞。
rationalize your impulse buy if you want, but you still overspent. 你要替衝動購物找理由也行，但你還是花太多了。
The manager tried to rationalize cutting the lunch break. 經理試圖替縮短午休找理由。

meaning: 合理化者；愛找藉口的人
sentences: He is such a skilled rationalizer that every failure becomes someone else's fault in his story. 他很會自我合理化，在他的說法裡每次失敗都會變成別人的錯。
A rationalizer can sound persuasive until you compare the excuse with the facts. 一個善於找藉口的人聽起來可能很有說服力，但只要把說法和事實一比就露餡了。
She breathed deeply and responded rationally instead of escalating the argument. 她深呼吸後理性地回應，沒有讓爭執進一步升高。
Markets do not always behave rationally when fear spreads faster than facts. 當恐懼傳播得比事實更快時，市場未必會理性運作。
The rationalness of her plan became obvious once the numbers were reviewed. 一旦把數字重新檢查過，她那套計畫的合理性就變得很明顯。
In a crisis, people often admire calm rationalness more than bold promises. 在危機中，人們往往更欣賞冷靜的理性，而不是大膽的承諾。
During the drought, the town had to rationate water to protect the reservoir. 乾旱期間，鎮上不得不對用水實施配給以保住水庫存量。
The camp rationated medicine first to the children and the elderly. 那個營地先把藥品定量分配給孩童和老人。
After the convoy was delayed, several families spent a rationless night at the shelter. 車隊延誤後，幾個家庭在避難所度過了一個沒有口糧的夜晚。
The rationless soldiers learned to stretch every scrap of food they could find. 沒有配給可領的士兵只好盡量把找到的每一點食物都撐久一點。
Fuel rationment changed daily life more than people had expected. 燃料配給對日常生活造成的改變，比人們原先預料的還大。
The old poster explained wartime rationment in simple, direct language. 那張老海報用簡單直接的語言說明了戰時配給制度。
The zoology chart groups ostriches and emus under Ratitae. 動物學圖表把鴕鳥和鴯鶓歸在平胸類鳥之下。
Ratitae includes large birds that cannot fly. 平胸類鳥包含無法飛行的大型鳥類。
ratite eggs are much larger than chicken eggs. 平胸鳥的蛋比雞蛋大得多。
The zoo keeps a ratite from Africa near the giraffes. 那家動物園在長頸鹿附近養了一種來自非洲的平胸鳥。

meaning: 平胸類鳥的；似平胸類鳥的
sentences: Its long legs and heavy body gave the bird a distinctly ratitous look. 牠修長的腿和厚重的身軀，讓那隻鳥看起來很有平胸類鳥的特徵。
The illustrator exaggerated the creature's ratitous posture for comic effect. 插畫家刻意誇大那生物像平胸類鳥般的姿態，來製造喜劇效果。
The small animal had a ratlike face but a much softer tail. 那隻小動物有一張像老鼠的臉，但尾巴柔軟得多。
In the dim alley, his quick, ratlike movements made everyone uneasy. 在昏暗的小巷裡，他那種像老鼠般迅速的動作讓每個人都覺得不安。
The sailor climbed the ratline to reach the upper rigging. 那名水手沿著攀索橫繩爬上高處索具。
A broken ratline can make work on the mast dangerous. 一條斷掉的桅索踏繩會讓桅杆上的工作變得危險。
The young ratliner spent the morning repairing the worn rigging. 那位年輕水手花了一整個上午修補磨損的索具。
An experienced ratliner could work high above the deck without fear. 有經驗的裝索水手能在甲板高處從容工作。
The farmer left the cane roots in place to produce a ratoon crop. 那位農夫把甘蔗根留在地裡，好讓它長出再生作物。
A healthy ratoon can save both time and labor in the next season. 健康的再生芽能在下一季節省不少時間與人力。
The ratooner checked the field for fresh shoots after the harvest. 那位再生作物種植者在收成後查看田裡的新芽。
A skilled ratooner knows when the old roots are still worth keeping. 熟練的再生作物栽培者知道什麼時候舊根還值得保留。
They stored the grain in a ratproof metal bin. 他們把穀物存放在防鼠的金屬桶裡。
A ratproof design matters most in old warehouses near the river. 在靠河的老倉庫裡，防鼠設計格外重要。
The caretaker set out ratsbane in the corners of the cellar. 管理員把滅鼠藥放在地下室的角落。
Children should never be allowed near open ratsbane. 絕不能讓孩子靠近未收好的滅鼠藥。

meaning: 地下酒館；市政廳地下餐館
sentences: We ate supper in a warm old ratskeller beneath the town hall. 我們在市政廳地下那間溫暖的老酒館裡吃晚餐。
The ratskeller was famous for dark beer and slow music. 那間地下酒館以黑啤酒和舒緩音樂聞名。
The rattage of loose boards kept everyone awake. 鬆動木板發出的嘎嘎聲讓所有人都睡不著。
Street rattage rose sharply when the carts rolled past. 當手推車經過時，街上的喧鬧聲一下子大了起來。

meaning: 細長尾；鼠尾魚；鼠尾狀物
sentences: The deep-sea net brought up a strange rattail from the dark water. 深海拖網從黑暗海水裡撈上一條奇特的鼠尾魚。
Her braid hung down her back like a rattail. 她的辮子垂在背後，像一條細細的鼠尾。
The chair was woven from pale rattan and felt surprisingly light. 那張椅子是用淺色藤材編成的，拿起來意外地輕。
A basket maker can shape damp rattan into strong curves. 籃匠能把濕潤的藤材塑成結實的彎曲形狀。
The tailor used ratteen for a warm winter coat. 裁縫用厚斜紋絨布做了一件保暖冬衣。
A bolt of ratteen lay folded on the cutting table. 一匹厚斜紋絨布摺好放在裁布桌上。

meaning: 工會式破壞；以恐嚇手段騷擾
sentences: The old report accuses the group of ratten during the strike. 那份舊報告指控該團體在罷工期間從事破壞與恐嚇。
Stories of ratten spread fear among small workshop owners. 關於這種騷擾破壞的傳聞在小工坊主之間引起恐懼。
The watchman caught the rattener tampering with the mill tools. 守夜人逮到那個破壞者正在動磨坊工具的手腳。
A child had become the secret rattener of every loose window in the house. 有個孩子成了家裡每扇鬆動窗戶背後偷偷弄出聲音的人。
The farmer kept a terrier as a skilled ratter in the barn. 農夫在穀倉裡養了一隻善於捕鼠的㹴犬。
They never forgave him after calling him a ratter in public. 在公開場合把他罵成變節者之後，大家就再也沒有原諒他。
The alley behind the market had turned into a filthy rattery. 市場後方那條巷子已經變成骯髒的鼠窩。
The scientist kept a small rattery for controlled breeding studies. 那位科學家設置了一間小型養鼠室，用於受控繁殖研究。

meaning: 拉蒂，印度傳統重量單位
sentences: The jeweler weighed the gem in ratti before quoting a price. 那位珠寶商先用拉蒂這個傳統單位為寶石秤重，再開價。
Old trade manuals sometimes list pearl weights in ratti. 舊式貿易手冊有時會用拉蒂來記錄珍珠重量。
She chose rattinet for a coat lining that needed to feel soft. 她選用細斜紋絨布來做外套內裡，因為手感較柔軟。
The fabric merchant unfolded a roll of dark blue rattinet. 布商攤開了一卷深藍色細斜紋絨布。
His rattish face peered out from behind the curtain. 他那張像老鼠般的臉從窗簾後方探了出來。
The detective distrusted the witness because of his rattish manner. 偵探因那名證人鬼鬼祟祟的樣子而不信任他。
The old car began to rattle as it drove down the bumpy country road. 舊車在崎嶇的山路上行駛時開始發出嘎嘎聲。
Don't let the criticism rattle you; stay focused on your own work and goals. 不要讓批評使你驚惶失措；專注於自己的工作和目標。

meaning: 喋喋不休的人；會發響聲的袋子
sentences: Everyone at the office knew him as a cheerful rattlebag. 辦公室裡每個人都知道他是個愛說個不停的人。
The child shook the old rattlebag just to hear the seeds inside. 那孩子搖著那個會發出聲響的舊袋子，只為聽裡面種子的聲音。

meaning: 瘦骨嶙峋的人；骨頭咯咯作響的人
sentences: The village children laughed and called the scarecrow rattlebones. 村裡的孩子笑著把那個稻草人叫作瘦骨嶙峋的傢伙。
He was all elbows and knees, a true rattlebones after the long winter. 漫長冬天過後，他瘦得只剩手肘和膝蓋，活像個瘦骨如柴的人。

meaning: 會發響聲的盒子；聒噪的人
sentences: The baby smiled whenever the bright rattlebox was shaken. 每當彩色的響盒被搖動時，嬰兒就會笑起來。
In the neighborhood, she had a reputation as a harmless rattlebox. 在鄰里之間，她以愛說話卻無害著稱。
rattlebrain forgot his keys again and locked himself out. 那個糊塗鬼又忘了帶鑰匙，把自己鎖在門外。
Do not let that rattlebrain handle the cash box. 別讓那個冒失鬼管收銀箱。
Her rattlebrained plan nearly cost the team a month's work. 她那個輕率無腦的計畫，差點讓團隊白費一個月的努力。
He was charming but hopelessly rattlebrained under pressure. 他雖然討喜，但一有壓力就顯得非常沒頭腦。

meaning: 響豆灌木；一種果莢會作響的植物
sentences: A dry rattlebush shook noisily in the hot wind. 一叢乾燥的響豆灌木在熱風中發出沙沙作響的聲音。
The children picked a pod from the rattlebush and used it as a toy. 孩子們從那株果莢會響的植物上摘下一個豆莢，拿來當玩具。
She looked rattled after the unexpected question from the judge. 法官突然發問後，她看起來有些慌亂。
Even the veteran pilot sounded rattled on the radio. 就連經驗豐富的飛行員在無線電裡都顯得有些受驚。
Only a complete rattlehead would drive that fast in the rain. 只有十足沒頭腦的人才會在雨中開那麼快。
The captain scolded the young rattlehead for ignoring the map. 船長責罵那個魯莽的年輕人，因為他完全不看地圖。
It was a rattleheaded decision made in pure excitement. 那是個一時興奮下做出的魯莽決定。
His rattleheaded confidence vanished when the real work began. 真正工作開始後，他那種沒頭腦的自信很快就消失了。

meaning: 老舊嘎響的車；聒噪的人
sentences: The farmer still drove the same rattlejack he had used for twenty years. 那位農夫仍開著那輛用了二十年的嘎嘎作響老車。
We could hear the rattlejack coming up the lane long before we saw it. 我們還沒看見那輛車，就先聽見它沿著小路嘎嘎作響地開來。

meaning: 會發出細碎聲響的小鼠；鼩鼱類小動物
sentences: A rattlemouse darted through the dry leaves at dusk. 黃昏時，一隻小小的會發出沙沙聲的鼠類從枯葉間竄過。
The cat sat still, listening for the rattlemouse beneath the floorboards. 那隻貓靜靜坐著，聽地板下那隻小鼠發出的細碎聲響。

meaning: 響子果；會發出聲響的果莢或種子
sentences: The dried rattlenut made a sharp sound when shaken. 那顆乾掉的響子果一搖就會發出清脆聲響。
Children collected rattlenut pods and strung them into toys. 孩子們把會響的果莢收集起來，串成玩具。

meaning: 糊塗又多話的人；輕浮空心的人
sentences: Everyone laughed when the village rattlepate forgot his own speech and started telling jokes. 大家都笑了，因為村裡那個冒失多話的人忘了自己的講稿，反而開始講笑話。
She called herself a rattlepate after misplacing the keys for the third time that week. 她那週第三次弄丟鑰匙後，便自嘲自己是個糊塗鬼。

meaning: 糊塗輕浮的；沒頭沒腦的
sentences: His rattlepated plan involved quitting his job before he had even checked the contract. 他那個糊裡糊塗的計畫竟然是在還沒看合約前就先辭職。
The novel's hero is charming but hopelessly rattlepated in matters of money. 小說主角很迷人，但一碰到金錢問題就糊塗得沒救。

meaning: 響莢植物；乾燥豆莢會發聲的豆科植物
sentences: The children shook a dried rattlepod and listened to the seeds clicking inside. 孩子們搖著乾掉的響莢植物，聽著裡頭種子喀喀作響。
Rattlepod can spread quickly along roadsides if the seed pods are left undisturbed. 如果讓種莢自然留著，響莢植物很快就會沿著路邊蔓延。
We added rubber washers to make the metal cover more rattleproof on rough roads. 我們加了橡膠墊圈，讓金屬蓋在顛簸路面上更不會發出碰撞聲。
The designer wanted a rattleproof case because the recorder would be carried in a backpack all day. 設計師想做一個防晃不作響的外殼，因為那台錄音機整天都要放在背包裡。

meaning: 響尾蛇；會嘎嘎作響的東西
sentences: The hiker froze when he realized the coil beside the rock was a rattler. 登山客一發現岩石旁蜷著的是一條響尾蛇，立刻僵住了。
In old Western stories, a rattler often appears before the hero notices the danger. 在老西部故事裡，響尾蛇常在主角察覺危險前先出現。
The cook simmered rattleran until it became tender. 廚師慢燉牛胸腹肉，直到它變軟。
Rattleran works well in a rich stew. 牛胸腹肉很適合做濃郁燉菜。
rattleroot grows in dry prairie soil. 響根草長在乾燥的草原土壤裡。
The herbal garden labels rattleroot beside the purple flowers. 藥草園把那株響根草標在紫花旁邊。

meaning: 果莢會作響的樹；響莢樹
sentences: When the pods dried in late summer, the rattlertree sounded alive in the wind. 夏末果莢乾掉後，那棵響莢樹一吹風就像活過來似地作響。
The gardener kept the rattlertree for its odd music as much as for its shade. 園丁留下那棵響莢樹，不只是為了樹蔭，也為了它奇特的聲響。
The old bus gave a chorus of rattles every time it crossed the bridge. 那台舊巴士每次過橋都會發出一連串嘎啦聲。
Silver rattles were once given as keepsakes for newborns in some families. 在一些家庭裡，銀製搖鈴曾經是送給新生兒的紀念禮物。
Only a rattleskull would bet his rent money on a rumor from the bar. 只有冒失又愚笨的人，才會把房租拿去押在酒吧裡聽來的流言上。
Her uncle was affectionate but such a rattleskull that nobody trusted him with directions. 她叔叔雖然和氣，但實在太冒失，沒人敢相信他指路。
The committee rejected the rattleskulled proposal after two minutes of discussion. 委員會討論兩分鐘後就否決了那個輕率無腦的提案。
He made a rattleskulled remark and spent the rest of dinner trying to fix the damage. 他說了一句不經大腦的話，結果整場晚餐都在努力補救。
A rattlesnake shook its tail in the dry grass before sliding away. 一條響尾蛇在乾草裡甩動尾巴發出警告後才滑走。
The ranger taught us how to back away calmly if we ever met a rattlesnake on the trail. 巡山員教我們，如果在山徑上遇到響尾蛇，該如何冷靜後退。

meaning: 喀啦作響的；吵鬧惱人的
sentences: The loose window frame grew more rattlesome whenever the north wind picked up. 北風一強，鬆動的窗框就變得更喀啦作響。
His rattlesome cough kept the whole carriage awake through the night. 他那陣惱人的咳嗽吵得整節車廂整晚都睡不好。

meaning: 破舊又吵的東西；老爺車
sentences: They arrived in a blue rattletrap that sounded as if every bolt were loose. 他們開著一輛藍色破車來，聽起來像每顆螺絲都鬆了。
The theater troupe hauled its costumes across the county in a stubborn old rattletrap. 那個劇團開著一輛頑固的老爺車，把戲服一路載遍整個郡。

meaning: 響草；廣義指某些乾果會作響的植物
sentences: The field was dotted with rattleweed, and the dry pods clicked under our boots. 田裡零星長著響草，我們一踩過去，乾莢就在腳邊喀喀作響。
Farmers pulled the rattleweed before it crowded out the young beans. 農夫在響草擠掉幼豆之前就先把它清掉了。
A note in the herbarium identified the specimen as rattlewort from the coastal plain. 標本館裡的一張註記把這份植物標本標為來自海岸平原的響果草。
Rattlewort was easy to recognize once the pods dried and began to shake. 一旦莢果乾掉開始作響，響果草就很容易辨認。

meaning: 喀啦作響的；飛快有勁的；極好的
sentences: We heard a rattling noise from the heater before it stopped working altogether. 暖氣在徹底壞掉前，先傳出一陣喀啦作響的聲音。
She set a rattling pace on the climb, and nobody could keep up with her. 她上坡時走得飛快，沒有人跟得上。
The cart rolled rattlingly over the stones and woke the dogs in every yard. 那輛手推車喀啦作響地碾過石路，把每個院子裡的狗都吵醒了。
For an old-fashioned phrase, the reviewer called the new detective novel rattlingly good. 用一種老派說法，那位評論者稱這本新偵探小說好看得不得了。

meaning: 喀啦作響或充滿勁道的特質
sentences: What annoyed him was not the volume of the engine but its constant rattlingness at low speed. 讓他受不了的不是引擎多大聲，而是它低速時持續不斷的喀啦感。
The coach loved the rattlingness of the team's start, saying it showed real urgency. 教練很欣賞球隊開局那股猛勁，說那顯示出真正的企圖心。

meaning: 喀啦作響的；鬆鬆垮垮有雜聲的
sentences: This old fan still works, but it has become so rattly that I only use it in emergencies. 這台舊電扇還能用，但已經吵到喀啦作響，我只在緊急時才會開。
The drawer felt rattly because one of the side rails had come loose. 抽屜摸起來鬆鬆響響的，因為旁邊一條滑軌鬆了。
A ratton chewed a hole in the grain sack. 一隻老鼠把穀袋咬出洞。
The farmer set a trap after seeing a ratton in the barn. 農夫在穀倉看到老鼠後設了陷阱。
The town once hired a rattoner to keep the market stores free of vermin. 那個鎮以前會雇一名捕鼠人，避免市場倉庫鼠患成災。
In the archive, a rattoner was paid less than the lamplighter but more than the sweep. 在檔案紀錄裡，捕鼠人的薪水比點燈人低，卻比清掃工高。
He set a rattrap behind the pantry after hearing scratching in the wall. 他聽見牆裡有抓刮聲後，就在儲藏室後方放了一個捕鼠器。
The museum displayed an iron rattrap that looked more brutal than clever. 博物館展出一個鐵製捕鼠器，看起來殘酷多於巧妙。
Rattus includes several common rat species. 鼠屬包含數種常見的鼠類。
Researchers compared Rattus with other rodent genera. 研究人員把鼠屬和其他囓齒類屬做比較。
He showed up in a ratty sweater with paint on both sleeves. 他穿著一件破舊毛衣來，兩邊袖子都沾了油漆。
I get ratty when meetings drift on without a clear decision. 會議拖著卻沒有明確結論時，我就會變得很煩躁。
ratwa slipped across the forest path before sunrise. 一隻麂在天亮前迅速穿過林道。
The ranger said a ratwa had been calling near the stream. 巡山員說溪邊附近有一隻吠鹿在叫。

meaning: 一種加勒比海常綠灌木
sentences: The botanist collected leaves from the ratwood. 植物學家從這種灌木採集了葉片。
Ratwood grows in warm coastal habitats. 這種灌木生長在溫暖的海岸棲地。
After three nights of singing, his voice turned dry and raucid. 連唱三晚後，他的嗓音變得乾澀而嘶啞。
The speaker's raucid laugh filled the narrow room before anyone saw him enter. 那名講者還沒進門，粗啞的笑聲就先充滿了狹小房間。
Years of shouting over factory noise had left a permanent raucidity in her voice. 多年在工廠噪音中大喊，讓她的聲音留下了永久的粗啞感。
The actor used a touch of raucidity to make the old sailor sound convincing. 那位演員在聲音裡加上一點沙啞粗糙感，讓老水手這個角色更可信。
The trumpet's raucity cut through the parade like a blade. 小號那種刺耳的粗啞聲像刀一樣劃過遊行隊伍。
What the recording lacked in polish, it made up for in raw raucity. 那段錄音雖然不夠精緻，卻以原始粗獷的刺耳感彌補了不足。
raucous fans kept shouting outside the stadium. 喧鬧的球迷一直在體育場外大喊。
The bar turned raucous after midnight. 那家酒吧過了午夜後變得吵鬧刺耳。
The crows cried raucously above the empty parking lot. 烏鴉在空蕩的停車場上方發出沙啞刺耳的叫聲。
He laughed raucously after hearing the last joke. 他聽完最後一個笑話後放聲大笑，聲音又粗又響。
The raucousness of the crowd made the speaker pause. 人群喧鬧刺耳的聲浪讓講者停頓了一下。
Her voice had gained a rough raucousness after the long concert. 經過那場長時間演唱會後，她的聲音多了一股粗啞感。
The letter was at last raught from the back of the shelf. 那封信終於從書架深處被取了出來。
A raught branch lay across the path after the storm. 暴風雨後，一截被拉扯下來的樹枝橫在小路上。
The farmer used a raugrave to break the hard clods after plowing. 農夫在犁地後用粗齒耙打碎硬土塊。
A heavy raugrave leaned against the barn wall beside the spades. 一把沉重的耙子靠在穀倉牆邊，旁邊放著幾把鏟子。
Tourists walked down to the shore to photograph the rauk at sunset. 遊客們走下海岸，在日落時拍攝那座海蝕石柱。
The rauk stood alone against the gray sea and wind. 那座孤立岩柱獨自立在灰色海面與風中。
An old sailor began to raukle commands through the fog. 一名老水手開始用沙啞的聲音在霧中喊出指令。
The actor raukled the final line to make it sound more desperate. 那位演員把最後一句台詞說得又粗又啞，讓它聽起來更絕望。
Raul arrived early and set out the chairs before the guests came. 勞爾提早到了，在客人來之前先把椅子排好。
The note from Raul was brief but full of warmth. 勞爾寫來的便條雖然簡短，卻充滿溫度。
The carpenter chose rauli for the warm tone of its wood. 木匠因為那種木材色調溫暖而選用了勞利樹木。
A stand of rauli covered the hillside above the river. 河流上方的山坡長滿了一片智利山毛櫸。
The old house still showed a dark raun across the ceiling. 那棟老房子的天花板上仍可看見一根深色橫梁。
A cracked raun had to be replaced before the roof could be repaired. 在修屋頂之前，那根裂開的木樑必須先換掉。
He continued to raunge about the delay all the way home. 他一路回家都還在碎念抱怨那場延誤。
The old man liked to raunge at the weather whenever it changed. 那位老人每逢天氣一變就愛嘀咕責罵。
The edges of the wetland were thick with raupo. 濕地邊緣長滿了香蒲。
In some old settlements, raupo was used as a building material. 在一些早期聚落裡，香蒲曾被用作建材。
His rauque voice gave the speech an air of urgency. 他沙啞的聲音讓那場演講帶上一種急迫感。
A rauque cry echoed from the dark trees near the road. 一聲刺耳的叫喊從路邊黑暗的樹林裡傳來。

meaning: 勞拉奇人，古代高盧部族
sentences: The historian linked the settlement to the ancient Rauraci. 歷史學家把那處聚落和古代勞拉奇人聯繫起來。
Artifacts from the Rauraci were displayed beside Roman coins. 勞拉奇人的文物被陳列在羅馬錢幣旁邊。

meaning: 勞里奇人，古代部族名稱
sentences: Some older maps use Raurici where newer books prefer another form. 有些舊地圖使用勞里奇人這個名稱，而較新的書則採用其他拼法。
The lecture noted that the Raurici lived near the upper Rhine. 那場講座提到勞里奇人居住在萊茵河上游附近。
The botanist pointed out Rauwolfia in the medicinal plant garden. 植物學家在藥用植物園裡指出了蘿芙木屬植物。
Several species of Rauwolfia have been studied for alkaloids. 蘿芙木屬中的幾個物種曾因生物鹼而被研究。
The wildfire continued to ravage the dry valley for three days. 那場野火連續三天肆虐乾燥的山谷。
Years of war had ravaged the once-busy town. 多年的戰爭摧毀了這座曾經繁忙的小鎮。
The ravagement of the forest was visible from the hill. 從山上可以看見森林遭到嚴重破壞。
The town slowly recovered after years of ravagement. 多年破壞後，小鎮慢慢恢復。
The army was remembered as the great ravager of the region. 那支軍隊被記為這個地區的大破壞者。
The sea can be a ravager when storms strike the coast. 暴風襲擊海岸時，大海也可能成為無情的摧毀者。

meaning: 以過度的熱情、熱情或興奮的語氣說話。
sentences: He raved about her beauty. 他對她的美麗讚不絕口。
To rave means to talk with excessive enthusiasm, passion or excitement. 狂歡意味著以過度的熱情、激情或興奮來交談。
The worker used a ravehook to pull the heavy sack closer. 那名工人用彎鉤工具把沉重的麻袋勾近一些。
A rusty ravehook hung on the wall beside the rope coils. 一把生鏽的鉤具掛在牆上，旁邊是盤好的繩索。
The rain carved a raveinelike channel through the loose soil. 雨水在鬆軟的土壤上沖出一道像小峽谷般的溝槽。
A raveinelike cut split the hillside after the storm. 暴風雨過後，山坡上裂出一道像沖溝般的深痕。
Do not ravel the thread before I finish the pattern. 在我完成圖樣前，不要把線拆散。
The mystery slowly began to ravel as new documents appeared. 隨著新文件出現，那個謎團開始逐漸解開。
raveler pulled loose threads from the carpet by hand. 那位拆線工徒手把地毯上的鬆線扯掉。
In the mill, a raveler checked damaged yarn before it reached the loom. 在工廠裡，拆線工會在紗線送上織機前檢查損壞部分。
Across the ditch, the ravelin blocked a direct run to the gate. 壕溝對面的三角外堡擋住了直衝城門的路線。
Only weeds cover the old ravelin now. 如今那座舊三角外堡上只剩雜草。
The raveling of the sweater began at one loose stitch. 那件毛衣的鬆脫是從一針鬆線開始的。
She watched the slow raveling of the rope in her hands. 她看著手中的繩子一點點散開。
The cloth felt soft but slightly ravelly at the edges. 那塊布摸起來很柔軟，但邊緣有點容易鬆散。
Her hair turned ravelly in the sea wind. 她的頭髮在海風裡變得糾結散亂。
The legal case had become a ravelment of half-finished claims. 那宗法律案件已經變成一團未竟主張交纏的亂局。
She patiently sorted the ravelment of ribbons in the drawer. 她耐心整理抽屜裡那團纏在一起的絲帶。
The tailor chose a ravelproof fabric for the school uniform. 裁縫為校服選用了一種不易散邊的布料。
A ravelproof edge keeps the cloth neat after repeated washing. 不易鬆散的包邊能讓布料在多次清洗後仍保持整齊。

meaning: 尤其是頭髮：烏鴉羽毛的烏黑且通常有光澤的顏色（字源 1，名詞意義 1）。
sentences: Her raven curls framed her face beautifully. 她那烏黑的捲髮美麗地襯托著她的臉庞。
She was a tall, sophisticated, raven-haired beauty. 她是一位身材高挑、精緻、黑髮的美女。
A tall Ravenala spread its fan-shaped leaves over the path. 一株高大的旅人蕉屬植物把扇形葉片展開在小徑上方。
The garden label identified the plant as Ravenala rather than a true palm. 花園標牌說明這株植物屬於旅人蕉屬，而不是真正的棕櫚。

meaning: 成群烏鴉；烏鴉聚集之地
sentences: ravendom settled on the bare trees at dusk. 成群烏鴉在黃昏時落到光禿的樹上。
The poet called the winter field a piece of ravendom. 那位詩人把冬天的田野稱作一片烏鴉天地。
A ravenduck drifted just beyond the line of breaking waves. 一隻黑色海鴨漂浮在碎浪外側。
Birders were excited to spot a ravenduck among the winter flocks. 賞鳥者很興奮能在冬季鳥群中看到這種深色海鴨。
Ravenelia spreads quickly on wet leaves after summer rain. 這種銹菌在夏雨後會很快在濕葉上擴散。
The lab confirmed Ravenelia from the spore sample. 實驗室根據孢子樣本確認那是銹菌屬真菌。
The villagers feared the ravener that struck at night and vanished by dawn. 村民們害怕那個夜裡掠奪、天亮就消失的劫掠者。
In the poem, war itself is described as a blind ravener. 在那首詩裡，戰爭本身被描寫成一個盲目的吞噬者。
The bird's bold theft showed a touch of ravenhood. 那隻鳥大膽偷食，展現出一點烏鴉般的習性。
The story uses ravenhood to suggest hunger and cleverness. 這個故事用烏鴉習性暗示飢餓與狡猾。
A ravening pack moved through the hills after sunset. 一群貪婪掠食的野獸在日落後穿過山丘。
The novel paints famine as a ravening force that strips a village bare. 那部小說把饑荒寫成一股吞噬一切的力量，讓村莊一無所有。

meaning: 像烏鴉的；貪食的；烏黑的
sentences: His ravenish hair made him easy to spot in the crowd. 他那頭烏黑的頭髮讓他在人群裡很容易被認出。
The child's ravenish appetite surprised the whole family. 那孩子狼吞虎嚥般的食慾讓全家都很驚訝。
The figure had a ravenlike profile against the winter sky. 那個人影在冬日天空下顯得有種烏鴉般的側影。
A ravenlike cry echoed across the empty field. 一聲像烏鴉般的叫聲回蕩在空曠的田野上。
ravenous kids finished the noodles in minutes. 餓壞的孩子幾分鐘就把麵吃光了。
After the long swim, I felt ravenous. 長泳後，我覺得餓極了。
He ate ravenously after working in the sun all day. 他在烈日下工作了一整天後，狼吞虎嚥地吃了起來。
The stray dog watched the bread ravenously from the doorway. 那隻流浪狗從門口帶著極度飢餓的眼神盯著那塊麵包。
The ravenousness of the children made the picnic disappear quickly. 孩子們的飢餓程度，讓野餐食物很快就被吃光。
His sudden ravenousness worried the doctor more than the fever did. 他突如其來的極度飢餓，比發燒本身更讓醫生擔心。
A noisy ravenry gathered on the old church roof at dusk. 一群吵鬧的烏鴉在黃昏時聚到舊教堂屋頂上。
The warlord was followed by a ravenry of thieves and scouts. 那名軍閥身後跟著一群像烏鴉般的盜匪與斥候。
Two ravens circled above the cliff in the cold wind. 兩隻烏鴉在寒風中盤旋於懸崖上方。
The old legend says ravens carry messages between worlds. 古老傳說說烏鴉會在不同世界之間傳遞訊息。
The label identified the aromatic tree as Ravensara. 標籤把那棵芳香樹木標示為拉文薩拉屬。
Researchers discussed Ravensara in a paper on island flora. 研究人員在一篇島嶼植物群論文中討論了拉文薩拉屬。

meaning: 拉文薩拉，一種芳香植物或其精油
sentences: The shop sold ravensara oil beside lavender and cedar. 那家店把拉文薩拉精油和薰衣草、雪松精油擺在一起販售。
Some herbal guides mention ravensara for its strong scent. 有些草藥指南會提到拉文薩拉，因為它氣味很濃。
The monument was carved from a dark block of ravenstone. 那座紀念碑是用一大塊烏黑石材雕成的。
Children in the village believed ravenstone could ward off bad luck. 村裡的孩子相信烏鴉石可以驅走壞運氣。
The bird tilted its head ravenwise before stealing the bread. 那隻鳥像烏鴉似地歪著頭，然後叼走了麵包。
He watched the glittering coin ravenwise from the wall. 他像隻烏鴉般從牆上盯著那枚發亮的硬幣。
The last raver left the warehouse just after sunrise. 最後一名狂歡者在日出後不久離開了倉庫。
In debates, he sounds less like a critic and more like a raver. 在辯論中，他聽起來比較像情緒激動的狂熱發言者，而不是評論者。
Ravi arrived early and quietly helped arrange the chairs. 拉維提早到場，安靜地幫忙排好椅子。
The map showed the Ravi winding through the northern plains. 地圖顯示拉維河蜿蜒流過北方平原。

meaning: 法式香草酸味醬；使恢復精神之物
sentences: The chef served cold fish with a bright green ravigote. 主廚用一份鮮綠的法式香草酸味醬搭配冷魚料理。
A hot shower and strong coffee were the perfect ravigote after the trip. 洗個熱水澡再喝杯濃咖啡，簡直是旅途後最好的提神方式。
The horses had to pick their way around a steep ravin. 馬匹不得不小心繞過一道陡峭的沖溝。
After years of rain, a narrow ravin cut through the hillside. 多年雨水沖刷後，山坡上形成了一道狹窄的小峽谷。
Heavy runoff can ravinate a hillside within a few seasons. 強烈的逕流可能在幾個季節內就把山坡沖蝕成溝。
The storm began to ravinate the soft earth near the road. 暴風雨開始把道路附近的鬆軟土壤沖出溝痕。
Ravindran checked the figures twice before approving the report. 拉文德蘭在核准報告前把數字確認了兩次。
The article quotes Ravindran on the need for patient reform. 那篇文章引用了拉文德蘭對漸進改革必要性的看法。
Ravindranath signed his name on the guest book. 拉文德拉納特在來賓簿上簽了名。
I met Ravindranath at the train station after lunch. 我午餐後在火車站見到了拉文德拉納特。
We crossed the ravine by a narrow bridge. 我們走過一座狹窄的橋跨越峽谷。
Water had carved a deep ravine in the hillside. 水流在山坡上切出一道深峽谷。

meaning: 多溝谷的；被沖蝕成峽谷的
sentences: The travelers crossed a ravined landscape before reaching the coast. 旅人們穿越一片滿是溝谷的地形後才抵達海岸。
A ravined slope can be dangerous after heavy rain. 被沖蝕出深溝的山坡在豪雨後可能很危險。
Years of ravinement had left the valley walls jagged and bare. 多年的沖蝕成溝作用讓谷壁變得鋸齒狀而裸露。
The map shows clear ravinement along the old drainage line. 地圖顯示舊排水線上有明顯的溝谷化痕跡。
The raviney country made travel slow and exhausting. 多溝谷的地形讓旅程緩慢而疲憊。
A raviney hillside can hide streams and sudden drops. 多峽谷的山坡可能藏著溪流和突然下陷的地勢。
raving reviews filled the comment section after the concert. 演唱會後，留言區充滿狂熱好評。
Her aunt is a raving fan of old detective shows. 她阿姨是老偵探劇的超級迷。
The fans spoke ravingly about the singer's new album. 粉絲們極度熱烈地談論那位歌手的新專輯。
He paced ravingly through the room after hearing the accusation. 他聽到指控後在房裡狂亂地來回踱步。
We ordered mushroom ravioli with brown butter sauce. 我們點了蘑菇義大利餛飩，搭配褐奶油醬。
Homemade ravioli takes patience but rewards careful hands. 自製義式方餃很費工，但對細心的人來說很值得。
The singer's voice can ravish an audience. 那位歌手的嗓音能讓觀眾陶醉。

meaning: 再次連接或以不同方式連接。在長時間分開和/或沒有溝通後再次（與某人）見面；重聚。
sentences: To reconnect means to connect again or differently. To meet up again (with someone), after a long time apart and/or without communication; to reunite. 重新連接意味著再次連接或以不同的方式連接。在長時間分開和/或沒有溝通後再次（與某人）見面；重聚。

We used the afternoon to reconnoitre the village and find a quiet cafe. 我們利用下午時間勘查那座村子，找一家安靜的咖啡館。
The reconnoitrer returned with a sketch of the valley. 那名偵察員帶著山谷草圖回來了。
Our reconnoitrer found a dry path through the marsh. 我們的勘察員在沼澤裡找到一條乾路。

meaning: 以偵察的方式地；像在勘查似地（英式拼法）
sentences: He moved reconnoitringly through the garden, checking every corner. 他像在偵察一樣穿過花園，檢查每個角落。

The lawyer asked the court to reconstrue the clause more narrowly. 律師請法院把那條款重新做更狹義的解釋。

There was a sense of recontinuance in the music, as if the song picked up right where it left off. 那段音樂有種重新延續的感覺，彷彿剛好接回它中斷的地方。

sentences: After a long interruption, they decided to recontinue the discussion over coffee. 經過一段長時間的中斷後，他們決定喝咖啡時把討論重新繼續下去。

sentences: The escape plan was a recontrivance of an older idea, but it worked better this time. 那個逃脫計畫是舊點子的再次巧妙設計，這次效果更好。

The redistillation produced a cleaner sample than the first run. 再次蒸餾後得到的樣本比第一次更純淨。
His redistillation of the argument made the whole proposal easier to understand. 他對論點的再提煉，讓整個提案更容易理解。
The old redistiller in the workshop still worked better than the new machine. 工坊裡那台老舊的再次蒸餾器，運作起來還比新機器好。
As a careful redistiller, he checked every batch twice before approving it. 作為一名細心的再次蒸餾者，他會在放行前把每一批都檢查兩遍。

meaning: 再次扣押；重新強制取走財物
sentences: The creditor threatened to redistrain the goods if the rent stayed unpaid. 債權人威脅說，如果房租還不繳，就要再次扣押那些貨物。
No court would allow the officer to redistrain the same property twice without a new order. 如果沒有新的命令，沒有法院會允許執法人員對同一財產再次扣押兩次。

meaning: 再次扣押者；重新強制取財的人
sentences: In the dispute, the redistrainer arrived with a second notice and a stern expression. 在這場爭議中，那位再次扣押者帶著第二份通知和嚴肅表情出現了。
The record listed him as the redistrainer, but the details of the seizure were unclear. 紀錄上把他列為再次扣押者，但這次扣押的細節並不清楚。

The charity will redistribute the donated clothes to shelters across the city. 這家慈善機構會把捐來的衣物再分發到全市各地的收容所。
The software acts as a redistributer, sending files to the right folders automatically. 這套軟體像一個重新分配者，會自動把檔案送到正確的資料夾。
He was the redistributer of the leftover food after every event. 每次活動結束後，他都是負責重新分發剩餘食物的人。
The redistribution of tasks helped the department move faster. 工作重新分配後，部門的進度明顯加快了。
There was a careful redistribution of the supplies after the flood. 洪水過後，物資進行了仔細的重新分配。

meaning: 重新分配的；具再分配作用的
sentences: The policy has a redistributive effect, moving resources toward poorer neighborhoods. 這項政策帶有重新分配的效果，把資源往較貧困的社區傾斜。
Her speech focused on redistributive justice rather than simple efficiency. 她的演說重點放在再分配正義，而不只是單純的效率。
The warehouse software became a redistributor of incoming orders. 倉儲軟體成了進貨訂單的重新分配者。
In the relief effort, the redistributor made sure each town got what it needed. 在救援行動中，那位再分發者確保每個城鎮都拿到所需物資。

meaning: 再分配的；具有重新分配作用的
sentences: The debate centered on whether the new tax was redistributory or simply punitive. 這場辯論的焦點在於新稅制究竟是再分配性的，還是只是懲罰性的。
She described the program as redistributory, designed to balance opportunity more fairly. 她把這個計畫形容為再分配性的，目的是讓機會分配更公平。

meaning: 重新劃分選區；重新分區
sentences: The legislature voted to redistrict the county before the next election. 州議會投票決定在下次選舉前重新劃分該郡的選區。
If they redistrict the city again, many voters will end up in a different district. 如果他們再度重劃城市選區，很多選民最後會被劃到不同的區。

The noise from the hallway redisturbed her sleep before dawn. 走廊傳來的噪音在天亮前又把她的睡眠打擾了。

The seal will redive as soon as the boat passes. 小船一開過去，那隻海豹就會再潛下去。

There was a sudden rediversion of attention when the speaker changed topics. 當演講者換了話題時，大家的注意力突然又轉向別處。
The airline had to redivert several flights because of the storm. 因為暴風雨，航空公司不得不讓好幾個航班再次改道。
Please redivert the delivery to the back entrance after noon. 請在中午過後把送貨路線重新改到後門。

meaning: 可重新轉向的；可再次改道的
sentences: The route is redivertible, so the driver can adjust it if the bridge closes. 這條路線可重新改道，所以司機若遇到橋樑封閉就能調整。
He liked systems that were redivertible when plans changed at the last minute. 他喜歡那種在臨時變更計畫時，還能重新轉向的系統。
We had to redivide the budget after the funding cut. 經費被削減後，我們只好重新劃分預算。
The family agreed to redivide the land so each sibling would have fair access. 這家人同意再次分割土地，好讓每位手足都能公平使用。
The redivision of the classroom space created more room for group work. 教室空間重新劃分後，小組活動就有了更多位置。
There was a redivision of responsibilities after the manager left. 經理離職後，職責也跟著重新分配。

meaning: 再度復活的；重新活躍的
sentences: The old brand looked redivive after the campaign brought back public interest. 這個老品牌在行銷活動帶回人氣後，又重新活了起來。
She described his hope as redivive, not new but clearly alive again. 她說他的希望帶著再度復活的氣息，不是全新的，但確實又活了過來。
The poem gave the ruins a redivivous energy, as if they were waking from sleep. 這首詩賦予廢墟一種復活般的生命力，彷彿它們正從沉睡中醒來。

The repaired clock looked redivivus on the wall. 修好的時鐘掛在牆上，看起來像重新活過來。

The novel follows a couple who cannot seem to divorce, remarry, and redivorce in peace. 這本小說寫的是一對夫妻怎樣都無法平靜地離婚、再婚，又再次離婚。

meaning: 再次離婚；重新分開的狀態
sentences: Their redivorcement became the topic everyone whispered about at the reunion. 他們再次離婚成了同學會上人人私下議論的話題。

He worried that any redivulgence of the plan would ruin the surprise. 他擔心，只要這個計畫再度泄露，驚喜就全毀了。

meaning: 紅外套的人；穿紅夾克的人
sentences: The redjacket at the station turned out to be my cousin from New York. 站在車站穿紅夾克的人，原來是我從紐約來的表親。

The redknees limped home after sliding on gravel. 那些膝蓋擦紅的人在碎石上滑倒後一拐一拐回家。
At the creek, the kids came back as redknees from kneeling on stones. 在溪邊，孩子們跪在石頭上後回來時膝蓋都紅了。

The redlegs moved the guns before sunrise. 那些紅腿兵在日出前就把火砲移走了。
Villagers heard the redlegs crossing the bridge at night. 村民夜裡聽見那些紅腿兵過橋。
The sunset spread redly across the windows of the apartment. 日落的紅光斜斜地映滿公寓的窗戶。
He blushed redly when the teacher praised his answer. 老師稱讚他的答案時，他一下子臉紅了。
A redmouth flashed under the dock at dusk. 黃昏時，一條紅口魚從碼頭下閃過。
The boy caught a redmouth near the reeds. 男孩在蘆葦旁釣到一條紅口魚。
The redness around her eyes faded after a good night's sleep. 她眼周的紅腫在好好睡了一晚後消退了。
A touch of redness made the painting feel warmer and more alive. 一點點紅色讓這幅畫看起來更溫暖，也更有生氣。
I had to redo the slide deck after the data changed overnight. 因為資料一夜之間變了，我只好把簡報重做一遍。
If the sauce tastes wrong, just redo it from the beginning. 如果醬汁味道不對，就從頭再做一次。
The ferry had to redock because the first approach was too rough. 渡輪因為第一次靠岸太過顛簸，只好重新停靠。
They redocked the ship at the smaller pier to avoid the storm. 他們把船改停到較小的碼頭，以避開風暴。

meaning: 重新立案；重新編入案卷
sentences: The clerk had to redocket the file after the transfer. 這份案件移轉後，書記員得重新把檔案立案。
We asked the court to redocket the complaint today. 我們今天請法院把這份申訴重新編入案卷。

meaning: 芬芳；香氣；令人聯想到的氣息
sentences: The redolence of jasmine drifted through the open window. 茉莉的芬芳從打開的窗戶飄了進來。
There was a redolence of old books in the attic that made her nostalgic. 閣樓裡有種舊書的氣息，讓她不禁懷舊起來。

meaning: 芬芳；濃郁的香味；令人想起之感
sentences: The redolency of fresh bread made everyone hurry to the kitchen. 新鮮麵包的香氣讓大家都趕緊往廚房走去。
Her writing has a redolency of summer evenings and quiet streets. 她的文字帶著一種讓人聯想到夏夜與安靜街道的氣息。

meaning: 香氣四溢的；使人聯想到的
sentences: The room was redolent of cedar and old paper. 這個房間充滿雪松和舊紙的氣味。

meaning: 帶著香氣地；令人聯想到地
sentences: The market stalls smelled redolently of spices and roasted nuts. 市集攤位裡瀰漫著香料與烤堅果的氣味。

meaning: 西班牙四行詩；押韻四行詩節
sentences: The poet ended the poem with a redondilla. 詩人用一段西班牙四行詩結束作品。

sentences: The legend said the mountain would redoom anyone who climbed it alone. 傳說說，那座山會再次註定任何獨自攀登者的命運。

meaning: 使加倍者；加強的人或事物
sentences: In the story, he was the redoubler who kept turning a small risk into a bigger one. 在故事裡，他是那個把小風險越弄越大的加倍者。

meaning: 棱堡；小型防禦工事；最後防線
sentences: The old redoubt still overlooks the harbor from the hilltop. 那座古老的棱堡至今仍從山丘上俯瞰著港口。

meaning: 令人敬畏的；難以對付的；強大的
sentences: The redoubtable judge asked questions that left the lawyers silent. 那位令人敬畏的法官提出的問題，讓律師們一時語塞。

meaning: 令人敬畏；難以對付的程度
sentences: His redoubtableness on the debate stage came from calm timing, not volume. 他在辯論台上的威懾力來自穩定的節奏，而不是音量。
The redoubtableness of the old fortress was enough to discourage invaders. 那座古堡令人敬畏的程度，已足以讓入侵者卻步。

meaning: 令人敬畏地；難以對付地
sentences: The veteran spoke redoubtably, and everyone in the room listened. 那位老將軍說話時氣勢十足，房間裡的人都安靜聽著。
She redoubtably defended her choice without raising her voice. 她沒有提高音量，卻依然氣場十足地為自己的選擇辯護。

She grew into a redoubted trial lawyer in the city. 她後來成了城裡很有名又讓人敬畏的出庭律師。

sentences: The dancers practiced a redowa with a lively three-step rhythm. 舞者們練習了一段節奏活潑的波希米亞三步舞。

meaning: 氧化還原作用；氧化還原反應
sentences: Chemistry class spent the whole afternoon on redox reactions and their energy changes. 化學課整個下午都在講氧化還原反應和它們的能量變化。

Please redraft the email in a calmer tone. 請把這封信改寫成比較平和的語氣。

He had to redrag the suitcase across the wet floor. 他只好把行李箱在濕滑的地板上再拖一次。
The mechanic told him to redrag the cable before tightening the clamp. 技師叫他先把電纜重新拖回正確位置，再把夾具鎖緊。

meaning: 重新懸掛布料；重新垂掛
sentences: She redraped the curtains to let more light into the room. 她把窗簾重新垂掛好，讓更多光線照進房間。
The stylist redraped the fabric over the mannequin until the folds looked soft. 那位造型師把布料重新垂在模特兒上，直到皺摺看起來很柔順。
I need to redraw the kitchen plan after the leak. 漏水後，我得把廚房配置圖重畫。
She asked the child to redraw the cat with longer ears. 她請孩子把那隻貓重新畫成耳朵更長的樣子。
As a careful redrawer, he fixed old comic panels without losing their energy. 身為一個細心的重畫者，他修整舊漫畫頁面時仍保留了原本的張力。
The museum hired a redrawer to restore damaged diagrams from the archive. 博物館雇了一位重畫者，修復檔案裡受損的圖表。
After the breakup, she kept redreaming the same impossible reunion. 分手之後，她總是反覆夢見同一場不可能的重逢。
Some people redream childhood scenes so vividly that they wake up feeling they were there again. 有些人會把童年的場景夢回得非常鮮明，醒來時還覺得自己真的回到了那裡。
The city decided to redredge the harbor before the fishing season. 市政府決定在漁季前再次疏浚港口。
They had to redredge the canal after years of silt buildup. 由於多年淤積，他們只好把運河重新疏浚一遍。
The company promised to redress the billing error quickly. 公司承諾會盡快補救帳單上的錯誤。
The new policy was designed to redress a long-standing imbalance. 這項新政策是為了糾正長期存在的不平衡。
The complaint was redressable through the normal appeal process. 這項申訴可以透過一般上訴程序獲得補救。
Not every harm is redressable, but this one was clear and documented. 不是每一種傷害都能補救，但這次的情況證據明確、記錄完整。
The court ordered a redressal of the unfair charges. 法院要求對那些不公平的收費進行補救。
The union demanded redressal for the workers who had been underpaid. 工會要求替那些被低薪支付的勞工提供救濟。
In the town, the ombudsman was known as a quiet redresser of complaints. 在那個城鎮裡，申訴專員以安靜的糾正者著稱。
She acted as a redresser of old mistakes by helping people recover lost records. 她協助人們找回遺失的紀錄，像是在替舊錯誤補救。
The judge said the injury was redressible if the contract were rewritten. 法官表示，只要重新擬約，這項損害是可以補救的。

The redressive measures focused on training rather than punishment. 這些矯正措施把重點放在訓練，而不是懲罰。
Her redressive speech was meant to repair trust after the dispute. 她那番補救性的談話，是想在爭執後修補信任。

meaning: 無法補救的；無從糾正的
sentences: For years, the villagers felt redressless under the unfair landlord. 多年來，村民在那個不公正的地主底下都覺得無法申冤。

He wanted redressment, not an apology that changed nothing. 他要的是實際補救，而不是一個毫無改變的道歉。

At work, she is the redressor of every scheduling mistake. 在公司裡，她總是那個修正排程錯誤的人。
We had to redrill the holes after the measurements were off by a few millimeters. 因為量測差了幾毫米，我們只好把孔重新鑽過。
The coach will redrill the basics tomorrow until everyone gets the footwork right. 教練明天會再把基本動作重練一次，直到每個人的步法都正確。
I had to redrive across town after leaving my badge. 我把識別證忘了，只好再開車穿過整個城區。
The engineer will redrive the failed job tonight. 工程師今晚會把失敗的任務重新執行。
Redroot grows along the trail and sends up clusters of tiny flowers. 紅根植物常長在步道旁，還會開出一簇簇小花。
The herbalist pointed to redroot as a plant with a bright underground stem. 那位草藥師指著紅根植物，說它有鮮紅的地下莖。
Please redry the towels before guests arrive. 客人來之前，請把毛巾再烘乾一次。
She had to redry the rice after steam wet the lid. 蒸氣把鍋蓋打濕後，她得把米再弄乾一些。
The sun seemed to redsear the hillside by noon. 到了中午，太陽彷彿把山坡又烤焦了一遍。
He redseared the edge of the rope to keep it from fraying. 他把繩子的末端再燒一下，免得它繼續散開。
A redshank waded through the marsh with quick, nervous steps. 一隻紅腳鷸以敏捷又警覺的步伐涉過沼澤。
Birdwatchers came early to spot the redshank before the tide turned. 賞鳥人士一早就來，只為在潮水轉向前看到那隻紅腳鷸。

meaning: 紅衫球員；延後出賽的新生球員
sentences: The quarterback took a redshirt year and spent it learning the playbook. 那位四分衛先以紅衫年身分休戰，把時間拿來熟悉戰術本。
He returned from his redshirt season stronger and more confident. 結束紅衫賽季後，他回到場上時更強壯也更有自信。

meaning: 對美洲原住民的冒犯舊稱
sentences: The host apologized after saying redskin on air. 主持人在節目上說出那個冒犯舊稱後道歉了。
The poster was removed because it used redskin. 那張海報因用了那個冒犯稱呼而被撤下。
A redstart flashed through the branches like a little ember. 一隻紅尾鴝像小火星一樣，從樹枝間掠過。
We heard a redstart sing near the campsite at dawn. 破曉時分，我們聽見營地附近有一隻紅尾鴝在唱歌。
A redstreak ran through the marble and caught the light. 大理石裡有一道紅色條痕，還被光線照得很明顯。
The sunset left a redstreak across the horizon. 夕陽在地平線上留下了一道紅色的長痕。
He clipped a redtab onto the folder so the report would stand out. 他在資料夾上夾了一個紅色標籤，讓那份報告更醒目。
The jacket had a redtab at the pocket seam, which made it easy to spot. 那件外套口袋縫線上有一個紅色標記，因此很好辨認。
A redtail circled above the field and then vanished into the clouds. 一隻紅尾鵟在田野上空盤旋，接著消失在雲裡。
The children stopped to watch the redtail perch on the fence post. 孩子們停下來看那隻紅尾鵟棲在柵欄柱上。

meaning: 紅喉鳥；喉部帶紅色的鳥類
sentences: A redthroat perched on the fence and sang at sunrise. 一隻紅喉鳥停在圍欄上，在日出時唱著歌。
We spotted the redthroat again near the creek this afternoon. 今天下午我們又在小溪附近看見那隻紅喉鳥。

meaning: 紅頂草；紅穗草一類的植物
sentences: The meadow was dotted with redtop swaying in the wind. 草地上點綴著隨風搖曳的紅頂草。
Farmers once valued redtop for the hay it could provide. 農人過去很重視紅頂草，因為它能提供乾草。
The studio had to redub several lines after the microphone failed. 麥克風出問題後，錄音室不得不把幾句台詞重新配音。
They decided to redub the documentary for a younger audience. 他們決定為年輕觀眾把這部紀錄片重新配音。

meaning: 重新配音的人；重錄配音者
sentences: The redubber matched the actor's mouth movements with surprising care. 那位重新配音者把演員的口型對得出奇仔細。
In a busy post-production house, a good redubber is worth a lot. 在忙碌的後期製作公司裡，好的重新配音者非常珍貴。
We should all try to reduce our usage of single-use plastic. 我們都應該努力減少一次性塑料的使用。
The new system will help to reduce the overall operational costs. 新系統將有助於降低整體的營運成本。
The company treats overtime as reduceable when deadlines are flexible. 公司認為，只要期限有彈性，加班時間就是可以縮減的。
Not every cost in the budget is reduceable without consequences. 預算裡並不是每一筆開銷都能在沒有後果的情況下縮減。

meaning: 可縮減性；可降低的程度
sentences: She argued about the reduceableness of the project before signing off. 她在簽核前先討論了這個專案到底有多大的可縮減性。
The reduceableness of the plan depends on how much waste we can cut. 這個方案有多可縮減，要看我們能減掉多少浪費。
We bought reduced bread after 8 p.m. 我們晚上八點後買了降價麵包。
His work hours stayed reduced through July. 他的工時整個七月都維持縮減狀態。
The reducement of traffic noise made the street much calmer. 交通噪音的減少讓這條街安靜許多。
He presented the reducement of costs as the first step toward recovery. 他把成本縮減當成復甦的第一步。

meaning: 起減少作用的；使降低的
sentences: They were looking for a reducent ingredient in the formula. 他們正在配方裡尋找一種能起減少作用的成分。
The medicine has a reducent effect on swelling. 這種藥對腫脹有減輕作用。

meaning: 減縮器；降低裝置；減少者
sentences: The plumber installed a pressure reducer on the main line. 水管工在主管線上裝了一個減壓器。
In the lab, a reducer can make the reaction easier to control. 在實驗室裡，降低裝置能讓反應更容易控制。
The team tested the reducibility of the problem before choosing a method. 團隊在選擇方法前先測試了這個問題的可歸約性。
His talk focused on the reducibility of complex systems into smaller parts. 他的演講聚焦於複雜系統能否化簡成更小的部分。
The fraction is reducible if both numbers share a common factor. 如果分子和分母有公因數，這個分數就是可化簡的。
For her, stress was reducible once she changed her schedule. 對她來說，只要調整行程，壓力就能減輕。
The reducibleness of the equation made the homework easier than expected. 這道方程式的可化簡性讓作業比預期簡單。
He questioned the reducibleness of the whole proposal. 他質疑整個提案到底有多少可縮減的空間。
The data were organized reducibly so the model could read them quickly. 這些資料是以可化簡的方式整理的，所以模型能快速讀取。
He explained the idea reducibly, without losing the main point. 他把這個概念用可化簡的方式說明，卻沒有丟掉重點。
The city is reducing car lanes to make room for bikes. 這座城市正在減少汽車車道，為自行車騰出空間。
She is reducing her sugar intake before the marathon. 她在馬拉松前正減少糖分攝取。

meaning: 還原物；被還原的物質；縮減結果
sentences: In chemistry, the reduct was examined under a microscope. 在化學中，這種還原物被放在顯微鏡下檢查。
The old manuscript looked like a reduct of an earlier, longer version. 那份古老手稿看起來像是早期較長版本的縮減本。
The chemist added a reductant to speed up the reaction. 化學家加入還原劑來加快反應。
In this process, the reductant must be chosen very carefully. 在這個過程中，還原劑必須非常小心挑選。
The lab tracked one reductase in the liver sample. 實驗室在肝臟樣本裡追蹤一種還原酶。
Too little reductase slowed the reaction in the tube. 還原酶太少，讓試管裡的反應變慢了。
The reductibility of the compound made it useful in the experiment. 這種化合物的可還原性讓它在實驗中很有用。
We discussed the reductibility of the theory before the lecture ended. 在講座結束前，我們討論了這個理論的可化簡性。
The company announced a significant reduction in its workforce this year. 該公司宣布今年將大幅削減（減少）其勞動力。
You can get a further reduction in price if you pay for the goods in cash. 如果你用現金付款，價格可以進一步降低（折扣）。
The manager introduced a reductional policy to cut waste. 經理提出了一項縮減性的政策來減少浪費。
Her argument was reductional, but it helped the room reach a decision. 她的論點帶有縮減傾向，但也幫助大家做出決定。
The philosopher warned against reductionism in debates about human behavior. 那位哲學家警告，在討論人類行為時不要陷入還原主義。
Reductionism can be useful, but it also hides important details. 簡化主義有時很有用，但也會遮蔽重要細節。
The reductionist said every social problem could be traced to incentives. 那位還原主義者說，每個社會問題都能追溯到誘因。
As a reductionist, he liked explanations that were short and direct. 身為還原主義者，他喜歡簡短直接的解釋。

meaning: 還原主義的；過度簡化的
sentences: The article criticized the reductionistic view that money explains everything. 這篇文章批評了那種認為金錢能解釋一切的還原主義觀點。
A reductionistic answer is not always a wrong answer, but it can be incomplete. 過度簡化的答案不一定錯，但常常不完整。
The teacher gave a reductive summary to help beginners start. 老師給了一個簡化的摘要，讓初學者能先入門。
His reductive explanation left out the emotional side of the story. 他的簡化式說明忽略了故事中的情感面。
She reductively framed the issue as a choice between speed and safety. 她以簡化的方式把這個問題框成速度與安全之間的選擇。
The report reductively grouped several unrelated causes together. 那份報告用過度簡化的方式，把幾個不相關的原因混在一起。
The mill installed a reductor beside the motor. 工廠在馬達旁裝了一個減速器。
A worn reductor made the press shake at low speed. 磨損的減速器讓壓機低速運轉時發抖。

meaning: 與縮減有關的；與還原有關的
sentences: The essay had a reductorial tone that stripped the topic to its basics. 這篇文章帶有縮減式的語氣，把主題剝到最基本的層次。
His reductorial reading of the case missed the broader context. 他對這個案例的還原式解讀忽略了更大的背景。
If the numbers look wrong, redue the calculation from the beginning. 如果數字看起來不對，就從頭再算一次。
The editor asked the writer to redue the opening paragraph. 編輯要作者把開頭段落重新處理一次。
Redunca includes several kinds of reedbuck. 這個屬包含幾種蘆羚。
At the zoo, Redunca stood on the sign above the enclosure. 動物園圍欄上方的牌子寫著這個屬名。
The report had too much redundance, so I trimmed several paragraphs. 這份報告冗詞太多，所以我刪掉了幾段。
A little redundance can be helpful in a speech, but too much becomes tiring. 演說裡有一點冗餘也許有幫助，但太多就會讓人疲倦。
The backup line adds redundancy to the network. 備援線路替網路增加了冗餘。
He got redundancy pay after the factory cut jobs. 工廠裁員後，他拿到了資遣補償。
Four employees were made redundant. 四名員工被裁員。
Something described as redundant is dismissed from employment because no longer needed. 被描述為多餘的人因不再需要而被解僱。
He redundantly repeated the warning three times before leaving. 他在離開前多餘地重複提醒了三次。
The system was redundantly backed up in case one server failed. 這套系統以冗餘方式備份，以防其中一台伺服器故障。
The announcer reduplicated the final phrase for dramatic effect. 主持人為了營造戲劇效果，把最後一句又重複了一次。
I don't want to reduplicate your work, so I'll check the shared notes first. 我不想重複你的工作，所以我會先查看共用筆記。

meaning: 重複；複製；語言中的重疊構詞
sentences: The designer used reduplication to make the logo feel playful. 設計師用重複手法讓標誌看起來更俏皮。
In linguistics, reduplication can change meaning without adding new words. 在語言學裡，重疊構詞可以不增加新字就改變意思。
Her reduplicative style made the speech sound musical and memorable. 她那種重複性的說法讓演講聽起來更有韻律，也更好記。
The children loved the reduplicative rhyme in the bedtime story. 孩子們很喜歡睡前故事裡那種重疊式的押韻。

meaning: 以重複的方式；以重疊構詞的方式
sentences: He spoke reduplicatively, letting each important word come back twice. 他用重複的方式說話，讓每個重要的字都回來兩次。
The chant was reduplicatively patterned, so it sounded almost hypnotic. 那段吟唱以重疊的節奏排列，聽起來幾乎有催眠感。

meaning: 造成重複的；具重疊效果的
sentences: The editor removed the reduplicatory lines to tighten the paragraph. 編輯刪掉那些造成重複的句子，讓段落更精簡。
The poem's reduplicatory rhythm gave it an old folk-song feel. 這首詩那種反覆的節奏，讓它有種古老民謠的味道。

meaning: 摺返的部分；重疊折返處
sentences: The map had a reduplicature where the paper folded back on itself. 那張地圖上有一處摺返，紙邊往回折了起來。
A careful hand smoothed the reduplicature before the manuscript was photographed. 在手稿拍照前，一隻細心的手先把摺返處壓平。
The reduviid moved slowly along the wall, looking like a tiny predator. 那隻蠍蝽科昆蟲沿著牆慢慢爬行，看起來像個小獵手。
A naturalist identified the bug as a reduviid rather than a harmless beetle. 一位自然學家認出那隻蟲是蠍蝽，而不是無害的甲蟲。
Reduviidae hunts other insects with a sharp beak. 獵蝽科會用尖嘴捕食其他昆蟲。
The student pinned Reduviidae on the family chart. 那名學生把這個科名標在分類圖上。
The insect had a reduvioid shape, narrow and sharply pointed. 那隻昆蟲有蠍蝽狀的外形，又窄又尖。
Its reduvioid profile made it easy to mistake for a predatory bug. 它那種像蠍蝽的輪廓，很容易讓人誤以為是掠食性昆蟲。
Reduvius can hide in wall cracks during the day. 這個屬的昆蟲白天會躲在牆縫裡。
The jar label identified the specimen as Reduvius. 罐子上的標籤把那個標本標成這個屬。

meaning: 再現的；重新呈現的；復返的
sentences: The film felt like a noir redux with brighter colors. 這部電影像是黑色電影的復返版，只是色彩更明亮。
She treated the dish as a family recipe redux, not a copy. 她把這道菜當成家傳食譜的再現版，而不是照抄。
The sky shifted redward as the sun dropped lower. 太陽愈沉愈低時，天空也往紅色那端轉去。
The graph drifted redward when the warm light hit the screen. 暖光照到螢幕時，圖表的色調往紅端偏移。
The shelf was lined with old redware from a local kiln. 架子上擺滿了當地窯場燒出的舊紅陶。
She collected redware because she loved the warm color of the clay. 她收藏紅陶，因為她喜歡那種泥土的溫暖色澤。
A redweed spread along the fence after the rain. 下雨後，一株紅莖野草沿著籬笆長開了。
She pulled redweed from the bean patch before breakfast. 她早餐前把豆田裡的紅色雜草拔掉了。

meaning: 紅翼鳥；尤指歐洲紅翼鶇或紅翅黑鸝
sentences: A redwing flashed across the hedges and vanished into the trees. 一隻紅翼鳥掠過樹籬，隨即消失在樹林裡。
In winter, the park sometimes fills with redwings from farther north. 冬天時，公園裡有時會飛來北方的紅翼鳥。

meaning: 紅柳枝；可彎曲的紅色繩條
sentences: The fence was tied with a redwithe cut from a willow tree. 那道籬笆是用從柳樹上割下的紅柳枝綁住的。
He bent the redwithe into a loop before fastening the bundle. 他先把紅柳枝彎成圈，再把那捆東西綁好。
A redwood shaded the picnic tables all afternoon. 一棵紅杉整個下午都替野餐桌遮蔭。
We bought a redwood bench for the yard. 我們替院子買了一張紅杉木長椅。
I want to redye this scarf so the color looks deeper. 我想把這條圍巾重新染色，讓顏色更深一些。
They had to redye the fabric after the first batch came out too pale. 第一批布料染得太淡，所以他們只好再染一次。
Ree signed the guest book before entering the gallery. 他在進入展廳前先在來賓簿上簽名。
The package was addressed to Ree, so the front desk held it aside. 包裹是寄給某人的，所以櫃台先代為保留。
The baker had to ree the flour before mixing the dough. 麵包師傅在和麵之前，得先把麵粉過篩。
Old recipes sometimes ask you to ree grain by hand. 舊食譜有時會叫你用手把穀物篩過。

meaning: 有濃烈氣味的；煙燻發黑的
sentences: The kitchen went reechy after the onions burned. 洋蔥燒焦後，廚房裡瀰漫著一股濃重的味道。
His coat smelled reechy from the campfire and the wet wood. 他的外套沾上了營火和濕木頭的味道，聞起來很嗆。

meaning: 凝乳酵素；反芻動物的第四胃
sentences: In older texts, reed meant the fourth stomach of a ruminant. 舊文本中，這個詞指反芻動物的第四胃。
The old recipe called for reed to help the milk curdle. 舊配方要求使用凝乳酵素來幫助牛奶凝結。

meaning: 葦地鳥；常指在蘆葦叢中活動的小鳥
sentences: A reedbird darted out of the marsh and vanished in a blink. 一隻葦地鳥從沼澤裡竄出來，一眨眼就不見了。
The birdwatcher came early to catch sight of the reedbird at dawn. 那位賞鳥人很早就來，只為在清晨看見那隻蘆葦鳥。

meaning: 水羚屬的非洲羚羊；蘆葦羚
sentences: A reedbuck stepped out of the tall grass near the riverbank. 一隻蘆葦羚從河岸旁的高草裡走了出來。
The safari guide pointed out a reedbuck hiding in the reeds. 狩獵導遊指著躲在蘆葦裡的一隻蘆葦羚。

meaning: 蘆葦叢；長滿蘆葦的灌叢
sentences: The path disappeared into a dense reedbush beside the pond. 小徑消失在池塘邊濃密的蘆葦叢裡。
We heard frogs before we saw the reedbush sway in the wind. 我們先聽見青蛙叫，才看到那片蘆葦叢在風中搖動。

meaning: 有細條紋的；帶滾紋的；飾有蘆葦狀紋理的
sentences: The old coin had a reeded edge that felt familiar in my palm. 那枚舊硬幣邊緣有滾紋，握在手裡很有熟悉的觸感。
She chose a reeded glass vase because the grooves caught the light. 她選了一只帶細紋的玻璃花瓶，因為那些凹槽會把光線抓住。

meaning: 由蘆葦做成的；含蘆葦的
sentences: The cottage had a reeden roof that looked rustic and tidy. 那間小屋有一個蘆葦做的屋頂，看起來樸實又整齊。
He followed the reeden bank until the stream widened into a marsh. 他沿著長滿蘆葦的河岸走，直到溪流變寬成了沼澤。

meaning: 從事蘆葦屋頂、織機筘或相關工作的工人
sentences: The reeder checked the loom before the day's weaving began. 那位修筘工人在一天的織布開始前先檢查了織機。
In the village, a reeder was once needed to keep the roof watertight. 在那個村子裡，過去得靠蘆葦屋頂工人來保持屋頂不漏水。
He called the shortcut reediemadeasy in the chat. 他在聊天群裡把那個捷徑戲稱成一個自造怪詞。
The poster used reediemadeasy as a silly fake product name. 那張海報拿一個自造怪詞當成搞笑商品名。

meaning: 像蘆葦般地；纖細地；帶有蘆葦感地
sentences: The singer leaned reedily into the microphone, almost too softly to hear. 那位歌手像蘆葦般纖細地靠近麥克風，聲音小得幾乎聽不見。
The grass moved reedily in the wind along the river edge. 河岸邊的草在風中像蘆葦一樣輕輕搖擺。

meaning: 蘆葦茂密；纖細如蘆葦的狀態
sentences: The reediness of the marsh made the shoreline hard to see. 沼澤裡蘆葦叢生，讓岸線很難看清。

He tried to refeign indifference, but his grin gave him away. 他想再次裝作無所謂，但嘴角的笑意早就出賣了他。
The actor had to refeign surprise for the second take. 那位演員在第二次拍攝時得再次裝作驚訝。
The editor wrote a short note to refel the rumor before it spread further. 編輯寫了一則簡短說明，駁斥那則謠言，以免它繼續擴散。
She could refel a bad argument with one sharp question. 她只要用一個尖銳的問題，就能駁倒糟糕的論點。
They had to refence the garden after the storm. 暴風雨過後，他們得把花園重新圍起來。
Please refence the dog run before sunset. 日落前請把狗活動區再圍好。
Please refer to the instruction manual if you have any questions about the machine. 如果你對這台機器有任何疑問，請參考（查閱）說明書。
The doctor decided to refer the patient to a specialist for further tests. 醫生決定將病人轉介給專科醫生進行進一步檢查。

meaning: 可歸因於某事的；可參照的
sentences: The delay was referable to a train strike, not to bad planning. 這次延誤可歸因於火車罷工，而不是規劃失當。
Several notes in the margin were referable to the chapter we had just read. 頁邊的幾則筆記都能對照到我們剛讀過的那一章。
The referee made several controversial decisions during the football match. 裁判在足球比賽中做出了幾項具爭議的判決。
She asked her former professor to act as a referee for her job application. 她請以前的教授擔任她求職申請的推薦人（介紹人）。
He made a brief reference to the incident during his speech but didn't go into detail. 他在演講中簡短地提到了（參考了）那次事件，但沒有詳述細節。
You will need to provide at least two professional references for your job application. 你的工作申請需要提供至少兩份專業推薦人（參考資料）。
The constitution allowed local referenda on school funding. 憲法允許地方就學校經費舉行公投。
Two referenda were held in the same year, and both drew strong public debate. 同一年舉行了兩次公投，兩次都引發激烈的公眾討論。

meaning: 公投的；與公民投票有關的
sentences: The committee studied the referendal question for weeks before making a recommendation. 委員會花了好幾週研究這個公投議題，才提出建議。
His speech turned referendal when he asked the crowd to vote on the proposal. 當他請群眾對提案投票時，演說就帶上了公投式的語氣。
The referendary announced the final count late that night. 那位公投官在當晚很晚才宣布最終票數。
As referendary, he had to keep the process fair and transparent. 身為公投官，他必須讓程序保持公平又透明。

meaning: 公投官職；公投官的職位
sentences: She accepted the referendaryship only after the council promised full support. 她是在議會承諾全力支援後，才接受這個公投官職。
His referendaryship was short, but it left a strong record of impartial work. 他的公投官任期雖短，卻留下了公正辦事的好紀錄。
The country held a national referendum to decide on the new policy. 該國舉行了全國公民投票來決定這項新政策。
The results of the referendum show a strong support for democratic principles. 公投結果顯示大眾對民主原則的強烈支持。
In linguistics, the word's referent is the actual thing it points to. 在語言學裡，詞語的所指是它實際指向的事物。
When he said 'that book,' the referent was clear to everyone in the room. 當他說「那本書」時，房間裡每個人都知道他指的是哪一本。

meaning: 參照的；提及的；指稱性的
sentences: Her joke was so referential that only longtime fans understood it. 她的笑話太多參照梗，只有老粉絲看得懂。
The article was carefully referential and included sources for every major claim. 那篇文章引用得很謹慎，幾乎每個重要說法都有來源。
The phrase works referentially, pointing back to an earlier line in the poem. 這個片語在指稱上是有作用的，它指回詩中的前一句。
He spoke referentially, as if every sentence depended on an old family story. 他說話總帶著參照意味，彷彿每句話都依附在某個老家族故事上。

meaning: 以指涉方式；作為所指地
sentences: In the sentence, the name points referently to her aunt. 在那個句子裡，那個名字是用來指她阿姨。
He used the title referently, not politely. 他用那個稱呼只是作為指涉，不是出於禮貌。
The referment of the case to another office caused a long delay. 這個案件被轉交到另一個單位，因而拖了很久。
Her referment to the old letter changed the tone of the meeting. 她提到那封舊信後，整場會議的氣氛都變了。
The doctor gave her a referral to a specialist downtown. 醫生把她轉介給市區的一位專科醫師。
Thanks to a referral from a friend, he found the apartment before it was listed online. 多虧朋友介紹，他在房子上網刊登前就先找到了那間公寓。
The referrer asked for an update after the interview. 那位推薦人在面試後詢問了進度。
Each referrer received a thank-you message when the program ended. 活動結束時，每位介紹人都收到了一封感謝訊息。

meaning: 可轉介的；可歸屬的；可提及的
sentences: The complaint was referrible to the customer service team, not to accounting. 這起投訴應轉給客服團隊處理，不是會計部門。
His nickname was referrible to a joke he had made years earlier. 他的綽號可以追溯到他多年前開的一個玩笑。

meaning: 可轉介性；可歸屬性；可提及性
sentences: The referribleness of the issue mattered more than the wording of the report. 這個問題是否能被轉介處理，比報告用詞更重要。
We discussed the referribleness of the claim before deciding whom to contact. 在決定要聯絡誰之前，我們先討論了這項主張是否有可轉介性。
Spring refertilization helped the lawn recover. 春天再施肥讓草坪恢復了生氣。
The farmer delayed refertilization until after rain. 那位農夫把再施肥延到下雨之後。
We refertilize the roses every six weeks. 我們每六週替玫瑰再施一次肥。
They will refertilize the field after the corn is cut. 玉米收割後，他們會再替田地施肥。
I had to refetch my badge from the car. 我得回車上再去拿一次識別證。
Please refetch the blue towel from upstairs. 請上樓把那條藍毛巾再拿下來。
The two boxers agreed to refight next winter. 那兩名拳手同意明年冬天再戰一場。
Families still refight the same parking argument every holiday. 每逢假日，家人還是會為同樣的停車問題再吵一次。
Please refigure the total with the student discount. 請把學生折扣算進去後重新計算總額。
She stayed late to refigure the budget by hand. 她留到很晚，用手重新核算預算。

meaning: 用於補充或替換某物的東西。以優惠的價格提供額外的食物或飲料。
sentences: Today it is $2 for a coffee, with free refills throughout the day. 現在一杯咖啡的價格為 2 美元，全天免費續杯。
Tank's empty. We need to go for a refill. 水箱空了。我們需要去補充一下。
This soap bottle is refillable at the shop. 這個洗手乳瓶可以在店裡重複補充。
We keep refillable pens in the meeting room. 我們在會議室放可重複填墨的筆。
The director chose to refilm the kitchen scene. 導演決定把廚房那一幕重拍。
We need to refilm that clip before the light fades. 天色變暗前，我們得把那段片重拍。
Please refilter the coffee because grounds got through. 咖啡渣漏進去了，請把咖啡重新過濾。
The lab had to refilter the sample after dust fell in. 灰塵掉進去後，實驗室只好重新過濾樣本。
The draft is rough but still refinable. 這份草稿很粗，但還是能再修。
That crude oil is refinable at the coastal plant. 那批原油可以在沿海工廠進一步精煉。
One more step of refinage removed the smell from the raw sugar. 再多一道精煉程序就去除了粗糖的氣味。
The metal went through one more stage of refinage. 那塊金屬又多經過了一道提純程序。
We may refinance the house next spring. 我們明年春天可能會替房貸重新辦理融資。
She chose to refinance the truck at a lower rate. 她選擇用較低利率重新貸這輛卡車。
I had to refind the page after the app crashed. 應用程式當掉後，我得重新找到那一頁。
The hikers used the stream to refind the trail. 登山客靠著溪流重新找到步道。
Oil is refined into gasoline at the refinery. 原油在煉油廠被提煉成汽油。
He spent years trying to refine his technique. 他花了多年時間試圖完善自己的技術。
The manager wrote refine(ment) next to the rough layout. 經理在粗略版面旁寫下要再精修的意思。
We kept one box for refine(ment) on the checklist. 我們在清單上留了一格給後續改進。

meaning: 精確，沒有不精確，特別是： 睿智，有時過於微妙或假裝睿智。微妙、謹慎、深思熟慮。
sentences: The argument, while not persuasive, is quite refined. 這個論點雖然沒有說服力，但相當精煉。
The curriculum has been carefully refined to meet the needs of foreign students. 課程經過精心完善，以滿足外國學生的需求。
She answered refinedly even after the rude joke. 就算遇到無禮玩笑，她回話仍很得體。
The room was refinedly decorated in cream and blue. 那個房間用奶油色和藍色布置得很雅致。
The tea set gave the table a quiet refinedness. 那組茶具讓桌面多了一種安靜的雅致。
His writing lost some warmth in its polished refinedness. 他的文字雖然很講究，卻少了一點溫度。

meaning: 精煉；提純；去除雜質的過程
sentences: The refinement of the metal removed the last impurities. 金屬的精煉去除了最後的雜質。
Further refinement improved the sample's purity. 進一步提純提高了樣本的純度。
A skilled refiner can judge gold by color. 熟練的精煉者能靠顏色判斷黃金狀態。
The refiner removed sulfur from the fuel. 那台精煉設備把燃料中的硫去掉了。
The refinery turns crude oil into fuel. 那座精煉廠把原油轉成燃料。
A new refinery was built near the port. 港口附近新建了一座精煉廠。
Please do not refinger the pastries after choosing one. 選好之後，請不要再用手去摸其他點心。
He refingered the zipper until it finally moved. 他又用手去拉了幾次拉鍊，最後才拉開。
The sauce needs a little refining before dinner. 晚餐前，這個醬汁還需要再調整一下。
Years of refining made her swing look easy. 經過多年琢磨，她揮拍時看起來很輕鬆。

meaning: 以改進方式；使更精緻地
sentences: The coach spoke refiningly, fixing one habit at a time. 教練用一步步修正的方式說明，一次只改一個習慣。
The editor cut the paragraph refiningly, not harshly. 編輯修改那段文字時是在細修，不是硬砍。
We plan to refinish the table this weekend. 我們打算這週末把桌面重新整修上漆。
They had to refinish the floor after the leak. 漏水後，他們得把地板表面重新整修。
The kiln may refire if the first glaze looks dull. 如果第一層釉看起來太暗，窯爐可能要再燒一次。
He tried to refire the grill after the wind died. 風停後，他試著把烤爐重新點起來。
The yard will refit the boat before winter. 船廠會在冬天前把這艘船整修好。
We refit the guest room with brighter lamps. 我們替客房重新配上更亮的燈。
The ship returned for refitment after the storm. 暴風雨後，那艘船回來整修。
Office refitment took three quiet weekends. 辦公室整修花了三個安靜的週末。
Please refix the loose shelf before dinner. 晚餐前請把鬆掉的層板重新固定好。
The dentist had to refix the small bracket. 牙醫得把那個小托槽重新黏好。
The plaster needed refixation after the crack spread. 裂縫擴大後，那塊灰泥需要重新固定。
Lens refixation kept the camera steady. 鏡片重新固定後，相機穩多了。
The sign required refixture after the screws rusted. 螺絲生鏽後，那塊招牌需要重新安裝固定。
Quick refixture put the mirror back on the wall. 迅速重新固定後，鏡子又回到牆上了。
The owner plans to reflag the cargo ship this year. 船東打算今年替貨輪改掛別國旗幟。
They had to reflag the boat after the sale. 船賣掉後，他們得替它重新掛上新旗。
The cruel order was to reflagellate the captive at dawn. 那道殘酷命令是要在黎明時再鞭打那名俘虜。
No court should reflagellate someone for the same offense. 任何法院都不該為同一件事再次施以鞭刑。
Dry wind can reflame the brush by noon. 乾風可能在中午前讓灌木叢再次起火。
One rude text may reflame the family argument. 一則無禮訊息就可能讓家族爭執再度升高。
The technician had to reflash the router after the failed update. 更新失敗後，技師得把路由器重新刷寫。
We can reflash the board with a clean image. 我們可以用乾淨映像重新燒錄這塊板子。
Please reflate the bike tire before school. 上學前請把腳踏車輪胎再充飽。
The central bank tried to reflate the economy with cheap loans. 中央銀行試著用低利貸款重新刺激經濟。

meaning: 通貨再膨脹；讓經濟與物價回升的政策
sentences: The central bank hinted at reflation to pull the economy out of its slump. 中央銀行暗示會推動通貨再膨脹，好讓經濟走出低迷。
Investors began pricing in reflation after wages and spending picked up. 在薪資和消費回升後，投資人開始把通貨再膨脹納入考量。

meaning: 通貨再膨脹主義；主張以擴張貨幣刺激經濟的觀點
sentences: His speech sounded like reflationism, with its promise to flood the market with easier money. 他的演說聽起來很像通貨再膨脹主義，承諾要用更寬鬆的資金灌進市場。
The committee remained split over whether reflationism would revive growth or simply raise prices. 委員會對於通貨再膨脹主義究竟能振興成長，還是只會推高物價，始終意見分歧。
The calm surface of the lake reflected the surrounding mountains perfectly. 平靜的湖面完美地倒映（反射）出周圍的山巒。
After the project finished, we took some time to reflect on what we had learned. 專案結束後，我們花了一些時間來反思（思考）我們學到了什麼。
The sensor measures leaf reflectance in bright sun. 這個感測器會在強光下測量葉片反射率。
Dark paint has lower reflectance than white tile. 深色油漆的反射率比白色磁磚低。
The reflected glare made the screen hard to read. 反射眩光讓螢幕很難看清。
We watched the reflected light dance on the ceiling. 我們看著反射光在天花板上跳動。

meaning: 反射地；經由反射地；經思考後地
sentences: The lamp's glow reached the hallway reflectedly from the polished wall. 燈光經由拋光牆面反射地照進了走廊。
She answered reflectedly, choosing her words only after a long pause. 她思索後才回答，停了很久才選定用字。
The reflectedness of the image made it hard to tell where the window ended. 影像的反射狀態讓人很難分辨窗戶到底在哪裡結束。
Scientists measured the reflectedness of the surface under different angles. 科學家測量了該表面在不同角度下的反射狀態。

meaning: 反射的；可反射的；反光的
sentences: The reflectent surface flashed whenever the train headlights passed. 列車頭燈經過時，那個反光表面就會一閃一閃。
A reflectent coating was added to make the instrument easier to read. 後來又加上一層可反射的塗層，讓儀器更容易讀值。

meaning: 反射器；反光裝置；反光的人
sentences: The bicycle light has a small reflecter that helps drivers notice it at night. 這台腳踏車的燈上有一個小反射器，能讓駕駛人在夜裡更容易注意到它。
He used the shiny tray as a makeshift reflecter to brighten the corner. 他把那個亮面托盤當成臨時反射器，來照亮角落。

meaning: 可反射性；能被反射的特性
sentences: The reflectibility of the foil made it useful in the experiment. 那層箔片的可反射性，讓它很適合用在實驗裡。
Low reflectibility is one reason the coating reduces glare so well. 低可反射性正是這種塗層能有效減少眩光的原因之一。

meaning: 可反射的；能反射光線的
sentences: The film is thin but still reflectible enough to show a faint image. 這層薄膜雖然很薄，卻仍然具有足夠的可反射性來呈現淡淡的影像。
He chose a reflectible layer so the sensor could read the signal clearly. 他選了可反射的那一層，好讓感測器能清楚讀取訊號。
The reflecting water turned the sunset into a second sky. 那片會反光的水面把夕陽變成了另一片天空。
She sat by the window, reflecting on the decision she had to make. 她坐在窗邊，沉思著自己必須做出的決定。
He stared at the table reflectingly before giving his answer. 他在回答前，先若有所思地盯著桌面。
The essay was written reflectingly, with every claim carefully weighed. 那篇文章寫得很有反思感，每個論點都經過仔細衡量。
She stared at her own reflection in the mirror for a long time. 她對著鏡子裡自己的影像（倒影）凝視了良久。
The survey results are a clear reflection of public opinion on the new policy. 調查結果清楚地反映（體現）了大眾對新政策的意見。
The reflectional pattern on the glass made the storefront look deeper than it was. 玻璃上的反射圖樣讓店面看起來比實際更有深度。
She gave a reflectional account of the incident, not just a quick summary. 她用帶有反思意味的方式描述那件事，而不只是草草摘要。

meaning: 反思論者；重視反思哲學的人
sentences: The reflectionist argued that careful self-examination should come before any judgment. 那位反思論者主張，在做出任何判斷前都應先仔細自我檢視。
As a reflectionist, she loved books that turned ordinary moments into questions. 她身為一位重視反思的人，特別喜歡把平凡時刻變成問題意識的書。
The new display screen was almost reflectionless, even under bright lights. 新螢幕幾乎不反光，就算在強光下也一樣。
A reflectionless surface can make scientific measurements far more reliable. 不反光的表面能讓科學測量可靠得多。
The moon's reflective light illuminated the calm surface of the lake. 月亮的反射光照亮了平靜的湖面。
She was in a reflective mood, pondering her future plans and dreams. 她正處於沈思的心境中，思索著未來的計畫與夢想。
He smiled reflectively, as if the answer had taken shape slowly in his mind. 他若有所思地笑了，彷彿答案在腦中慢慢成形。
The surface shimmered reflectively in the afternoon sun. 那個表面在午後陽光下反光閃爍。

meaning: 反思性；沉思氣質；反光性
sentences: Her reflectiveness showed up in the way she asked careful follow-up questions. 她那種沉思氣質，從她總是謹慎追問後續問題就看得出來。
The reflectiveness of the metal helped the camera pick up the shape of the room. 金屬的反光性幫助相機捕捉到房間的輪廓。
Snow has high reflectivity, which is why it can be painful to look at on a sunny day. 雪的反射率很高，所以晴天直視時會很刺眼。
The scientist compared the reflectivity of several coatings before choosing one. 科學家先比較了幾種塗層的反射率，再決定選哪一種。
The reflectometer gave a precise reading of the sample's surface. 反射計精確地讀出了樣本表面的數值。
In the lab, a reflectometer can reveal changes that the eye would miss. 在實驗室裡，反射率測定儀能看出肉眼忽略的變化。

meaning: 反射測量法；反射率測定技術
sentences: The team used reflectometry to inspect the coating without damaging it. 團隊用反射測量法檢查那層塗膜，而且不會破壞它。
Reflectometry is especially useful when the surface is too delicate to touch. 當表面太脆弱不適合碰觸時，反射率測定技術特別有用。
The road reflector caught my headlights long before I reached the bend. 道路反光器在我轉彎前很久就先把車燈反射回來了。
A good reflector can make a small stage feel much brighter. 一個好的反射器能讓小舞台看起來明亮許多。

meaning: 反射投影儀；早期投影裝置
