The reformed schedule gave the students longer breaks and fewer late nights. 調整後的課表讓學生有更長的休息時間，也不必再熬那麼多夜。

meaning: 以改革後的方式；經過改革地
sentences: The town council rebuilt the park reformedly, with stricter rules and a cleaner design. 鎮議會以改革後的方式重建公園，規則更嚴，設計也更整潔。
He spoke reformedly about his old habits, as if he no longer wanted to return to them. 他談起舊習慣時帶著一種改過之後的語氣，彷彿再也不想回頭。
The reformer pushed for cleaner elections and fairer rules. 這位改革者推動更乾淨的選舉和更公平的規則。
Many reformers face resistance before their ideas are accepted. 許多改革者在想法被接受之前都會遇到阻力。

meaning: 女性改革者；女改革人士
sentences: The old newspaper article praised her as a reformeress who fought for cleaner streets. 那篇舊報導稱讚她是一位為乾淨街道奮鬥的女性改革者。
In the biography, the reformeress was remembered for turning a small idea into public change. 在那本傳記裡，這位女改革者被記住的是，她把一個小點子變成了公共改變。

meaning: 以改革的方式地；帶著改良意味地
sentences: She reformingly rewrote the club rules after listening to the members' complaints. 她在聽完社員的抱怨後，以改革的方式重新改寫了社團規則。
The committee approached the issue reformingly, trying to improve the process instead of just blaming people. 委員會以改良的態度處理這個問題，著重改善流程，而不是只會怪罪別人。
His reformism was practical, not flashy, and he cared more about small fixes than grand speeches. 他的改良主義很務實，不花俏，比起高調演說，他更在意一點一滴的修正。
The party's reformism appealed to voters who wanted change without chaos. 這個政黨的改良主義吸引了那些想要改變、卻不想要混亂的選民。

meaning: 改革派人士；改革主義者
sentences: The reformist won support by promising cleaner government and simpler forms. 這位改革派人士靠著承諾更乾淨的政府和更簡化的表格而獲得支持。
As a reformist, she preferred steady progress over dramatic slogans. 身為改革派人士，她偏好穩定前進，而不是誇張口號。

meaning: 改革主義的；偏向改革的
sentences: Her reformistic approach kept the school stable while still improving the rules. 她那種偏改革的做法讓學校在維持穩定的同時，也能慢慢改善規章。
The report took a reformistic view of the industry, suggesting changes that were realistic and gradual. 那份報告以改革取向看待這個產業，提出的是務實而漸進的調整。

meaning: 不易改革的；抗拒改革的
sentences: The old bureaucracy seemed reformproof, surviving every new manager who tried to change it. 那套老官僚體系看起來幾乎不受改革影響，每位想改變它的新主管都撐不久。
Some habits are so deep that they feel reformproof until someone is willing to be patient. 有些習慣根深蒂固，彷彿怎麼改都改不動，直到有人願意耐心面對。
After one complaint, the bakery chose to reformulate the soup. 收到一次客訴後，那家麵包店決定重新調整湯的配方。
She paused to reformulate her answer in simpler words. 她停了一下，把回答改成更簡單的說法。
The scientist's reformulation made the idea easier to test in the lab. 那位科學家的重新表述讓這個概念更容易在實驗室裡驗證。
The sauce tasted better after a careful reformulation of the original recipe. 經過謹慎重新調整配方後，這款醬汁嚐起來更好了。
He promised not to reforsake his family again after years of absence. 經過多年缺席後，他承諾不會再一次拋棄家人。
The novel shows what happens when someone reforsakes responsibility at the worst possible time. 那部小說寫出了當一個人在最糟的時刻再次放棄責任時，會發生什麼事。
The village began refortification before the storm season arrived. 在風暴季來臨前，村莊開始重新加固防禦工事。
Refortification of the bridge supports was finished just in time for the heavy trucks to pass. 橋樑支撐的再次加固剛好在重型卡車通行前完成。
Workers hurried to refortify the seawall before the typhoon. 工人趕在颱風前替海堤再次加固。
After the breach, the army moved to refortify the gate. 缺口出現後，軍隊立刻去重新強化城門。

meaning: 再次轉寄；重新向前推進
sentences: Please reforward the email to the whole team so nobody misses the update. 請把那封電子郵件再轉寄給整個團隊，免得有人錯過更新。
The chair asked the committee to reforward the proposal after the revisions were finished. 主席請委員會在修訂完成後，再把提案向前推進。
The nonprofit was refounded after a long pause and a change in leadership. 那個非營利組織在停擺多年並更換領導後，又重新成立了。
After the fire, the family refounded the bakery in a smaller storefront. 火災之後，這家人把麵包店在較小的店面重新開了起來。
The city budget included money for the refoundation of the damaged library. 市政府預算裡編列了經費，用來重建受損圖書館的基礎。
The school's refoundation began with a new charter and fresh funding. 這所學校的重建從新的章程和新的資金開始。
As a refounder, she rebuilt the school around a new mission and a smaller staff. 身為重建者，她以新的使命和更精簡的團隊重新打造這所學校。
The museum honored its refounder for rescuing the collection after the flood. 博物館向那位再創立者致敬，感謝他在洪水後搶救了這批館藏。
A prism can refract white light into a rainbow of colors. 稜鏡可以把白光折射成一道道彩虹般的顏色。
The glass roof seemed to refract the sunlight into soft patterns across the floor. 玻璃屋頂似乎把陽光折射成地板上柔和的光影圖案。
The material is refractable enough for the lens experiment we planned. 這種材料有足夠的可折射性，能用在我們規劃的透鏡實驗裡。
Only a refractable surface will bend the beam in the way the teacher described. 只有可折射的表面，才會像老師說的那樣把光束彎折。
The sunlight refracted through the glass and painted bright bands on the wall. 陽光穿過玻璃後發生折射，在牆上投下明亮的光帶。
The refracted image looked slightly doubled in the shallow water. 那個經過折射的影像在淺水裡看起來有點重影。

meaning: 以折射後的樣子；經折射地
sentences: The lamp shone refractedly through the water bottle on the desk. 桌上的水瓶讓燈光以折射後的樣子散開。
Her reflection appeared refractedly in the curved shop window. 她的倒影在弧形店窗上呈現出折射過的樣子。

meaning: 折射狀態；被折射的性質
sentences: The refractedness of the image made the straight line look bent. 圖像的折射狀態讓原本筆直的線看起來彎了。
The refractedness of the water surface changed every time the wind picked up. 水面的折射狀態會隨著風勢增強而改變。
Tiny crystals in the sample were refractile under the microscope. 樣本裡那些微小的晶體在顯微鏡下具有折光性。
The refractile surface of the bead caught the light from every angle. 那顆珠子的具折光性表面從每個角度都會抓住光線。
The refractility of the gem gave it a sharp, lively sparkle. 這顆寶石的折光性讓它看起來特別清亮有神。
Scientists measured the refractility of the new material before using it in the display panel. 科學家先測量這種新材料的折光性，再把它用在顯示面板上。

meaning: 折射中的；使光線彎折的
sentences: The refracting window caught the afternoon sun and scattered it across the room. 那扇會折射光線的窗戶把午後陽光散開，灑滿整個房間。
We studied the refracting properties of the lens during the science fair. 我們在科學展期間研究了這個透鏡的折射特性。
Refraction is why a straw looks bent in a glass of water. 折射就是為什麼吸管放在水杯裡看起來會彎掉的原因。
The optician explained how refraction changes the way we see sharp edges. 驗光師解釋了折射如何改變我們看清邊緣線條的方式。
The optometrist explained the refractional change in my eyes after the exam. 驗光師在檢查後解釋了我眼睛的折射變化。
The chart showed refractional differences between the two lenses. 那張圖表顯示了兩片鏡片之間的折射差異。
The technicians refractionate the light before measuring each wavelength. 技術人員先把光分段折射，再測量每個波長。
In the old lab notes, the beam was refractionated through several prisms. 在那份舊實驗筆記裡，光束曾經經過好幾個稜鏡被分段折射。

meaning: 研究折射的人；折射學家
sentences: The refractionist spent the morning comparing how different lenses bent the light. 那位折射學家花了整個上午比較不同透鏡如何彎折光線。
As a refractionist, she enjoyed explaining a complex optical effect in plain language. 身為折射學家，她很喜歡用淺白的語言解釋複雜的光學現象。
The crystal has a strong refractive quality that makes the edges shimmer. 這塊水晶具有很強的折光特性，讓邊緣看起來閃閃發亮。
Her glasses were designed with a refractive coating to reduce glare. 她的眼鏡加了折射塗層，好減少眩光。
The beam moved refractively through the layered glass panels. 那道光束以折射的方式穿過層層玻璃板。
The scene looked almost unreal because the water surface bent the image refractively. 因為水面以折射的方式扭曲了影像，整個畫面看起來幾乎不真實。
The refractiveness of the mineral made it useful in optical instruments. 這種礦物的折射性使它很適合用在光學儀器裡。
He was surprised by the refractiveness of the surface, which scattered the lamp light in every direction. 他對那表面的折光特性感到驚訝，因為它把燈光四散到各個方向。
Scientists measured the refractivity of the sample before publishing the results. 科學家在發表結果前，先測量了樣本的折射性。
A small change in refractivity can make a lens behave very differently. 折射性只要有一點點變化，就會讓透鏡表現大不相同。
She placed a drop of juice on the refractometer to check its sugar level. 她把一滴果汁滴在折射計上，檢查它的糖度。
The refractometer gave a precise reading, even for the cloudy sample. 即使是混濁的樣本，折射計也能給出精確讀值。
The lab report included a refractometric analysis of the liquid mixture. 那份實驗報告包含了液體混合物的折射測量分析。
A refractometric test can reveal tiny differences that the eye would miss. 折射測量檢驗可以看出肉眼會忽略的細微差異。

meaning: 折射測量法；折射計量學
sentences: He studied refractometry so he could work in quality control for beverages. 他研習折射測量法，為的是到飲料品質管制部門工作。
Refractometry is especially helpful when a sample is too delicate for rough handling. 當樣本太脆弱、不能粗暴處理時，折射測量法特別有用。
The old refractor still gave a clear view of the moon. 那台老式折射望遠鏡看月亮時依然很清楚。
He carried the refractor to the roof and spent the evening stargazing. 他把折射望遠鏡搬到屋頂，整個晚上都在觀星。
The child stared refractorily at the teacher and refused to apologize. 那孩子倔強地瞪著老師，怎麼也不肯道歉。
The old horse moved refractorily until it recognized the handler's voice. 那匹老馬在聽出照料者的聲音前，始終不情不願地移動。
The refractoriness of the valve made the repair take much longer than expected. 那個閥門難以處理的特性，讓維修時間比預期長得多。
Her refractoriness showed up only when someone tried to rush her decisions. 只有在別人想催她做決定時，她的倔強才會明顯表現出來。

meaning: 倔強的；難處理的；耐火的
sentences: The mechanic was dealing with a refractory bolt that refused to turn. 那位機械師正對付一顆怎麼也轉不動的頑固螺栓。
The patient became refractory to the first treatment, so the doctor tried another approach. 病人對第一種治療反應不佳，所以醫生改用了另一種方法。
He was careful not to refracture the wrist during basketball practice. 他很小心，免得在籃球練習時讓手腕再次骨折。
A sudden slip on the stairs could refracture a bone that has not healed fully. 樓梯上要是一滑倒，還沒完全癒合的骨頭可能會再次折斷。
The lawyer pointed out the refragability of the witness's statement. 律師指出了那位證人證詞的可反駁性。
In a debate, refragability matters because no claim should be beyond question. 在辯論裡，說法是否可被反駁很重要，因為沒有哪個主張應該完全不能被質疑。
His argument sounded confident, but it was still refragable. 他的論點聽起來很有自信，但仍然是可以反駁的。
The professor reminded us that even a polished theory must remain refragable. 教授提醒我們，即使是很完整的理論也仍然應該保留可反駁性。
The refragableness of the claim became obvious once the data arrived. 一旦資料到手，那個主張的可反駁性就很明顯了。
He appreciated the refragableness of the proposal because it kept the discussion honest. 他欣賞這份提案的可反駁性，因為這能讓討論保持誠實。
To refrain means to show restraint; to hold oneself back. 克制意味著表現克制；阻止自己。
People may refrain in different situations depending on the context. 人們可能會根據具體情況在不同的情況下克制。
As a refrainer, she walked away before the argument got personal. 她很懂得克制，在爭執變得人身攻擊之前就先離開了。
The best refrainer in the room was the one who listened twice as much as he spoke. 房間裡最懂自制的人，是那位聽得比說得多兩倍的人。
His refrainment from gossip made the office feel calmer. 他克制住不去八卦，讓辦公室氣氛平靜了不少。
Refrainment can be harder than action when emotions are running high. 當情緒很高漲時，克制往往比採取行動還難。
She tried to reframe the mistake as a useful lesson instead of a failure. 她試著把那個錯誤重新詮釋成有用的教訓，而不是失敗。
If you reframe the problem, the solution often becomes easier to see. 如果你重新定義問題，解法常常就會變得更清楚。
The refrangent properties of the surface bent the beam just enough to matter. 那個表面的折射特性，讓光束剛好偏折到重要的程度。
In the museum display, a refrangent layer made the colors seem to shift as you moved. 在博物館展櫃裡，一層折射材料讓顏色隨著你移動而改變。
The refrangibility of the material determined how it would behave under bright light. 這種材料的可折射性決定了它在強光下的表現。
A prism separates colors because each one has a different refrangibility. 稜鏡能把顏色分開，是因為每種顏色的可折射性不同。
The scientist chose a refrangible medium to slow and bend the light. 那位科學家選用可折射的介質來減慢並彎折光線。
Even a refrangible beam can look straight until it passes through glass. 就算是可折射的光束，在穿過玻璃之前看起來也可能很直。
The refrangibleness of the liquid made it suitable for the experiment. 這種液體的可折射性讓它很適合這項實驗。
He did not expect the refrangibleness of the film to alter the image so much. 他沒想到那層薄膜的可折射性會把影像改變得那麼大。
Do not refreeze the berries once they have fully thawed. 莓果一旦完全解凍，就不要再重新冷凍。
The puddle began to refreeze overnight as the temperature dropped. 氣溫下降後，那個水窪在夜裡開始再次結冰。
His refrenation of the anger kept the meeting from exploding. 他把怒氣壓了下來，才沒讓會議當場爆開。
Refrenation can look like weakness, but it often takes real discipline. 克制看起來也許像軟弱，但它其實常常需要真正的自律。

meaning: 再度狂熱；重新陷入瘋狂
sentences: The crowd fell into refrenzy when the singer returned for an encore. 當歌手回來安可時，人群又再度陷入狂熱。
Online chatter can refrenzy a rumor long after it should have faded. 網路上的討論常會讓謠言在早該淡去之後又再度瘋傳。

meaning: 使恢復精神；更新；使清新
sentences: A short walk outside helped refresh his mind before the presentation. 在簡報前出去走一小段路，讓他的腦袋清爽了不少。
Please refresh the page after the file finishes uploading. 檔案上傳完成後，請重新整理頁面。
A cold shower can bring refresh(ment) after a humid run. 悶熱跑步後，沖冷水澡能帶來提神感。
Fresh paint gave the hall some refresh(ment) before guests arrived. 客人到來前，新油漆讓大廳多了一點煥新感。

meaning: 使人清新的事物；提神物
sentences: For her, cold mint tea was the perfect refreshant on a hot afternoon. 對她來說，冰涼的薄荷茶是炎熱午後最棒的提神物。
The breeze from the open window worked like a gentle refreshant. 從打開的窗戶吹進來的微風，像一種溫和的清新劑。

meaning: 使重新清新；使再度振作
sentences: She splashed water on her face to refreshen herself before dinner. 她在晚餐前用水潑了潑臉，讓自己重新精神起來。
A change of scenery can refreshen even the most tired mood. 換個環境就能讓再疲倦的心情重新恢復活力。

meaning: 使人精神一振的東西；提神物
sentences: A cup of tea worked as a quick refreshener after the long meeting. 一杯茶在漫長會議後立刻讓人精神一振。
The short walk was a perfect refreshener before we started again. 那段短短的散步，正好讓我們重新提起精神再出發。
That short refresher helped me remember the parking rules. 那堂短短的複習課讓我又記起停車規則。
A lemon mint is a nice refresher after coffee. 喝完咖啡後，一顆檸檬薄荷糖很提神。

meaning: 令人耳目一新的；有提神效果的
sentences: The refreshful sea breeze made everyone open the windows. 那股清新的海風讓大家都把窗戶打開了。
Her refreshful way of speaking made a familiar topic feel new. 她那種令人耳目一新的說話方式，讓熟悉的話題也變得新鮮。

meaning: 清新地；使人精神一振地
sentences: The singer began refreshfully, with a quiet line that caught everyone's attention. 那位歌手用一段安靜的開場清新地起筆，一下就吸引了所有人。
The room smelled refreshfully of mint and rain. 房間裡帶著薄荷和雨水般清新的氣味。

meaning: 令人耳目一新的；提神的
sentences: It was refreshing to hear someone admit they were wrong. 聽到有人坦白承認自己錯了，真讓人耳目一新。
After the heat, the refreshing water felt almost miraculous. 炎熱過後，那杯清涼的水幾乎像奇蹟一樣令人舒暢。

meaning: 令人耳目一新地；清新地
sentences: She answered the question refreshingly honestly, without any polished speech. 她回答那個問題時坦率得令人耳目一新，沒有任何修飾過的話術。
The film moves refreshingly fast for a story of this length. 以這樣長度的故事來說，這部電影的節奏快得很清新。

meaning: 清新感；令人精神一振的特質
sentences: The refreshingness of the first rain surprised everyone on the street. 第一場雨那種清新感，讓街上的每個人都精神一振。
What I liked most was the refreshingness of his straightforward advice. 我最喜歡的是他那種直截了當的建議所帶來的清新感。
They served light refreshment at the reception before the speeches began. 演說開始前的招待會上，他們提供了簡單茶點。
A few minutes of silence gave me the refreshment I needed. 安靜幾分鐘就足以讓我恢復精神。
Light refreshment(s) were set out near the back door. 後門附近擺了些簡單點心和飲料。
We grabbed light refreshment(s) after the game. 比賽後，我們拿了些簡單點心和飲料。
The repair tag says the fridge lost refrigerant overnight. 維修標籤寫著那台冰箱一夜之間漏掉了冷媒。
Without enough refrigerant, the car air conditioner blows warm air. 冷媒不夠時，車上的冷氣就只會吹出暖風。
Please refrigerate the soup once it has cooled to room temperature. 湯冷卻到室溫後，請把它冷藏起來。

Her beautiful voice is reminiscent of a famous opera singer from the past. 她優美的嗓音讓人回想起過去一位著名的歌劇演唱家。

meaning: 使人聯想到的；與回憶相關的
sentences: The painting has a reminiscential quality. 這幅畫帶有令人聯想到往事的氣質。
His tone was reminiscential of an earlier era. 他的語氣讓人聯想到更早的年代。
She looked at the old station reminiscentially. 她懷舊地看著那座舊車站。
The song was written reminiscentially, as if it were a postcard. 這首歌寫得很有聯想意味，像一張明信片。
He smiled reminiscently at the cracked teacup. 他看著那只裂了的茶杯，露出懷舊的微笑。
The house was decorated reminiscently of the 1950s. 那棟房子的裝潢讓人聯想到 1950 年代。
Every reunion needs one good reminiscer. 每場重聚都需要一位會追憶往事的人。
The reminiscer kept the conversation alive with old stories. 那位愛回想的人靠著舊故事讓談話持續下去。
The smell of bread was instantly reminiscitory. 麵包的香味立刻喚起了回憶。
He gave a reminiscitory tour of the neighborhood. 他帶著懷舊意味地帶大家走訪那個街區。
The museum will remint the commemorative coin. 博物館將重新鑄造那枚紀念幣。
After the design change, the mint had to remint the whole batch. 設計更改後，造幣廠不得不把整批硬幣重新鑄造。

meaning: 洞穴甲殼動物；裂腹甲殼類
sentences: A remiped swam slowly through the underground pool. 一隻洞穴甲殼動物緩緩游過地下水池。
The biologist described the remiped as a rare cave dweller. 這位生物學家把這種洞穴甲殼類動物描述為稀有的洞穴居民。
The lake remirrored the mountains after the wind dropped. 風停後，湖面再次映照出群山。
Morning light remirrored the glass wall across the street. 早晨的光線又在街對面的玻璃牆上反射出來。
The court may remise the fine in special cases. 法院在特殊情況下可以減免罰款。
The landlord agreed to remise part of the fee. 房東同意免除部分費用。
Do not remisrepresent the numbers in your report. 不要在報告裡錯誤陳述那些數字。
He remisrepresented the timeline and confused everyone. 他把時程再次誤述，讓大家都困惑了。
The memo contained a clear remisrepresentation of the facts. 備忘錄裡有明顯的事實錯誤陳述。
One remisrepresentation can ruin trust quickly. 一次錯誤陳述就足以迅速破壞信任。
It was remiss of me to miss the deadline. 我錯過截止日期，實在太疏忽了。
The team was remiss in checking the final figures. 這個團隊在核對最終數字時有些怠慢。
He gave a remissful shrug and left the folder open. 他有些疏忽地聳了聳肩，還把資料夾開著。
Her remissful approach caused a few avoidable delays. 她那種略顯怠慢的做法造成了幾個本可避免的延誤。
The lawyer argued for the remissibility of the penalty. 律師主張那項罰則具有可減免性。
The report discussed the remissibility of minor late fees. 這份報告討論了小額逾期費的可減免性。
The charge is remissible if the appeal succeeds. 如果上訴成功，這項費用是可以減免的。
Small mistakes may be remissible, but repeated ones are not. 小錯誤也許可以寬恕，但一再發生就不行了。
They debated the remissibleness of the sentence. 他們討論了這項判決的可減免性。
The remissibleness of the fee depends on local rules. 這筆費用是否可減免取決於當地規定。
Her asthma is in remission this year. 她今年的氣喘進入了緩解期。
The doctor said the rash was in remission after two days. 醫生說兩天後疹子已經明顯減輕。
The agency issued a remissive order for the penalty. 該機關發布了減免罰則的命令。
A remissive policy can help people recover faster. 寬免性的政策能幫助人們更快恢復。

meaning: 以寬免方式；以減免方式
sentences: The manager handled the request remissively. 經理以寬免的方式處理了這個請求。
The court remissively reduced the fine after hearing the appeal. 法院在聽取上訴後以減免方式降低了罰款。
Their remissiveness showed up in the missing paperwork. 缺少的文件暴露出他們的疏忽。
The coach warned the team against remissiveness before the match. 比賽前，教練警告球隊不要怠慢。
He remissly forgot to lock the side gate. 他疏忽地忘了鎖側門。
The deadline was remissly ignored until the last hour. 截止日期被怠慢地忽視到最後一小時。
The error came from simple remissness. 這個錯誤源於單純的疏忽。
Her remissness in replying upset the client. 她回覆上的怠慢惹惱了客戶。
The contract includes a remissory clause. 合約裡包含一條免除條款。
The remissory note eased the debtor's burden. 那份寬免文件減輕了債務人的負擔。
Please do not remisunderstand my text again. 請不要再誤解我的訊息了。
They remisunderstand each other whenever they rush the call. 他們每次匆忙講電話都會再次誤會彼此。
I will remit the fee before Friday. 我會在星期五前匯付那筆費用。
The judge agreed to remit part of the fine. 法官同意減免部分罰金。
The remitment of funds was completed before noon. 資金的匯付在中午前完成了。
We waited for the remitment of the case to the higher office. 我們等著案件被轉交到上級單位。
The fee is remittable within thirty days. 這筆費用在三十天內是可匯付的。
Only certain penalties are remittable under the policy. 只有某些罰款可依政策減免。
The judge approved the remittal of the remaining charges. 法官批准了其餘費用的減免。
The remittal of the file took place on Friday. 這份檔案在星期五被轉交了。
The remittance arrived from Singapore this morning. 今天早上匯款從新加坡到了。
Please attach the remittance slip to the invoice. 請把匯款單附在發票上。
The remittancer confirmed the transfer by email. 匯款處理人已用電子郵件確認轉帳。
A remittancer kept careful records of every payment. 匯款人仔細記錄了每一筆付款。

meaning: 匯款收款人；款項受領人
sentences: The remittee confirmed that the transfer had arrived. 匯款收款人確認款項已經入帳。
The bank asked the remittee to verify the account details. 銀行請收款人再次核對帳戶資料。
The remittence of the fever let him sleep through the night. 發燒的暫時緩解讓他整晚都能睡覺。
Doctors watched the remittence carefully because symptoms could return. 醫師仔細觀察這種緩解，因為症狀可能會再出現。
The remittency of the pain made therapy possible. 疼痛的暫時減輕讓治療成為可能。
A remittency in the cough did not mean he was fully recovered. 咳嗽稍有緩解並不代表他已經完全康復。

meaning: 間歇緩解的；時強時弱的
sentences: The remittent fever rose at noon and eased by evening. 這種時強時弱的發燒在中午升高，到了傍晚才緩和。
Her remittent symptoms never stayed steady for long. 她的症狀總是時好時壞，從來不會穩定太久。
The pain returned remittently through the afternoon. 疼痛在整個下午斷斷續續地反覆出現。
He checked the thermometer remittently instead of resting. 他只是斷斷續續地看著溫度計，沒有好好休息。
The remitter forgot to add the invoice number. 匯款人忘了附上發票號碼。
As the remitter, she had to confirm the recipient's account. 身為匯款人，她必須先確認收款帳戶。

meaning: 減額裁定；法院減少過高判賠的程序
sentences: The judge ordered a remittitur after finding the award excessive. 法官認為賠償金過高後，下令減額裁定。
She accepted the remittitur rather than face a new trial. 她接受了減額裁定，而不是再面對一次重審。
The remittor signed the form to release the claim. 讓渡者簽下表格以放棄該項主張。
The remittor's name appeared on the transfer record. 匯款紀錄上顯示了匯款人的名字。
The DJ played a remix after the main set. DJ在主表演結束後播放了一個混音版本。
Fans streamed the remix all summer long. 粉絲整個夏天都在串流聆聽這首混音版。

meaning: 再次混合；重新調和的事物
sentences: The baker noticed the remixture was smoother after another stir. 麵包師發現再度混合後，麵糊變得更細滑了。
A careful remixture gave the sauce a richer color. 小心地重新混合後，醬汁的顏色更濃郁了。
Only a remnant of the old wall still stood. 那道老牆只剩下一小段殘跡。
She saved the remnant of cloth for a patchwork project. 她把剩餘的布料留下來做拼布。
The geologist described the remnantal ridge as evidence of erosion. 地質學家把這道殘餘山脊視為侵蝕的證據。
A remnantal layer of soil remained after the flood. 洪水過後，地表仍留下一層殘餘土壤。
The mayor approved the remobilization of emergency crews. 市長批准緊急人員重新動員。
The remobilization of supplies helped the town recover faster. 物資的再度調度讓小鎮恢復得更快。

meaning: 重新動員；使再度投入行動
sentences: The agency will remobilize volunteers after the storm passes. 暴風雨過後，該機構會重新動員志工。
Doctors helped him remobilize his injured leg. 醫生幫助他讓受傷的腿重新恢復活動。

meaning: 流浪苦修者；不受常規約束的修士
sentences: A medieval chronicle mentioned a Remoboth among wandering ascetics. 一部中世紀編年史提到一位流浪苦修者。
The museum label explained that a Remoboth was an irregular monk. 博物館標牌說明，這個詞指的是不受常規約束的修士。

meaning: 再次嘲弄；重新模仿取笑
sentences: He tried to remock the speaker's accent, but it sounded forced. 他試著再次模仿那位講者的口音，卻顯得很刻意。

The company is planning to remodel its existing business strategy. 公司正計畫更新其現有的業務策略。
A remodeler gutted the kitchen and rebuilt it from scratch. 一位重新裝修者把廚房整個拆空，從頭重做。
They hired a remodeler to open up the cramped hallway. 他們請來一位改造者，把那條狹窄的走廊打通。
The remodeller planned a brighter layout for the studio flat. 那位改造者為單間公寓規畫了更明亮的格局。

We had to remodify the plan after lunch. 我們午飯後只好再修改計畫。
She remodify the poster each time the date changes. 她每次日期一改就會再調整海報。

meaning: 法式雷莫拉德醬；調味醬
sentences: The chef served the salmon with remolade on the side. 主廚把鮭魚配上雷莫拉德醬一起端上來。

meaning: 使再度柔軟的；再軟化的
sentences: The remollient lotion softened the rough patch on her hands. 這款再軟化乳液讓她手上的粗糙處變柔軟了。
A remollient treatment helped the leather regain its bend. 這種再軟化處理讓皮革重新恢復了彈性。

meaning: 重新貨幣化；恢復貨幣功能
sentences: The remonetization of silver changed trade across the region. 白銀重新貨幣化改變了整個地區的貿易。
The policy debate focused on remonetization rather than tax cuts. 這場政策辯論聚焦在重新貨幣化，而不是減稅。

meaning: 使重新貨幣化；使再度流通
sentences: Some countries may remonetize old coins during shortages. 有些國家在短缺時可能會讓舊硬幣重新流通。

His remonstrative tone made everyone listen. 他那種勸諫式的語氣讓所有人都安靜下來聽。
The letter was remonstrative, but never rude. 那封信帶著勸戒意味，但並不失禮。
She folded her arms remonstratively and waited. 她雙臂交叉，帶著抗議的姿態等著。
The child remonstratively asked for one more story. 那孩子帶著不滿地要求再講一個故事。
The remonstrator stood up to question the new policy. 那位抗議者站起來質疑新政策。
Every remonstrator was heard before the vote. 在投票前，每位提出異議的人都被聽取了意見。
The editor wrote a remonstratory note in the margin. 編輯在頁邊寫下帶勸諫意味的註記。
His remonstratory letter warned the company to change course. 他的勸諫信警告公司該改變方向了。

meaning: 山中叛亂者；逃入山區者
sentences: The story follows a remontado hiding in the hills. 那個故事寫的是一名藏在山裡的叛亂者。

meaning: 多次開花的；再度抽花的
sentences: The gardener planted remontant roses for a longer blooming season. 園丁種了多次開花的玫瑰，好讓花期更長。

meaning: 時計補償裝置；上鏈裝置
sentences: The watchmaker adjusted the remontoir with a steady hand. 鐘錶匠用穩定的手勢調整上鏈裝置。
A tiny remontoir can help a clock keep a more even beat. 小小的時計補償裝置能讓時鐘走時更穩。

He sounded genuinely remorseful after the harsh comment. 他在說出那句刻薄的話後，聽起來真心懊悔。
The remorseful student wrote an apology by hand. 那位懊悔的學生親手寫了一封道歉信。
She smiled remorsefully and admitted her mistake. 她帶著愧疚的笑容承認了自己的錯誤。
He looked remorsefully at the broken vase. 他愧疚地望著那個打碎的花瓶。
There was no remorsefulness in his voice. 他的語氣裡沒有半點悔意。
Her remorsefulness showed in the long apology she wrote. 她寫下的長篇道歉信裡可以看出她的懊悔。

meaning: 無情的；冷酷的；不知悔改的
sentences: The remorseless storm battered the coast all night. 那場無情的暴風雨整夜拍打著海岸。

The remorselessness of the attack shocked the whole town. 這場攻擊的無情程度震驚了整個城鎮。
What bothered her most was his remorselessness. 最讓她不安的是他的不知悔改。

meaning: 毫無悔意的；不受愧疚影響的
sentences: He looked almost remorseproof after the cruel prank. 那場惡作劇之後，他看起來幾乎毫無悔意。
The villain was written as remorseproof and proud of it. 那個反派被寫成毫無悔意，甚至還對此感到自豪。

meaning: 重新抵押；再次辦理房貸
sentences: They decided to remortgage the house to get a lower interest rate. 他們決定把房子重新抵押，好拿到較低的利率。
She remortgaged her apartment after the renovation costs went up. 裝修費用增加後，她把公寓重新抵押了。

I'm not remotely in love with you. 我並沒有完全愛上你。
If someone acts remotely, they do so in a way that is not much; scarcely; hardly. 如果有人遠端行動，他們的方式並不多；幾乎沒有；幾乎沒有。
The remoteness of the village made deliveries slow and expensive. 那個村子的偏遠讓送貨又慢又貴。

After the remotion of the table, the room looked bigger. 桌子移開後，房間看起來更大了。

meaning: 具有移除作用的；促使離開的
sentences: The cleaner had a remotive effect on the stubborn stain. 那種清潔劑對頑固污漬有移除作用。
His remotive comment made the volunteers step back from the argument. 他那句讓人退場的話，使志工們從爭論中退開。
The artist remoulded the clay until the face looked alive. 那位藝術家把黏土重新塑形，直到臉孔看起來有了生氣。
The company wants to remould its image after the scandal. 這家公司想在醜聞後重塑形象。
He paused to remount after checking the saddle. 他檢查完馬鞍後停了一下再上馬。
We had to remount the shelf after the wall dried. 牆乾了之後，我們得把架子重新裝上。
The removability of the filter makes cleaning much easier. 這個濾網的可拆卸性讓清潔容易得多。

sentences: The physicist had to renormalize the equation before publishing it. 這位物理學家在發表前必須把方程重新正規化。

meaning: 更新；改造某物，使其再次煥然一新。
sentences: To renovate means to renew; to revamp something to make it look new again. 翻新意味著更新；改造某物，使其看起來煥然一新。

sentences: The essay criticized resignationism as a quiet form of defeat. 那篇文章批評認命主義是一種溫和的失敗態度。
Resignationism can sound practical, but it may also hide fear. 認命主義聽起來務實，卻也可能掩蓋恐懼。
She gave a resigned smile and accepted the delay. 她露出一個無奈的微笑，接受了延誤。
His resigned tone made it clear that he had stopped arguing. 他那種認命的語氣很明顯表示他已經不再爭辯。
He nodded resignedly when the flight was canceled. 航班取消時，他無奈地點了點頭。
The old dog followed her resignedly to the car. 那隻老狗無奈地跟著她走向汽車。

The resignee handed back the office key on Friday. 那位辭職者在星期五交回了辦公室鑰匙。
Each resignee was asked to complete an exit interview. 每位辭職員工都被要求完成離職訪談。
The resigner thanked the team before leaving the project. 那位辭職者在離開專案前感謝了團隊。
A resigner is not always unhappy; sometimes the timing is simply right. 辭職的人不一定是不快樂，有時只是時機剛好。
He gave a resignful shrug and paid the fine. 他無奈地聳聳肩，然後把罰款付了。
A resignful smile crossed her face at the station. 她在車站露出一抹認命的微笑。
His resignment from the board surprised everyone in the room. 他從董事會辭職讓房間裡每個人都很驚訝。
The company accepted her resignment without delay. 公司毫不拖延地接受了她的辭職。
The child watched the rubber ball resile off the wall. 孩子看著橡膠球從牆上彈回來。
If the promise turns out to be false, I will resile from it. 如果那個承諾證明是假的，我會撤回對它的接受。
The resilement of the spring was tested again and again. 彈簧的回彈性一次又一次地被測試。
Her sudden resilement from the deal left the buyers confused. 她突然撤回那筆交易，讓買家感到困惑。
The engineer liked the resilial quality of the new alloy. 這位工程師喜歡這種新合金的彈韌特性。
The bridge was built with a resilial design to handle stress. 這座橋採用了有彈性的設計來承受壓力。
The material can resiliate after being bent. 這種材料彎曲後能恢復彈性。
Scientists studied how the membrane resiliates under pressure. 科學家研究薄膜在壓力下如何反彈回復。
The team showed resilience after the loss. 球隊在失利後展現了韌性。
Her resilience helped her recover quickly. 她的韌性讓她很快恢復過來。
The team's resiliency helped them recover after the setback. 團隊的韌性幫助他們在挫折後重新站起來。
Good materials need resiliency as well as strength. 好材料不僅要堅固，也要有韌性。
Children are often resilient after difficult changes. 孩子們在面對困難變動後，常常很有韌性。
We need a resilient system that can keep working under stress. 我們需要一個能在壓力下持續運作的穩健系統。
The paleontologist pointed to the resilifer inside the shell. 古生物學家指著貝殼內部的韌帶座。
In bivalves, the resilifer helps anchor the hinge mechanism. 在雙殼類中，韌帶座有助於固定鉸鏈機構。
The lab technician checked the sample with a resiliometer. 實驗室技術員用韌性測試儀檢查樣本。
A resiliometer can show how quickly a material springs back. 韌性測試儀可以顯示材料回彈的速度。
The resilition of the metal was better than expected. 這種金屬的回彈性比預期更好。
After the bend, the strip showed a slight resilition. 彎折之後，那條金屬片出現了些微的回彈。
The resilium supports the hinge of the shell. 韌帶支撐著貝殼的鉸鏈。
A damaged resilium can affect how the shell opens. 韌帶受損會影響貝殼如何張開。
The antique mirror was resilvered by a specialist. 這面古董鏡由專家重新鍍銀。
They decided to resilver the tray instead of replacing it. 他們決定把托盤重新鍍銀，而不是換新的。
The craft project smelled faintly of resin. 那個手作作品隱約散發著樹脂味。

The old jar still smelled faintly of resina. 那只舊罐子仍隱約帶著樹脂味。
The label mentioned resina as a natural ingredient. 標籤上把樹脂列為天然成分。
The bark had a resinaceous smell after the rain. 雨後樹皮帶著樹脂質的氣味。
Resinaceous sap can make the forest path sticky. 含樹脂的樹液會讓森林小徑變得黏滑。

meaning: 使成樹脂狀；以樹脂處理
sentences: They resinate the surface to protect it from moisture. 他們用樹脂處理表面，以防潮氣。

A resinbush grew beside the dry trail. 一株樹脂灌木長在乾燥的小徑旁。
Birds nested in the resinbush even during the hot season. 即使在炎熱季節，鳥兒仍在那株樹脂灌木裡築巢。
The resiner coated the board with a thin layer of resin. 那位塗樹脂的人在木板上覆了一層薄薄的樹脂。
A careful resiner can make a rough surface look smooth. 一位細心的塗樹脂者能讓粗糙表面看起來很平滑。
This compound is resinfiable under heat and pressure. 這種化合物在加熱與加壓下可以樹脂化。
Only resinfiable fibers were used in the test batch. 這次測試批次只使用了可樹脂化的纖維。
Workers resing the surface before the final polish. 工人在最後拋光前先把表面塗上樹脂。
If the coating wears off, we can resing the panel. 如果塗層磨掉了，我們可以把這塊板重新上樹脂。
The sample had a strong resinic smell after heating. 這個樣本加熱後帶有強烈的樹脂氣味。
The resinic coating protected the tool from moisture. 這層樹脂塗膜保護工具不受潮氣影響。

meaning: 樹脂化；轉為樹脂的過程
sentences: The resinification of the sap took several days in the lab. 樹液的樹脂化在實驗室裡花了好幾天。

meaning: 如樹脂般流動的；樹脂狀流出的
sentences: A resinifluous stream seeped from the cut branch. 樹脂般流動的汁液從切口枝條滲出。

The sap dried into a resiniform lump on the bark. 樹液在樹皮上乾成一塊樹脂狀硬塊。
Under the lamp, the coating looked resiniform and sticky. 在燈下，那層塗料看起來像樹脂而且黏黏的。

The laboratory tried to resinify the sample without damaging it. 實驗室試著在不破壞樣本的情況下讓它樹脂化。
The factory will resinize the fibers for extra strength. 工廠會用樹脂處理纖維，讓它們更堅固。
We resinize the cloth before shaping it into the final form. 我們會先讓布料吸附樹脂，再把它塑形成最終形狀。
The boat began to resink after the patch failed. 補丁失效後，那艘船又開始下沉。
If the ice breaks, the heavy sled may resink into the water. 如果冰層裂開，沉重的雪橇可能會再次沉進水裡。
The glaze dried into a resinlike finish. 釉面乾後形成了像樹脂一樣的表面光澤。
A resinlike film covered the surface of the old paint. 舊漆表面覆著一層樹脂般的薄膜。

meaning: 樹脂起電的；琥珀起電的
sentences: Amber is famously resinoelectric when rubbed with cloth. 琥珀摩擦布料時會產生樹脂起電的現象。
The museum display explained the resinoelectric effect in simple terms. 博物館展品用簡單的方式解釋了樹脂起電效應。

meaning: 樹脂萃取的；樹脂萃取物
sentences: The chemist isolated a resinoextractive substance from the bark. 化學家從樹皮中分離出一種樹脂萃取物。

The resinogenous shrub seeped sap after the cut. 這種產樹脂的灌木在切開後滲出了汁液。

A resinoid sheen covered the dried leaf surface. 乾掉的葉面上覆著樹脂樣的光澤。
Resinol is a compound found in some plant resins. 樹脂醇是一種可在某些植物樹脂中找到的化合物。

meaning: 樹脂醇的；與樹脂醇相關的
sentences: The resinolic fraction was tested for stability. 這個樹脂醇相關部分接受了穩定性測試。
Scientists tracked the resinolic compounds in the sample. 科學家追蹤了樣本中的樹脂醇化合物。
The botanist pointed to a resinophore near the cut stem. 植物學家指著切口旁的一個樹脂囊柄。
A damaged resinophore leaked onto the slide. 受損的樹脂載體把分泌物滲到了載玻片上。
The doctor diagnosed a rare case of resinosis in the lungs. 醫生診斷出一例罕見的肺部樹脂沉積症。
In old medical texts, resinosis was described with unusual symptoms. 在古老的醫學文獻中，樹脂病被描述成一種症狀奇特的狀況。

meaning: 樹脂的；含樹脂的；樹脂狀的
sentences: The air was thick with the resinous scent of pine. 空氣中瀰漫著松樹濃郁的樹脂香氣。

The old varnish spread resinously across the surface. 舊清漆帶著樹脂感緩緩鋪開在表面上。
The resinousness of the varnish made it slow to dry. 這層清漆的樹脂性讓它乾得很慢。
The cook noted the resinousness of the herb before adding it. 廚師在加入前注意到那種香草帶有樹脂性。

meaning: 樹脂玻璃質的；樹脂狀透明的
sentences: The bead had a resinovitreous shine. 這顆珠子帶有樹脂玻璃質的光澤。

The resipiscent student apologized and changed her behavior. 那位悔悟的學生道了歉，也改變了行為。
He sounded resipiscent when he admitted the mistake. 他承認錯誤時，語氣顯得很有悔意。

The force was strong but still resistable. 這股力量很強，但仍然可以抵抗。
The urge felt resistable once she took a deep breath. 她深呼吸後，那股衝動就變得可以抗拒了。

The proposed new tax met with a lot of resistance from the local community. 擬議中的新稅收遭到了當地社區的強烈抵制（反抗）。
Regular exercise can help improve your body's resistance to various diseases. 定期運動可以幫助提高身體對各種疾病的抵抗力。
The new phone is water-resistant and can be used in the rain safely. 這款新手機是防水的（防...的），可以在雨中安全使用。

He shook his head resistantly and refused the offer. 他帶著抗拒地搖頭，拒絕了這個提議。

meaning: 充滿抵抗心的；不情願的
sentences: He gave a resistful look before agreeing. 他在同意前露出不太情願的神情。

The resistibility of the coating helped it survive the storm. 這層塗料的可抵抗性幫助它撐過風暴。

She shook her head resistingly when asked to leave. 她被要求離開時，帶著抗拒地搖了搖頭。
The dog stepped back resistingly from the water. 那隻狗帶著抗拒地從水邊退開。

meaning: 以有電阻的方式；抗拒地
sentences: The charge passed resistively through the material. 電荷以有電阻的方式穿過這種材料。

sentences: The river moved with a resistless force after the flood. 洪水過後，河水以無法抵擋的力量奔流。

meaning: 無法抵抗地；勢不可擋地
sentences: The march moved resistlessly through the streets. 遊行隊伍勢不可擋地穿過街道。

meaning: 重新鋪板岩瓦；再以板岩覆蓋
sentences: They reslated the roof before the rainy season. 他們在雨季前重新鋪了屋頂的板岩瓦。

meaning: 重新安排時段；插回槽位
sentences: The scheduler had to reslot the meeting into the afternoon. 排程者只好把會議重新安排到下午。

sentences: She had to resnap the buttons after the costume shifted. 服裝移位後，她只好把鈕扣重新扣上。

meaning: 逆流而上；再次沿流前進
sentences: The boat had to restem against the current to reach the dock. 小船必須逆著水流前進，才能靠上碼頭。
The pilot tried to restem the plane through the narrow air corridor. 飛行員試著讓飛機沿著狹窄的空中航道再次前進。
The dancer had to restep the sequence after missing a beat. 那位舞者在漏掉一拍後，不得不把動作再踏一遍。
Please restep on the mat so the sensor can read your weight again. 請再踩一次墊子，讓感測器重新讀取你的重量。
The lounge had room for every rester who needed a break. 休息室裡有足夠空間給每一位需要休息的人。
A lone rester sat by the window and watched the rain. 一位獨自停留的人坐在窗邊看著雨。
The nurse had to resterilize the tray after it dropped. 托盤掉地後，護理師只好重新滅菌。
Please resterilize the bottle before the next sample. 下一份樣本來之前，請先把瓶子再消毒一次。
The restes from dinner were packed away for lunch the next day. 晚餐的剩菜被收好，留到第二天午餐吃。
Archaeologists cataloged the restes of the ancient wall carefully. 考古學家仔細記錄了那道古牆的殘骸。
The quiet room felt restful after a noisy day. 在喧鬧的一天之後，那間安靜的房間讓人感到很安寧。
A restful walk in the park helped him clear his mind. 在公園裡安適地散步，幫助他整理思緒。
She slept restfully through the night. 她整晚都睡得很安穩。
The baby lay restfully in the crib. 嬰兒安穩地躺在嬰兒床裡。
The restfulness of the garden made it a favorite place to read. 花園的寧靜讓它成了最適合閱讀的地方。
He missed the restfulness of his hometown after moving downtown. 搬到市中心後，他很懷念家鄉那份安寧。
Restharrow grows in dry fields with tough roots and pink flowers. 刺骨草常長在乾燥田地裡，根系粗硬，還會開粉紅色花。
The botanist pointed out a restharrow beside the path. 那位植物學家指著小徑旁的一株刺骨草說明。
The hikers stopped at a resthouse near the trail. 登山客在步道附近的休息屋停了下來。
The village resthouse offered shade and drinking water. 村裡的休息屋提供遮蔭和飲用水。
Botanists placed the species in Restiaceae after examining its stems. 植物學家在檢視它的莖之後，把這個物種歸入帚燈草科。
Several Restiaceae species grow in sandy coastal habitats. 幾種帚燈草科植物生長在砂質的海岸棲地。
The restiaceous stems looked like thin rushes in the wetland. 那些帚燈草科的莖在濕地裡看起來像細細的燈心草。

A restiad covered the wet patch behind the dunes. 一株帚燈草科植物長滿了沙丘後方的濕地。
The guide knelt to show us a tiny restiad by the path. 導覽員蹲下來，指給我們看步道旁一株小小的帚燈草科植物。
Older anatomy texts sometimes call the inferior cerebellar peduncle the restibrachium. 舊式解剖學教材有時把小腦下腳稱為這個名稱。
An injury to the restibrachium can affect balance and coordination. 小腦下腳受損會影響平衡與協調。
The restiff horse refused to move at first. 那匹倔強的馬一開始怎麼都不肯動。
He sounded restiff after waiting in the heat for an hour. 他在烈日下等了一小時後，語氣變得很不耐煩。

meaning: 使再次變硬；使再度倔強
sentences: Cold air can restiffen the glue before it cures. 冷空氣會讓膠水在固化前再次變硬。
The setback seemed to restiffen his resolve instead of breaking it. 這次挫折似乎讓他的決心更加堅硬，而不是被打垮。

meaning: 使再次變硬的東西；加硬劑
sentences: The maker added a restiffener to keep the leather firm. 製作者加入加硬劑，讓皮革保持挺度。
In the lab, the restiffener changed the texture of the sample. 在實驗室裡，那種加硬劑改變了樣本的質地。
The restiffness in his legs faded after a short walk. 他腿部再次出現的僵硬感，在短暫走動後就減輕了。
Her restiffness toward the idea disappeared once she heard the full plan. 她在聽完整個計畫後，對這個想法的抗拒就消失了。
The smoke seemed to restifle the conversation in the room. 煙霧似乎讓房間裡的談話再次停了下來。
She tried not to restifle her own curiosity during the lecture. 她努力不要在演講中再次壓抑自己的好奇心。
The root looked restiform after it dried. 那條根乾掉後看起來像細繩一樣。
Under the microscope, the fibers appeared restiform and tough. 在顯微鏡下，那些纖維看起來呈繩索狀而且很韌。
The rumor could restigmatize a group that had already suffered enough. 這則謠言可能會再次污名化一個已經受夠傷害的群體。
We should not restigmatize people who are trying to rebuild their lives. 我們不應該再次污名化那些正努力重建生活的人。

A short walk can restimulate your focus after a long meeting. 開完長會後，短暫走動一下可以再次激發你的專注力。
The therapist was careful about restimulation during the session. 治療師在諮商過程中特別小心避免再次刺激。
Restimulation of the market helped sales recover. 市場的再度激發幫助銷售回升。
The resting bird kept one eye open. 休息中的鳥仍然睜著一隻眼睛。
The resting machine hummed softly in the corner. 休息中的機器在角落裡低聲嗡嗡作響。
He sat restingly by the window after the long run. 長跑結束後，他安靜地坐在窗邊休息。
The child slept restingly in the back seat. 孩子在後座睡得很安穩。
Restio is a genus of leafless herbs found in the south. 帚燈草屬是一屬無葉草本植物，常見於南方地區。
The botanist collected a Restio specimen for the herbarium. 植物學家為標本館採集了一份帚燈草屬標本。
Restionaceae includes many rush-like plants of the southern hemisphere. 帚燈草科包含許多來自南半球、外形像燈心草的植物。
The guidebook described Restionaceae as a family of slender, grasslike herbs. 導覽書把帚燈草科描述成一群細長、像草的草本植物。
The restionaceous stems swayed in the coastal wind. 那些帚燈草科的莖在海風中搖曳。
Her notes compared the restionaceous plant with a common rush. 她的筆記把這種帚燈草科植物和一般燈心草做了比較。
The partners had to restipulate the deadline after the delay. 合作夥伴在延誤後不得不重新約定期限。
We can restipulate the terms if both sides agree. 只要雙方同意，我們就可以重新約定條款。
The restipulation of the contract settled the disagreement. 合約的重新約定解決了這場爭議。
A restipulation can clarify terms that were too vague before. 重新約定可以釐清先前過於含糊的條款。

meaning: 重新約定的；附加條款的
sentences: The lawyer added a restipulatory note about delivery time. 律師補上一則重新約定交貨時間的附註。
A restipulatory clause changed the payment schedule. 一條附加約定條款改掉了付款時程。
He let the soup rest for a minute, then gave it a restir. 他讓湯靜置一分鐘，然後又攪了一下。
Please restir the batter so the flour is mixed evenly. 請把麵糊再攪拌一次，讓麵粉均勻混合。
She bound the bundle with a restis. 她用粗繩把那捆東西綁起來。
The sailor coiled the restis on the deck. 水手把粗繩盤在甲板上。
She had to restitch the torn pocket by hand. 她只好用手把破掉的口袋再縫一次。
The tailor restitched the hem before closing the shop. 裁縫在打烊前把褲腳重新縫好。
The court ordered the company to restitute the stolen funds. 法院命令公司歸還被竊取的資金。
They tried to restitute the painting to its rightful owner. 他們試著把那幅畫歸還給合法擁有者。
The judge ordered restitution for the damaged bike. 法官判定要對那輛受損腳踏車作出賠償。
He paid restitution in three monthly installments. 他分三個月把賠償款付清了。

meaning: 補償歸還主義；主張歸還的思想
sentences: The essay described restitutionism as a response to historical loss. 那篇文章把補償歸還主義描述為對歷史損失的回應。
In that debate, restitutionism focused on repairing past harm. 在那場辯論中，補償歸還主義著重於修補過去的傷害。

meaning: 主張歸還者；補償歸還論者
sentences: A restitutionist argued that the land should be returned. 一位主張歸還者認為那片土地應該被歸還。
The restitutionist spoke about justice and repair. 那位補償歸還論者談到正義與修復。
The policy was meant to have a restitutive effect on the community. 這項政策旨在對社區產生恢復性的效果。
A restitutive gesture can help rebuild trust after conflict. 在衝突之後，帶有修復性的舉動有助於重建信任。
The restitutor returned the stolen ring to its owner. 那名歸還者把被偷的戒指交還給失主。
A careful restitutor repaired the old frame before handing it back. 那名修復歸還者先把舊框修好才交回去。
The settlement had a restitutory purpose. 那項和解有補償歸還的目的。
They chose a restitutory solution instead of a punishment. 他們選擇了補償性的解決方式，而不是處罰。

meaning: 焦躁不安的；難以安撫的
sentences: The crowd grew restive as the delay continued. 隨著延誤持續，人群變得焦躁不安。
The horse looked restive before the race began. 賽事開始前，那匹馬看起來很難安撫。

The child shifted restively in the chair. 那個孩子在椅子上不安地挪動。
The restiveness in the room was easy to feel. 房間裡的焦躁感很明顯。
His restiveness showed up in every impatient glance. 他的不安從每一次不耐煩的眼神裡都看得出來。

meaning: 坐立不安的；難以平靜的
sentences: The child grew restless during the long speech. 冗長的演講進行到一半時，那孩子開始坐不住了。
I felt restless all night before the interview. 面試前一晚，我整夜都很不安。
He slept restlessly after hearing the bad news. 聽到壞消息後，他睡得很不安穩。
The puppy moved restlessly around the room. 那隻小狗在房間裡不安地來回走動。
His restlessness kept him pacing the hallway. 他的焦躁讓他一直在走廊來回踱步。
A cup of coffee only added to her restlessness. 那杯咖啡只讓她更坐立不安。
We need to restock the shelves before the weekend rush. 我們需要在週末人潮來之前把貨架補滿。
The shop restocked popular notebooks overnight. 那家店在夜裡補進了熱門筆記本。

meaning: 重新塞住的人或物；再封口裝置
sentences: The restopper kept the bottle sealed after the cork slipped out. 那個再封口裝置在木塞滑出後仍把瓶子封住。
As a makeshift restopper, he used a folded cloth to close the jar. 他臨時拿折好的布當作再封口的工具，把罐子蓋住。
The old photo was faded but still restorable. 那張老照片雖然褪色了，但仍可修復。
Fortunately, the deleted file was restorable from backup. 幸好，刪除的檔案還能從備份中恢復。
The restorableness of the manuscript surprised the conservator. 那份手稿的可修復性讓保存專家感到驚訝。
They judged the restorableness of the chair before starting repairs. 他們在開始修理前先評估那把椅子的可恢復性。
The restoral of service took longer than expected. 服務的恢復比預期花了更久。
He celebrated the restoral of his old family name. 他慶祝自己舊家族姓氏的復用。
The restoration of the historic cathedral took several years to complete. 這座歷史悠久的大教堂的修復工作花了好幾年才完成。
The project aims to facilitate the restoration of the local wildlife habitat. 該專案旨在促進當地野生動物棲息地的恢復（修復）。

meaning: 修復者；復原者；修復工作者
sentences: The restorationer spent months repairing the mural. 那位修復者花了幾個月修補壁畫。
As a restorationer, she loved bringing old objects back to life. 作為一名修復工作者，她喜歡讓古老物件重新煥發生機。
The movement was inspired by restorationism and a desire to return to old forms. 這場運動受到復興主義啟發，並渴望回到舊有形式。
Restorationism often looks backward to imagine a better future. 復原主義常常透過回望過去來想像更好的未來。

meaning: 復興主義者；主張復原者
sentences: A restorationist argued for rebuilding the historic district exactly as it was. 一位復興主義者主張把歷史街區完全依原樣重建。
The restorationist preferred tradition over modern shortcuts. 那位主張復原者偏好傳統，而不是現代的捷徑。

meaning: 恢復精力的；有助復原的
sentences: A short nap had a restorative effect on her mood. 小睡一下讓她精神和情緒都恢復不少。
The hot soup was restorative after the cold ride home. 冷天騎車回家後，那碗熱湯很能讓人恢復過來。

meaning: 恢復性地；有助於復原地
sentences: She slept restoratively after a long hike. 她在長途健行後睡得很有恢復作用。
The garden was designed to be restoratively calming. 那座花園被設計得具有恢復性的平靜感。

meaning: 恢復力；修復效果；養生性
sentences: The restorativeness of the quiet room helped everyone relax. 那間安靜房間的恢復效果讓每個人都放鬆下來。
People praised the restorativeness of a walk by the river. 大家都稱讚沿河散步帶來的恢復感。
The restorator carefully cleaned the cracked vase. 那位修復者小心清潔那只裂開的花瓶。
The software worked like a restorator for damaged files. 那套軟體像是受損檔案的恢復器。
The meal had a restoratory quality after the exhausting trip. 那頓餐在疲憊旅程後帶來了恢復性的感受。
They chose a restoratory treatment to ease her fatigue. 他們選擇了一種有助於恢復的療程來減輕她的疲勞。
The old palace was carefully restored to its original beauty last year. 這座舊宮殿去年被仔細修復，恢復了原本的美麗。
We hope to restore peace and order in the region as soon as possible. 我們希望盡快恢復該地區的和平與秩序。
The restorer spent years bringing the old painting back to color. 那位修復者花了好幾年把老畫作恢復色彩。
Every restorer needs patience and a steady hand. 每位修復者都需要耐心和穩定的手。
They had to restow the cargo after the storm shifted it. 暴風雨把貨物弄亂後，他們不得不重新裝載。
Please restow the boxes so the aisle stays clear. 請把箱子重新堆放，讓走道保持暢通。
The restowal of supplies took most of the morning. 供應品的重新裝載占去了大半個早上。
After the inspection, the restowal of the crates began. 檢查結束後，木箱開始重新堆放。

meaning: 不易疲勞的；耐久的；可持續使用的
sentences: The brand advertised a restproof cushion for long journeys. 那個品牌宣稱有適合長途旅行的不易疲勞坐墊。
A restproof chair should stay comfortable for hours. 一把耐久的椅子應該坐上好幾個小時都舒服。
He had to restraighten the bent sign after the wind blew it over. 風把招牌吹歪後，他只好重新把它弄直。
Use a ruler to restraighten the paper edge. 用尺把紙邊重新校直。
He had to restrain himself from shouting during the heated argument. 在激烈爭論中，他不得不克制（抑制）自己不要大叫。
The dog needed to be restrained by a leash during the walk in the park. 散步在公園時，這隻狗需要用皮帶管束（束縛）住。
The report measured the restrainability of the material under heat. 報告測量了那種材料受熱後的可控制性。
Parents admired his restrainability when the crowd got noisy. 人群變吵時，家長們很佩服他的自制力。
Her reply was polite but restrained. 她的回答很有禮，但明顯有所保留。
The room used restrained colors and simple lines. 那個房間用了很克制的配色和簡單線條。
She smiled restrainedly instead of laughing out loud. 她克制地微笑，沒有放聲大笑。
He spoke restrainedly, even when the topic became personal. 即使話題變得私密，他仍然說得很克制。
Her restrainedness made the whole room feel calm. 她的克制讓整個房間都顯得平靜。
The speech was admired for its restrainedness and clarity. 那場演講因為克制而清楚，受到讚賞。

meaning: 約束者；抑制器；限制裝置
sentences: The restrainer kept the lid from opening during transport. 那個限制裝置在運送途中把蓋子固定住。
As a restrainer, his job was to keep the conversation civil. 作為約束者，他的工作是讓談話保持得體。
A restraining hand on his shoulder calmed him down. 一隻放在他肩上的約束之手讓他安靜下來。
The law includes a restraining order in serious cases. 這部法律在嚴重情況下包含限制令。
He spoke restrainingly to stop the argument from growing. 他以克制的方式說話，避免爭執擴大。
The coach held up a hand restrainingly. 教練舉起手，示意要大家克制。
The government showed great restraint in its response to the protest. 政府在應對抗議活動時展現了極大的克制。
The tight budget is a major restraint on the development of the project. 緊縮的預算是專案發展的一個主要束縛（限制）。
Her restraintful reply kept the meeting on track. 她那句克制的回應讓會議得以順利進行。
The child gave him a restraintful nod instead of a shout. 那孩子克制地點了點頭，沒有大聲喊叫。
He had to restrap the suitcase after the latch broke. 行李箱扣環壞掉後，他只好重新綁緊。
Please restrap the package before it slips apart. 請在包裹散開前把它重新綁好。
The flood caused restratification in the reservoir. 洪水讓水庫裡的水層重新分層。
Scientists tracked restratification after the storm passed. 暴風雨過後，科學家持續追蹤再分層情況。
The water began to restream through the broken channel. 水開始沿著破損的水道重新流動。
We decided to restream the event for viewers in another time zone. 我們決定為另一個時區的觀眾再次串流那場活動。
The team tried to restrengthen its defense after halftime. 球隊在下半場後試著再次加強防守。
They plan to restrengthen the bridge before winter. 他們計畫在冬天前重新加固那座橋。
Let me restress the importance of turning off the oven. 讓我再次強調關掉烤箱的重要性。
The teacher will restress the main rule at the end of class. 老師會在下課前再強調一次主要規則。
We need to restretch the canvas before painting. 上色前，我們得把畫布重新拉緊。
He paused to restretch his sore calf muscles. 他停下來，把痠痛的小腿肌肉再拉開。
The government decided to restrict the usage of single-use plastic. 政府決定限制一次性塑料的使用。
Parking is restricted to residents only in this particular area. 這一帶僅限居民停車（受限）。
Access to the lab is restricted to staff only. 只有員工才能進入這間實驗室。
The restricted menu still offered plenty of good choices. 這份受限的菜單仍然提供了很多不錯的選擇。
The permit lets you park restrictedly in the loading zone. 這張許可證讓你可以有限度地停在裝卸區。
The topic was discussed restrictedly because of privacy concerns. 由於隱私考量，這個話題被有限度地討論。
The restrictedness of the program made it harder to join. 那個方案的限制程度讓人更難參與。
She did not like the restrictedness of the office rules. 她不喜歡辦公室規則的嚴格限制。
The government imposed strict travel restrictions during the pandemic. 政府在疫情期間實施了嚴格的旅行限制。
There are some age restrictions on watching certain types of movies in the cinema. 在電影院觀看某些類型的電影有一些年齡限制。
The restrictionary policy frustrated many residents. 那項限制性的政策讓許多居民感到沮喪。

A quick retier fixed the rope before loading began. 裝貨前，一名動作快的綁繩工把繩子重新綁妥了。
The retiform veins spread like a fine net. 那些網狀的靜脈像細網一樣散開。
A retiform crack pattern can appear on dried mud. 乾裂的泥土上可能出現網狀裂痕。
Use the wrench to retighten that loose bolt. 用板手把那顆鬆掉的螺栓重新鎖緊。
I had to retighten the jar lid after it leaked. 罐子漏了之後，我只好把蓋子再擰緊。
We plan to retile the bathroom next month. 我們打算下個月重新鋪浴室磁磚。
After the leak was fixed, they retiled the damaged wall. 漏水修好後，他們把受損的牆面重新貼磚。
Farmers retill the field after the first harvest. 農夫在第一次收成後會重新翻耕田地。
If the soil compacts, you may need to retill it before planting. 如果土壤變得太緊實，種植前可能需要再翻耕一次。

meaning: 重新以木材加固；重修木構件
sentences: They had to retimber the old bridge before winter. 冬天來前，他們得先用新木材加固那座老橋。
The crew retimbered the mine tunnel after the cave-in. 坍方後，工班重新以木材支撐那條礦坑隧道。

meaning: 重新安排時間；改變時程
sentences: We had to retime the meeting after the flight delay. 航班延誤後，我們只好重新安排會議時間。
The director retimed the scene to match the music better. 導演重新調整了那一幕的節奏，好配合音樂。
The spider's web formed a delicate retin in the morning light. 蜘蛛網在晨光中形成了一張細緻的網狀物。
He traced the roots as if they were part of a hidden retin underground. 他沿著那些根摸索，彷彿它們是地下隱藏的一張網。
The retina is a layer of tissue at the back of the eye that senses light. 視網膜是眼睛後部感光的一層組織。
The doctor performed a test to check the health of his retina. 醫生進行了測試以檢查他視網膜的健康狀況。
The doctor examined the retinacular tissue near the wrist. 醫師檢查了手腕附近的束帶狀組織。
A retinacular band helps keep the tendon from slipping. 束帶狀的韌帶有助於防止肌腱滑脫。
The botanist described the seed as retinaculate. 植物學家形容那顆種子帶有鉤附構造。
A retinaculate structure held the tiny mass in place. 一個具束帶的構造把那團小東西固定住了。
The retinaculum keeps the tendon close to the ankle bone. 這條支持帶讓肌腱貼近腳踝骨。
In class, we traced the retinaculum across the back of the wrist. 上課時，我們描出手腕背側的那條束帶。

meaning: 視網膜的；與視網膜有關的
sentences: The doctor checked her retinal health during the eye exam. 醫師在眼科檢查中查看她的視網膜健康。
Retinal damage can affect central vision. 視網膜受損可能影響中央視力。
The collector showed a pale sample of retinalite. 收藏家展示了一塊淡色的稀有礦物。
A thin vein of retinalite ran through the rock. 岩石中有一條細細的稀有礦物脈。
The sample dried into a dark retinasphalt. 樣本乾燥後變成深色的類瀝青物質。
He scraped the retinasphalt from the tray. 他把托盤上的類瀝青物質刮了下來。
The jar contained a sticky retinasphaltum. 罐子裡裝著黏稠的瀝青質樹脂。
She chipped a fragment of retinasphaltum from the block. 她從那塊硬塊上敲下一小片瀝青質樹脂。
The fabric needed a retincture after the first dye faded. 布料第一次染色褪掉後，需要再染一次。
A careful retincture gave the curtain a deeper blue tone. 仔細的再染色讓窗簾呈現更深的藍調。
The paper uses retinene as an older name. 這篇文章把它稱作較舊的名稱。
Retinene was measured in the solution. 溶液中的視黃醛被測了出來。

meaning: 具網狀葉脈的；網脈明顯的
sentences: The leaf looked retinerved under the bright lamp. 那片葉子在明亮燈光下看起來具網狀葉脈。
Botanists noted a retinerved pattern running through the blade. 植物學家注意到葉片上有明顯的網脈紋路。
A small retinian tear appeared near the edge of the image. 影像邊緣附近出現一道小小的視網膜裂口。
She asked whether the bright flash could damage retinian tissue. 她問那道強光會不會傷到視網膜組織。
The label identified the culture as retinispora from the old taxonomy. 標籤把這個培養物標成舊分類裡的舊屬名。
She copied the name retinispora carefully into her notes. 她小心地把這個舊屬名抄進筆記裡。
The old chart used retinite for a retinal condition. 那張舊圖表用這個詞指涉一種視網膜病變。
The clinician explained that retinite was affecting the patient's vision. 臨床醫師解釋，這種病變正在影響病人的視力。
The patient was treated for retinitis before the symptoms worsened. 病人在症狀惡化前接受了視網膜炎治療。
Retinitis can make reading difficult when the central vision is affected. 當中央視力受影響時，視網膜炎會讓閱讀變得困難。

meaning: 使網狀化；使呈現網狀結構
sentences: The designer used a mesh pattern to retinize the background. 設計師用網格圖案把背景網狀化。
Scientists retinized the surface to help the coating grip better. 科學家把表面做成網狀，讓塗層更容易附著。
He retinkered the radio until the static finally disappeared. 他把收音機反覆修補，直到雜訊終於消失。
If the shelf still wobbles, we can retinker the brackets tomorrow. 如果那個架子還是晃，明天我們可以再把支架修一修。
The screening helped doctors detect retinoblastoma early. 篩檢幫助醫師及早發現視網膜母細胞瘤。
Families are often relieved when retinoblastoma is found before it spreads. 當視網膜母細胞瘤在擴散前被發現時，家屬通常會鬆一口氣。
The article referred to the retinochorioid as part of the eye's lining. 那篇文章把視網膜脈絡膜稱為眼部內襯的一部分。
She underlined the word retinochorioid in the pathology report. 她在病理報告上把這個詞劃了線。
The retinochorioidal layer was described in the anatomy seminar. 解剖學研討會中提到了視網膜脈絡膜層。
A retinochorioidal lesion can change how light reaches the retina. 視網膜脈絡膜的病灶會改變光線到達視網膜的方式。
The diagnosis of retinochorioiditis worried the patient at first. 被診斷為視網膜脈絡膜炎時，病人一開始很擔心。
Treatment for retinochorioiditis often focuses on reducing inflammation. 視網膜脈絡膜炎的治療通常著重於減輕發炎。

meaning: 類視黃醇化合物；類維生素A物質
sentences: The cream contains a retinoid that may help smooth the skin. 這款乳霜含有一種類視黃醇化合物，可能有助於讓肌膚更平滑。
She checked whether the retinoid was safe to use at night. 她確認這種類視黃醇物質是否適合晚上使用。
The serum lists retinol as one of its active ingredients. 這瓶精華液把視黃醇列為活性成分之一。
She started with a low dose of retinol to avoid irritation. 她先從低濃度的視黃醇開始使用，以避免刺激。
The specialist explained that retinopapilitis can blur vision. 專科醫師解釋，視網膜視乳頭炎會讓視力變模糊。
The chart listed retinopapilitis as a possible cause of the pain. 病歷表把視網膜視乳頭炎列為疼痛的可能原因。

meaning: 與視網膜攜帶細胞有關的；視覺細胞的
sentences: The paper discussed retinophoral structures in the tiny organism. 那篇論文討論了小型生物中的視覺相關構造。
A retinophoral cell may carry pigments that affect how the animal sees. 視覺相關細胞可能攜帶影響動物視覺的色素。
Under the lens, each retinophore sat inside a dark ring of cells. 在放大鏡下，每個感光柱都被一圈深色細胞包住。
The drawing marks one retinophore at the center of each unit eye. 那張圖在每個小眼中央都標出一根感光柱。
The optometrist reached for a retinoscope during the exam. 驗光師在檢查時拿起了檢影鏡。
She watched the light from the retinoscope move across the pupil. 她看著檢影鏡的光線在瞳孔上移動。

meaning: 檢影的；與檢影鏡有關的
sentences: The retinoscopic reading helped determine the prescription. 檢影結果幫助決定了處方度數。
She asked for a retinoscopic explanation of the vision test. 她請對方用檢影法的角度解釋這項視力測驗。

meaning: 以檢影法地；用檢影方式地
sentences: The lenses were assessed retinoscopically in a dim room. 這些鏡片是在昏暗的房間裡以檢影法來評估的。
He retinoscopically checked the eye before changing the prescription. 他在更改處方前先用檢影方式檢查了眼睛。
The retinoscopist adjusted the light and asked the patient to stay still. 檢影驗光師調整燈光，請病人保持不動。
An experienced retinoscopist can spot small changes in refraction quickly. 經驗豐富的檢影驗光師能迅速看出折光的細微變化。
Retinoscopy is often used before choosing glasses. 在選擇眼鏡前，常會先做檢影驗光。
The student practiced retinoscopy until the reflections made sense. 那名學生練習檢影驗光，直到能看懂反光為止。
The old nursery tag still read Retinospora. 那張舊苗圃標籤上仍寫著這個舊屬名。
She smiled at the outdated name Retinospora in the botany book. 她看到植物學書中過時的舊屬名時笑了。
The mayor arrived with a small retinue of aides. 市長帶著一小隊隨行人員到場。
A quiet retinue followed the actor through the hotel lobby. 一群安靜的隨從跟著那位演員穿過飯店大廳。
The insect slide shows a retinula around the light-sensitive core. 那張昆蟲切片顯示感光核心周圍有一圈視小體細胞群。
Each retinula on the diagram is shaded to show pigment placement. 圖上的每組視小體細胞群都用陰影標出色素位置。

meaning: 視細胞群的；感光細胞的
sentences: The report described retinular cells in the compound eye. 報告描述了複眼中的視細胞群細胞。
A retinular pattern could be seen in the image after staining. 染色後，影像中可以看見視細胞群式的排列。
The old anatomy note referred to each retinule as a separate unit. 那份舊解剖筆記把每個單位視為獨立單位。
She drew a tiny retinule beside the larger diagram. 她在較大的圖旁邊畫了一個小感光單位。
I had to retip the umbrella after the cap fell off. 傘頭掉了之後，我只好重新裝尖。
The carpenter will retip the broken pencil-like tool tomorrow. 木工明天會把那支像鉛筆的工具重新裝上尖頭。
The retiracied scholar lived quietly near the coast. 那位退隱的學者安靜地住在海邊。
Her retiracied life left plenty of time for reading. 她隱居般的生活留下了很多閱讀時間。
After forty years at sea, he chose retiracy in a quiet hill town. 在海上工作四十年後，他選擇在安靜的山城過退休生活。
Her small garden became the center of her retiracy. 她那座小花園成了她隱居生活的中心。
The general ordered a retirade before nightfall. 將軍命令在天黑前撤退。
A hurried retirade left the camp in disarray. 一場匆忙的撤退讓營地亂成一團。
Her retiral from the company was announced in April. 她在四月宣布離職退休。
The ceremony marked his retiral after forty years of work. 這場典禮標誌著他工作四十年後的退休。
He is planning to retire from the company next year. 他計畫明年從公司退休。
She decided to retire from the competition due to an injury. 她因受傷決定退出比賽。
Our benefits leaflet puts retire(ment) next to savings and insurance. 我們的福利手冊把退休安排放在儲蓄和保險那一欄。
At dinner, retire(ment) became the topic after his last workday was set. 他的最後工作日確定後，晚餐桌上就開始談退休這件事。
My retired neighbor now spends mornings feeding stray cats. 我那位退休鄰居現在早上都在餵流浪貓。
They rented a retired cabin at the end of the pine road. 他們租下松樹路盡頭那間幽靜的小木屋。

meaning: 以退休者的方式；隱退地
sentences: He retiredly spent the morning reading by the window. 他像退休者般悠閒地在窗邊讀了一上午書。
She spoke retiredly, with the calm of someone long past the rush. 她說話帶著隱退後的從容，像是早已遠離忙碌的人。
The retiredness of the village made it feel peaceful. 那座村莊的隱退氣息讓人感到平靜。
He liked the retiredness of his new routine. 他喜歡新作息帶來的退休般安穩。
She looked forward to retirement. 她期待退休生活。
His retirement from public life was quiet. 他從公眾生活退隱得很低調。
The retirer now spends his days gardening and walking. 那位退休者如今把日子花在園藝和散步上。
As a retirer, she finally had time to learn painting. 作為一名退隱者，她終於有時間學畫畫。
Although she is retiring at first, she laughs a lot with close friends. 她雖然一開始有點內向，但和熟朋友在一起時很愛笑。
His retiring manner made the noisy party feel even louder. 他那種靦腆的樣子讓吵鬧的聚會顯得更喧鬧。
She smiled retiringly and looked at the floor. 她羞怯地笑了笑，低頭看著地板。
He retiringly stepped back to let the others speak first. 他謙讓地退到後面，讓其他人先說。
Her retiringness made her seem thoughtful rather than distant. 她的內斂讓人覺得她只是沉思，而不是疏離。
The speaker's retiringness softened the tone of the whole meeting. 那位講者的謙遜退讓，讓整場會議的氣氛都柔和了。
The chemist isolated a fragile retistene from the residue. 化學家從殘渣中分離出一種脆弱的稀有化合物。
A faint smell of retistene lingered in the storage room. 倉庫裡還殘留著淡淡的那種氣味。
If the bread feels cold, retoast it for thirty seconds. 如果吐司摸起來冷掉了，就再烤三十秒。
I had to retoast the bagel after the power flickered. 停電閃了一下之後，我只好把貝果再烤一次。
He retold the story with a few extra details. 他把那個故事又講了一遍，還加了幾個細節。
The legend was retold from one generation to the next. 這個傳說被一代又一代地重述下去。
I can retolerate the noise if the work finishes sooner. 如果工作能早點完成，我可以再忍受那個噪音。
After the repair, the machine was retolerated for another week. 維修之後，這台機器又被勉強再用了一週。
Retoleration was the only practical choice during the busy season. 在繁忙季節裡，重新容忍是唯一務實的選擇。
The manager's retoleration of small delays kept the team calm. 經理對小延誤的再次容忍，讓團隊保持冷靜。
The cloth seemed to retomb after I smoothed it out. 我把布撫平後，它似乎又重新鼓了起來。
By afternoon, the old cushion had retombed in the middle. 到了下午，那個舊坐墊中央又再次鼓起來了。
The choir's retonation was softer than before. 那個合唱團的重新發聲比先前更柔和。
For language learners, retonation can help correct a flat tone. 對語言學習者來說，重新發音有助於修正平板的語調。

meaning: 再次拿回；重新奪回；重考
sentences: She retook the exam and passed on her second try. 她重考了那場測驗，第二次就通過了。
The army retook the bridge before sunrise. 這支軍隊在日出前重新奪回了那座橋。
The workshop had to retool its machines for the new product line. 工坊必須為新產品線重新改裝機器。
We need to retool our study habits if we want better results. 如果我們想要更好的成果，就得重新調整讀書習慣。
The shop can retooth the old saw instead of replacing it. 那家店可以把舊鋸片重新裝齒，不必整片換掉。
Some fish can retooth within weeks after losing a bite tooth. 有些魚失去咬合齒後，幾週內就能再長牙。

meaning: 重新裝齒的人；補齒工具
sentences: The retoother checked each blade before the shift began. 那位重新裝齒的人在交班前檢查了每片刀鋒。
In the old factory, the retoother was as important as the mechanic. 在那座老工廠裡，重新裝齒的人和機械師一樣重要。
She gave a sharp retort when he questioned her professional ability. 當他質疑她的專業能力時，她給予了尖銳的反駁（回嘴）。
He was ready with a witty retort when he was asked the difficult question. 面對困難的問題時，他準備好了一個機智的反駁。
His claim was retortable, so the debate continued. 他的說法是可以反駁的，因此辯論繼續下去。
Not every rude remark is worth answering, even when it is retortable. 即使某些無禮的話可以回嘴，也不代表每一句都值得回應。
He retorted that the plan had never been his idea. 他反駁說，那個計畫根本不是他的主意。
She retorted so quickly that the room went silent. 她回嘴得太快，整個房間都安靜了下來。
No retorter in the room could beat her sharp logic. 房間裡沒有任何擅長回嘴的人能贏過她犀利的邏輯。
The best retorter is not always the loudest speaker. 最會反駁的人不一定是最吵的那一個。
His retortion of the facts only made people more suspicious. 他對事實的扭曲只讓大家更起疑。
The lawyer's retortion came across as clever but strained. 那位律師的反駁聽起來機巧，卻也有些勉強。
His retortive tone made the meeting tense. 他那種愛回嘴的語氣讓會議變得緊繃。
A retortive answer can sound witty, but it may also sound unkind. 回嘴式的回答有時很機智，但也可能顯得不友善。
The prisoner described the interrogation as a kind of retorture. 那名囚犯把這次訊問形容成一種折磨。
Sleepless nights can feel like retorture when the mind will not rest. 失眠的夜晚會像折磨一樣，讓人怎麼也無法安歇。
He retossed the salad just before serving it. 他在上桌前又把沙拉翻拌了一次。
The boat seemed to retoss on the rough water. 小船在湍急的水面上似乎又被拋起翻轉。
Please retotal the lunch slips before you send the form. 送出表單前，請先把午餐單重新加總。
We had to retotal the boxes after one stack fell over. 有一疊箱子倒下來後，我們得重新清點總數。
She retouched the portrait to soften the shadows. 她把肖像再修飾了一下，好讓陰影變柔和。
I only needed to retouch the photo before posting it. 我只需要在上傳前稍微修一下照片。
The retoucher fixed the skin tones in minutes. 那位修圖者在幾分鐘內就修好了膚色。
A skilled retoucher can improve an image without making it look fake. 熟練的潤飾者能提升影像品質，卻不會讓它看起來失真。
The magazine used light retouching on the cover photo. 那本雜誌只對封面照做了輕微修圖。
Too much retouching can erase the character of a real face. 過度修圖會抹去真實臉孔的個性。
The old painting needed only a small retouchment. 那幅舊畫只需要小幅修整。
His speech was polished through careful retouchment. 他的演講經過仔細潤飾後更加順暢。
We booked a retour ticket so the trip would be easier. 我們訂了來回票，這樣旅行會方便些。
After the long walk, the retour felt peaceful. 經過長途步行後，回程讓人覺得很平靜。
The route is retourable if the bridge stays open. 如果橋還開著，這條路是可以回返的。
They chose a retourable plan so no one would be stranded. 他們選了可返回的方案，這樣沒有人會被困住。
We retraced our steps to find the missing wallet. 我們沿著來時的路折返，好找回遺失的錢包。
The historian tried to retrace the events of that night. 那位歷史學家試著追溯那晚發生的事件。

meaning: 可追溯的；可沿原路返回的
sentences: The path was retraceable even after the rain. 即使下過雨，那條路仍然可以沿路折返。

He leaned closer to rewhisper the password. 他俯身靠近，再次低聲說出密碼。
She had to rewhisper the answer because the room was noisy. 房間太吵，她只好再把答案輕聲說一遍。
Sun and soap can rewhiten cotton curtains over time. 陽光和肥皂久了能讓棉窗簾重新變白。
We used paste to rewhiten the stained collar. 我們用糊劑把染黃的衣領再漂白一些。
I had to rewiden the doorway for the new cabinet. 為了放進新櫃子，我得把門口重新加寬。
The contractor rewidened the path before the rainy season. 承包商在雨季前把小路再拓寬了一次。

meaning: 再次贏得；重新奪回勝利
sentences: She hopes to rewin the championship this year. 她希望今年能再次贏得冠軍。
After a slow start, the team managed to rewin the crowd's trust. 在開局不順之後，球隊總算重新贏回觀眾的信任。
One rewind let us catch the name we missed. 倒回一次後，我們就聽清楚剛才漏掉的名字。
The old remote has a sticky rewind on the left side. 那支舊遙控器左邊的倒帶鍵有點黏。
The old cassette rewinder still sits on my desk. 那台老式卡帶倒帶器還放在我的桌上。
He used the rewinder to tidy the ribbon before packing it. 他用重繞器先把絲帶整理好再收起來。
This lamp is rewirable, so we can repair it instead of replacing it. 這盞燈可重新接線，所以我們能修好它而不是直接換掉。
The shop sells rewirable fixtures for custom installations. 這家店販售可重新接線的燈具，方便客製安裝。
We need to rewire the kitchen before installing the new oven. 在安裝新烤箱之前，我們得先把廚房重新接線。
The electrician rewired the circuit to make it safer. 電工把電路重新接線，讓它更安全。
I rewish you success whenever you start over. 不管你何時重新開始，我都再次祝你成功。
She paused to rewish the patient good health after the surgery. 她停下來，再次祝那位病人在手術後早日康復。
He tried to rewithdraw the document, but the system would not allow it. 他想把文件再次撤回，但系統不允許。
If the cash is needed, you can rewithdraw it from the account later. 如果需要現金，你之後可以再從帳戶提領。
The manager approved a rewithdrawal of the proposal after the meeting. 經理在會後同意再次撤回那份提案。
Any rewithdrawal from the account will show up on the statement. 帳戶的任何再次提領都會顯示在對帳單上。

meaning: 重新鋪木；再以木材包覆
sentences: We plan to rewood the porch with cedar boards. 我們打算用雪松木板重新鋪設門廊。
The stage was rewooded after the flood damaged the floor. 洪水損壞地板後，舞台又重新鋪上木材。
I had to reword the email to sound kinder. 我得把那封信改寫得更客氣。
Could you reword the question so the class understands it? 你能把問題換個說法，讓全班都懂嗎？
Please rework the poster before the fair opens. 園遊會開始前，請先把海報重做一下。
We had to rework the stew after it turned out too salty. 那鍋燉菜太鹹了，我們只好再調整一次。

meaning: 經過重新加工的；改修的
sentences: The reworked draft reads much more smoothly. 這份重新修訂過的草稿讀起來順多了。
She wore a reworked jacket with new lining and buttons. 她穿著一件重新改造過的外套，裡面換了新襯裡和鈕扣。
I rewound the tape and listened again. 我把錄音帶倒回去，又聽了一次。
He rewound the scene to catch the exact moment of the mistake. 他把那一幕倒回去，想抓住出錯的精確時刻。
She rewove the torn basket handle with fresh reeds. 她用新的蘆葦把破掉的籃把重新編織起來。
The artisan rewove the cloth to strengthen the edge. 那位工匠把布料重新編織，讓邊緣更牢固。
The rewoven scarf felt softer than the original. 那條重新編織過的圍巾摸起來比原本更柔軟。
Only a rewoven section was needed after the rip. 破口之後只需要補上一小段重新編織的部分。
Can you rewrap the gift after I add the card. 我把卡片放進去後，你可以把禮物重新包好嗎。
The baker had to rewrap the loaf when the paper tore. 包裝紙破掉時，麵包師只好把那條麵包重新包一次。

meaning: 重新寫，換一種方式；修改；修改。
sentences: The editor asked me to rewrite my article for a non-technical audience. 編輯要求我為非技術讀者重寫我的文章。
To rewrite means to write again, differently; to modify; to revise. 重寫意味著以不同的方式再次書寫；修改；進行修改。
The rewriter polished the article for a younger audience. 那位改寫者把文章潤飾成更適合年輕讀者的版本。
This code rewriter helps turn old scripts into cleaner drafts. 這個程式重寫工具能把舊腳本整理成更乾淨的草稿。
Rex barked whenever the mail arrived. 雷克斯每次聽到郵件送達就會吠叫。
We adopted a puppy and named him Rex. 我們領養了一隻小狗，給牠取名雷克斯。
Several dinosaur names include rex at the end. 許多恐龍名稱會把這個詞放在詞尾。
In Latin, rex means king. 在拉丁語裡，這個詞表示國王。
The rexen banner made the hall feel ceremonial. 那面王族風格的旗幟讓大廳顯得很有儀典氣氛。
He chose a rexen pose for the portrait, straight-backed and formal. 他拍肖像時擺出王者般的姿態，背脊挺直又正式。
Even after more pressure, the firm refused to reyield. 即使壓力更大，那家公司仍拒絕再次讓步。
The soil seemed to reyield moisture after the evening rain. 傍晚下雨後，土壤似乎又再次釋放出水分。
Reynard is a classic fox figure in European tales. 雷納德是歐洲故事中的經典狐狸角色。
The children laughed when Reynard tricked the hunters. 當雷納德戲弄獵人時，孩子們都笑了。
Reynold left his umbrella by the front bench again. 雷諾德又把他的雨傘忘在前面的長椅旁。
At noon, Reynold brought dumplings for the whole office. 中午時，雷諾德帶了餃子給整個辦公室。
The farmer had to reyoke the oxen after the cart slipped. 牛車滑開後，農夫只好再把牛重新套上軛。
Some traditions try to reyoke people to old rules. 有些傳統試圖把人們重新束縛回舊規矩。
Moving to the coast gave her a feeling of reyouth. 搬到海邊讓她有一種重返青春的感覺。
The novel treats travel as a kind of reyouth. 這部小說把旅行寫成一種第二青春。
The tray held a tiny piece of rezbanyite beside brighter ores. 托盤裡有一小塊雷茲班英石，旁邊放著更亮的礦石。
A label marked the greenish crust as rezbanyite from an old mine. 標籤把那層帶綠的結殼標成來自舊礦區的雷茲班英石。
The flatworm released a rhabdite near the edge of the slide. 那隻扁蟲在載玻片邊緣放出一個桿狀分泌體。
Each rhabdite on the image looks like a short clear rod. 圖上的每個桿狀分泌體都像一小段透明棒。
The larva is rhabditiform at this stage of development. 這個幼體在發育的這個階段呈桿狀。
Researchers noted the rhabditiform shape under the microscope. 研究人員在顯微鏡下記錄到那種桿狀形態。
Rhabditis is often found in moist soil. 桿線蟲屬常見於潮濕土壤。
Researchers observed Rhabditis under the microscope. 研究人員在顯微鏡下觀察桿線蟲屬。
The specimen included a visible rhabdium near the edge. 樣本邊緣可見一個明顯的桿狀構造。
Scientists used the rhabdium as a clue to identify the organism. 科學家把這個桿狀構造當作辨認生物的線索。
Rhabdocarpum is mentioned in a few old botanical manuals. 這個植物屬只在少數古老植物手冊中被提到。
The specimen card was filed under Rhabdocarpum. 那張標本卡被歸在這個植物屬名下。
Rhabdocoela are tiny flatworms that live in water and damp soil. 索形蟲類是生活在水中與潮濕土壤中的微小扁形蟲。
The class included several free-living Rhabdocoela. 這一類群包含許多自由生活的索形蟲。
One rhabdocoelan drifted through the dish under dim light. 微弱光線下，有一隻桿腔渦蟲類動物在培養皿裡游過。
The student found a rhabdocoelan in mud from the pond edge. 那名學生在池邊的泥裡找到一隻桿腔渦蟲類動物。
In the pond sample, a rhabdocoele slid between grains of sand. 池水樣本裡，一隻桿腔渦蟲在沙粒間滑過。
Under low light, the rhabdocoele looked almost transparent. 在弱光下，那隻桿腔渦蟲幾乎是透明的。
Rhabdocoelida includes many small free-living flatworms. 索形蟲目包含許多小型自由生活的扁形蟲。
The guide compared Rhabdocoelida with other worm groups. 這本指南把索形蟲目和其他蠕蟲類群作了比較。

meaning: 索形蟲目生物；索形蟲目的
sentences: The marine survey recorded a rhabdocoelidan among the samples. 海洋調查在樣本中記錄到一隻索形蟲目生物。
Some rhabdocoelidan features are easier to spot in preserved specimens. 有些索形蟲目的特徵在保存標本中更容易看出來。
The notes compare two rhabdocoelous species from the same pool. 筆記裡比較了同一個水池中的兩種桿腔渦蟲類物種。
A rhabdocoelous body plan can look simple at first glance. 桿腔渦蟲類的身體構造乍看之下很簡單。
The stain revealed a rhabdoid pattern inside the cell. 染色後，細胞內部出現桿狀的圖樣。
A rhabdoid inclusion stood out near the center. 中央附近有一個桿狀包涵體特別明顯。
The lesion had a rhabdoidal appearance on imaging. 影像檢查顯示那個病灶呈桿狀外觀。
We noted a rhabdoidal texture in the crystal cluster. 我們注意到那簇水晶帶有桿狀的質地。
The ocean sample contained a rhabdolith from a tiny plankton species. 海洋樣本中含有來自微小浮游生物的桿石。
Under high magnification, the rhabdolith gleamed like a narrow needle. 在高倍放大下，那顆桿石閃得像一根細針。
The insect's eye uses a rhabdom to collect light. 昆蟲的眼睛利用感桿來收集光線。
Researchers examined the rhabdom after comparing several species. 研究人員在比較幾個物種後，檢視了那個視桿。
The rhabdomal region responded quickly to the flash. 視桿區域對閃光反應很快。
Scientists measured rhabdomal activity in the insect eye. 科學家測量了昆蟲眼中的感桿活動。
The rhabdomancer searched for water with a forked stick. 那位占卜者拿著叉枝棍尋找水源。
In old tales, a rhabdomancer could read hidden paths in the earth. 在古老傳說裡，占卜者能讀出大地中隱藏的路徑。
The villagers trusted rhabdomancy to help locate a spring. 村民相信杖卜能幫忙找到泉水。
Modern readers treat rhabdomancy as part folklore, part ritual. 現代讀者把杖卜看作一半民間傳說、一半儀式。
The manuscript describes a rhabdomantic rite performed at dusk. 那份手稿描述了一場黃昏舉行的杖卜儀式。
He spoke in a rhabdomantic tone, as if every sign mattered. 他說話帶著占卜般的語氣，好像每個徵兆都很重要。
The rhabdomantist claimed the stream ran beneath the hill. 那位杖卜者聲稱溪流就在山丘下方。
People still invited a rhabdomantist when wells ran dry. 井水乾涸時，人們還是會請杖卜者來幫忙。
Rhabdomonas is studied in microbiology labs. 原生生物屬常在微生物實驗室中被研究。
Scientists noted Rhabdomonas in the sample from the pond. 科學家在池塘樣本中記錄到這種原生生物屬。
A small rhabdomyoma appeared near the heart wall. 心壁附近出現一個小型橫紋肌瘤。
Monthly images tracked the rhabdomyoma after the first visit. 初診之後，每月影像都在追蹤那個橫紋肌瘤。
The biopsy confirmed rhabdomyosarcoma, so treatment started quickly. 切片檢查證實是橫紋肌肉瘤，因此治療很快就開始了。
Doctors discussed surgery and chemotherapy for the rhabdomyosarcoma. 醫師討論了針對橫紋肌肉瘤的手術與化療。
The chart lists rhabdomysarcoma among the soft tissue cancers. 那張表把橫紋肌肉瘤列在軟組織癌症裡。
Doctors ordered another scan after the child was suspected of rhabdomysarcoma. 孩子被懷疑有橫紋肌肉瘤後，醫師又安排了一次掃描。
Rhabdophane can form tiny crystals in rare deposits. 這種稀土磷酸鹽礦物可在稀有礦床中形成微小晶體。
The geologist identified rhabdophane in the rock sample. 地質學家在岩石樣本中辨認出這種礦物。
Rhabdophanite was described from a very small specimen. 這種稀有礦物最初是根據一小塊標本描述的。
Collectors value rhabdophanite because it is so uncommon. 收藏家珍視這種礦物，因為它非常罕見。
Rhabdophora appears in many older paleontology books. 這個已滅絕的筆石類群常見於較早期的古生物學書籍。
The shale layer preserved traces of Rhabdophora. 那層頁岩保存了這個類群的痕跡。

meaning: 筆石類的；屬於 Rhabdophora 的
sentences: The rhabdophoran specimen was carefully mounted for display. 那件筆石類標本被仔細裝裱起來展出。
Its rhabdophoran shape helped researchers identify the fossil group. 它的筆石類外形幫助研究人員辨認出化石類群。
Rhabdopleura lives in small tube-like colonies on the seafloor. 管觸手類動物屬生活在海底的小型管狀群體中。
Biologists study Rhabdopleura to learn about early animal evolution. 生物學家研究這個屬，以了解早期動物演化。
The amoeba extended a rhabdopod toward the food particle. 那隻變形蟲朝食物顆粒伸出一根桿狀偽足。
A thin rhabdopod appeared first, then the cell body followed. 先伸出來的是細細的桿狀偽足，之後整個細胞才跟上。
The diagram marked the central rhabdos as the main support. 圖中把中央的棒狀體標為主要支撐。
In the fossil, the rhabdos was still clearly visible. 在化石裡，這根棒狀體仍然清楚可見。

meaning: 筆石群體；棒狀群體結構
sentences: A graptolite rhabdosome may preserve delicate branches. 筆石的群體結構可能保存細緻分枝。
The curator showed us a fossil rhabdosome with clear symmetry. 館員向我們展示了一件具有清楚對稱性的化石群體結構。
Rhabdosophy is a niche topic in historical paleontology. 筆石研究是古生物學史中的冷門主題。
Her thesis touched on rhabdosophy and fossil classification. 她的論文涉及筆石研究與化石分類。
The structure formed a rhabdosphere rather than a straight rod. 這個結構形成的是近球形棒狀體，而不是筆直的桿。
Researchers described the rhabdosphere as compact and rounded. 研究人員把這種近球形棒狀體描述為緊密而圓潤。
The rhabdus of the organism was visible at high magnification. 這種生物的桿狀體在高倍放大下可見。
A thin rhabdus often appears in microscope drawings. 顯微鏡圖中常會出現細長的桿狀體。
Rhacianectes is an older genus name for the gray whale. 這是灰鯨的舊屬名。
The museum card listed Rhacianectes beside related genera. 博物館卡片把它列在相關屬名旁邊。
Rhacomitrium often grows on exposed rocks in cool places. 這類苔蘚常生長在涼爽地區裸露的岩石上。
We found a soft patch of Rhacomitrium after the rain. 雨後我們在岩面上找到一片柔軟的苔蘚。
Rhacophorus clung to the wet leaf above the stream. 那隻樹蛙屬的蛙緊貼在溪流上方的濕葉片上。
The field card lists Rhacophorus for the gliding frog we saw at dusk. 那張野外紀錄卡把我們傍晚看到的滑翔蛙列在樹蛙屬。

meaning: 公正嚴明的；冷峻不可動搖的
sentences: Her Rhadamanthine judgment left no room for excuses. 她那種公正嚴明的判斷幾乎不給任何藉口空間。
The old king was remembered for his Rhadamanthine fairness. 那位古老的國王因公正無私而被記住。

meaning: 拉達曼堤斯；希臘神話中的公正判官
sentences: Rhadamanthus appears in myths as a stern judge of souls. 這位神話人物在傳說中是嚴峻的靈魂判官。
The poet invoked Rhadamanthus when speaking about justice. 那位詩人在談論正義時提到了這位神話人物。

meaning: 拉達曼堤斯的另一種古典拼法
sentences: Rhadamanthys is another classical form of the same mythic name. 這是同一個神話名字的另一種古典拼法。
Classical readers may recognize Rhadamanthys from epic poetry. 熟悉古典文學的人可能會從史詩詩作中認出這個名字。

meaning: 萊提階的；三疊紀晚期的
sentences: The Rhaetian rocks were laid down near the end of the Triassic. 這些岩層形成於三疊紀接近尾聲的時期。
Fossils from the Rhaetian period can reveal ancient ecosystems. 來自該時期的化石能揭示古老的生態系統。
Rhaetic layers often mark a major change in earth history. 這些地層常標誌著地球歷史上的重大轉變。
The textbook used Rhaetic as a term for the late Triassic. 那本教科書把這個詞用來指稱三疊紀晚期。
Rhagades may form when skin becomes very dry or inflamed. 當皮膚非常乾燥或發炎時，這些裂口可能會形成。
The doctor treated the rhagades gently to reduce pain. 醫師小心處理這些裂口，以減輕疼痛。
The rhagadiform crack spread along the old bark. 那道裂隙狀裂痕沿著老樹皮延伸開來。
A rhagadiform pattern can look jagged under close inspection. 裂隙狀的紋理在近看時會顯得參差不齊。
Rhagiocrin is the kind of name that appears in fossil catalogues. 這是常見於化石目錄中的名稱。
The researcher compared Rhagiocrin with other ancient marine forms. 研究人員將它與其他古老海洋生物作比較。
A rhagionid flew slowly over the shaded stream bank. 一隻雜角蠅科昆蟲緩緩飛過陰影中的溪岸。
Entomologists sometimes note rhagionid larvae in moist soil. 昆蟲學家有時會在潮濕土壤中記錄這類幼蟲。
Rhagionidae are slender flies found in many habitats. 雜角蠅科是分布廣泛的細長蠅類。
The field guide included a short note on Rhagionidae identification. 那本野外圖鑑附上了辨認這一科的簡短說明。
Rhagite was mentioned in an old mineral list from the region. 它曾出現在該地區的一份舊礦物清單中。
The specimen looked like a dark rhagite fragment in the tray. 那件樣本在托盤裡看起來像一小塊深色碎片。
Rhagodia shrubs can tolerate salty coastal winds. 這類灌木能耐受帶鹽分的海風。
We saw Rhagodia growing low and dense beside the path. 我們看到這個屬低矮而茂密地長在小路旁。
In the lab diagram, the rhagon was shown as a rounded chamber. 在實驗室圖解中，這種囊狀構造被畫成一個圓形腔室。
The term rhagon helps describe an early simple body plan. 這個術語有助於描述早期簡單的身體構造。

meaning: 呈囊狀的；具囊狀結構的
sentences: The rhagonate form was easier to recognize in the sketch. 這種囊狀形態在草圖中更容易辨認。
Scientists used rhagonate to describe the organism's rounded body. 科學家用這個詞來描述該生物的圓潤身形。
The rhagose surface had fine cracks across it. 那個有裂紋的表面布滿細小裂痕。
A rhagose seed pod can split unevenly as it dries. 乾燥時，有裂紋的蒴果可能會不規則裂開。
