The chef grated the rind into the sauce. 主廚把果皮刨碎加入醬汁。
Professor Rind canceled class for the afternoon. 林德教授取消了下午的課。
The badge on the desk read Rind. 桌上的名牌寫著林德。
Rinde signed the receipt with a blue pen. 林德用藍筆簽收了單據。
The nurse called for Rinde in the waiting room. 護理師在候診室喊了林德的名字。
The market sold rinded cheese by the slice. 市場按片販售有外皮的起司。
A rinded fruit sat alone on the tray. 托盤上單獨放著一顆有外皮的水果。
The report described how rinderpest spread through the herd. 報告說明了牛瘟如何在牛群中蔓延。
Farmers feared rinderpest during that dry year. 那個乾旱的年份裡，農民很怕爆發牛瘟。
A clear rindle crossed the hiking path. 一條清澈的小水道穿過登山步道。
The children floated leaves in the rindle. 孩子們把葉子放進那條小溪流裡漂。
She bought a rindless wedge of cheese. 她買了一塊去皮的起司。
The cook used rindless bacon for the soup. 廚師用去皮培根來煮湯。
This melon is small but very rindy. 這顆甜瓜不大，但皮很厚。
The lemon looked rindy and hard to peel. 那顆檸檬外皮厚厚的，不太好剝。
Rine finished the sketch before lunch. 賴恩在午餐前完成了草圖。
The museum guide pointed out the work by Rine. 博物館導覽員指著賴恩的作品介紹。
She wore a beautiful diamond ring on her wedding finger. 她在手指上戴了一枚漂亮的鑽石戒指。
I heard the phone ring several times, but nobody answered it. 我聽到電話響了好幾聲，但沒人接。
She put the handouts into a ring binder. 她把講義放進活頁夾。
My old ring binder is full of math notes. 我的舊活頁筆記本裡滿是數學筆記。

meaning: 可按鈴呼叫的；可鳴響的
sentences: The front desk is ringable after 8 a.m. 早上八點後可以按鈴呼叫櫃台。
A ringable bell hung by the garden gate. 花園門旁掛著一個可以按響的鈴。

meaning: 新西蘭毛利人的林加圖教派
sentences: Her grandfather belonged to Ringatu for many years. 她祖父多年來都屬於林加圖教派。
The museum had a small display about Ringatu. 博物館裡有一個介紹林加圖教派的小展區。
They warned us not to ringbark the young trees. 他們提醒我們不要環剝那些幼樹的樹皮。
A careless cut can ringbark a tree by mistake. 不小心劃一圈就可能誤把樹環剝致死。
The ringbarker moved from trunk to trunk with an axe. 那名環剝工拿著斧頭在一棵棵樹之間移動。
An old ringbarker showed us the cut marks. 一位老環剝工指給我們看那些切痕。
A ringbill landed on the fence after the rain. 雨後有一隻喙上帶環紋的鳥停在籬笆上。
The guide pointed out a ringbill near the reeds. 導覽員指著蘆葦旁一隻喙上有環紋的鳥。
We spotted a ringbird in the low branches. 我們在低矮樹枝間看到一隻有環紋的鳥。
The painting showed a ringbird above the stream. 畫裡的小溪上方有一隻帶環紋的鳥。
He clipped the rope to a ringbolt on the wall. 他把繩子扣在牆上的環首螺栓上。
The crate was lifted by a heavy ringbolt. 那個木箱靠一支粗重的環首螺栓吊了起來。
ringbone made the mare limp after work. 那匹母馬工作後因骨贅病而跛行。
The vet diagnosed ringbone in the older horse. 獸醫診斷那匹老馬得了馬蹄骨贅病。
The trainer rested the ringboned gelding for a week. 訓練師讓那匹患病的閹馬休息了一週。
A ringboned horse should not jump today. 患有馬蹄骨贅病的馬今天不該跳躍。
Her ringcraft helped her avoid the stronger boxer. 她的場上技巧讓她避開了更強壯的拳手。
The coach praised his ringcraft after the match. 教練在賽後稱讚了他的拳台技巧。
A ringdove called from the tall pine. 一隻斑尾林鴿在高高的松樹上鳴叫。
We watched a ringdove walk across the grass. 我們看著一隻斑尾林鴿走過草地。
The old bell began to ringe in the wind. 那口老鐘在風裡開始鳴響。
At noon, the tower would ringe across the square. 中午時，鐘樓會把鈴聲傳遍廣場。
The bird has a ringed neck. 這隻鳥的頸部有環紋。
A ringed halo surrounded the moon. 月亮周圍出現一圈光暈。
The flower looked ringent from the side. 從側面看，那朵花像張著嘴一樣大開。
A ringent corolla faced the morning light. 那朵張口形花冠朝向晨光。
He was a ringer for my brother. 他和我兄弟幾乎一模一樣。
The casting director found a ringer for the lead role. 選角導演找到了和主角極為相像的人。
A ringeye peered out from the dark branch. 一隻眼周帶環紋的小動物從暗處樹枝間探頭。
The kids laughed when the ringeye stole fruit. 那隻眼圈動物偷走水果時，孩子們都笑了。
The ringgiver looked nervous before the proposal. 求婚前，那位贈戒者看起來很緊張。
A proud ringgiver opened the small velvet box. 那位滿心期待的贈戒者打開了小小的絨盒。
Their ringgiving happened on a rainy balcony. 他們的贈戒儀式是在下雨的陽台上進行的。
The poem described ringgiving as a sign of trust. 那首詩把贈送戒指寫成信任的象徵。
A ringgoer saved the best seat near the ropes. 一名常看拳賽的人先占了繩邊最好的座位。
My uncle is a ringgoer every Friday night. 我叔叔每個週五晚上都去看拳賽。
The ringhals lifted its head when the keeper approached the glass. 管理員走近玻璃時，那條環頸蛇抬起了頭。
A ringhals can look calm before it suddenly moves. 環頸蛇在突然移動前常常看起來很平靜。

meaning: 圓環狀的頭部；環形頭端
sentences: The old statue had a ringhead that looked almost like a halo. 那座老雕像的頭部有個圓環狀的部分，看起來幾乎像光環。
He touched the ringhead carefully so the metal would not bend. 他小心碰了碰那個環形頭端，免得金屬彎掉。
The ringiness of the dough made the baker roll it again. 那團麵糰帶著環狀感，麵包師只好再重新擀一次。
She noticed the ringiness of the pattern under the light. 她在燈光下注意到那個圖案的環狀感。
The ringing from the tower woke everyone. 鐘樓傳來的鈴聲吵醒了所有人。
We heard a faint ringing in the hallway. 我們聽見走廊裡傳來微弱的響聲。
The bell sounded ringingly across the quiet yard. 鈴聲清脆地響遍安靜的院子。
He answered ringingly, as if he wanted everyone to hear. 他響亮地回答，像是想讓每個人都聽見。

meaning: 清脆回響；持續作響的狀態
sentences: The ringingness of the cymbal faded slowly after the strike. 鈸在敲擊後的清脆回響慢慢消散。
She liked the ringingness of the wind chime near the door. 她喜歡門邊風鈴那種持續作響的感覺。
The label called the sample ringite. 標籤把那塊樣本標成環狀礦物。
A thin vein of ringite crossed the stone. 一條細細的環狀礦物脈穿過那塊石頭。
A small ringle held the strap in place on the bag. 一個小環把背包上的帶子固定住。
She threaded the ribbon through the ringle before tying it. 她先把緞帶穿過那個小圈，再把它綁好。

meaning: 帶領成圈；讓人繞圈前進
sentences: The guide seemed to ringlead the children around the fountain. 那位導覽員似乎帶著孩子們圍著噴泉繞圈走。
We had to ringlead the horse slowly so it would stay calm. 我們得慢慢牽著那匹馬繞圈前進，牠才會保持冷靜。
The ringleader spoke first and the others followed his plan. 那位首領先開口，其他人就跟著他的計畫走。
Police asked who the ringleader was after the meeting ended. 會議結束後，警方詢問誰是主事者。

meaning: 沒有首領的；無主事者的
sentences: After the arrest, the group seemed ringleaderless and confused. 逮捕之後，那個團體看起來沒有首領，也亂成一團。
The ringleaderless crowd drifted apart within minutes. 那群沒有主事者的人群在幾分鐘內就散開了。
He was praised for his ringleadership during the rescue. 他在救援行動中的帶頭角色受到稱讚。
The committee argued over who should take ringleadership next. 委員會爭論下一步該由誰來擔任領導地位。
The ringless key was easy to lose in the pocket. 那把沒有環的鑰匙很容易在口袋裡弄丟。
She kept her hands ringless during the performance. 表演時，她的手上沒有戴任何戒指。
A ringlet fell across her forehead after the rain. 雨後，一綹小卷髮垂在她額前。
He tied the rope into a tight ringlet for storage. 他把繩子纏成一個緊密的小圈收起來。

meaning: 有小卷髮的；成小環狀的
sentences: The child looked ringleted and cheerful in the photo. 照片裡那個孩子頂著一頭小卷髮，看起來很開心。
The carved border appeared ringleted around the rim. 雕刻邊框沿著邊緣看起來像一圈圈的小環。

meaning: 帶小卷的；有環狀小捲髮的
sentences: Her ringlety hair bounced as she walked down the hall. 她走過走廊時，那頭帶小卷的頭髮一跳一跳的。
The ringlety fringe framed his face softly. 那撮帶小卷的瀏海柔和地襯著他的臉。
The stain left a ringlike mark on the table. 那塊污漬在桌上留下環狀的痕跡。
A ringlike cloud formed around the moon at midnight. 午夜時，月亮周圍形成了一圈環狀雲。
The ringmaker showed us how he shaped the silver band. 那位製環者向我們展示他如何塑形銀戒。
Every ringmaker in the market had a different style. 市集裡每位做戒指的人都有不同風格。
She took a class in ringmaking after school. 她放學後去上了一門製環課。
Ringmaking requires patience and a steady hand. 製環需要耐心和穩定的手。

meaning: 帶環的人；戴著戒指的人
sentences: The ringman held the horse steady beside the gate. 那位牽馬的人在大門旁穩住了馬。
At the ceremony, the ringman carried the box with care. 在儀式上，那位拿著戒指的人小心地捧著盒子。
The ringmaster stepped forward and welcomed the audience. 馬戲團主持人走上前歡迎觀眾。
Everyone looked at the ringmaster for the next cue. 所有人都等著指揮者的下一個指示。
A ringneck flashed green feathers near the pond. 一隻環頸鳥在池塘邊閃過綠色羽毛。
The ringneck stayed still until the camera stopped moving. 那隻環頸鳥一直靜靜待著，直到相機停止晃動。
The old boat used a ringsail on windy afternoons. 那艘老船在有風的下午會用環帆。
A torn ringsail can make steering harder. 一張破損的環帆會讓操舵變得更難。
We sat ringside and watched the fighters closely. 我們坐在擂台邊，近距離看著選手。
He chose a ringside seat to catch every detail. 他選了靠近的座位，好看清每個細節。

meaning: 擂台邊觀眾；近旁旁觀者
sentences: The ringsider leaned forward when the bell rang. 鈴聲一響，那位擂台邊觀眾就往前傾。
Each ringsider reacted differently to the final round. 每位近旁旁觀者對最後一回合的反應都不同。
The old ringster on the shelf was covered with dust. 架子上的舊環形裝置積滿了灰塵。
He called the helper a ringster because she worked the band into shape. 他把那位助手叫作做環的人，因為是她把金屬帶塑成形。
A ringtail crossed the branch and vanished into the leaves. 一隻環尾獸穿過樹枝，消失在樹葉裡。
The ringtail's striped tail made it easy to spot. 那隻環尾獸條紋分明的尾巴很容易辨認。

meaning: 帶琥珀色的；灰白帶黃的
sentences: The ringtaw marble had a warm amber tone. 那塊帶琥珀色的玻璃珠呈現溫暖的琥珀調。
Her ringtaw scarf matched the autumn leaves. 她那條灰白帶黃的圍巾和秋天的葉子很搭。
At ringtime, the whole hallway grew quiet. 到了響鈴時刻，整條走廊都安靜下來。
They used ringtime to signal the start of class. 他們用鐘響時刻來表示上課開始。
The children played ringtoss at the fair. 孩子們在集市上玩套圈遊戲。
He won a toy after three perfect throws in ringtoss. 他在投環遊戲裡三次都投得很準，贏得了一個玩具。
The ringwalk around the field helped warm up the players. 繞著場地走圈幫助球員熱身。
She took a slow ringwalk before the rehearsal began. 綵排開始前，她慢慢沿著圈道走了一圈。

meaning: 環形圍牆；圍成一圈的牆
sentences: The ruins still showed a low ringwall around the site. 遺址周圍仍可看見一圈低矮的環形圍牆。
From above, the ringwall looked like a faded circle. 從上方看，那道環形圍牆像個褪色的圓圈。
The dancers moved ringwise around the lantern. 舞者們繞著燈籠成圈移動。
The stones were laid ringwise to make a border. 那些石頭被環狀地排成一道邊框。
The doctor said the rash was ringworm. 醫師說那片疹子是體癬。
He kept the towel separate because of ringworm. 因為得了體癬，他把毛巾另外分開放。
The ringy bell note lingered in the room. 那個有回響的鈴聲在房間裡久久不散。
His ringy style of speaking made the speech sound lively. 他那種帶回響感的說話方式，讓演講聽起來很有活力。
After work, we went straight to the rink. 下班後，我們直接去了溜冰場。
The rink was crowded on Saturday afternoon. 星期六下午的溜冰場擠滿了人。

meaning: 一種不常見的環狀標記或名稱
sentences: The archivist found a note about a rinka in the old ledger. 檔案管理員在舊帳本裡找到一則關於圓形標記的記錄。
A rinka was drawn beside the main entry in red ink. 主條目旁邊用紅墨水畫了一個圓形標記。

meaning: 做小環的人；裝環的器具
sentences: The rinker sat near the workbench with his tools laid out. 那位做小環的人坐在工作台旁，工具都排好了。
She used a rinker to shape the thin wire into a loop. 她用裝環的器具把細鐵絲做成一個圈。
The label identified the pale crystal as rinkite. 標籤把那顆淡色晶體辨認為環狀礦物。
Collectors were excited to see a real rinkite sample. 收藏家看到真正的稀有礦物樣本都很興奮。

meaning: 愛爾蘭風格的長隊舞；一種群舞
sentences: The festival opened with a lively rinncefada. 慶典一開始就是一段熱鬧的長隊舞。
They practiced the rinncefada until every step matched. 他們把那支長隊舞練到每一步都整齊一致。
The museum case displayed a tiny piece of rinneite. 博物館的展櫃裡放著一小塊稀有礦物。
Rinneite is interesting to collectors because of its rarity. 這種礦物因為稀有而引起收藏家的興趣。
The fastest rinner reached the gate first. 跑得最快的人最先到了大門口。
A young rinner dashed across the field. 一個年輕快跑者衝過了草地。
The fabric is rinsable, so cleaning it is easy. 這種布料可以沖洗，所以清潔起來很容易。
She chose a rinsable bottle because the nursery needed quick cleanup. 她選了可沖洗的瓶子，因為育兒室需要快速清理。
Please rinse the vegetables before cooking them. 煮菜之前，請先把蔬菜沖洗乾淨。
He rinsed the cup and set it on the shelf to dry. 他把杯子沖乾淨後，放到架上晾乾。
The rinser sat beside the sink and worked quickly. 那位負責沖洗的人坐在水槽旁，動作很快。
He bought a rinser for the lab to clean the glassware. 他為了清洗玻璃器皿，替實驗室買了一台沖洗器。
Rinsing the bowl took less than a minute. 沖洗那個碗不到一分鐘就完成了。
The extra rinsing removed the soap smell completely. 多沖洗一次後，肥皂味就完全消失了。
The old map sent travelers rinthereout across the hills. 舊地圖指引旅人往那邊穿過山丘去。
He went rinthereout before sunrise and did not return until dusk. 他在日出前就往那邊去了，直到黃昏才回來。

meaning: 到那裡去的人；四處奔走的人
sentences: The rintherout arrived late with mud on his boots. 那位四處奔走的人穿著沾泥的靴子，遲到了。
People laughed at the rintherout's wild stories. 大家都被那位奔走者的荒唐故事逗笑了。
Their trip to Rio took longer than planned. 他們前往里約的旅程比原先預計更久。
The postcard from Rio arrived on Monday. 從里約寄來的明信片在星期一送到。
Rio looked out the window and watched the rain start. 里約望著窗外，看著雨開始下起來。
They planned to visit Rio after the conference ended. 他們打算在會議結束後去里約。
The police were called to control the violent riot in the city center. 警察被召集來控制市中心發生的暴力騷亂（暴動）。
The garden was a riot of colors in the spring, with flowers blooming everywhere. 春天時，花園裡百花齊放，色彩斑斕（豐富多彩）。
The rioter was arrested before the crowd reached the gate. 在人群到達大門前，那名暴動者就被逮捕了。
A rioter shouted from the sidewalk and people stepped back. 一名滋事者在路邊大喊，大家都退後了。
Rioting broke out after the final announcement. 最後的公告一出，騷亂就爆發了。
The police moved quickly to stop the rioting downtown. 警方迅速行動，阻止市中心的暴動。
The children laughed riotingly after the parade ended. 遊行結束後，孩子們喧鬧地笑成一團。
He spoke riotingly about the prank, making everyone laugh. 他以鬧哄哄的方式講那個惡作劇，讓大家都笑了。
The riotist refused to leave when the hall emptied. 大廳清空後，那名暴動者還是不肯離開。
People called him a riotist because he loved stirring trouble. 大家叫他好鬧事的人，因為他總愛挑起麻煩。
The riotistic mood of the crowd worried the organizers. 群眾那種好鬧事的氣氛讓主辦方很擔心。
Her riotistic joke was meant to provoke a reaction. 她那句帶挑釁意味的玩笑本來就是想引起反應。

meaning: 群眾暴政；由暴民掌控的局面
sentences: The council feared the city was sliding into riotocracy. 委員會擔心這座城市正滑向群眾暴政。
When no one kept order, riotocracy took over the square. 當沒有人維持秩序時，廣場就變成了群眾暴政。
The students gave the match a riotous welcome. 學生們用喧鬧的歡呼迎接那場比賽。
A riotous crowd filled the street after the concert. 演唱會結束後，一群喧鬧的人擠滿了街道。
They laughed riotously at the absurd joke. 他們對那個荒唐笑話笑得很放縱。
The guests danced riotously until midnight. 賓客們一直喧鬧地跳舞到半夜。
The riotousness of the party kept the neighbors awake. 那場派對的喧鬧讓鄰居都睡不著。
He missed the riotousness of the old festival. 他很懷念那個舊節慶的熱鬧氣氛。

meaning: 耐騷亂的；不易引發暴動的
sentences: The stadium used riotproof barriers around the field. 體育場在場地周圍使用耐騷亂的護欄。
The school installed riotproof doors after the disturbance. 那所學校在騷亂後裝上了不易被破壞的門。
The riotry in the harbor lasted for hours. 港口的騷亂持續了好幾個小時。
He wrote about the riotry of the crowded market. 他寫下那個擁擠市集的喧鬧景象。

sentences: Good road sense helps children cross streets safely. 良好的交通安全意識能幫助孩子安全過馬路。
Cyclists need road sense as much as strong legs. 騎腳踏車的人需要道路判斷力，也需要體力。
The roadability of the van was excellent. 那台廂型車的道路適應性很好。
Engineers tested roadability before the trip. 工程師在出發前測試了道路適應性。
The car is roadable after the repair. 修好之後，這輛車已經可以上路。
Only roadable vehicles were allowed past the gate. 只有可上路的車輛才被允許通過大門。
Workers compacted the roadbed before paving. 工人在鋪路前先壓實路基。
The roadbed had to stay dry through the night. 路基整晚都必須保持乾燥。
Police set up a roadblock after the heavy landslide. 大規模土石崩落後，警方設置了路障。
Lack of funding became the biggest roadblock to the project. 資金不足成了這個計畫最大的阻礙。
She packed a roadbook for the journey. 她為這趟旅程帶上了一本路書。
The roadbook helped the driver stay on course. 那本路書幫助駕駛人保持正確路線。
Good roadcraft helps a driver stay safe. 良好的駕駛技巧能幫助駕駛人保持安全。
He learned roadcraft from years on the highway. 他是從多年跑公路的經驗裡學會駕駛技巧的。
The town was roaded after the flood. 洪水過後，這座城鎮重新鋪上了道路。
The roaded field became easier to cross. 鋪過路的田地更容易通過。
The roader parked beside the station. 那位常跑公路的人把車停在車站旁。
Every roader knew the next fuel stop. 每個常跑公路的人都知道下一個加油站在哪。
He greeted his roadfellow with a smile. 他笑著跟同路人打招呼。
A good roadfellow can make a long trip easier. 一位好同路人能讓長途旅行輕鬆一些。
The roadhead marked the start of the trail. 道路起點標示了步道的開始。
We left the truck at the roadhead and walked on. 我們把卡車停在路頭，然後繼續步行。
We stopped at a roadhouse for dinner. 我們在路邊旅館停下來吃晚餐。
The travelers spent the night in a roadhouse. 旅人們在路邊旅館過夜。
The roading took two weeks to finish. 鋪路工程花了兩週才完成。
Heavy rain delayed the roading again. 大雨又讓鋪路工程延後了。

meaning: 與道路工程有關的罕見詞
sentences: The guidebook treated roadite as a rare term. 指南把它當作罕見詞。
I found roadite only in an old dictionary. 我只在一本舊字典裡找到它。
The village was roadless for many years. 那座村落多年來沒有道路。
A roadless valley is hard to reach. 沒有道路的山谷很難抵達。
The roadlessness of the area made travel slow. 那一帶沒有道路，讓旅行變得很慢。
Roadlessness can isolate small farms. 缺少道路會使小農場與外界隔絕。
The path was roadlike and easy to follow. 那條小路像道路一樣，很容易跟著走。
A roadlike strip cut through the grass. 一條像道路的帶狀小徑穿過草地。
A roadman checked the shoulder of the highway. 一名道路工人檢查了公路邊坡。
The roadman wore a bright orange vest. 那名道路工人穿著亮橘色背心。
The roadmaster approved the repair work. 道路主管核准了維修工程。
Every crew reported to the roadmaster at noon. 每個工班中午都向道路主管報到。
They stopped at a roadside stand to buy fresh fruit. 他們在路邊攤停下來買新鮮水果。
Wild flowers were blooming along the roadside. 路旁正開滿野花。
A roadsider sold fruit from a small cart. 一名路邊攤販用小推車賣水果。
The roadsider waved as cars passed by. 那位路邊攤販在車輛經過時揮手。

meaning: 靠路營生的人；道路工人
sentences: The roadsman patched the pothole at noon. 那名道路工人在中午修補了坑洞。
A roadsman needs strong boots in winter. 道路工人在冬天需要結實的靴子。
The harbor offered a calm roadstead for ships. 那座港口提供了平靜的錨地。
The captain anchored in the roadstead overnight. 船長把船停在錨地過夜。
He drove a roadster along the coast. 他開著敞篷跑車沿海岸行駛。
The old roadster still started on the first try. 那台老敞篷車仍然一次就能發動。
The builder ordered roadstone for the driveway. 建築工為車道訂了鋪路石。
Roadstone made the surface firm and level. 鋪路石讓路面堅實又平整。
The map showed the old roadtrack to the port. 地圖標出了通往港口的舊道路線。
Fresh dust marked the truck's roadtrack at dawn. 清晨時，卡車留下的新灰痕標出了它的行進軌跡。
Please keep the bicycles off the main roadway. 請不要讓腳踏車進入主要車道。
Rainwater was flowing across the roadway after the storm. 暴雨過後，雨水正從路面上流過。
Roadweed grew along the fence line. 路邊雜草沿著圍欄生長。
The gardener removed the roadweed by hand. 園丁用手把路邊雜草拔掉。
He drove roadwise on the wet highway. 他在濕滑的公路上開得很有路況判斷。
She planned the trip roadwise and avoided traffic. 她以路況為重規畫行程，避開了塞車。
The inspector checked the roadworthiness of the bus. 檢查員確認那輛公車是否適合上路。
Roadworthiness matters before a long drive. 長途出發前，車輛是否適合上路很重要。

meaning: 適合行車的；可安全上路的
sentences: The car is roadworthy after the repair. 修好之後，這輛車已經可以上路。
Only roadworthy vehicles may enter the highway. 只有適合上路的車輛才能進入公路。
We enjoyed roaming around the narrow streets of the ancient city yesterday. 我們昨天喜歡在古城的狹窄街道上漫遊（漫步）。
Wild animals roam freely in the vast wilderness of the national park. 野生動物在國家公園廣闊的荒野中自由自在地流浪（漫遊）。
His roamage across the town took the whole afternoon. 他在城裡漫遊了一整個下午。
The story described the roamage of a restless boy. 故事描寫了一個坐不住的男孩四處遊蕩。
The roamer slept in different towns each week. 那位漫遊者每週都睡在不同的城鎮。
As a roamer, he preferred open roads. 作為一名四處遊走的人，他更喜歡開闊的道路。
The roaming dog wandered through the park. 那隻流浪的狗在公園裡走來走去。
Roaming lights moved across the dark field. 游移的燈光在黑暗的田野上移動。
He wandered roamingly through the empty town. 他漫無目的地在空城裡遊走。
The dog moved roamingly along the riverbank. 那隻狗沿著河岸隨意走動。

meaning: 白褐相間的；夾雜白毛的；白褐色馬
sentences: The horse had a roan coat with soft white patches. 那匹馬有白褐相間的毛色，夾著柔和白斑。
She rode a roan pony to the meadow. 她騎著一匹白褐色的小馬去了草地。
The map marked Roanoke near the coast. 地圖上把羅阿諾克標在海岸附近。
We stopped in Roanoke for one night. 我們在羅阿諾克停留了一晚。
The lion gave a powerful roar that echoed through the savannah. 獅子發出一聲強而有力的吼叫，在熱帶草原上迴盪。
We could hear the constant roar of the ocean waves at night. 我們晚上能聽到持續不斷的大海波濤聲。
The lion was the loudest roarer in the zoo. 那頭獅子是動物園裡叫聲最大的吼叫者。
An old motorcycle can be a real roarer at night. 老機車在夜裡真的像個轟鳴怪物。
The pub was roaring after the home win. 主場贏球後，那間酒吧熱鬧得很。
Business stayed roaring through the holiday week. 整個假期那一週，生意都非常興旺。
The crowd laughed roaringly at the joke. 觀眾對那個笑話放聲大笑。
The wind rushed roaringly through the canyon. 風呼嘯著穿過峽谷。
My mother is preparing a delicious roasted chicken for dinner. 我媽媽正為晚餐準備美味的烤雞。
The restaurant is famous for its slow-roasted beef steaks. 這家餐廳以其慢火烘烤的牛排聞名。
These vegetables are roastable in a hot oven. 這些蔬菜很適合放進熱烤箱烘烤。
He sorted the roastable nuts from the rest. 他把適合烘烤的堅果挑了出來。

meaning: 烘烤器；烤肉的人；適合烤的食材
sentences: The coffee roaster filled the room with a rich smell. 烘豆機讓整個房間充滿濃郁香氣。
She bought a new roaster for the holiday meal. 她為節日大餐買了一個新的烤盤。
The roasting took nearly an hour. 這次烘烤幾乎花了一個小時。
We sat in the roasting sun all afternoon. 我們整個下午都坐在炙熱的陽光下。
The pavement shimmered roastingly in the heat. 路面在酷熱中看起來熱得發亮。
He opened the door roastingly and stepped back. 他帶著灼熱感把門打開，又退了回去。
Two armed men managed to rob the local bank yesterday morning. 兩名持械男子昨天早上竟然搶劫了當地銀行。
The tragic accident managed to rob him of his promising future. 那場悲慘意外竟然奪走了他大有可為的未來。
Rob arrived before sunrise. 羅布在日出前就到了。
Everyone called him Rob instead of Robert. 大家都叫他羅布，而不是羅伯特。
The fisherman caught a small robalito near the pier. 漁夫在碼頭附近釣到一條小羅巴洛魚。
The guidebook listed robalito among local fish. 那本指南把小羅巴洛魚列為當地魚種之一。
The robalo was grilled with herbs and lime. 那條羅巴洛魚加了香草和萊姆一起烤。
He saw a robalo leap in the clear water. 他看見一條羅巴洛魚在清澈水中躍起。

meaning: 帆索繫帶；固定帆的繩帶
sentences: The sailor checked each roband before sailing. 水手在出航前逐一檢查每條帆索繫帶。
A broken roband made the sail flap wildly. 一條斷掉的帆索繫帶讓帆劇烈拍打。
The bank robber was caught by the police just a few blocks away. 那名銀行強盜在僅僅幾個街區外就被警察抓獲了。
Armed robbers broke into the jewelry store and stole thousands of dollars' worth of diamonds. 武裝強盜闖入珠寶店，偷走了價值數千美元的鑽石。
The vault was designed to be robberproof. 那座保險庫被設計成防盜的。
They wanted a robberproof lock for the door. 他們想替門裝上一把防盜鎖。
The police are investigating a bank robbery that happened recently. 警方正調查一起最近發生的銀行搶劫案。
Armed robbery is considered a very serious and dangerous crime. 持械搶劫被認為是一項非常嚴重且危險的罪行。
Robbin signed the guest book at the hotel. 羅賓在飯店簽了名冊。
Her cousin Robbin lives in the next town. 她的堂兄羅賓住在隔壁城鎮。
The form listed robbin as the family name. 表格上把羅賓寫成了姓氏。
He wrote robbin in lowercase on the envelope. 他在信封上用小寫寫了羅賓。
Robbing the shop was a serious crime. 搶劫那家商店是很嚴重的罪行。
He was caught robbing a parked car. 他在偷竊停著的車時被抓到。
She put on her soft silk robe after taking a warm bath. 洗完熱水澡後，她穿上了柔軟的絲綢長袍。
The wise monk was wearing a traditional long orange robe. 那位英明的僧侶穿著傳統的橘色長袍。

meaning: 沒有長袍的；不穿袍服的
sentences: The statue stood robeless in the garden. 那座雕像在花園裡沒有披上長袍。
He appeared robeless at the ceremony, which surprised everyone. 他在典禮上沒穿袍服現身，讓大家都很驚訝。
The museum displayed a Robenhausian bowl by the entrance. 博物館入口旁展示了一只羅本豪森文化的碗。
Her paper compared Robenhausian tools with later finds. 她的論文把羅本豪森文化工具和後期出土物作了比較。
The old tale speaks of a rober on the road. 那個古老故事提到路上的一名竊賊。
He played the role of a rober in the drama. 他在戲劇裡扮演一名搶匪。
The villagers feared the roberd in the hills. 村民害怕山裡的那名搶劫者。
A roberd broke into the house at midnight. 一名竊賊在午夜闖入屋內。
The poem mentions a Roberdsman roaming the woods. 那首詩提到一名在森林裡遊蕩的盜賊。
The old chronicle described him as a Roberdsman. 舊編年史把他形容成一個搶匪。
Robert called his sister after work. 羅伯特下班後打電話給妹妹。
The package was addressed to Robert Chen. 包裹收件人是羅伯特陳。
Robert kept the receipts in a neat folder. 羅伯特把收據整齊地放進資料夾裡。
They invited Robert to the family dinner. 他們邀請羅伯特來參加家庭晚餐。
Roberta brought soup when I had the flu. 我得流感時，蘿伯塔帶了湯來。
The note on the fridge was from Roberta. 冰箱上的便條是蘿伯塔留的。
Roberto fixed the broken chair. 羅伯托修好了壞掉的椅子。
We met Roberto at the station. 我們在車站遇見羅伯托。

meaning: 羅比加利亞節；古羅馬節日
sentences: The history class discussed Robigalia and its rituals. 歷史課討論了羅比加利亞節及其儀式。
Robigalia was linked to the protection of crops. 羅比加利亞節與保護作物有關。

meaning: 羅比古斯；古羅馬的農作物守護神
sentences: Robigus was honored to guard the grain. 人們祭祀羅比古斯以守護穀物。
The essay described Robigus as a Roman deity. 那篇文章把羅比古斯描述成羅馬神祇。
A Robin sang from the branch at dawn. 一隻知更鳥在黎明時停在樹枝上鳴唱。
Robin left a note on the kitchen table. 羅賓在廚房桌上留了一張便條。
A robin hopped across the lawn. 一隻知更鳥跳過草坪。
She spotted a robin near the window. 她在窗邊看見一隻知更鳥。
He turned the robinet to stop the water. 他把小水龍頭轉了一下，讓水停住。
The old robinet dripped all night. 那個老舊的小閥門整晚都在滴水。
The robing took place before the ceremony. 典禮前先進行了穿袍的儀式。
She watched the robing from the side of the hall. 她在大廳一側看著大家披上長袍。
The garden featured a tall Robinia tree. 那座花園裡有一棵高大的刺槐屬樹木。
Botanists studied Robinia as a hardwood genus. 植物學家把刺槐屬當作一類硬木樹木來研究。

meaning: 刺槐苷；一種植物化合物
sentences: Scientists isolated robinin from Robinia flowers. 科學家從刺槐花中分離出刺槐苷。
The report listed robinin as a natural compound. 報告把刺槐苷列為一種天然化合物。

meaning: 刺槐苷配糖體；植物化合物
sentences: The paper analyzed robinoside in leaf extracts. 那篇論文分析了葉片萃取物中的刺槐苷配糖體。
Robinoside was mentioned in the chemistry notes. 化學筆記裡提到了刺槐苷配糖體。

meaning: 羅布萊木；一種南美樹木
sentences: The carpenter used roble for the table top. 木匠用羅布萊木做桌面。
Roble grows in parts of South America. 羅布萊木生長在南美部分地區。
The story mentioned a robomb hidden underground. 故事裡提到地底埋著一個炸彈裝置。
The engineer defused the robomb before noon. 工程師在中午前拆除了那個爆炸裝置。
The old doctor recommended a roborant tonic after the fever. 那位老醫師在退燒後建議喝一種補益的滋養劑。
A roborant meal helped him recover after the hike. 一頓滋補的餐點幫他在健行後恢復體力。
They roborate the frame with extra beams. 他們用額外橫樑把框架加固。
The evidence helped roborate the claim. 這些證據有助於加強那項主張。
The roboration of the wall took two days. 牆體的加固花了兩天。
The witness gave roboration to the story. 那位證人為這個故事提供了佐證。
Warm porridge can be surprisingly roborative on cold days. 在冷天裡，一碗熱粥意外地很能補身。
The nurse prepared a roborative drink for the patient. 護理師替病人準備了一杯補益飲品。
The roborean panels looked dark and sturdy. 那些像橡木的板材看起來又深色又堅固。
She admired the roborean finish on the cabinet. 她很欣賞那個櫃子上橡木般的表面處理。
The roboreous beam supported the roof. 那根木質橫梁支撐著屋頂。
He described the furniture as roboreous in texture. 他把那組家具形容成有木質紋理。
Modern factories use robots to perform repetitive and dangerous tasks. 現代工廠使用機器人來執行重複且危險的任務。
The robot vacuum cleaner helps me keep my house clean. 掃地機器人幫我保持家裡整潔。

meaning: 像機器人的；呆板機械的
sentences: His movements were robotesque and stiff. 他的動作像機器人一樣僵硬呆板。
The actor gave the character a robotesque voice. 那位演員讓角色的聲音帶有機器人感。

meaning: 機器人式的；像機器人的
sentences: The robotian routine left no room for surprise. 那種機器人式的例行程序沒有任何驚喜空間。
She noticed a robotian rhythm in his work. 她注意到他的工作節奏很像機器人。

meaning: 機械化傾向；機器人式行為
sentences: The novel warns against robotism in daily life. 那本小說警告人們日常生活中的機械化傾向。
His robotism made the conversation feel cold. 他的機器人式反應讓談話顯得很冷淡。
The robotistic response sounded too formal. 那種機械式回應聽起來過於正式。
She disliked the robotistic tone of the report. 她不喜歡那份報告的機器人式語氣。
The factory went through rapid robotization. 那座工廠經歷了快速的機器人化。
Robotization changed the way the line worked. 自動化改變了生產線的運作方式。
They plan to robotize the packing process. 他們打算把包裝流程自動化。
The company will robotize several routine tasks. 這家公司會讓幾項例行工作自動化。

meaning: 像機器人的；機械呆板的
sentences: Her robotlike answers gave nothing away. 她那種像機器人的回答沒有透露任何訊息。
The guard moved with robotlike precision. 那名警衛以機械般的精準度移動。

meaning: 機器人系統；機械化行為
sentences: The author used robotry to describe the factory. 作者用機器人系統來描述那座工廠。
People feared that robotry would replace human judgment. 人們擔心機械化系統會取代人的判斷。
The Latin word robur can mean oak. 拉丁語羅布爾可以表示橡樹。
Writers once used robur to suggest strength. 作家過去常用羅布爾來表示力量。

meaning: 羅布炸藥；礦用無煙炸藥
sentences: The mine once stored roburite in a locked shed. 那座礦場以前把羅布炸藥存放在上鎖的小屋裡。
Workers handled roburite with extreme care. 工人們處理那種礦用無煙炸藥時非常小心。
He has a very robust build and is well-suited for difficult physical labor. 他體格非常強健，非常適合繁重的體力勞動。
The new software is designed to be robust and reliable for all users. 這款新軟體設計得非常結實（堅固）且可靠。
The child looked robustful after a week of rest. 休息一週後，那孩子看起來很有活力。
A robustful plant can handle colder weather. 健壯的植物可以承受較冷的天氣。
He walked robustfully up the hill. 他精神飽滿地走上山坡。
The seedlings grew robustfully in the warm light. 幼苗在溫暖的光線下長得很有活力。
The doctor noted the boy's robustfulness. 醫生注意到那男孩的身體很有活力。
Her robustfulness helped her recover quickly. 她充沛的活力讓她很快恢復。
The robustic frame held the heavy load. 那個結實的框架撐住了重物。
A robustic style of design feels plain but strong. 結實的設計風格看起來簡單，卻很堅固。
The horse's robusticity made it good for hard work. 那匹馬的結實體格讓牠很適合做重活。

Please wipe your muddy shoes on the small rug by the door. 進入前請在門邊的小地毯上擦掉鞋上的泥。

meaning: 英格蘭沃里克郡的城鎮，也是橄欖球名稱的來源

His ruggy hair needed a comb. 他那頭蓬亂的頭髮需要梳一下。
A ruggy path led up the hill. 一條粗糙不平的小路通往山上。

meaning: 頭髮蓬亂的；頂部粗亂的
sentences: The rugheaded boy forgot his cap again. 那個頭髮蓬亂的男孩又忘了帽子。

sentences: The chronicle referred to the region as Rum. 那部編年史把那片地區稱作魯姆。

A cotton rumal covered the lunch basket. 一條棉方巾蓋在午餐籃上。

The cart rolled rumblingly over loose stones. 推車轟轟地滾過鬆散石子。

rumbustical kids filled the yard after lunch. 午餐後，一群鬧哄哄的孩子擠滿院子。
The pub turned rumbustical once the game began. 比賽一開始，那間酒吧就熱鬧起來。
rumbustious crowd kept singing outside the gate. 那群吵鬧的人一直在大門外唱歌。
My nephews get rumbustious after too much soda. 我那幾個外甥汽水喝太多就會鬧翻天。
rumbustiousness in the room faded after midnight. 房裡那股鬧騰勁到了半夜就退了。
The teacher tolerated some rumbustiousness on sports day. 老師在運動會那天容許大家稍微鬧一點。

Too much cheap beer made Dan rumchunder in the alley. 便宜啤酒喝太多，丹就在巷子裡吐了。
A Rumelian sold figs near the harbor gate. 一位魯米利亞人在港口門邊賣無花果。
The history note mentions one Rumelian family in the town. 那份歷史筆記提到鎮上有一戶魯米利亞人家。
The vet explained that the cow's rumen was swollen. 獸醫解釋那頭牛的瘤胃脹起來了。
Feed changes can upset a goat's rumen very quickly. 飼料一變，山羊的瘤胃很快就會出問題。
rumenitis made the calf stop eating by evening. 瘤胃炎讓那頭小牛到傍晚就不肯吃了。
The farmer called the vet when rumenitis was suspected. 農夫一懷疑是瘤胃炎就打電話找獸醫。
rumenocentesis helped the vet sample fluid from the cow. 瘤胃穿刺讓獸醫能從牛的瘤胃取液檢查。
The clinic performed a rumenocentesis before changing treatment. 那間診所在更改治療前先做了瘤胃穿刺。
rumenotomy removed the trapped plastic from the cow. 瘤胃切開術把卡在牛胃裡的塑膠取了出來。
The surgeon scheduled a rumenotomy for early morning. 外科獸醫把瘤胃切開術排在清晨進行。
Rumex grew thickly along the wet ditch. 酸模屬植物沿著潮濕水溝長得很密。
